entry.summary: Argues that single-vector steering methods for LLMs will likely stop working as models become more capable, drawing an analogy to human intrusive thoughts and OCD. Suggests this is important for steering as a mitigation against eval-awareness.

entry.title: GRADE: Probing Knowledge Gaps in LLMs through Gradient Subspace Dynamics

author.name: Yujing Wang, Yuanbang Liang, Yukun Lai, Hainan Zhang, Hanqi Yan

entry.summary: Proposes GRADE, a method for detecting knowledge gaps in LLMs by analyzing cross-layer rank ratios of gradients relative to hidden state subspaces, arguing that activated knowledge may not align with query requirements.

entry.title: Dependency-Guided Parallel Decoding in Discrete Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Liran Ringel, Ameen Ali, Yaniv Romano

entry.summary: DEMASK proposes a dependency-guided approach for parallel token unmasking in discrete diffusion language models, using a lightweight predictor to estimate pairwise dependencies and select independent positions for simultaneous decoding.

entry.title: Learning Structured Robot Policies from Vision-Language Models via Synthetic Neuro-Symbolic Supervision

author.name: Alessandro Adami, Tommaso Tubaldo, Marco Todescato, Ruggero Carli, Pietro Falco

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic approach where VLMs synthesize executable Behavior Tree policies from visual observations and natural language instructions for robot control, bridging high-dimensional learning with symbolic control.

entry.title: Measuring What Cannot Be Surveyed: LLMs as Instruments for Latent Cognitive Variables in Labor Economics

author.name: Cristian Espinal Maya

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical foundations for using LLMs as measurement instruments for latent economic variables in labor economics. Formalizes four validity conditions and constructs an Augmented Human Capital Index from 18,796 task statements scored by Claude Haiku 4.5, showing strong convergent validity with existing AI exposure indices.

entry.title: Generating Counterfactual Patient Timelines from Real-World Data

author.name: Yu Akagi, Tomohisa Seki, Toru Takiguchi, Hiromasa Ito, Yoshimasa Kawazoe, Kazuhiko Ohe

entry.summary: Demonstrates that an autoregressive generative model trained on 300K+ patients and 400M timeline entries can generate clinically plausible counterfactual patient trajectories, validated on COVID-19 hospitalization scenarios.

entry.title: LLM Reasoning with Process Rewards for Outcome-Guided Steps

author.name: Mohammad Rezaei, Jens Lehmann, Sahar Vahdati

entry.summary: Proposes using process reward models as relative ranking signals rather than absolute rewards for LLM reasoning, addressing the problem of reward hacking when PRM scores are imperfectly aligned with correctness.

entry.title: Using LLM-as-a-Judge/Jury to Advance Scalable, Clinically-Validated Safety Evaluations of Model Responses to Users Demonstrating Psychosis

author.name: May Lynn Reese, Markela Zeneli, Mindy Ng, Jacob Haimes, Andreea Damien, Elizabeth Stade

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM-as-a-Judge for safety assessment of LLM responses to users with psychosis symptoms. Develops clinician-informed safety criteria and benchmarks automated evaluation against human consensus.

entry.title: Xpertbench: Expert Level Tasks with Rubrics-Based Evaluation

author.name: Xue Liu, Xin Ma, Yuxin Ma, Yongchang Peng, Duo Wang, Zhoufutu Wen, Ge Zhang, Kaiyuan Zhang, Xinyu Chen, Tianci He, Jiani Hou, Liang Hu, Ziyun Huang, Yongzhe Hui, Jianpeng Jiao, Chennan Ju, Yingru Kong, Yiran Li, Mengyun Liu, Luyao Ma, Fei Ni, Yiqing Ni, Yueyan Qiu, Yanle Ren, Zilin Shi, Zaiyuan Wang, Wenjie Yue, Shiyu Zhang, Xinyi Zhang, Kaiwen Zhao, Zhenwei Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces XpertBench, a benchmark of 1,346 expert-level tasks across 80 categories derived from 1,000+ domain expert submissions, designed to evaluate LLMs on complex professional tasks with rubric-based evaluation.

entry.title: Opal: Private Memory for Personal AI

author.name: Darya Kaviani and Alp Eren Ozdarendeli and Jinhao Zhu and Yu Ding and Raluca Ada Popa

entry.summary: Opal is a private memory system for personal AI that decouples data-dependent reasoning in trusted enclaves from bulk data on untrusted storage, hiding retrieval access patterns that would leak private information.

entry.title: AdaHOP: Fast and Accurate Low-Precision Training via Outlier-Pattern-Aware Rotation

author.name: Seonggon Kim, Alireza Khodamoradi, Kristof Denolf, Eunhyeok Park

entry.summary: AdaHOP improves low-precision LLM training by systematically studying outlier patterns across weights, activations, and gradients, then applying adaptive Hadamard-based rotation tailored to each tensor's outlier structure.

entry.title: Computing with Living Neurons: Chaos-Controlled Reservoir Computing with Knowledge Transplant

author.name: Seung Hyun Kim, Zhi Dou, Gaurav Upadhyay, Anay Pattanaik, Leo Maslov, Lav Varshney, John Beggs, Howard Gritton, and Mattia Gazzola

entry.summary: Introduces chaos-controlled Reservoir Computing for living neural cultures, using optical chaos control to stabilize biological activity and enable robust pattern classification. Proposes Knowledge Transplant for transferring learned representations between cultures.

entry.title: Robust Learning with Optimal Error

author.name: Guy Blanc

entry.summary: Constructs algorithms with optimal error rates for learning with adversarial noise, showing randomized hypotheses can halve error rates compared to deterministic ones. Answers an open question from Cesa-Bianchi et al. (1999).

entry.title: Overcoming the "Impracticality" of RAG: Proposing a Real-World Benchmark and Multi-Dimensional Diagnostic Framework

author.name: Kenichirou Narita, Siqi Peng, Taku Fukui, Moyuru Yamada, Satoshi Munakata, Satoru Takahashi

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-dimensional diagnostic framework for enterprise RAG evaluation with a four-axis difficulty taxonomy covering reasoning complexity, retrieval difficulty, document structure, and explainability requirements. Addresses the gap where models with high benchmark scores fail in practice.

entry.title: Let's Have a Conversation: Designing and Evaluating LLM Agents for Interactive Optimization

author.name: Joshua Drossman, Alexandre Jacquillat, S\'ebastien Martin

entry.summary: Proposes a methodology for evaluating LLM-based optimization agents through simulated conversations with LLM-powered decision agents that role-play diverse stakeholders. Generates thousands of conversations to assess interactive optimization capabilities.

entry.title: MOMO: Mars Orbital Model Foundation Model for Mars Orbital Applications

author.name: Mirali Purohit, Bimal Gajera, Irish Mehta, Bhanu Tokas, Jacob Adler, Steven Lu, Scott Dickenshied, Serina Diniega, Brian Bue, Umaa Rebbapragada, Hannah Kerner

entry.summary: Introduces MOMO, the first multi-sensor foundation model for Mars remote sensing, integrating representations from three Martian sensors (HiRISE, CTX, THEMIS) via model merging. Uses novel Equal Validation Loss strategy for checkpoint alignment before fusion.

entry.title: DeltaLogic: Minimal Premise Edits Reveal Belief-Revision Failures in Logical Reasoning Models

author.name: Amit Dhanda

entry.summary: Introduces DeltaLogic, a benchmark protocol that tests LLMs' belief revision capabilities by making minimal premise edits and checking whether models can correctly revise or maintain conclusions. Shows stronger initial reasoning doesn't guarantee better belief revision.

entry.title: Aligning Progress and Feasibility: A Neuro-Symbolic Dual Memory Framework for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

author.name: Bin Wen, Ruoxuan Zhang, Yang Chen, Hongxia Xie, Lan-Zhe Guo

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic dual memory framework for long-horizon LLM agents that separates global progress tracking (fuzzy semantic planning) from local feasibility validation (strict logical constraints), addressing progress drift and feasibility violations.

entry.title: DeCo-DETR: Decoupled Cognition DETR for efficient Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

author.name: Siheng Wang, Yanshu Li, Bohan Hu, Zhengdao Li, Haibo Zhan, Linshan Li, Weiming Liu, Ruizhi Qian, Guangxin Wu, Hao Zhang, Jifeng Shen, Piotr Koniusz, Zhengtao Yao, Junhao Dong, Qiang Sun

entry.summary: Proposes DeCo-DETR, a vision-centric open-vocabulary object detection framework that constructs hierarchical semantic prototypes from LVLM-generated descriptions and eliminates the need for text encoders at inference. Decouples closed-set and open-vocabulary training objectives.

entry.title: QuadAgent: A Responsive Agent System for Vision-Language Guided Quadrotor Agile Flight

author.name: Ao Zhuang, Feng Yu, Tianbao Zhang, Linzuo Zhang, Danping Zou

entry.summary: Presents QuadAgent, a training-free agent system for agile quadrotor flight using vision-language inputs with an asynchronous multi-agent architecture. Uses an Impression Graph for scene memory and demonstrates real-world complex instruction following.

entry.title: CharTool: Tool-Integrated Visual Reasoning for Chart Understanding

author.name: Situo Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Zichen Zhu, Da Ma, Lei Pan, Danyang Zhang, Zihan Zhao, Lu Chen, Kai Yu

entry.summary: Introduces CharTool, equipping MLLMs with external tools (image cropping, code computation) for chart understanding, trained via agentic reinforcement learning on a new dual-source data pipeline called DuoChart.

entry.title: UNICA: A Unified Neural Framework for Controllable 3D Avatars

author.name: Jiahe Zhu, Xinyao Wang, Yiyu Zhuang, Yanwen Wang, Jing Tian, Yao Yao, Hao Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces UNICA, a skeleton-free generative model for controllable 3D avatars that unifies appearance, motion, rigging, and simulation into a single neural framework using action-conditioned diffusion on 2D position maps and 3D Gaussian Splatting.

entry.title: Goal-Conditioned Neural ODEs with Guaranteed Safety and Stability for Learning-Based All-Pairs Motion Planning

author.name: Dechuan Liu, Ruigang Wang, Ian R. Manchester

entry.summary: Presents goal-conditioned neural ODEs via bi-Lipschitz diffeomorphisms for all-pairs motion planning with guaranteed global exponential stability and safety, with explicit bounds on convergence and tracking error.

entry.title: NavCrafter: Exploring 3D Scenes from a Single Image

author.name: Hongbo Duan, Peiyu Zhuang, Yi Liu, Zhengyang Zhang, Yuxin Zhang, Pengting Luo, Fangming Liu, Xueqian Wang

entry.summary: Introduces NavCrafter, a framework for exploring 3D scenes from a single image by synthesizing novel-view videos with camera controllability using video diffusion models and 3D Gaussian Splatting.

entry.title: Open-Loop Planning, Closed-Loop Verification: Speculative Verification for VLA

author.name: Zihua Wang, Zhitao Lin, Ruibo Li, Yu Zhang, Xu Yang, Siya Mi, Xiu-Shen Wei

entry.summary: Proposes SV-VLA, a framework combining open-loop action chunking with lightweight closed-loop verification for Vision-Language-Action models. Uses a heavy VLA as a macro-planner and a lightweight verifier for online checking, inspired by speculative decoding.

entry.title: Beyond Isolated Tasks: A Framework for Evaluating Coding Agents on Sequential Software Evolution

author.name: KN Ajay Shastry, Ganesh Senrayan, Shrey Satapara, Pranoy Panda, Chaitanya Devaguptapu

entry.summary: Introduces SWE-STEPS, a dataset for evaluating coding agents on sequential, dependent pull requests rather than isolated tasks. Tests conversational coding and PRD-based coding settings that mirror real developer workflows.

entry.title: Co-Evolution of Policy and Internal Reward for Language Agents

author.name: Xinyu Wang, Hanwei Wu, Jingwei Song, Shuyuan Zhang, Jiayi Zhang, Fanqi Kong, Tung Sum Thomas Kwok, Xiao-Wen Chang, Yuyu Luo, Chenglin Wu, Bang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Guide, a self-generated internal reward for LLM agents that serves dual purpose: inference-time action guidance and training-time step-level reward. Creates a co-evolving loop between policy and reward improvement.

entry.title: Self-Distilled RLVR

author.name: Chenxu Yang, Chuanyu Qin, Qingyi Si, Minghui Chen, Naibin Gu, Dingyu Yao, Zheng Lin, Weiping Wang, Jiaqi Wang, Nan Duan

entry.summary: Studies on-policy self-distillation for RLVR, finding that privileged teacher signals cause information leakage and unstable training. Identifies the optimal balance between distillation and RL signals.

entry.title: Gradient Boosting within a Single Attention Layer

author.name: Saleh Sargolzaei

entry.summary: Introduces gradient-boosted attention, which applies gradient boosting within a single attention layer by having a second attention pass attend to the prediction error of the first with a gated correction. Shows this maps onto Friedman's gradient boosting framework.

entry.title: BAS: A Decision-Theoretic Approach to Evaluating Large Language Model Confidence

author.name: Sean Wu, Fredrik K. Gustafsson, Edward Phillips, Boyan Gao, Anshul Thakur, David A. Clifton

entry.summary: Introduces the Behavioral Alignment Score (BAS), a decision-theoretic metric for evaluating LLM confidence in abstention-aware settings, derived from an answer-or-abstain utility model that aggregates performance across risk thresholds.

entry.title: Token Warping Helps MLLMs Look from Nearby Viewpoints

author.name: Phillip Y. Lee, Chanho Park, Mingue Park, Seungwoo Yoo, Juil Koo, Minhyuk Sung

entry.summary: Explores whether warping tokens (rather than pixels) helps MLLMs understand nearby viewpoint changes, finding that backward token warping achieves greater stability, drawing on theories of mental imagery.

entry.title: LiME: Lightweight Mixture of Experts for Efficient Multimodal Multi-task Learning

author.name: Md Kowsher, Haris Mansoor, Nusrat Jahan Prottasha, Ozlem Garibay, Victor Zhu, Zhengping Ji, Chen Chen

entry.summary: Proposes LiME, a lightweight Mixture of Experts approach that achieves expert specialization through modulation of a single shared PEFT module rather than adapter replication, with zero-parameter routing. Reduces expert parameters while generalizing to any PEFT method.

entry.title: Backdoor Attacks on Decentralised Post-Training

author.name: O\u{g}uzhan Ersoy, Nikolay Blagoev, Jona te Lintelo, Stefanos Koffas, Marina Kr\v{c}ek and Stjepan Picek

entry.summary: Presents the first backdoor attack on pipeline parallelism in decentralized LLM post-training, where an adversary controls an intermediate pipeline stage rather than the whole model or dataset.

entry.title: On the Geometric Structure of Layer Updates in Deep Language Models

author.name: Jun-Sik Yoo

entry.summary: Studies the geometric structure of layer-to-layer representation updates in deep language models, decomposing updates into dominant tokenwise components and structurally distinct residuals. Finds consistent patterns across Transformers and state-space models.

entry.title: Token-Efficient Multimodal Reasoning via Image Prompt Packaging

author.name: Joong Ho Choi, Jiayang Zhao, Avani Appalla, Himansh Mukesh, Dhwanil Vasani, Boyi Qian

entry.summary: Introduces Image Prompt Packaging (IPPg), embedding structured text directly into images to reduce token costs for multimodal LLMs, achieving 35-91% cost reduction across GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.

entry.title: Overconfidence and Calibration in Medical VQA: Empirical Findings and Hallucination-Aware Mitigation

author.name: Ji Young Byun, Young-Jin Park, Jean-Philippe Corbeil, Asma Ben Abacha

entry.summary: Studies overconfidence and calibration in medical VQA across three VLM families (Qwen3-VL, InternVL3, LLaVA-NeXT) at multiple scales, finding persistent overconfidence not resolved by scaling or chain-of-thought prompting.

entry.title: Mitigating LLM biases toward spurious social contexts using direct preference optimization

author.name: Hyunji Nam, Dorottya Demszky

entry.summary: Investigates LLM sensitivity to spurious social contexts (teacher demographics, experience, sycophancy) in educational evaluation using the NCTE classroom transcript dataset, then applies DPO to mitigate biases.

entry.title: Moondream Segmentation: From Words to Masks

author.name: Ethan Reid

entry.summary: Moondream Segmentation extends the Moondream 3 vision-language model with referring image segmentation, using autoregressive vector path decoding and a novel RL stage to optimize mask quality. They also release RefCOCO-M, a cleaned validation split with boundary-accurate masks. Achieves 80.2% cIoU on RefCOCO.

entry.title: Train Yourself as an LLM: Exploring Effects of AI Literacy on Persuasion via Role-playing LLM Training

author.name: Qihui Fan, Min Ge, Chenyan Jia, Weiyan Shi

entry.summary: Introduces LLMimic, a gamified AI literacy tutorial where participants role-play as an LLM going through pretraining, SFT, and RLHF stages. A between-subjects study (N=274) tests whether this interactive experience helps people resist AI persuasion.

entry.title: GBQA: A Game Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs as Quality Assurance Engineers

author.name: Shufan Jiang, Chios Chen, Zhiyang Chen

entry.summary: Introduces GBQA, a benchmark with 30 games and 124 human-verified bugs across three difficulty levels for evaluating whether LLMs can autonomously detect software bugs. Uses a multi-agent system for scalable game and bug generation.

entry.title: DocShield: Towards AI Document Safety via Evidence-Grounded Agentic Reasoning

author.name: Fanwei Zeng, Changtao Miao, Jing Huang, Zhiya Tan, Shutao Gong, Xiaoming Yu, Yang Wang, Weibin Yao, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Jianshu Li, Yin Yan

entry.summary: Proposes DocShield, the first unified framework for text-centric document forgery analysis combining detection, localization, and explanation via Cross-Cues-aware Chain of Thought reasoning that cross-validates visual anomalies with textual semantics.

entry.title: VBGS-SLAM: Variational Bayesian Gaussian Splatting Simultaneous Localization and Mapping

author.name: Yuhan Zhu, Yanyu Zhang, Jie Xu, Wei Ren

entry.summary: Proposes VBGS-SLAM, a variational Bayesian approach to Gaussian Splatting SLAM that couples map refinement and pose tracking in a generative probabilistic form with closed-form updates and explicit uncertainty maintenance.

entry.title: EnsemHalDet: Robust VLM Hallucination Detection via Ensemble of Internal State Detectors

author.name: Ryuhei Miyazato, Shunsuke Kitada, Kei Harada

entry.summary: Proposes EnsemHalDet, an ensemble-based hallucination detection framework for VLMs that combines multiple internal representations (attention outputs and hidden states) through ensemble methods for more robust detection.

entry.title: Towards Secure Agent Skills: Architecture, Threat Taxonomy, and Security Analysis

author.name: Zhiyuan Li, Jingzheng Wu, Xiang Ling, Xing Cui, Tianyue Luo

entry.summary: Presents the first comprehensive security analysis of the Agent Skills framework, defining the full lifecycle across four phases and constructing a threat taxonomy with seven categories and seventeen scenarios.

entry.title: High-resolution probabilistic estimation of three-dimensional regional ocean dynamics from sparse surface observations

author.name: Niloofar Asefi, Tianning Wu, Ruoying He, Ashesh Chattopadhyay

entry.summary: Presents a depth-aware generative framework using conditional DDPM for reconstructing 3D ocean states from extremely sparse (99.9%) surface observations, with continuous depth embeddings for vertical generalization.

entry.title: EMS: Multi-Agent Voting via Efficient Majority-then-Stopping

author.name: Yiqing Liu, Hantao Yao, Wu Liu, Yongdong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Efficient Majority-then-Stopping (EMS) for multi-agent voting that prioritizes agents by task-aware reliability and terminates once majority is achieved, significantly reducing computational overhead.

entry.title: One Model to Translate Them All? A Journey to Mount Doom for Multilingual Model Merging

author.name: Baban Gain, Asif Ekbal, Trilok Nath Singh

entry.summary: Systematically studies weight-space model merging for multilingual machine translation, finding that merging degrades performance especially when target languages differ, with analysis of language-specific neuron distributions.

entry.title: SentiAvatar: Towards Expressive and Interactive Digital Humans

author.name: Chuhao Jin, Rui Zhang, Qingzhe Gao, Haoyu Shi, Dayu Wu, Yichen Jiang, Yihan Wu, Ruihua Song

entry.summary: Presents SentiAvatar, a framework for expressive interactive 3D digital humans with synchronized speech, full-body motion, and facial expressions, including a new 37-hour motion capture dataset and Motion Foundation Model.

entry.title: Efficient Logistic Regression with Mixture of Sigmoids

author.name: Federico Di Gennaro, Saptarshi Chakraborty, Nikita Zhivotovskiy

entry.summary: Studies Exponential Weights algorithm for online logistic regression, showing near-optimal regret can be achieved with O(B³n⁵) complexity, substantially improving prior O(B¹⁸n³⁷) bounds.

entry.title: R2-Write: Reflection and Revision for Open-Ended Writing with Deep Reasoning

author.name: Wanlong Liu, Bo Zhang, Chenliang Li, Shaopeng Lai, Yuning Wu, Xuanyu Lei, Ming Yan

entry.summary: Introduces R2-Write, a framework for improving LLM writing through synthesized thinking trajectories with reflection and revision patterns. Shows that existing reasoning models achieve limited gains on open-ended writing compared to math tasks.

entry.title: Can VLMs Truly Forget? Benchmarking Training-Free Visual Concept Unlearning

author.name: Zhangyun Tan, Zeliang Zhang, Susan Liang, Yolo Yunlong Tang, Lisha Chen, Chenliang Xu

entry.summary: Introduces VLM-UnBench, the first benchmark for training-free visual concept unlearning in VLMs. Covers four forgetting levels, 7 datasets, and 11 concept axes to evaluate whether VLMs can truly forget via prompts/instructions.

entry.title: InCoder-32B-Thinking: Industrial Code World Model for Thinking

author.name: Jian Yang, Wei Zhang, Jiajun Wu, Junhang Cheng, Tuney Zheng, Fanglin Xu, Weicheng Gu, Lin Jing, Yaxin Du, Joseph Li, Yizhi Li, Yan Xing, Chuan Hao, Ran Tao, Ruihao Gong, Aishan Liu, Zhoujun Li, Mingjie Tang, Chenghua Lin, Siheng Chen, Wayne Xin Zhao, Xianglong Liu, Ming Zhou, Bryan Dai, Weifeng Lv

entry.summary: Introduces InCoder-32B-Thinking, a 32B parameter model trained with an Error-driven Chain-of-Thought synthesis framework and an Industrial Code World Model for reasoning about hardware-constrained code (Verilog, GPU, embedded systems). The model generates reasoning traces by learning causal dynamics from domain-specific execution traces and incorporates error-correction feedback loops.

entry.title: Research note on selective inoculation

author.name: ChristopherT

entry.summary: Studies selective inoculation prompting for improving LLM alignment, applying inoculation prompts only to examples exhibiting negative traits during training rather than globally. Tests automated detection of negative traits using LLM auditing and SAE features.

entry.title: Topological Effects in Neural Network Field Theory

author.name: Christian Ferko, James Halverson, Vishnu Jejjala, Brandon Robinson

entry.summary: Extends neural network field theory to topological settings, recovering the BKT transition and verifying T-duality of the bosonic string. Demonstrates neural network ensembles can capture topological quantum effects.

entry.title: SIEVE: Sample-Efficient Parametric Learning from Natural Language

author.name: Parth Asawa, Alexandros G. Dimakis, Matei Zaharia

entry.summary: Proposes SIEVE, a method for sample-efficient parametric learning from natural language context requiring as few as 3 examples. Uses decomposable context insight for synthetic data generation to enable weight updates from limited natural language instructions.

entry.title: From Broad Exploration to Stable Synthesis: Entropy-Guided Optimization for Autoregressive Image Generation

author.name: Han Song, Yucheng Zhou, Jianbing Shen, Yu Cheng

entry.summary: Presents entropy-based analysis of CoT+RL interaction in text-to-image generation, finding CoT expands exploration while RL contracts it, and proposes Entropy-Guided GRPO (EG-GRPO) for fine-tuning based on these insights.

entry.title: SEDGE: Structural Extrapolated Data Generation

author.name: Kun Zhang, Jiaqi Sun, Yiqing Li, Ignavier Ng, Namrata Deka, Shaoan Xie

entry.summary: SEDGE proposes a framework for generating data that extrapolates beyond training distribution using structural assumptions about the data generating process, with approximate identifiability guarantees and practical algorithms based on diffusion posterior sampling.

entry.title: Principled and Scalable Diversity-Aware Retrieval via Cardinality-Constrained Binary Quadratic Programming

author.name: Qiheng Lu, Nicholas D. Sidiropoulos

entry.summary: Formulates diversity-aware retrieval for RAG as cardinality-constrained binary quadratic programming with theoretical guarantees, using Frank-Wolfe optimization. Dominates baselines on relevance-diversity Pareto frontier.

entry.title: AutoVerifier: An Agentic Automated Verification Framework Using Large Language Models

author.name: Yuntao Du, Minh Dinh, Kaiyuan Zhang, Ninghui Li

entry.summary: Presents AutoVerifier, an LLM-based agentic framework for automated verification of technical claims. Decomposes assertions into structured claim triples, constructs knowledge graphs, and performs verification across six progressively enriching layers from corpus construction to final aggregation.

entry.title: SocioEval: A Template-Based Framework for Evaluating Socioeconomic Status Bias in Foundation Models

author.name: Divyanshu Kumar, Ishita Gupta, Nitin Aravind Birur, Tanay Baswa, Sahil Agarwal, Prashanth Harshangi

entry.summary: Introduces SocioEval, a template-based framework for evaluating socioeconomic status bias in LLMs through decision-making tasks. Evaluates 13 frontier LLMs across 8 themes and 18 topics, revealing substantial variation in socioeconomic bias.

entry.title: IndustryCode: A Benchmark for Industry Code Generation

author.name: Puyu Zeng, Zhaoxi Wang, Zhixu Duan, Liang Feng, Shaobo Wang, Cunxiang Wang, Jinghang Wang, Bing Zhao, Hu Wei, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces IndustryCode, the first comprehensive benchmark for code generation spanning multiple industrial domains and programming languages with 570+ problems, addressing the gap between academic code benchmarks and real industrial requirements.

entry.title: OMNI-PoseX: A Fast Vision Model for 6D Object Pose Estimation in Embodied Tasks

author.name: Michael Zhang, Wei Ying, Fangwen Chen, Shifeng Bai, Hanwen Kang

entry.summary: Presents OMNI-PoseX, a vision foundation model for 6D object pose estimation that unifies open-vocabulary perception with SO(3)-aware reflected flow matching, decoupling object understanding from geometry-consistent rotation inference.

entry.title: Vision-Based End-to-End Learning for UAV Traversal of Irregular Gaps via Differentiable Simulation

author.name: Linzuo Zhang, Yu Hu, Feng Yu, Yang Deng, Wenxian Yu, Danping Zou

entry.summary: Presents a vision-based end-to-end framework for UAV navigation through irregular gaps using differentiable simulation. Maps depth images directly to control commands in SE(3) space with a Stop-Gradient operator and bimodal initialization.

entry.title: LumaFlux: Lifting 8-Bit Worlds to HDR Reality with Physically-Guided Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Shreshth Saini, Hakan Gedik, Neil Birkbeck, Yilin Wang, Balu Adsumilli, Alan C. Bovik

entry.summary: Introduces LumaFlux, a physically and perceptually guided diffusion transformer for SDR-to-HDR image reconstruction. Adapts a pretrained DiT with physically-guided adaptation modules injecting luminance and frequency cues.

entry.title: HiDiGen: Hierarchical Diffusion for B-Rep Generation with Explicit Topological Constraints

author.name: Shurui Liu, Weide Chen, Ancong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes HiDiGen, a hierarchical generation framework for B-rep (boundary representation) CAD models that decouples topology and geometry modeling into two stages with transformer-based diffusion refinement.

entry.title: Few-Shot Distribution-Aligned Flow Matching for Data Synthesis in Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Jie Yang, Ziqi Ye, Aihua Ke, Jian Luo, Bo Cai, Xiaosong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes AlignFlow, a flow matching model for medical image synthesis that aligns with target distributions via differentiable reward fine-tuning, effective even with few reference images for data augmentation.

entry.title: Progressive Video Condensation with MLLM Agent for Long-form Video Understanding

author.name: Yufei Yin, Yuchen Xing, Qianke Meng, Minghao Chen, Yan Yang, Zhou Yu

entry.summary: Proposes ProVCA, a progressive video condensation agent using MLLMs that iteratively locates key frames at multiple granularities through segment localization, snippet selection, and keyframe refinement.

entry.title: RayMamba: Ray-Aligned Serialization for Long-Range 3D Object Detection

author.name: Cheng Lu, Mingqian Ji, Shanshan Zhang, Zhihao Li and Jian Yang

entry.summary: Proposes RayMamba, a geometry-aware plug-and-play enhancement for voxel-based 3D detectors that organizes sparse voxels into ray-aligned sequences for better long-range context modeling in LiDAR detection.

entry.title: PolyReal: A Benchmark for Real-World Polymer Science Workflows

author.name: Wanhao Liu, Weida Wang, Jiaqing Xie, Suorong Yang, Jue Wang, Benteng Chen, Guangtao Mei, Zonglin Yang, Shufei Zhang, Yuchun Mo, Lang Cheng, Jin Zeng, Houqiang Li, Wanli Ouyang, and Yuqiang Li

entry.summary: Introduces PolyReal, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on the full lifecycle of polymer science experimentation, covering five capabilities from foundational knowledge to equipment analysis.

entry.title: SkillRT: Compiling Skills for Efficient Execution Everywhere

author.name: Le Chen, Erhu Feng, Yubin Xia, Haibo Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SkillRT, a compilation and runtime system treating LLM agent skills as code and LLMs as heterogeneous processors. Analyzes 118K skills and provides portable, efficient skill execution across different agent platforms.

entry.title: A Systematic Security Evaluation of OpenClaw and Its Variants

author.name: Yuhang Wang, Haichang Gao, Zhenxing Niu, Zhaoxiang Liu, Wenjing Zhang, Xiang Wang, and Shiguo Lian

entry.summary: Presents a systematic security assessment of six OpenClaw-series agent frameworks under multiple backbone models, with 205 test cases covering the full agent execution lifecycle.

entry.title: Beyond Precision: Importance-Aware Recall for Factuality Evaluation in Long-Form LLM Generation

author.name: Nazanin Jafari, James Allan, Mohit Iyyer

entry.summary: Proposes a factuality evaluation framework for LLMs that jointly measures precision and recall, introducing importance-aware recall to assess whether generated responses cover the relevant facts that should be included.

entry.title: Eligibility-Aware Evidence Synthesis: An Agentic Framework for Clinical Trial Meta-Analysis

author.name: Yao Zhao and Zhiyue Zhang and Yanxun Xu

entry.summary: Introduces EligMeta, an agentic framework combining LLM-based automated trial discovery with eligibility-aware meta-analysis for clinical evidence synthesis. Incorporates eligibility alignment into study weighting for cohort-specific pooled estimates.

entry.title: Not All Denoising Steps Are Equal: Model Scheduling for Faster Masked Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Ivan Sedykh, Nikita Sorokin, Valentin Malykh

entry.summary: Studies model scheduling for masked diffusion language models where smaller models replace the full model at specific denoising steps, achieving up to 17% FLOPs reduction. Shows early and late steps are most robust to model substitution.

entry.title: DrugPlayGround: Benchmarking Large Language Models and Embeddings for Drug Discovery

author.name: Tianyu Liu, Sihan Jiang, Fan Zhang, Kunyang Sun, Teresa Head-Gordon, Hongyu Zhao

entry.summary: Presents DrugPlayGround, a benchmark framework for evaluating LLMs and embeddings in drug discovery across physiochemical properties, drug synergism, drug-protein interactions, and perturbation responses.

entry.title: Compositional Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning

author.name: Anugyan Das, Omkar Ghugarkar, Vishvesh Bhat, Asad Aali

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic architecture for the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) that combines neural object extraction with symbolic DSL-based transformation proposals and cross-example consistency filtering. Tests on ARC-AGI-2.

entry.title: Causal-Audit: A Framework for Risk Assessment of Assumption Violations in Time-Series Causal Discovery

author.name: Marco Ruiz, Miguel Arana-Catania, David R. Ardila, Rodrigo Ventura

entry.summary: Introduces Causal-Audit, a framework for validating assumptions in time-series causal discovery, computing calibrated risk scores across five assumption families and recommending methods only when evidence supports reliable inference.

entry.title: Jump Start or False Start? A Theoretical and Empirical Evaluation of LLM-initialized Bandits

author.name: Adam Bayley, Xiaodan Zhu, Raquel Aoki, Yanshuai Cao, Kevin H. Wilson

entry.summary: Systematically examines LLM-initialized contextual bandits, finding warm-starting is effective up to 30% noise corruption but degrades beyond 50%, and systematic preference misalignment can worsen performance even without noise.

entry.title: Fast NF4 Dequantization Kernels for Large Language Model Inference

author.name: Xiangbo Qi, Chaoyi Jiang, Murali Annavaram

entry.summary: Presents optimized NF4 dequantization kernels for LLM inference on NVIDIA GPUs, achieving 2.0-2.2x kernel speedup over BitsAndBytes across Gemma 27B, Qwen3 32B, and Llama3.3 70B through shared memory optimization.

entry.title: Why Invariance is Not Enough for Biomedical Domain Generalization and How to Fix It

author.name: Sebo Diaz, Polina Golland, Elfar Adalsteinsson, Neel Dey

entry.summary: DropGen proposes a simple, theoretically-grounded approach for domain generalization in 3D biomedical image segmentation by combining source-domain images with domain-stable foundation model representations, achieving strong gains with minimal overhead.

entry.title: An Empirical Study of Many-Shot In-Context Learning for Machine Translation of Low-Resource Languages

author.name: Yinhan Lu, Gaganpreet Jhajj, Chen Zhang, Anietie Andy, David Ifeoluwa Adelani

entry.summary: Empirical study of many-shot in-context learning for machine translation into 10 truly low-resource languages recently added to FLORES+. Investigates example selection strategies, out-of-domain data, and length ordering for long-context LLMs. Finds many-shot ICL becomes more effective with better retrieval but has cost implications for low-resource communities.

entry.title: Smart Transfer: Leveraging Vision Foundation Model for Rapid Building Damage Mapping with Post-Earthquake VHR Imagery

author.name: Hao Li, Liwei Zou, Wenping Yin, Gulsen Taskin, Naoto Yokoya, Danfeng Hong and Wufan Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Smart Transfer, a GeoAI framework leveraging vision foundation models for rapid building damage mapping from post-earthquake VHR imagery, targeting the critical 'Golden 72 Hours' rescue window. Designed to generalize across different urban morphologies.

entry.title: V2X-QA: A Comprehensive Reasoning Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models in Autonomous Driving Across Ego, Infrastructure, and Cooperative Views

author.name: Junwei You, Pei Li, Zhuoyu Jiang, Weizhe Tang, Zilin Huang, Rui Gan, Jiaxi Liu, Yan Zhao, Sikai Chen, Bin Ran

entry.summary: Introduces V2X-QA, a benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs across vehicle-side, infrastructure-side, and cooperative viewpoints in autonomous driving, with a twelve-task taxonomy spanning perception, prediction, and planning.

entry.title: Breakdowns in Conversational AI: Interactional Failures in Emotionally and Ethically Sensitive Contexts

author.name: Jiawen Deng, Wentao Zhang, Ziyun Jiao, Fuji Ren

entry.summary: Explores breakdowns in conversational AI during emotionally and ethically sensitive interactions. Develops a persona-conditioned user simulator and identifies common failure patterns including emotional trajectory escalation.

entry.title: Generative Frontiers: Why Evaluation Matters for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Patrick Pynadath, Jiaxin Shi, Ruqi Zhang

entry.summary: Technical note discussing evaluation methodology issues for diffusion language models, including limitations of likelihood evaluations and why OpenWebText became the standard benchmark. Proposes principled evaluation augmentations.

entry.title: THOM: Generating Physically Plausible Hand-Object Meshes From Text

author.name: Uyoung Jeong, Yihalem Yimolal Tiruneh, Hyung Jin Chang, Seungryul Baek, Kwang In Kim

entry.summary: Introduces THOM, a training-free framework for generating physically plausible 3D hand-object interaction meshes from text, using a two-stage pipeline with novel mesh extraction from Gaussians and physics-based optimization.

entry.title: Visual Instruction-Finetuned Language Model for Versatile Brain MR Image Tasks

author.name: Jonghun Kim, Sinyoung Ra, Hyunjin Park

entry.summary: Proposes LLaBIT, extending visual LLMs for brain MR image tasks including segmentation and image translation (reconstructing missing sequences), integrating clinically relevant tasks within a single versatile language model.

entry.title: Towards Realistic Class-Incremental Learning with Free-Flow Increments

author.name: Zhiming Xu, Baile Xu, Jian Zhao, Furao Shen, and Suorong Yang

entry.summary: Formalizes Free-Flow Class-Incremental Learning (FFCIL) where new classes arrive in variable quantities, and proposes a model-agnostic framework with class-wise mean objective and virtual replay that maintains robustness under free-flow arrivals.

entry.title: SentinelAgent: Intent-Verified Delegation Chains for Securing Federal Multi-Agent AI Systems

author.name: KrishnaSaiReddy Patil

entry.summary: Proposes SentinelAgent, a formal framework for verifiable delegation chains in multi-agent AI systems, including a Delegation Chain Calculus with seven properties and a runtime protocol. Addresses the authorization and policy compliance problem when agents delegate tasks to other agents.

entry.title: ChatSVA: Bridging SVA Generation for Hardware Verification via Task-Specific LLMs

author.name: Lik Tung Fu, Jie Zhou, Shaokai Ren, Mengli Zhang, Jia Xiong, Hugo Jiang, Nan Guan, Xi Wang, Jun Yang

entry.summary: Introduces ChatSVA, an LLM-based multi-agent system for generating SystemVerilog Assertions for hardware verification, achieving 98.66% syntax and 94.53% functional accuracy on 24 RTL designs.

entry.title: ESL-Bench: An Event-Driven Synthetic Longitudinal Benchmark for Health Agents

author.name: Chao Li, Cailiang Liu, Ang Gao, Kexin Deng, Shu Zhang, Langping Xu, Xiaotong Shi, Xionghao Ding, Jian Pei, Xun Jiang

entry.summary: Presents ESL-Bench, a synthetic longitudinal health benchmark with 100 users having 1-5 year trajectories for evaluating health agents, including event-driven synthesis with explicit ground truth for temporal reasoning.

entry.title: HairOrbit: Multi-view Aware 3D Hair Modeling from Single Portraits

author.name: Leyang Jin, Yujian Zheng, Bingkui Tong, Yuda Qiu, Zhenyu Xie, Hao Li

entry.summary: Proposes HairOrbit for single-view 3D hair reconstruction using video generation model priors to transform the problem into calibrated multi-view reconstruction, with a neural orientation extractor and two-stage strand fitting.

entry.title: SPG: Sparse-Projected Guides with Sparse Autoencoders for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection

author.name: Tomoyasu Nanaumi, Yukino Tsuzuki, Junichi Okubo, Junichiro Fujii, Takayoshi Yamashita

entry.summary: Proposes SPG, a prompt-free zero-shot anomaly detection framework using Sparse Autoencoder latent spaces to generate normal/anomaly guide vectors, avoiding prompt embedding collapse issues.

entry.title: Learning Task-Invariant Properties via Dreamer: Enabling Efficient Policy Transfer for Quadruped Robots

author.name: Junyang Liang, Yuxuan Liu, Yabin Chang, Junfan Lin, Junkai Ji, Hui Li, Changxin Huang, Jianqiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes DreamTIP framework for quadruped robot sim-to-real transfer using Dreamer world models with Task-Invariant Properties identified by LLMs, such as contact stability and terrain clearance.

entry.title: Prompt Compression in the Wild: Measuring Latency, Rate Adherence, and Quality for Faster LLM Inference

author.name: Cornelius Kummer, Lena Jurkschat, Michael F\"arber, Sahar Vahdati

entry.summary: First large-scale study of prompt compression trade-offs for LLM inference, evaluating whether preprocessing time savings offset faster decoding across multiple LLMs, GPU classes, and 30,000 queries.

entry.title: JoyAI-LLM Flash: Advancing Mid-Scale LLMs with Token Efficiency

author.name: Aichen Cai, Anmeng Zhang, Anyu Li, Bo Zhang, Bohua Cai, Chang Li, Changjian Jiang, Changkai Lu, Chao Xue, Chaocai Liang, Cheng Zhang, Dongkai Liu, Fei Wang, Guoqiang Huang, Haijian Ke, Han Lin, Hao Wang, Ji Miao, Jiacheng Zhang, Jialong Shi, Jifeng Zhu, Jingjing Qian, Junhui Luo, Junwu Xiong, Lam So, Liang Huang, Ming Ke, Mingyang Li, Panfeng Shi, Peng Hao, Qi Wang, Qian Lai, Qiaoqiao Yuan, Qingyu Yin, Qiong Cao, Qixiang Wang, Rongcheng Bian, Rongduo Han, Shaoqiang Zheng, Shi Hu, Shi Suo, Shijie Ren, Shijin Zhang, Shiying Fan, Shuai Xie, Tianyi Zhang, Wei Liu, Wentao Tan, Xianghan Meng, Xiaodong He, Xing Pan, Xiran Wang, Xuyang Peng, Ya Zhang, Yang Liu, Yangyang Duan, Yanxu Chen, Yicheng Gong, Yidan Huang, Yifei Liu, Yinhao Bai, Yongqiang Liu, Yuesong Zhang, Yuqi Zhang, Zerui Xie, Zhenfang Wang, Zhennan Shen, Zheyuan Liu, Zhuwei Zeng

entry.summary: Introduces JoyAI-LLM Flash, a MoE language model under 50B parameters pretrained on 20T tokens with a novel RL algorithm (FiberPO) inspired by fibration theory for multi-scale stability in training.

entry.title: StoryScope: Investigating idiosyncrasies in AI fiction

author.name: Jenna Russell, Rishanth Rajendhran, Mohit Iyyer, John Wieting

entry.summary: Proposes StoryScope, a pipeline for analyzing discourse-level narrative features in AI vs human fiction across 61,608 stories. Focuses on character agency, chronological discontinuity, and other narrative choices rather than style.

entry.title: VOSR: A Vision-Only Generative Model for Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Rongyuan Wu, Lingchen Sun, Zhengqiang Zhang, Xiangtao Kong, Jixin Zhao, Shihao Wang, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes VOSR, a vision-only generative super-resolution model that uses a pretrained vision encoder instead of text-to-image diffusion priors, showing that pure visual semantic guidance can rival T2I-based SR methods. Revisits classifier-free guidance design for restoration tasks.

entry.title: Interpreting Gradient Routing’s Scalable Oversight Experiment

author.name: makataomu

entry.summary: Critiques the Gradient Routing paper's scalable oversight experiment, showing that a simpler early-stopping baseline matches GR's performance. Discusses how GR's setting relates to scalable oversight and weak-to-strong generalization.

entry.title: Tune to Learn: How Controller Gains Shape Robot Policy Learning

author.name: Antonia Bronars, Younghyo Park, Pulkit Agrawal

entry.summary: Systematically investigates how position controller gains affect robot learning pipelines (behavior cloning, RL, teleoperation), arguing gain selection should optimize learnability rather than task compliance.

entry.title: When Modalities Remember: Continual Learning for Multimodal Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Linyu Li, Zhi Jin, Yichi Zhang, Dongming Jin, Yuanpeng He, Haoran Duan, Gadeng Luosang and Nyima Tashi

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic study of continual learning for multimodal knowledge graphs (CMMKGR), constructing new benchmarks and proposing MRCKG model that uses multimodal-structural collaborative curriculum for progressive learning.

entry.title: UniSpector: Towards Universal Open-set Defect Recognition via Spectral-Contrastive Visual Prompting

author.name: Geonuk Kim, Minhoi Kim, Kangil Lee, Minsu Kim, Hyeonseong Jeon, Jeonghoon Han, Hyoungjoon Lim, Junho Yim

entry.summary: Proposes UniSpector for universal open-set defect recognition using spectral-contrastive visual prompting, addressing prompt embedding collapse through Spatial-Spectral and Contrastive Prompt Encoders.

entry.title: AIVV: Neuro-Symbolic LLM Agent-Integrated Verification and Validation for Trustworthy Autonomous Systems

author.name: Jiyong Kwon, Ujin Jeon, Sooji Lee, Guang Lin

entry.summary: AIVV proposes a neuro-symbolic framework using LLMs as deliberative outer loops for automated verification and validation of autonomous systems, combining deep learning anomaly detection with formal verification.

entry.title: Low-Rank Compression of Pretrained Models via Randomized Subspace Iteration

author.name: Farhad Pourkamali-Anaraki

entry.summary: Addresses low-rank compression of pretrained models using randomized subspace iteration, establishing theoretical connections between approximation error and predictive performance. Shows improvements over standard randomized SVD for slowly-decaying singular value spectra.

entry.title: Generative Event Pretraining with Foundation Model Alignment

author.name: Jianwen Cao, Jiaxu Xing, Nico Messikommer, Davide Scaramuzza

entry.summary: Proposes GEP (Generative Event Pretraining), a two-stage framework that transfers semantic knowledge from image foundation models to event cameras through alignment and autoregressive pretraining.

entry.title: Holos: A Web-Scale LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for the Agentic Web

author.name: Xiaohang Nie, Zihan Guo, Zicai Cui, Jiachi Yang, Zeyi Chen, Leheyi De, Yu Zhang, Junwei Liao, Bo Huang, Yingxuan Yang, Zhi Han, Zimian Peng, Linyao Chen, Wenzheng Tom Tang, Zongkai Liu, Tao Zhou, Botao Amber Hu, Shuyang Tang, Jianghao Lin, Weiwen Liu, Muning Wen, Yuanjian Zhou, Weinan Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Holos, a web-scale LLM-based multi-agent system with five-layer architecture for the 'Agentic Web' where heterogeneous agents autonomously interact. Features include agent generation, market-driven orchestration, and value cycles.

entry.title: OPRIDE: Offline Preference-based Reinforcement Learning via In-Dataset Exploration

author.name: Yiqin Yang, Hao Hu, Yihuan Mao, Jin Zhang, Chengjie Wu, Yuhua Jiang, Xu Yang, Runpeng Xie, Yi Fan, Bo Liu, Yang Gao, Bo Xu, Chongjie Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes OPRIDE for offline preference-based RL, addressing low query efficiency through principled in-dataset exploration and mechanisms to prevent overoptimization of learned reward functions.

entry.title: Street-Legal Physical-World Adversarial Rim for License Plates

author.name: Nikhil Kalidasu, Sahana Ganapathy

entry.summary: Introduces SPAR, a physically realizable adversarial rim for license plates that attacks ALPR systems without modifying the plate itself, argued to be street-legal in Texas. Reduces detection rates significantly under optimal conditions.

entry.title: Optimal Projection-Free Adaptive SGD for Matrix Optimization

author.name: Dmitry Kovalev

entry.summary: Proves improved convergence guarantees for Leon (a variant of One-sided Shampoo optimizer) by establishing stability properties of its preconditioner. Achieves dimension-independent convergence and optimal matrix-regret bounds.

entry.title: PolyJarvis: LLM Agent for Autonomous Polymer MD Simulations

author.name: Alexander Zhao, Achuth Chandrasekhar, Amir Barati Farimani

entry.summary: PolyJarvis is an LLM agent that autonomously executes end-to-end polymer property prediction through molecular dynamics simulations, coupling an LLM with RadonPy via Model Context Protocol servers.

entry.title: Contrastive Language-Colored Pointmap Pretraining for Unified 3D Scene Understanding

author.name: Ye Mao, Weixun Luo, Ranran Huang, Junpeng Jing, Krystian Mikolajczyk

entry.summary: UniScene3D is a transformer encoder learning unified 3D scene representations from multi-view colored pointmaps with novel cross-view geometric and semantic alignment objectives, achieving SOTA on scene understanding tasks.

entry.title: VoxelCodeBench: Benchmarking 3D World Modeling Through Code Generation

author.name: Yan Zheng, Florian Bordes

entry.summary: VoxelCodeBench introduces a platform and benchmark for evaluating code generation models on 3D spatial reasoning tasks in Unreal Engine, spanning symbolic, geometric, and artistic composition dimensions.

entry.title: Making Written Theorems Explorable by Grounding Them in Formal Representations

author.name: Hita Kambhamettu, Will Crichton, Sean Welleck, Harrison Goldstein, Andrew Head

entry.summary: Proposes 'explorable theorems' that use LLMs to translate written mathematical proofs into Lean (a formal proof language), linking natural language with formal code so readers can interactively step through proofs, test examples, and trace logical dependencies.

entry.title: WGFINNs: Weak formulation-based GENERIC formalism informed neural networks'

author.name: Jun Sur Richard Park, Auroni Huque Hashim, Siu Wun Cheung, Youngsoo Choi, and Yeonjong Shin

entry.summary: Proposes WGFINNs, which integrate weak formulations of dynamical systems with GENERIC formalism-informed neural networks to improve robustness to noisy data while preserving thermodynamic structure. Addresses a key limitation of strong-form PINNs for scientific discovery.

entry.title: Complex-Valued GNNs for Distributed Basis-Invariant Control of Planar Systems

author.name: Samuel Honor, Mohamed Abdelnaby, Kevin Leahy

entry.summary: Presents a complex-valued GNN architecture that is globally invariant to choice of local basis for distributed control of planar systems. Uses complex-valued linear layers with phase-equivariant activations for GPS/compass-denied environments.

entry.title: Conditional Sampling via Wasserstein Autoencoders and Triangular Transport

author.name: Mohammad Al-Jarrah, Michele Martino, Marcus Yim, Bamdad Hosseini, Amirhossein Taghvaei

entry.summary: Presents Conditional Wasserstein Autoencoders (CWAEs) for conditional simulation, using triangular decoders with independence assumptions on latent variables. Explores connections to conditional optimal transport.

entry.title: Communication-free Sampling and 4D Hybrid Parallelism for Scalable Mini-batch GNN Training

author.name: Cunyang Wei, Siddharth Singh, Aishwarya Sarkar, Daniel Nichols, Tisha Patel, Aditya K. Ranjan, Sayan Ghosh, Ali Jannesari, Nathan R. Tallent, Abhinav Bhatele

entry.summary: Presents ScaleGNN, a 4D parallel framework for mini-batch GNN training combining communication-free distributed sampling with 3D parallel matrix multiplication and data parallelism. Enables scalable training on extremely large graphs.

entry.title: Multiple-Debias: A Full-process Debiasing Method for Multilingual Pre-trained Language Models

author.name: Haoyu Liang, Peijian Zeng, Wentao Huang, Aimin Yang, Dong Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces Multiple-Debias, a comprehensive debiasing method for multilingual pre-trained language models that addresses gender, race, and religion biases across four languages. Extends CrowS-Pairs benchmark to German, Spanish, Chinese, and Japanese.

entry.title: Factorized Multi-Resolution HashGrid for Efficient Neural Radiance Fields: Execution on Edge-Devices

author.name: Kim Jun-Seong, Mingyu Kim, GeonU Kim, Tae-Hyun Oh, Jin-Hwa Kim

entry.summary: Introduces Fact-Hash, a parameter-encoding method merging tensor factorization with hash-encoding for on-device NeRF training, enabling deployment on resource-constrained devices.

entry.title: Deformation-based In-Context Learning for Point Cloud Understanding

author.name: Chengxing Lin, Jinhong Deng, Yinjie Lei and Wen Li

entry.summary: Proposes DeformPIC, a deformation-based framework for point cloud in-context learning that leverages geometric priors instead of masked point modeling, addressing training-inference objective mismatch.

entry.title: A Paradigm Shift: Fully End-to-End Training for Temporal Sentence Grounding in Videos

author.name: Allen He, Qi Liu, Kun Liu, Xinchen Liu, Wu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a fully end-to-end paradigm for temporal sentence grounding in videos that jointly optimizes video backbone and localization head, with a Sentence Conditioned Adapter (SCADA) bridging the task discrepancy.

entry.title: Split and Conquer Partial Deepfake Speech

author.name: Inbal Rimon, Oren Gal and Haim Permuter

entry.summary: Proposes a split-and-conquer framework for partial deepfake speech detection that separates boundary detection from segment-level classification, simplifying the learning objective for detecting manipulated regions.

entry.title: Council Mode: Mitigating Hallucination and Bias in LLMs via Multi-Agent Consensus

author.name: Shuai Wu, Xue Li, Yanna Feng, Yufang Li, Zhijun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Council Mode, a multi-agent consensus framework dispatching queries to multiple heterogeneous frontier LLMs in parallel with a three-phase pipeline including triage, parallel execution, and consensus synthesis.

entry.title: Self-Optimizing Multi-Agent Systems for Deep Research

author.name: Arthur C\^amara, Vincent Slot, Jakub Zavrel

entry.summary: Explores self-optimizing multi-agent Deep Research systems where agents self-play and explore different prompt combinations, showing this can match or outperform expert-crafted prompts.

entry.title: STEAR: Layer-Aware Spatiotemporal Evidence Intervention for Hallucination Mitigation in Video Large Language Models

author.name: Linfeng Fan, Yuan Tian, Ziwei Li, Zhiwu Lu

entry.summary: Proposes STEAR, a layer-aware framework for mitigating spatiotemporal hallucinations in Video LLMs. Discovers that different decoder layers contribute differently to visual grounding vs linguistic composition, and applies layer-specific interventions.

entry.title: Speaker-Reasoner: Scaling Interaction Turns and Reasoning Patterns for Timestamped Speaker-Attributed ASR

author.name: Zhennan Lin, Shuai Wang, Zhaokai Sun, Pengyuan Xie, Chuan Xie, Jie Liu, Qiang Zhang, Lei Xie

entry.summary: Proposes Speaker-Reasoner, an end-to-end Speech LLM with agentic multi-turn temporal reasoning for multi-speaker transcription. Iteratively analyzes audio structure, predicts boundaries, and performs segment analysis with speaker-aware caching.

entry.title: Salt: Self-Consistent Distribution Matching with Cache-Aware Training for Fast Video Generation

author.name: Xingtong Ge, Yi Zhang, Yushi Huang, Dailan He, Xiahong Wang, Bingqi Ma, Guanglu Song, Yu Liu, Jun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Salt (Self-Consistent Distribution Matching with Cache-Aware Training) for fast video generation at 2-4 NFEs, combining distribution matching distillation with endpoint consistency regularization.

entry.title: CoME-VL: Scaling Complementary Multi-Encoder Vision-Language Learning

author.name: Ankan Deria, Komal Kumar, Xilin He, Imran Razzak, Hisham Cholakkal, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Salman Khan

entry.summary: Proposes CoME-VL, a modular fusion framework that integrates contrastive (CLIP) and self-supervised (DINO) vision encoders for vision-language modeling, using entropy-guided multi-layer aggregation and orthogonal projection to combine complementary visual representations.

entry.title: Characterization of Gaussian Universality Breakdown in High-Dimensional Empirical Risk Minimization

author.name: Chiheb Yaakoubi and Cosme Louart and Malik Tiomoko and Zhenyu Liao

entry.summary: Studies high-dimensional ERM under non-Gaussian data, extending CGMT heuristically to characterize how non-Gaussianity affects estimator distributions. Shows projections of the estimator follow a convolution of non-Gaussian and Gaussian components.

entry.title: Guideline2Graph: Profile-Aware Multimodal Parsing for Executable Clinical Decision Graphs

author.name: Onur Selim Kilic, Yeti Z. Gurbuz, Cem O. Yaldiz, Afra Nawar, Etrit Haxholli, Ogul Can, and Eli Waxman

entry.summary: Guideline2Graph converts clinical practice guidelines into executable clinical decision graphs using a decomposition-first pipeline with topology-aware chunking and provenance-preserving aggregation, addressing cross-page continuity challenges.

entry.title: Unlocking Multi-Site Clinical Data: A Federated Approach to Privacy-First Child Autism Behavior Analysis

author.name: Guangyu Sun, Wenhan Wu, Zhishuai Guo, Ziteng Wang, Pegah Khosravi, Chen Chen

entry.summary: First study applying federated learning to automated recognition of autistic behaviors in children across multiple clinical sites, addressing privacy concerns with pediatric data under HIPAA while enabling multi-site collaboration.

entry.title: Differentiable SpaTiaL: Symbolic Learning and Reasoning with Geometric Temporal Logic for Manipulation Tasks

author.name: Licheng Luo, Kaier Liang, Cristian-Ioan Vasile, Mingyu Cai

entry.summary: Proposes Differentiable SpaTiaL, a fully tensorized toolbox for smooth, autograd-compatible geometric primitives over polygonal sets, enabling gradient-based optimization for manipulation tasks with coupled geometric and temporal constraints.

entry.title: XrayClaw: Cooperative-Competitive Multi-Agent Alignment for Trustworthy Chest X-ray Diagnosis

author.name: Shawn Young, Lijian Xu

entry.summary: Introduces XrayClaw, a multi-agent framework for chest X-ray diagnosis using cooperative-competitive architecture with four specialized cooperative agents and competitive alignment to reduce diagnostic hallucinations.

entry.title: CANDLE: Illumination-Invariant Semantic Priors for Color Ambient Lighting Normalization

author.name: Rong-Lin Jian, Ting-Yao Chen, Yu-Fan Lin, Chia-Ming Lee, Fu-En Yang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Chih-Chung Hsu

entry.summary: Proposes CANDLE, a method for color ambient lighting normalization that uses DINOv3's self-supervised features as illumination-robust semantic priors. Introduces multi-layer DINOv3 feature injection and color-frequency refinement for recovering object-intrinsic color.

entry.title: Toward an Artificial General Teacher: Procedural Geometry Data Generation and Visual Grounding with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Hai Nguyen-Truong, Alper Balbay, Tunga Bayrak

entry.summary: Studies visual explanation in geometry education as a referring image segmentation problem, creating a procedural data engine generating 200K+ synthetic geometry diagrams with pixel-perfect annotations.

entry.title: Feature Attribution Stability Suite: How Stable Are Post-Hoc Attributions?

author.name: Kamalasankari Subramaniakuppusamy and Jugal Gajjar

entry.summary: Introduces FASS, a benchmark for evaluating post-hoc feature attribution stability under realistic perturbations, enforcing prediction-invariance filtering and decomposing stability into structural similarity, rank correlation, and top-k overlap.

entry.title: LLM-based Atomic Propositions help weak extractors: Evaluation of a Propositioner for triplet extraction

author.name: Luc Pommeret (STL), Thomas Gerald (LISN), Patrick Paroubek (STL), Sahar Ghannay (STL), Christophe Servan (STL, AMIAD), Sophie Rosset (LISN, STL)

entry.summary: Introduces MPropositionneur-V2, a small multilingual model for decomposing text into atomic propositions to improve knowledge graph triplet extraction, trained by distilling from Qwen3-32B to Qwen3-0.6B.

entry.title: Information-Regularized Constrained Inversion for Stable Avatar Editing from Sparse Supervision

author.name: Zhenxiao Liang, Qixing Huang

entry.summary: Proposes information-regularized constrained inversion for editing animatable human avatars from sparse keyframes, using a structured latent space to prevent identity leakage and temporal flicker.

entry.title: BEVPredFormer: Spatio-temporal Attention for BEV Instance Prediction in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Miguel Antunes-Garc\'ia, Santiago Montiel-Mar\'in, Fabio S\'anchez-Garc\'ia, Rodrigo Guti\'errez-Moreno, Rafael Barea and Luis M. Bergasa

entry.summary: Proposes BEVPredFormer, using spatio-temporal attention for bird's-eye-view instance prediction in autonomous driving, addressing the challenge of processing dense spatial and temporal information.

entry.title: Rethinking Forward Processes for Score-Based Data Assimilation in High Dimensions

author.name: Eunbi Yoon, Donghan Kim, and Dae Wook Kim

entry.summary: Proposes measurement-aware score-based data assimilation that redesigns the forward diffusion process to account for observation structure, avoiding heuristic likelihood score approximations that accumulate errors.

entry.title: Escape dynamics and implicit bias of one-pass SGD in overparameterized quadratic networks

author.name: Dario Bocchi, Theotime Regimbeau, Carlo Lucibello, Luca Saglietti, Chiara Cammarota

entry.summary: Analyzes one-pass SGD dynamics of two-layer quadratic networks in teacher-student framework, showing overparameterization only modestly accelerates escape from plateaus and examining implicit bias toward max-margin solutions.

entry.title: Characterizing WebGPU Dispatch Overhead for LLM Inference Across Four GPU Vendors, Three Backends, and Three Browsers

author.name: J\k{e}drzej Maczan

entry.summary: Systematically characterizes WebGPU dispatch overhead for LLM inference across four GPU vendors, three browsers, and two backends. Reveals naive benchmarks overestimate dispatch cost by ~20x and provides true per-dispatch costs.

entry.title: Differentiable Symbolic Planning: A Neural Architecture for Constraint Reasoning with Learned Feasibility

author.name: Venkatakrishna Reddy Oruganti

entry.summary: Introduces Differentiable Symbolic Planning (DSP), a neural architecture that performs discrete constraint reasoning while remaining differentiable, using feasibility channels and sparsemax attention for exact-zero rule selection.

entry.title: Beyond Message Passing: Toward Semantically Aligned Agent Communication

author.name: Dun Yuan, Fuyuan Lyu, Ye Yuan, Weixu Zhang, Bowei He, Jiayi Geng, Linfeng Du, Zipeng Sun, Yankai Chen, Changjiang Han, Jikun Kang, Alex Chen, Haolun Wu, Xue Liu

entry.summary: Analyzes 18 agent communication protocols through a three-layer framework (communication, syntactic, semantic), identifying that current protocols lack semantic-level coordination mechanisms like clarification and grounding.

entry.title: F2F-AP: Flow-to-Future Asynchronous Policy for Real-time Dynamic Manipulation

author.name: Haoyu Wei, Xiuwei Xu, Ziyang Cheng, Hang Yin, Angyuan Ma, Bingyao Yu, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: Proposes F2F-AP, a framework using predicted object flow to synthesize future observations for real-time dynamic manipulation, with flow-based contrastive learning to align predicted and ground-truth future states.

entry.title: Generative models on phase space

author.name: Zachary Bogorad, Ibrahim Elsharkawy, Yonatan Kahn, Andrew J. Larkoski, Noam Levi

entry.summary: Proposes generative models (diffusion/flow matching) constrained to physical phase space for high-energy physics data, ensuring exact enforcement of conservation laws like energy-momentum conservation. This addresses reliability issues when physics constraints are only approximately learned.

entry.title: Hierarchical, Interpretable, Label-Free Concept Bottleneck Model

author.name: Haodong Xie, Yujun Cai, Rahul Singh Maharjan, Yiwei Wang, Federico Tavella, and Angelo Cangelosi

entry.summary: Proposes HIL-CBM, a hierarchical Concept Bottleneck Model that extends CBMs to operate across multiple semantic levels without requiring relational concept annotations, better mirroring human hierarchical categorization.

entry.title: Rascene: High-Fidelity 3D Scene Imaging with mmWave Communication Signals

author.name: Kunzhe Song, Geo Jie Zhou, Xiaoming Liu, Huacheng Zeng

entry.summary: Introduces Rascene, a framework using ubiquitous mmWave OFDM communication signals for 3D scene imaging, performing multi-frame spatially adaptive fusion. Aims to provide robust 3D perception in conditions where cameras and LiDAR fail (smoke, fog).

entry.title: Analytic Drift Resister for Non-Exemplar Continual Graph Learning

author.name: Lei Song, Shihan Guan, Youyong Kong

entry.summary: Proposes Analytic Drift Resister (ADR) for non-exemplar continual graph learning, combining iterative backpropagation with analytic learning to address feature drift while maintaining model plasticity.

entry.title: Efficient3D: A Unified Framework for Adaptive and Debiased Token Reduction in 3D MLLMs

author.name: Yuhui Lin, Siyue Yu, Yuxing Yang, Guangliang Cheng, Jimin Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes Efficient3D, a framework for visual token pruning in 3D multimodal LLMs that uses a debiased importance estimator and adaptive retention strategy to accelerate inference while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: Task-Guided Prompting for Unified Remote Sensing Image Restoration

author.name: Wenli Huang, Yang Wu, Xiaomeng Xin, Zhihong Liu, Jinjun Wang, Ye Deng

entry.summary: Proposes TGPNet, a unified framework handling multiple remote sensing image restoration tasks (denoising, cloud removal, shadow removal, deblurring, SAR despeckling) using task-guided prompting with learnable task-specific embeddings.

entry.title: InverseDraping: Recovering Sewing Patterns from 3D Garment Surfaces via BoxMesh Bridging

author.name: Leyang Jin, Zirong Jin, Zisheng Ye, Haokai Pang, Xiaoguang Han, Yujian Zheng, Hao Li

entry.summary: Proposes InverseDraping, a two-stage framework for recovering sewing patterns from draped 3D garments using BoxMesh as a structured intermediate representation that disentangles panel geometry from draping deformations.

entry.title: Disrupting Cognitive Passivity: Rethinking AI-Assisted Data Literacy through Cognitive Alignment

author.name: Yongsu Ahn, Nam Wook Kim, and Benjamin Bach

entry.summary: Argues that AI chatbots' default comprehensive response mode induces cognitive passivity in users, and proposes a cognitive alignment framework that dynamically adapts AI interaction modes to users' cognitive demands for data literacy development.

entry.title: CMCC-ReID: Cross-Modality Clothing-Change Person Re-Identification

author.name: Haoxuan Xu, Hanzi Wang, Guanglin Niu

entry.summary: Defines a new task combining cross-modality (visible-infrared) and clothing-change person re-identification, with a new benchmark SYSU-CMCC addressing both challenges simultaneously.

entry.title: Adaptive Local Frequency Filtering for Fourier-Encoded Implicit Neural Representations

author.name: Ligen Shi, Jun Qiu, Yuhang Zheng, Chang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive local frequency filtering method for Fourier-encoded implicit neural representations with a spatially varying parameter that enables smooth transitions between low-pass, band-pass, and high-pass behaviors.

entry.title: Toward an Operational GNN-Based Multimesh Surrogate for Fast Flood Forecasting

author.name: Valentin Mercier (Toulouse INP, IRIT, EPE UT), Serge Gratton (IRIT, EPE UT, Toulouse INP), Lapeyre Corentin (NVIDIA), Gwena\"el Chevallet

entry.summary: Develops a GNN-based surrogate model for flood forecasting on unstructured finite-element meshes, trained on synthetic but operationally grounded flood events for the lower Têt River in France.

entry.title: Unlocking Positive Transfer in Incrementally Learning Surgical Instruments: A Self-reflection Hierarchical Prompt Framework

author.name: Yu Zhu, Kang Li, Zheng Li, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: Proposes a self-reflection hierarchical prompt framework for class incremental segmentation of surgical instruments, unlocking positive forward and backward knowledge transfer.

entry.title: InstructTable: Improving Table Structure Recognition Through Instructions

author.name: Boming Chen, Zining Wang, Zhentao Guo, Jianqiang Liu, Chen Duan, Yu Gu, Kai zhou, Pengfei Yan

entry.summary: Introduces InstructTable, an instruction-guided multi-stage training framework for table structure recognition that combines visual and semantic information to handle complex layouts with merged or empty cells.

entry.title: Towards Near-Real-Time Telemetry-Aware Routing with Neural Routing Algorithms

author.name: Andreas Boltres, Niklas Freymuth, Benjamin Schichtholz, Michael K\"onig, Gerhard Neumann

entry.summary: Proposes neural routing algorithms for telemetry-aware network routing that explicitly model communication delays, casting the problem as delay-aware closed-loop control.

entry.title: Learning from Synthetic Data via Provenance-Based Input Gradient Guidance

author.name: Koshiro Nagano, Ryo Fujii, Ryo Hachiuma, Fumiaki Sato, Taiki Sekii, Hideo Saito

entry.summary: Proposes a framework that uses provenance information from synthetic data generation to guide model learning via input gradients. Explicitly teaches models which regions contribute to discrimination, reducing spurious correlations from synthesis artifacts.

entry.title: Not All Frames Deserve Full Computation: Accelerating Autoregressive Video Generation via Selective Computation and Predictive Extrapolation

author.name: Hanshuai Cui, Zhiqing Tang, Zhi Yao, Fanshuai Meng, Weijia Jia, Wei Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes SCOPE, a training-free framework for accelerating autoregressive video diffusion with a tri-modal scheduler (cache, predict, recompute) using noise-level Taylor extrapolation for intermediate cases.

entry.title: Minimal Information Control Invariance via Vector Quantization

author.name: Ege Yuceel, Teodor Tchalakov, Sayan Mitra

entry.summary: Proposes a vector-quantized autoencoder learning minimal control codebooks for safety-critical systems, with formal certification via Lipschitz reachable-set enclosures. Achieves 157x reduction in control complexity for a 12D quadrotor.

entry.title: Enhancing Robustness of Federated Learning via Server Learning

author.name: Van Sy Mai, Kushal Chakrabarti, Richard J. La, and Dipankar Maity

entry.summary: Proposes a federated learning defense combining server learning, client update filtering, and geometric median aggregation that maintains model accuracy even when more than 50% of clients are malicious, using potentially synthetic server data.

entry.title: Transfer Learning for Meta-analysis Under Covariate Shift

author.name: Zilong Wang, Ali Abdeen, Turgay Ayer

entry.summary: Proposes a placebo-anchored transport framework for meta-analysis under covariate shift, calibrating baseline risk using target-trial placebo outcomes and producing doubly robust estimators for heterogeneous treatment effects.

entry.title: Inversion-Free Natural Gradient Descent on Riemannian Manifolds

author.name: Dario Draca, Takuo Matsubara, Minh-Ngoc Tran

entry.summary: Proposes an inversion-free stochastic natural gradient method for optimization on Riemannian manifolds, maintaining an online approximation of the inverse Fisher information matrix updated at quadratic cost.

entry.title: Multi-Model Synthetic Training for Mission-Critical Small Language Models

author.name: Nolan Platt and Pragyansmita Nayak

entry.summary: Demonstrates 261x cost reduction for maritime intelligence by using LLMs as one-time teachers to fine-tune a Qwen2.5-7B model on synthetic QA pairs generated from 3.2B AIS vessel tracking records.

entry.title: Prism: Policy Reuse via Interpretable Strategy Mapping in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Thomas Pravetz

entry.summary: Presents PRISM, a framework grounding RL agents' decisions in discrete causally validated concepts that serve as a zero-shot transfer interface between agents trained with different algorithms.

entry.title: Evaluating Small Language Models for Front-Door Routing: A Harmonized Benchmark and Synthetic-Traffic Experiment

author.name: Warren Johnson and Charles Lee

entry.summary: Evaluates small language models (1-4B) for front-door inference routing, testing whether they can serve as sub-second, zero-cost task classifiers to route queries to appropriate models.

entry.title: Backup-Based Safety Filters: A Comparative Review of Backup CBF, Model Predictive Shielding, and gatekeeper

author.name: Taekyung Kim, Aswin D. Menon, Akshunn Trivedi, Dimitra Panagou

entry.summary: Provides a unified comparative review of three backup-based safety filters (Backup CBF, Model Predictive Shielding, gatekeeper), showing MPS is a special case of gatekeeper and relating gatekeeper to Backup CBF.

entry.title: Adaptive Learned State Estimation based on KalmanNet

author.name: Arian Mehrfard, Bharanidhar Duraisamy, Stefan Haag, Florian Geiss, Mirko M\"ahlisch

entry.summary: Presents Adaptive Multi-modal KalmanNet (AM-KNet) for autonomous driving state estimation, introducing sensor-specific modules for radar/lidar/camera and a hypernetwork for context-dependent adaptation. Tested on real automotive data.

entry.title: Social Meaning in Large Language Models: Structure, Magnitude, and Pragmatic Prompting

author.name: Roland M\"uhlenbernd

entry.summary: Introduces metrics (Effect Size Ratio and Calibration Deviation Score) to evaluate whether LLMs capture human social meaning quantitatively, and tests pragmatic prompting strategies derived from linguistic theory.

entry.title: A Spectral Framework for Multi-Scale Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction

author.name: Zeyang Huang, Angelos Chatzimparmpas, Thomas H\"ollt, and Takanori Fujiwara

entry.summary: Proposes a spectral framework for nonlinear dimensionality reduction that bridges the global-local preservation trade-off using spectral basis with cross-entropy optimization, providing analytical transparency.

entry.title: WSVD: Weighted Low-Rank Approximation for Fast and Efficient Execution of Low-Precision Vision-Language Models

author.name: Haiyu Wang, Yutong Wang, Jack Jiang, Sai Qian Zhang

entry.summary: WSVD applies finer-granularity SVD with adaptive importance weighting for VLM compression, achieving real latency reduction where previous SVD approaches failed to deliver practical speedups.

entry.title: High Volatility and Action Bias Distinguish LLMs from Humans in Group Coordination

author.name: Sahaj Singh Maini, Robert L. Goldstone, Zoran Tiganj

entry.summary: Compares LLM and human coordination in Group Binary Search, finding LLMs exhibit high volatility and action bias that distinguish them from humans' adaptive stabilization strategies.

entry.title: Drift-Resilient Temporal Priors for Visual Tracking

author.name: Yuqing Huang, Liting Lin, Weijun Zhuang, Zhenyu He, Xin Li

entry.summary: Introduces DTPTrack, a lightweight module for visual tracking that suppresses model drift by calibrating per-frame reliability scores and synthesizing temporal priors. Integrates into existing trackers as a plug-in module.

entry.title: Parser-Oriented Structural Refinement for a Stable Layout Interface in Document Parsing

author.name: Fuyuan Liu, Dianyu Yu, He Ren, Nayu Liu, Xiaomian Kang, Delai Qiu, Fa Zhang, Genpeng Zhen, Shengping Liu, Jiaen Liang, Wei Huang, Yining Wang, Junnan Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces a lightweight structural refinement stage between DETR-style detectors and downstream parsers to stabilize the parser interface for document layout analysis, performing set-level reasoning over query features.

entry.title: LieTrunc-QNN: Lie Algebra Truncation and Quantum Expressivity Phase Transition from LiePrune to Provably Stable Quantum Neural Networks

author.name: Haijian Shao, Dalong Zhao, Xing Deng, Wenzheng Zhu, Yingtao Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces LieTrunc-QNN, an algebraic-geometric framework for quantum neural networks that characterizes trainability via Lie algebra truncation, establishing connections between expressivity (manifold dimension) and barren plateaus.

entry.title: ALIVE-LIO: Degeneracy-Aware Learning of Inertial Velocity for Enhancing ESKF-Based LiDAR-Inertial Odometry

author.name: Seongjun Kim, Daehan Lee, Junwoo Hong, Sanghyun Park, Hyunyoung Jo, Soohee Han

entry.summary: Proposes ALIVE-LIO, a degeneracy-aware LiDAR-inertial odometry that integrates a neural network into a Kalman filter to predict body-frame velocity and selectively fuse it when LiDAR observability is compromised.

entry.title: Learning Locomotion on Complex Terrain for Quadrupedal Robots with Foot Position Maps and Stability Rewards

author.name: Matthew Hwang, Yubin Liu, Ryo Hakoda, Takeshi Oishi

entry.summary: Introduces foot position maps integrated into heightmaps and dynamic stability rewards within an attention-based RL framework for quadrupedal robot locomotion on complex terrain.

entry.title: Geometrically-Constrained Radar-Inertial Odometry via Continuous Point-Pose Uncertainty Modeling

author.name: Wooseong Yang, Dongjae Lee, Minwoo Jung, Ayoung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes geometrically-constrained radar-inertial odometry using continuous trajectory models that propagate pose uncertainty and integrate it with heteroscedastic measurement uncertainty for adaptive radar point weighting.

entry.title: STDDN: A Physics-Guided Deep Learning Framework for Crowd Simulation

author.name: Zijin Liu and Xu Geng and Wenshuai Xu and Xiang Zhao and Yan Xia and You Song

entry.summary: Proposes STDDN, a physics-guided deep learning framework for crowd simulation that combines macroscopic physical laws with microscopic trajectory prediction using spatio-temporal decoupled differential equations.

entry.title: Improving Role Consistency in Multi-Agent Collaboration via Quantitative Role Clarity

author.name: Guoling Zhou, Wenpei Han, Fengqin Yang, Li Wang, Yingcong Zhou, Zhiguo Fu

entry.summary: Proposes a quantitative role clarity metric for multi-agent LLM systems, using a role assignment matrix based on semantic similarity between agent behaviors and role descriptions. Defines a role clarity matrix and uses its Frobenius norm as a regularization term to improve role consistency.

entry.title: STRNet: Visual Navigation with Spatio-Temporal Representation through Dynamic Graph Aggregation

author.name: Hao Ren, Zetong Bi, Yiming Zeng, Zhaoliang Wan, Lu Qi, Hui Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes STRNet, a spatio-temporal representation framework using dynamic graph aggregation for visual navigation, with a spatio-temporal fusion module for better feature encoding.

entry.title: Accelerating Black-Box Bilevel Optimization with Rank-Based Upper-Level Value Function Approximation

author.name: Marc Ong and Youhei Akimoto

entry.summary: Proposes an efficient bilevel optimization framework exploiting rank-based evolutionary algorithm invariance to monotonic transformations, reducing computational cost of nested bilevel optimization.

entry.title: Extracting Money Laundering Transactions from Quasi-Temporal Graph Representation

author.name: Haseeb Tariq and Marwan Hassani

entry.summary: Presents ExSTraQt, a supervised learning approach for detecting money laundering transactions using quasi-temporal graph representations of financial transaction networks.

entry.title: InfoSeeker: A Scalable Hierarchical Parallel Agent Framework for Web Information Seeking

author.name: Ka Yiu Lee, Yuxuan Huang, Zhiyuan He, Huichi Zhou, Weilin Luo, Kun Shao, Meng Fang, Jun Wang
