entry.title: Omni123: Exploring 3D Native Foundation Models with Limited 3D Data by Unifying Text to 2D and 3D Generation

author.name: Chongjie Ye, Cheng Cao, Chuanyu Pan, Yiming Hao, Yihao Zhi, Yuanming Hu, Xiaoguang Han

entry.summary: Omni123 presents a 3D-native foundation model unifying text-to-2D and text-to-3D generation in a single autoregressive framework, using cross-modal consistency between images and 3D as implicit structural constraint to address limited 3D data.

entry.title: A Simple Baseline for Streaming Video Understanding

author.name: Yujiao Shen, Shulin Tian, Jingkang Yang, Ziwei Liu

entry.summary: SimpleStream demonstrates that a basic sliding-window baseline feeding recent frames to an off-the-shelf VLM matches or surpasses complex streaming video models with memory mechanisms, challenging the trend of increasingly complex architectures.

entry.title: Why Instruction-Based Unlearning Fails in Diffusion Models?

author.name: Zeliang Zhang, Rui Sun, Jiani Liu, Qi Wu, Chenliang Xu

entry.summary: Investigates why instruction-based unlearning fails in diffusion models, finding that unlike in LLMs, unlearning instructions don't sustainably reduce attention to targeted concepts during denoising, causing suppressed concepts to re-emerge.

entry.title: Towards Reliable Truth-Aligned Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models

author.name: Ponhvoan Srey, Quang Minh Nguyen, Xiaobao Wu, Anh Tuan Luu

entry.summary: Formalizes 'proxy failure' in LLM uncertainty estimation where UE metrics become non-discriminative in low-information regimes, and proposes Truth AnChoring (TAC), a post-hoc calibration method that maps scores to truth-aligned scores using noisy few-shot supervision.

entry.title: CliffSearch: Structured Agentic Co-Evolution over Theory and Code for Scientific Algorithm Discovery

author.name: Youssef Mroueh, Carlos Fonseca, Brian Belgodere, David Cox

entry.summary: Presents CliffSearch, an agentic evolutionary framework for scientific algorithm discovery where LLM agents implement evolution operators (crossover, mutation, review) on structured scientific artifacts with theory+code representation and correctness/originality gating.

entry.title: Does Unification Come at a Cost? Uni-SafeBench: A Safety Benchmark for Unified Multimodal Large Models

author.name: Zixiang Peng, Yongxiu Xu, Qinyi Zhang, Jiexun Shen, Yifan Zhang, Hongbo Xu, Yubin Wang, Gaopeng Gou

entry.summary: Introduces Uni-SafeBench, a comprehensive safety benchmark for Unified Multimodal Large Models spanning six safety categories across seven task types, along with Uni-Judger for evaluation that decouples contextual understanding from safety assessment.

entry.title: Agent psychometrics: Task-level performance prediction in agentic coding benchmarks

author.name: Chris Ge, Daria Kryvosheieva, Daniel Fried, Uzay Girit, Kaivalya Hariharan

entry.summary: Presents a framework for predicting task-level success/failure in agentic coding benchmarks by augmenting Item Response Theory with rich task features, decomposing agent capability into subtask skills for interpretable analysis.

entry.title: RefineRL: Advancing Competitive Programming with Self-Refinement Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shaopeng Fu, Xingxing Zhang, Li Dong, Di Wang, Furu Wei

entry.summary: Introduces RefineRL for competitive programming, combining a Skeptical-Agent for iterative self-refinement with a novel RL training approach using inter-attempt reward shaping to improve multi-attempt problem solving.

entry.title: LinearARD: Linear-Memory Attention Distillation for RoPE Restoration

author.name: Ning Yang, Hengyu Zhong, Wentao Wang, Baoliang Tian, Haijun Zhang, Jun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes LinearARD, a self-distillation method that restores RoPE-scaled model capabilities by aligning attention-structure (Q/K/V self-relation matrices) with a frozen native-RoPE teacher, using linear memory complexity.

entry.title: Brevity Constraints Reverse Performance Hierarchies in Language Models

author.name: MD Azizul Hakim

entry.summary: Demonstrates that larger LLMs underperform smaller ones on 7.7% of benchmark problems due to spontaneous scale-dependent verbosity, and shows that brevity constraints can improve large model accuracy by 26 percentage points.

entry.title: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation

author.name: Patrice Bechard, Orlando Marquez Ayala, Emily Chen, Jordan Skelton, Sagar Davasam, Srinivas Sunkara, Vikas Yadav, Sai Rajeswar

entry.summary: Argues that terminal-only coding agents (with just filesystem and terminal access) can match or outperform more complex agentic systems with MCP or web interfaces for enterprise automation tasks.

entry.title: Diversity-Aware Reverse Kullback-Leibler Divergence for Large Language Model Distillation

author.name: Hoang-Chau Luong, Dat Ba Tran, Lingwei Chen

entry.summary: Analyzes the gradient structure of Reverse KL divergence in LLM distillation, showing it drives overconfident predictions. Proposes a diversity-aware modification that preserves output diversity while maintaining distillation quality.

entry.title: Robust Multimodal Safety via Conditional Decoding

author.name: Anurag Kumar, Raghuveer Peri, Jon Burnsky, Alexandru Nelus, Rohit Paturi, Srikanth Vishnubhotla, Yanjun Qi

entry.summary: Proposes CASA, a conditional decoding strategy that uses internal MLLM representations to predict a binary safety token before response generation, improving safety alignment against cross-modal attacks without external classifiers.

entry.title: Deep Networks Favor Simple Data

author.name: Weyl Lu, Chenjie Hao, Yubei Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Jacobian-based and autoregressive self-estimators for analyzing the OOD anomaly where deep models assign higher density to simpler out-of-distribution data, providing a unified analysis across architectures including diffusion models.

entry.title: Internal APIs Are All You Need: Shadow APIs, Shared Discovery, and the Case Against Browser-First Agent Architectures

author.name: Lewis Tham, Nicholas Mac Gregor Garcia, Jungpil Hahn

entry.summary: Argues that every website already exposes internal APIs behind its UI and proposes Unbrowse, a shared route graph that indexes these callable interfaces to replace brittle browser-based agent interactions.

entry.title: PixelPrune: Pixel-Level Adaptive Visual Token Reduction via Predictive Coding

author.name: Nan Wang, Zhiwei Jin, Chen Chen, Haonan Lu

entry.summary: Proposes PixelPrune, which exploits pixel-level redundancy in document/GUI images (22-71% of patches are exact duplicates) to prune visual tokens before the ViT encoder using predictive-coding-based compression.

entry.title: Dual Optimal: Make Your LLM Peer-like with Dignity

author.name: Xiangqi Wang, Yue Huang, Haomin Zhuang, Kehan Guo, Xiangliang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes the Dignified Peer framework to counter LLM sycophancy and evasiveness, introducing PersonaKnob dataset with compositional persona preferences and a constrained Lagrangian DPO algorithm for balanced alignment.

entry.title: Bridging Structured Knowledge and Data: A Unified Framework with Finance Applications

author.name: Yi Cao, Zexun Chen, Lin William Cong, Heqing Shi

entry.summary: Develops SKINNs (Structured-Knowledge-Informed Neural Networks) that embed theoretical/domain constraints as differentiable penalties within neural networks, with formal statistical properties including root-N convergence.

entry.title: EgoSim: Egocentric World Simulator for Embodied Interaction Generation

author.name: Jinkun Hao, Mingda Jia, Ruiyan Wang, Xihui Liu, Ran Yi, Lizhuang Ma, Jiangmiao Pang, Xudong Xu

entry.summary: Introduces EgoSim, a closed-loop egocentric world simulator that generates spatially consistent interaction videos and updates the underlying 3D scene state for continuous simulation of embodied interactions.

entry.title: Automated Framework to Evaluate and Harden LLM System Instructions against Encoding Attacks

author.name: Anubhab Sahu, Diptisha Samanta, Reza Soosahabi

entry.summary: Presents an automated framework to evaluate and harden LLM system instructions against encoding-based attacks that bypass refusal-based protections. Targets system instruction leakage, a critical security risk listed in OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

entry.title: Paper Reconstruction Evaluation: Evaluating Presentation and Hallucination in AI-written Papers

author.name: Atsuyuki Miyai, Mashiro Toyooka, Zaiying Zhao, Kenta Watanabe, Toshihiko Yamasaki, Kiyoharu Aizawa

entry.summary: Introduces PaperRecon, the first systematic evaluation framework for assessing quality and hallucination risks in AI-written papers. An agent generates a full paper from an overview, then results are compared to the original to measure presentation fidelity and hallucination.

entry.title: ORBIT: Scalable and Verifiable Data Generation for Search Agents on a Tight Budget

author.name: Nandan Thakur, Zijian Chen, Xueguang Ma, Jimmy Lin

entry.summary: Introduces ORBIT, a 20K-sample training dataset for search agents with reasoning-intensive queries and verifiable answers, generated via a frugal framework without paid APIs. Spans 15 domains with 4-5 reasoning steps per query.

entry.title: Sven: Singular Value Descent as a Computationally Efficient Natural Gradient Method

author.name: Samuel Bright-Thonney, Thomas R. Harvey, Andre Lukas, Jesse Thaler

entry.summary: Introduces Sven, an optimization algorithm that treats each data point's residual separately using the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse of the loss Jacobian, approximated via truncated SVD with only k times overhead relative to SGD.

entry.title: Training In-Context and In-Weights Mixtures Via Contrastive Context Sampling

author.name: Deeptanshu Malu, Deevyanshu Malu, Aditya Nemiwal, Sunita Sarawagi

entry.summary: Investigates training strategies to co-develop in-context and in-weights learning, showing that context similarity structure matters critically. Proposes contrastive context sampling to prevent ICL degeneration while maintaining IWL.

entry.title: annbatch unlocks terabyte-scale training of biological data in anndata

author.name: Ilan Gold, Felix Fischer, Lucas Arnoldt, F. Alexander Wolf, Fabian J. Theis

entry.summary: Presents annbatch, a mini-batch data loader for the anndata format that enables out-of-core training on terabyte-scale biological datasets. Achieves up to 10x throughput improvement, reducing training from days to hours for single-cell transcriptomics and genomics workloads.

entry.title: On the Role of Depth in the Expressivity of RNNs

author.name: Maude Lizaire, Michael Rizvi-Martel, \'Eric Dupuis, Guillaume Rabusseau

entry.summary: Formally proves that depth increases RNN memory capacity efficiently relative to parameter count, enhancing expressivity both through complex transformations and better retention of past information. Extends analysis to multiplicative 2RNNs.

entry.title: Universal Hypernetworks for Arbitrary Models

author.name: Xuanfeng Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces Universal Hypernetwork (UHN), a fixed-architecture weight generator that predicts weights from deterministic parameter/architecture/task descriptors, decoupling the generator from target network parameterization to instantiate heterogeneous models across tasks.

entry.title: Descending into the Modular Bootstrap

author.name: Nathan Benjamin, A. Liam Fitzpatrick, Wei Li, Jesse Thaler

entry.summary: Uses machine-learning-style optimization to explore the landscape of 2D conformal field theories by minimizing a modular invariance loss function. Introduces techniques for spectrum truncation uncertainty and efficient search over primary operator spectra.

entry.title: Safety, Security, and Cognitive Risks in World Models

author.name: Manoj Parmar

entry.summary: Surveys safety, security, and cognitive risks specific to world models in autonomous systems, including adversarial data corruption, deceptive alignment, reward hacking, and automation bias from authoritative world model predictions.

entry.title: Efficient Equivariant Transformer for Self-Driving Agent Modeling

author.name: Scott Xu, Dian Chen, Kelvin Wong, Chris Zhang, Kion Fallah, Raquel Urtasun

entry.summary: Proposes DriveGATr, an SE(2)-equivariant transformer for autonomous driving agent modeling that avoids quadratic cost of pairwise relative positional encodings while maintaining geometric symmetries, improving scalability to larger scenes.

entry.title: Disentangling Prompt Element Level Risk Factors for Hallucinations and Omissions in Mental Health LLM Responses

author.name: Congning Ni, Sarvech Qadir, Bryan Steitz, Mihir Sachin Vaidya, Qingyuan Song, Lantian Xia, Shelagh Mulvaney, Siru Liu, Hyeyoung Ryu, Leah Hecht, Amy Bucher, Christopher Symons, Laurie Novak, Susannah L. Rose, Murat Kantarcioglu, Bradley Malin, Zhijun Yin

entry.summary: Introduces UTCO framework for stress-testing LLMs in mental health question answering, finding hallucinations in 18.8% of responses and omissions in 31.8%, with specific prompt elements (user identity, context) as key risk factors.

entry.title: From Early Encoding to Late Suppression: Interpreting LLMs on Character Counting Tasks

author.name: Ayan Datta, Mounika Marreddy, Alexander Mehler, Zhixue Zhao, Radhika Mamidi

entry.summary: Discovers that LLMs often compute the correct answer to character counting tasks internally but fail to express it at the output layer, through mechanistic analysis showing early correct encoding followed by late-layer suppression.

entry.title: When Users Change Their Mind: Evaluating Interruptible Agents in Long-Horizon Web Navigation

author.name: Henry Peng Zou, Chunyu Miao, Wei-Chieh Huang, Yankai Chen, Yue Zhou, Hanrong Zhang, Yaozu Wu, Liancheng Fang, Zhengyao Gu, Zhen Zhang, Kening Zheng, Fangxin Wang, Yi Nian, Shanghao Li, Wenzhe Fan, Langzhou He, Weizhi Zhang, Xue Liu, Philip S. Yu

entry.summary: Introduces InterruptBench, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM agents handling mid-task interruptions (additions, revisions, retractions) during long-horizon web navigation, finding significant performance degradation.

entry.title: IGLOSS: Image Generation for Lidar Open-vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Nermin Samet, Gilles Puy, Renaud Marlet

entry.summary: Proposes IGLOSS for zero-shot open-vocabulary semantic segmentation of 3D LiDAR data by generating prototype images from text instead of using CLIP's image-text matching directly. Achieves state-of-the-art on nuScenes and SemanticKITTI benchmarks.

entry.title: UniRecGen: Unifying Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Generation

author.name: Zhisheng Huang, Jiahao Chen, Cheng Lin, Chenyu Hu, Hanzhuo Huang, Zhengming Yu, Mengfei Li, Yuheng Liu, Zekai Gu, Zibo Zhao, Yuan Liu, Xin Li, Wenping Wang

entry.summary: UniRecGen unifies feed-forward 3D reconstruction and diffusion-based generation into a single cooperative system, addressing the tension between reconstruction fidelity and generative plausibility in sparse-view 3D modeling.

entry.title: DriveDreamer-Policy: A Geometry-Grounded World-Action Model for Unified Generation and Planning

author.name: Yang Zhou, Xiaofeng Wang, Hao Shao, Letian Wang, Guosheng Zhao, Jiangnan Shao, Jiagang Zhu, Tingdong Yu, Zheng Zhu, Guan Huang, Steven L. Waslander

entry.summary: DriveDreamer-Policy unifies depth generation, future video generation, and motion planning in a single driving world-action model with geometric grounding through depth, using an LLM backbone.

entry.title: Semantic Richness or Geometric Reasoning? The Fragility of VLM's Visual Invariance

author.name: Jason Qiu, Zachary Meurer, Xavier Thomas, Deepti Ghadiyaram

entry.summary: Demonstrates that VLMs exhibit systematic failures under basic geometric transformations (rotation, scaling), with performance dropping sharply as semantic content becomes sparse, revealing lack of true spatial invariance.

entry.title: NearID: Identity Representation Learning via Near-identity Distractors

author.name: Aleksandar Cvejic, Rameen Abdal, Abdelrahman Eldesokey, Bernard Ghanem, Peter Wonka

entry.summary: NearID introduces a framework using near-identity distractors to isolate object identity from background context in vision encoders. Provides a dataset of 19K identities with 316K matched-context distractors and trains encoders that better capture true identity features.

entry.title: UniDriveVLA: Unifying Understanding, Perception, and Action Planning for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yongkang Li, Lijun Zhou, Sixu Yan, Bencheng Liao, Tianyi Yan, Kaixin Xiong, Long Chen, Hongwei Xie, Bing Wang, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Wenyu Liu, Haiyang Sun, Xinggang Wang

entry.summary: UniDriveVLA addresses the dilemma between spatial perception and semantic reasoning in autonomous driving VLA models by decoupling their optimization into separate model parameters, avoiding the suboptimal compromises of existing approaches.

entry.title: VOID: Video Object and Interaction Deletion

author.name: Saman Motamed, William Harvey, Benjamin Klein, Luc Van Gool, Zhuoning Yuan, Ta-Ying Cheng

entry.summary: VOID addresses video object removal with physical interaction correction - when removing an object, it also corrects downstream physical interactions (e.g., collisions) that the removed object would have caused, using counterfactual training data.

entry.title: Mitigating collusive self-preference by redaction and paraphrasing

author.name: Taslim

entry.summary: Investigates mitigating collusive self-preference in AI systems through text redaction and paraphrasing, finding that superficial self-preference can be reduced by perturbation but is difficult to fully eliminate. Directly relevant to untrusted monitoring in AI control.

entry.title: Think Twice Before You Write -- an Entropy-based Decoding Strategy to Enhance LLM Reasoning

author.name: Jiashu He, Meizhu Liu, Olaitan P Olaleye, Amit Agarwal, M. Avendi, Yassi Abbasi, Matthew Rowe, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel, Paul Li, Tao Sheng, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth

entry.summary: Proposes an entropy-guided decoding framework that selectively branches at high-uncertainty token positions, maintaining a dynamic pool of partial rollouts to improve reasoning reliability with less overhead than full self-consistency.

entry.title: Oblivion: Self-Adaptive Agentic Memory Control through Decay-Driven Activation

author.name: Ashish Rana, Chia-Chien Hung, Qumeng Sun, Julian Martin Kunkel, Carolin Lawrence

entry.summary: Introduces Oblivion, a memory framework for LLM agents that implements decay-driven forgetting inspired by human memory, decoupling read (when to access) and write (what to strengthen) paths for adaptive memory management.

entry.title: How Emotion Shapes the Behavior of LLMs and Agents: A Mechanistic Study

author.name: Moran Sun, Tianlin Li, Yuwei Zheng, Zhenhong Zhou, Aishan Liu, Xianglong Liu, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes E-STEER, a framework for embedding emotion as a controllable variable in LLM hidden states to study how emotional signals affect reasoning, generation, safety, and agent behaviors. This mechanistic approach goes beyond surface-level emotion prompting to enable representation-level intervention.

entry.title: Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants

author.name: Deepak Nathani, Cheng Zhang, Chang Huan, Jiaming Shan, Yinfei Yang, Alkesh Patel, Zhe Gan, William Yang Wang, Michael Saxon, Xin Eric Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Pare, a framework for evaluating proactive AI agents using finite state machine-based application models that enable realistic active user simulation, addressing the lack of evaluation frameworks for agents that anticipate user needs.

entry.title: "Who Am I, and Who Else Is Here?" Behavioral Differentiation Without Role Assignment in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Houssam EL Kandoussi

entry.summary: Studies whether multiple LLMs develop differentiated social roles in shared conversations without role assignment, using 208 runs with 13,786 coded messages across 7 heterogeneous LLMs with dual LLM judge validation.

entry.title: Hybrid Energy-Based Models for Physical AI: Provably Stable Identification of Port-Hamiltonian Dynamics

author.name: Simone Betteti, Luca Laurenti

entry.summary: Introduces an energy-based model framework for system identification with provable stability guarantees, extending to nonsmooth activations and port-Hamiltonian dynamics with absorbing invariant dynamics.

entry.title: EvolveTool-Bench: Evaluating the Quality of LLM-Generated Tool Libraries as Software Artifacts

author.name: Alibek T. Kaliyev, Artem Maryanskyy

entry.summary: Introduces EvolveTool-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-generated tool libraries as software artifacts, measuring reuse, redundancy, regression stability, and safety rather than just task completion.

entry.title: Think, Act, Build: An Agentic Framework with Vision Language Models for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding

author.name: Haibo Wang, Zihao Lin, Zhiyang Xu, Lifu Huang

entry.summary: Proposes TAB (Think, Act, Build), a dynamic agentic framework for zero-shot 3D visual grounding that decouples spatial semantics (handled by 2D VLMs) from 3D structure (handled by multi-view geometry), avoiding reliance on preprocessed point clouds.

entry.title: DVGT-2: Vision-Geometry-Action Model for Autonomous Driving at Scale

author.name: Sicheng Zuo, Zixun Xie, Wenzhao Zheng, Shaoqing Xu, Fang Li, Hanbing Li, Long Chen, Zhi-Xin Yang, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: Proposes DVGT-2, a Vision-Geometry-Action model for autonomous driving that uses dense 3D geometry as the critical cue instead of language descriptions, with a streaming architecture for online planning.

entry.title: Fast and Accurate Probing of In-Training LLMs' Downstream Performances

author.name: Zhichen Liu, Tianle Lun, Zhibin Wen, Hao An, Yulin Ou, Jianhui Xu, Hao Zhang, Wenyi Fang, Yang Zheng, Yang Xu

entry.summary: Introduces a lightweight probe for monitoring LLM downstream performance during pretraining, addressing the gap between training loss and actual task performance. Offers fast, accurate in-training evaluation.

entry.title: TRACE: Training-Free Partial Audio Deepfake Detection via Embedding Trajectory Analysis of Speech Foundation Models

author.name: Awais Khan, Muhammad Umar Farooq, Kutub Uddin, Khalid Malik

entry.summary: Proposes TRACE, a training-free method for detecting partial audio deepfakes by analyzing embedding trajectory smoothness in speech foundation models. Genuine speech shows smooth trajectories while splice boundaries create abrupt disruptions.

entry.title: PI-JEPA: Label-Free Surrogate Pretraining for Coupled Multiphysics Simulation via Operator-Split Latent Prediction

author.name: Brandon Yee, Pairie Koh

entry.summary: Introduces PI-JEPA, a surrogate pretraining framework for reservoir simulation that trains without any completed PDE solves, using masked latent prediction on unlabeled parameter fields with PDE residual regularization aligned to operator splitting.

entry.title: CuTeGen: An LLM-Based Agentic Framework for Generation and Optimization of High-Performance GPU Kernels using CuTe

author.name: Tara Saba, Anne Ouyang, Xujie Si, Fan Long

entry.summary: Presents CuTeGen, an agentic framework for automated GPU kernel generation and optimization using LLMs with a structured generate-test-refine workflow, targeting high-performance CUDA kernels.

entry.title: CRIT: Graph-Based Automatic Data Synthesis to Enhance Cross-Modal Multi-Hop Reasoning

author.name: Junyoung Sung, Seungwoo Lyu, Minjun Kim, Sumin An, Arsha Nagrani, Paul Hongsuck Seo

entry.summary: Introduces CRIT, a graph-based automatic pipeline for generating cross-modal multi-hop reasoning training data and benchmark, where answers genuinely require combining textual and visual information across multiple steps.

entry.title: FourierMoE: Fourier Mixture-of-Experts Adaptation of Large Language Models

author.name: Juyong Jiang, Fan Wang, Hong Qi, Sunghun Kim, Jing Tang

entry.summary: Proposes FourierMoE, reformulating LLM adaptation in the spectral domain using Fourier-domain mixture of experts, finding that different tasks exhibit distinct frequency energy distributions and can be better separated spectrally.

entry.title: Enhancing the Reliability of Medical AI through Expert-guided Uncertainty Modeling

author.name: Aleksei Khalin, Ekaterina Zaychenkova, Aleksandr Yugay, Andrey Goncharov, Sergey Korchagin, Alexey Zaytsev, Egor Ershov

entry.summary: Proposes a novel uncertainty estimation method for medical AI that leverages disagreement among expert annotations to model aleatoric uncertainty. This enables better identification of high-risk cases where human review is most needed, addressing a critical gap in clinical AI deployment.

entry.title: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Control under Time-Varying Dynamics

author.name: Klemens Iten, Bruce Lee, Chenhao Li, Lenart Treven, Andreas Krause, Bhavya Sukhija

entry.summary: Studies model-based RL for control under time-varying dynamics using Gaussian process models with frequentist variation budgets. Shows that non-stationarity requires limiting outdated data influence and proposes a windowed GP approach with dynamic regret guarantees.

entry.title: Grounded Token Initialization for New Vocabulary in LMs for Generative Recommendation

author.name: Daiwei Chen, Zhoutong Fu, Chengming Jiang, Haichao Zhang, Ran Zhou, Tan Wang, Chunnan Yao, Guoyao Li, Rui Cai, Yihan Cao, Ruijie Jiang, Fedor Borisyuk, Jianqiang Shen, Jingwei Wu, Ramya Korlakai Vinayak

entry.summary: Analyzes why mean initialization for new vocabulary tokens in language models is problematic, showing it collapses tokens into a degenerate subspace, and proposes grounded initialization methods that preserve inter-token distinctions.

entry.title: TRIMS: Trajectory-Ranked Instruction Masked Supervision for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Lingjie Chen, Ruizhong Qiu, Yuyu Fan, Yanjun Zhao, Hanghang Tong

entry.summary: Proposes TRIMS, a trajectory-guided supervised fine-tuning framework for diffusion language models that provides explicit supervision over token reveal order using lightweight signals from autoregressive models.

entry.title: LESV: Language Embedded Sparse Voxel Fusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding

author.name: Fusang Wang, Nathan Piasco, Moussab Bennehar, Luis Rold\~ao, Dzmitry Tsishkou, Fabien Moutarde

entry.summary: Proposes LESV, a framework using Sparse Voxel Rasterization instead of 3D Gaussian Splatting for open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding, addressing spatial and semantic ambiguity issues in current approaches.

entry.title: Automatic Image-Level Morphological Trait Annotation for Organismal Images

author.name: Vardaan Pahuja, Samuel Stevens, Alyson East, Sydne Record, Yu Su

entry.summary: Uses sparse autoencoders on foundation model features to discover monosemantic neurons that activate on morphological parts, creating an automated pipeline for biological trait annotation from images.

entry.title: LivingWorld: Interactive 4D World Generation with Environmental Dynamics

author.name: Hyeongju Mun, In-Hwan Jin, Sohyeong Kim, Kyeongbo Kong

entry.summary: LivingWorld generates interactive 4D worlds with environmental dynamics (clouds, water, smoke) from a single image, using geometry-aware alignment for globally coherent motion field expansion.

entry.title: DynaVid: Learning to Generate Highly Dynamic Videos using Synthetic Motion Data

author.name: Wonjoon Jin, Jiyun Won, Janghyeok Han, Qi Dai, Chong Luo, Seung-Hwan Baek, Sunghyun Cho

entry.summary: DynaVid leverages synthetic motion data rendered as optical flow for training video diffusion models, enabling highly dynamic motion synthesis and fine-grained motion control that real training data lacks.

entry.title: STRIVE: Structured Spatiotemporal Exploration for Reinforcement Learning in Video Question Answering

author.name: Emad Bahrami, Olga Zatsarynna, Parth Pathak, Sunando Sengupta, Juergen Gall, Mohsen Fayyaz

entry.summary: STRIVE introduces spatiotemporal reinforcement learning for video QA that constructs visual variants of input videos for joint normalization, enriching reward signals beyond just textual diversity in GRPO-style training.

entry.title: Modular Energy Steering for Safe Text-to-Image Generation with Foundation Models

author.name: Yaoteng Tan, Zikui Cai, M. Salman Asif

entry.summary: Proposes inference-time safety steering for text-to-image generation using gradient feedback from frozen foundation models, avoiding model fine-tuning while controlling unsafe content generation.

entry.title: Generative World Renderer

author.name: Zheng-Hui Huang, Zhixiang Wang, Jiaming Tan, Ruihan Yu, Yidan Zhang, Bo Zheng, Yu-Lun Liu, Yung-Yu Chuang, Kaipeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a large-scale dynamic dataset from AAA games (4M frames with synchronized RGB and G-buffer channels) for bidirectional rendering research, plus evaluation of inverse and forward rendering methods.

entry.title: Bench2Drive-VL: Benchmarks for Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xiaosong Jia, Yuqian Shao, Zhenjie Yang, Qifeng Li, Zhiyuan Zhang, Junchi Yan

entry.summary: Bench2Drive-VL extends Bench2Drive for closed-loop evaluation of VLMs for autonomous driving, addressing the gap where existing benchmarks only evaluate scene understanding under open-loop static QA settings.

entry.title: Boosting Vision-Language-Action Finetuning with Feasible Action Neighborhood Prior

author.name: Haochen Niu, Kanyu Zhang, Shuyu Yin, Qinghai Guo, Peilin Liu, Fei Wen

entry.summary: Introduces a feasible action neighborhood (FAN) regularizer for VLA finetuning that shapes output distributions to align with the geometry of near-equivalent actions, improving generalization and sample efficiency.

entry.title: Signals: Trajectory Sampling and Triage for Agentic Interactions

author.name: Shuguang Chen, Adil Hafeez, Salman Paracha

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight signal-based framework for triaging agentic interaction trajectories at scale, computing cheap signals from live interactions for identifying informative trajectories without expensive human review or LLM evaluation.

entry.title: The Silicon Mirror: Dynamic Behavioral Gating for Anti-Sycophancy in LLM Agents

author.name: Harshee Jignesh Shah (Independent Researcher)

entry.summary: Presents an anti-sycophancy framework with behavioral access control, trait classification of persuasion tactics, and a generator-critic loop. Evaluated on TruthfulQA showing improvements in factual integrity under adversarial pressure.

entry.title: Adversarial Moral Stress Testing of Large Language Models

author.name: Saeid Jamshidi, Foutse Khomh, Arghavan Moradi Dakhel, Amin Nikanjam, Mohammad Hamdaqa, Kawser Wazed Nafi

entry.summary: Introduces Adversarial Moral Stress Testing (AMST), a framework for evaluating LLM ethical robustness under sustained adversarial multi-turn interactions, addressing limitations of single-round safety benchmarks.

entry.title: HippoCamp: Benchmarking Contextual Agents on Personal Computers

author.name: Zhe Yang, Shulin Tian, Kairui Hu, Shuai Liu, Hoang-Nhat Nguyen, Yichi Zhang, Zujin Guo, Mengying Yu, Zinan Zhang, Jingkang Yang, Chen Change Loy, Ziwei Liu

entry.summary: Introduces HippoCamp, a benchmark for evaluating agents on multimodal file management with 42.4GB of data across 2K+ real-world files and 581 QA pairs, testing search, evidence perception, and multi-step reasoning in personal computing contexts.

entry.title: When and Where: A Model Hippocampal Network Unifies Formation of Time Cells and Place Cells

author.name: Qiaorong S. Yu, Zhaoze Wang, Vijay Balasubramanian

entry.summary: A computational neuroscience paper showing that hippocampal place cells and time cells can emerge from two dynamical regimes of a single recurrent network trained as a predictive autoencoder, unifying previously separate models.

entry.title: Hierarchical Pre-Training of Vision Encoders with Large Language Models

author.name: Eugene Lee, Ting-Yu Chang, Jui-Huang Tsai, Jiajie Diao, Chen-Yi Lee

entry.summary: Proposes HIVE, a framework for hierarchical cross-attention pre-training between vision encoders and LLMs, enabling structured multi-layer feature fusion rather than flattened image embeddings.

entry.title: RAGShield: Provenance-Verified Defense-in-Depth Against Knowledge Base Poisoning in Government Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

author.name: KrishnaSaiReddy Patil

entry.summary: Proposes RAGShield, a five-layer defense framework against RAG knowledge base poisoning attacks in government systems, drawing analogy to software supply chain security with cryptographic attestation and trust-weighted retrieval.

entry.title: Optimsyn: Influence-Guided Rubrics Optimization for Synthetic Data Generation

author.name: Zhiting Fan, Ruizhe Chen, Tianxiang Hu, Ru Peng, Zenan Huang, Haokai Xu, Yixin Chen, Jian Wu, Junbo Zhao, Zuozhu Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Optimsyn, an automated rubric optimization system for synthetic data generation that uses influence functions to iteratively refine generation prompts, reducing reliance on expert-designed rubrics.

entry.title: IWP: Token Pruning as Implicit Weight Pruning in Large Vision Language Models

author.name: Dong-Jae Lee, Sunghyun Baek, Junmo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes IWP, a training-free token pruning framework for vision-language models grounded in the dual form of attention, reformulating token pruning as selecting optimal rank-1 updates to approximate the attention weight matrix.

entry.title: Scalable Pretraining of Large Mixture of Experts Language Models on Aurora Super Computer

author.name: Dharma Teja Vooturi, Dhiraj Kalamkar, Dipankar Das, Bharat Kaul

entry.summary: Showcases LLM pretraining at scale on Aurora supercomputer (127K Intel GPU tiles), training MoE models up to 220B parameters. Introduces Optimus training library for Intel PVC hardware.

entry.title: The Recipe Matters More Than the Kitchen:Mathematical Foundations of the AI Weather Prediction Pipeline

author.name: Piyush Garg, Diana R. Gergel, Andrew E. Shao, Galen J. Yacalis

entry.summary: Provides a unified mathematical framework for AI weather prediction covering the complete learning pipeline (architecture, loss function, training strategy, data distribution), grounded in approximation theory, dynamical systems, and statistical learning theory.

entry.title: Forecasting Supply Chain Disruptions with Foresight Learning

author.name: Benjamin Turtel, Paul Wilczewski, Kris Skotheim

entry.summary: Trains LLMs to produce calibrated probabilistic forecasts of supply chain disruptions using realized outcomes as supervision, substantially outperforming baselines including GPT-5 on accuracy and calibration.

entry.title: ZEUS: Accelerating Diffusion Models with Only Second-Order Predictor

author.name: Yixiao Wang, Ting Jiang, Zishan Shao, Hancheng Ye, Jingwei Sun, Mingyuan Ma, Jianyi Zhang, Yiran Chen, Hai Li

entry.summary: Proposes ZEUS, a training-free diffusion model acceleration method using only a second-order predictor, arguing that higher-order predictors amplify error under aggressive speedups and that the minimal available information (one fresh evaluation per window) only supports second-order methods.

entry.title: Thinking While Listening: Fast-Slow Recurrence for Long-Horizon Sequential Modeling

author.name: Shota Takashiro, Masanori Koyama, Takeru Miyato, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo, Kohei Hayashi

entry.summary: Extends latent recurrent modeling with fast-slow recurrence: interleaving fast recurrent latent updates with slow observation updates to maintain coherent representations over long horizons, improving OOD generalization in RL and algorithmic tasks.

entry.title: Robust Graph Representation Learning via Adaptive Spectral Contrast

author.name: Zhuolong Li, Boxue Yang, Haopeng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes ASPECT for robust graph contrastive learning, identifying a spectral dilemma where high-frequency signals needed for heterophily have higher variance under perturbations, and proving that global spectral fusion is suboptimal via regret bounds.

entry.title: Crystalite: A Lightweight Transformer for Efficient Crystal Modeling

author.name: Tin Had\v{z}i Veljkovi\'c, Joshua Rosenthal, Ivor Lon\v{c}ari\'c, Jan-Willem van de Meent

entry.summary: Presents Crystalite, a lightweight diffusion Transformer for crystal structure modeling that uses subatomic tokenization and a geometry enhancement module to inject periodic minimum-image pair geometry into attention, maintaining efficiency while capturing crystal symmetries.

entry.title: Experimental Design for Missing Physics

author.name: Arno Strouwen, Sebasti\'an Miclu\c{t}a-C\^ampeanu

entry.summary: Develops sequential experimental design for discovering missing physics using universal differential equations and symbolic regression, optimally discriminating between plausible model structures to gather maximally informative data.

entry.title: Prime Once, then Reprogram Locally: An Efficient Alternative to Black-Box Service Model Adaptation

author.name: Yunbei Zhang, Chengyi Cai, Feng Liu, Jihun Hamm

entry.summary: Proposes AReS, an alternative to zeroth-order optimization for adapting black-box API models. Uses a single-pass API interaction to prime a local pre-trained encoder, avoiding expensive iterative API calls, addressing challenges with modern APIs like GPT-4o.

entry.title: Non-monotonicity in Conformal Risk Control

author.name: Tareq Aldirawi, Yun Li, Wenge Guo

entry.summary: Studies conformal risk control under non-monotone loss functions with finite tuning parameter grids, showing that validity depends on the relationship between calibration sample size and grid size, providing corrected guarantees.

entry.title: ActionParty: Multi-Subject Action Binding in Generative Video Games

author.name: Alexander Pondaven, Ziyi Wu, Igor Gilitschenski, Philip Torr, Sergey Tulyakov, Fabio Pizzati, Aliaksandr Siarohin

entry.summary: Proposes ActionParty, a multi-subject world model for generative video games that solves action binding (associating specific actions with corresponding subjects) using subject state tokens and spatial attention mechanisms.

entry.title: Adapting Text LLMs to Speech via Multimodal Depth Up-Scaling

author.name: Kazuki Yano, Jun Suzuki, Shinji Watanabe

entry.summary: Proposes Multimodal Depth Upscaling to adapt text LLMs to speech by inserting new transformer layers into frozen text LLMs and training only those layers on speech data, achieving comparable ASR to full fine-tuning with far less text degradation.

entry.title: LangMARL: Natural Language Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Huaiyuan Yao, Longchao Da, Xiaoou Liu, Charles Fleming, Tianlong Chen, Hua Wei

entry.summary: Introduces LangMARL, a framework that brings credit assignment and policy gradient evolution from cooperative MARL into language space for LLM multi-agent coordination, addressing the causal signal problem in global outcomes.

entry.title: FGR-ColBERT: Identifying Fine-Grained Relevance Tokens During Retrieval

author.name: Anton\'in Jarol\'im, Martin Faj\v{c}\'ik

entry.summary: Proposes FGR-ColBERT, a modified ColBERT retrieval model that integrates fine-grained relevance signals distilled from an LLM into the retrieval function, achieving token-level F1 of 64.5 vs Gemma 2 27B's 62.8 while being 245x smaller.

entry.title: F3DGS: Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Decentralized Multi-Agent World Modeling

author.name: Morui Zhu, Mohammad Dehghani Tezerjani, M\'aty\'as Sz\'ant\'o, M\'arton Vaitkus, Song Fu, Qing Yang

entry.summary: F3DGS presents a federated 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for decentralized multi-agent 3D reconstruction, using shared geometric scaffolds and federated optimization while preserving geometric alignment.

entry.title: GPA: Learning GUI Process Automation from Demonstrations

author.name: Zirui Zhao, Jun Hao Liew, Yan Yang, Wenzhuo Yang, Ziyang Luo, Doyen Sahoo, Silvio Savarese, Junnan Li

entry.summary: GPA introduces a lightweight vision-based robotic process automation system that replays GUI processes from a single demonstration using Sequential Monte Carlo localization, offering deterministic execution and privacy through local operation.

entry.title: Ultrasound-CLIP: Semantic-Aware Contrastive Pre-training for Ultrasound Image-Text Understanding

author.name: Jiayun Jin, Haolong Chai, Xueying Huang, Xiaoqing Guo, Zengwei Zheng, Zhan Zhou, Junmei Wang, Xinyu Wang, Jie Liu, Binbin Zhou

entry.summary: Ultrasound-CLIP builds a 365K-sample ultrasound image-text dataset across 52 anatomical categories with hierarchical diagnostic taxonomy, creating a domain-specific CLIP model for ultrasound.

entry.title: Hidden Meanings in Plain Sight: RebusBench for Evaluating Cognitive Visual Reasoning

author.name: Seyed Amir Kasaei, Arash Marioriyad, Mahbod Khaleti, MohammadAmin Fazli, Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah, Mohammad Hossein Rohban

entry.summary: RebusBench evaluates LVLMs on rebus puzzles requiring multi-step cognitive reasoning where visual input serves as clues rather than direct answers, revealing systematic failures in abstract visual reasoning.

entry.title: HieraVid: Hierarchical Token Pruning for Fast Video Large Language Models

author.name: Yansong Guo, Chaoyang Zhu, Jiayi Ji, Jianghang Lin, Liujuan Cao

entry.summary: HieraVid proposes hierarchical token pruning for Video LLMs at segment, frame, and token levels, progressively reducing visual redundancy based on video structure and LLM information flow patterns.

entry.title: SPAR: Single-Pass Any-Resolution ViT for Open-vocabulary Segmentation

author.name: Naomi Kombol, Ivan Martinovi\'c, Sini\v{s}a \v{S}egvi\'c, Giorgos Tolias

entry.summary: SPAR enables single-pass any-resolution processing in ViTs for open-vocabulary segmentation, avoiding the expensive sliding-window strategy while maintaining accuracy for dense prediction tasks.

entry.title: AnchorVLA: Anchored Diffusion for Efficient End-to-End Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Jia Syuen Lim, Zhizhen Zhang, Peter Bohm, Brendan Tidd, Zi Huang, Yadan Luo

entry.summary: AnchorVLA proposes a diffusion-based VLA policy for mobile manipulation that uses anchored diffusion to amortize inference cost while maintaining action diversity and reactivity through periodic re-anchoring.

entry.title: Experiments on Refusal Shape in LLMs

author.name: ValueShift Research

entry.summary: Reproduces and extends experiments from 'Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction,' testing whether the single-direction assumption holds across different domains. Finds the assumption may not fully generalize.

entry.title: One Panel Does Not Fit All: Case-Adaptive Multi-Agent Deliberation for Clinical Prediction

author.name: Yuxing Lu, Yushuhong Lin, Jason Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces CAMP, a multi-agent clinical prediction framework where an attending-physician agent dynamically assembles specialist panels based on diagnostic uncertainty, using three-valued voting (KEEP/REFUSE/NEUTRAL) for principled abstention. Addresses case-level heterogeneity in clinical LLM predictions.

entry.title: Experience as a Compass: Multi-agent RAG with Evolving Orchestration and Agent Prompts

author.name: Sha Li, Naren Ramakrishnan

entry.summary: Proposes HERA, a hierarchical framework that jointly evolves multi-agent RAG orchestration and role-specific agent prompts through reward-guided sampling and experience accumulation for complex multi-hop tasks.

entry.title: Quantifying Gender Bias in Large Language Models: When ChatGPT Becomes a Hiring Manager

author.name: Nina Gerszberg, Janka Hamori, Andrew Lo

entry.summary: Quantifies gender bias in LLM hiring decisions, finding that LLMs are more likely to hire female candidates and perceive them as more qualified, but still recommend lower pay relative to male candidates.

entry.title: How Do Language Models Process Ethical Instructions? Deliberation, Consistency, and Other-Recognition Across Four Models

author.name: Hiroki Fukui

entry.summary: Conducts 600+ multi-agent simulations across 4 models to study how LLMs process ethical instructions, finding model-specific responses to different ethical framings and proposing new metrics for deliberation depth and value consistency.

entry.title: GenoBERT: A Language Model for Accurate Genotype Imputation

author.name: Lei Huang, Chuan Qiu, Kuan-Jui Su, Anqi Liu, Yun Gong, Weiqiang Lin, Lindong Jiang, Chen Zhao, Meng Song, Jeffrey Deng, Qing Tian, Zhe Luo, Ping Gong, Hui Shen, Chaoyang Zhang, Hong-Wen Deng

entry.summary: Presents GenoBERT, a BERT-based model for genotype imputation that captures long-range linkage disequilibrium dependencies without reference panels, outperforming conventional methods especially for rare variants and diverse ancestries.

entry.title: REM-CTX: Automated Peer Review via Reinforcement Learning with Auxiliary Context

author.name: Pawin Taechoyotin, Daniel E. Acuna

entry.summary: Introduces REM-CTX, an RL-based automated peer review system that incorporates figures and external scholarly signals via correspondence-aware reward functions, training an 8B model with GRPO to generate higher quality reviews.

entry.title: G-Drift MIA: Membership Inference via Gradient-Induced Feature Drift in LLMs

author.name: Ravi Ranjan, Utkarsh Grover, Xiaomin Lin, Agoritsa Polyzou

entry.summary: Proposes G-Drift MIA, a white-box membership inference attack for LLMs that measures gradient-induced changes in internal representations after a single gradient-ascent step, outperforming probability-based methods.

entry.title: Towards Initialization-dependent and Non-vacuous Generalization Bounds for Overparameterized Shallow Neural Networks

author.name: Yunwen Lei, Yufeng Xie

entry.summary: Develops initialization-dependent generalization bounds for overparameterized shallow neural networks that avoid dependence on the spectral norm of the initialization matrix, addressing the gap in explaining benign overfitting.

entry.title: WARP: Guaranteed Inner-Layer Repair of NLP Transformers

author.name: Hsin-Ling Hsu, Min-Yu Chen, Nai-Chia Chen, Yan-Ru Chen, Yi-Ling Chang, Fang Yu

entry.summary: Proposes WARP, a constraint-based repair framework for transformer NLP models that extends guaranteed repair beyond the last layer by formulating it as a convex quadratic program from linearized logit gaps.

entry.title: Query-Conditioned Evidential Keyframe Sampling for MLLM-Based Long-Form Video Understanding

author.name: Yiheng Wang, Lichen Zhu, Yueqian Lin, Yudong Liu, Jingyang Zhang, Hai "Helen" Li, Yiran Chen

entry.summary: Proposes an evidence-driven keyframe sampling framework for long-form video understanding grounded in information bottleneck theory, maximizing conditional mutual information between selected frames and the query.

entry.title: Neural Harmonic Textures for High-Quality Primitive Based Neural Reconstruction

author.name: Jorge Condor, Nicolas Moenne-Loccoz, Merlin Nimier-David, Piotr Didyk, Zan Gojcic, Qi Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Neural Harmonic Textures for primitive-based 3D reconstruction (like Gaussian Splatting), anchoring latent features on virtual scaffolds around each primitive and using periodic activations inspired by Fourier analysis to improve high-frequency detail modeling.

entry.title: Care-Conditioned Neuromodulation for Autonomy-Preserving Supportive Dialogue Agents

author.name: Shalima Binta Manir, Tim Oates

entry.summary: Introduces Care-Conditioned Neuromodulation (CCN) for supportive dialogue agents, using a learned scalar signal from user state to condition response generation, formalizing autonomy-preserving alignment that penalizes dependency and coercion.

entry.title: Learn by Surprise, Commit by Proof

author.name: Kang-Sin Choi

entry.summary: Proposes LSCP, a self-gated post-training framework where models autonomously identify knowledge gaps via anomalous per-token loss, generate self-verification Q&A chains, and adjust optimizer parameters proportional to conviction. Requires no external oracle.

entry.title: Auction-Based Online Policy Adaptation for Evolving Objectives

author.name: Guruprerana Shabadi, Kaushik Mallik

entry.summary: Proposes an auction-based mechanism for multi-objective RL where modular local policies bid for action execution based on state urgency, enabling dynamic adaptation as objectives appear or disappear at runtime.

entry.title: Taming the Exponential: A Fast Softmax Surrogate for Integer-Native Edge Inference

author.name: Dimitrios Danopoulos, Enrico Lupi, Michael Kagan, Maurizio Pierini

entry.summary: Proposes HCCS, a bounded monotone surrogate for softmax using clipped linear mapping with per-head calibration parameters, designed for integer-native edge inference where exponentiation is a computational bottleneck in small Transformer models.

entry.title: Demographic Parity Tails for Regression

author.name: Naht Sinh Le (LAMA), Christophe Denis (SAMM), Mohamed Hebiri (LAMA)

entry.summary: Proposes demographic parity focused on distribution tails rather than the full distribution, using optimal transport theory to enforce fairness constraints only in targeted regions, enabling more nuanced fairness interventions for regression.

entry.title: Gradient estimators for parameter inference in discrete stochastic kinetic models

author.name: Ludwig Burger, Annalena Kofler, Lukas Heinrich, Ulrich Gerland

entry.summary: Adapts three gradient estimators (Gumbel-Softmax, Score Function, Alternative Path) from machine learning for the Gillespie stochastic simulation algorithm, enabling gradient-based parameter inference in discrete stochastic kinetic models.

entry.title: Agent Q-Mix: Selecting the Right Action for LLM Multi-Agent Systems through Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Eric Hanchen Jiang, Levina Li, Rui Sun, Xiao Liang, Yubei Li, Yuchen Wu, Haozheng Luo, Hengli Li, Zhi Zhang, Zhaolu Kang, Kai-Wei Chang, Ying Nian Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Agent Q-Mix, a reinforcement learning framework using QMIX value factorization for learning communication topologies in LLM multi-agent systems, combining GNN encoders with per-agent Q-heads.

entry.title: Positional Cognitive Specialization: Where Do LLMs Learn To Comprehend and Speak Your Language?

author.name: Luis Frentzen Salim, Lun-Wei Ku, Hsing-Kuo Kenneth Pao

entry.summary: Investigates how LLMs acquire new languages during training through the lens of perceptual (comprehension) and productive (generation) cognitive specialization, revealing position-dependent layer specialization patterns.

entry.title: ParetoBandit: Budget-Paced Adaptive Routing for Non-Stationary LLM Serving

author.name: Annette Taberner-Miller

entry.summary: Presents ParetoBandit, an adaptive LLM router using cost-aware contextual bandits that enforces dollar budgets, adapts to non-stationary pricing/quality shifts, and onboards new models at runtime.

entry.title: A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models

author.name: Mingyang Song, Mao Zheng

entry.summary: Surveys on-policy distillation for LLMs, where students learn from their own generated trajectories with teacher feedback, organizing methods and connecting to interactive imitation learning theory.

entry.title: Multimodal Language Models Cannot Spot Spatial Inconsistencies

author.name: Om Khangaonkar, Hadi J. Rad, Hamed Pirsiavash

entry.summary: Introduces a task and evaluation method for testing whether multimodal LLMs can identify objects that violate 3D spatial consistency across two views of a scene, finding significant underperformance compared to humans.

entry.title: EgoFlow: Gradient-Guided Flow Matching for Egocentric 6DoF Object Motion Generation

author.name: Abhishek Saroha, Huajian Zeng, Xingxing Zuo, Daniel Cremers, Xi Wang

entry.summary: EgoFlow uses flow matching to generate physically plausible 6DoF object trajectories from egocentric video, employing a hybrid Mamba-Transformer-Perceiver architecture with gradient-guided physics constraints during inference.

entry.title: ReFlow: Self-correction Motion Learning for Dynamic Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Yanzhe Liang, Ruijie Zhu, Hanzhi Chang, Zhuoyuan Li, Jiahao Lu, Tianzhu Zhang

entry.summary: ReFlow presents a self-correction framework for monocular dynamic scene reconstruction that learns 3D motion from raw video without requiring external motion guidance like optical flow.

entry.title: SteerFlow: Steering Rectified Flows for Faithful Inversion-Based Image Editing

author.name: Thinh Dao, Zhen Wang, Kien T. Pham, Long Chen

entry.summary: SteerFlow proposes a model-agnostic image editing framework for flow-based generative models with theoretical guarantees on source fidelity, using an amortized fixed-point solver for trajectory straightening.

entry.title: A3R: Agentic Affordance Reasoning via Cross-Dimensional Evidence in 3D Gaussian Scenes

author.name: Di Li, Jie Feng, Guanbin Li, Ronghua Shang, Yuhui Zheng, Weisheng Dong, Guangming Shi

entry.summary: A3R reformulates 3D affordance reasoning as sequential evidence acquisition, where an agent progressively reduces ambiguity through complementary 3D geometric and 2D semantic evidence in Gaussian scenes.

entry.title: Interactive Tracking: A Human-in-the-Loop Paradigm with Memory-Augmented Adaptation

author.name: Yuqing Huang, Guotian Zeng, Zhenqiao Yuan, Zhenyu He, Xin Li, Yaowei Wang, Ming-Hsuan Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Interactive Tracking, a new paradigm allowing users to guide visual trackers via natural language commands during tracking. Presents InteractTrack benchmark with 150 videos and evaluates 25 trackers, showing current SOTA methods fail in interactive scenarios.

entry.title: Jagle: Building a Large-Scale Japanese Multimodal Post-Training Dataset for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Issa Sugiura, Keito Sasagawa, Keisuke Nakao, Koki Maeda, Ziqi Yin, Zhishen Yang, Shuhei Kurita, Yusuke Oda, Ryoko Tokuhisa, Daisuke Kawahara, Naoaki Okazaki

entry.summary: Jagle introduces the largest Japanese multimodal post-training dataset (9.2M instances) for VLMs, constructed by collecting heterogeneous source data and generating VQA pairs rather than relying on existing datasets.

entry.title: Beyond Referring Expressions: Scenario Comprehension Visual Grounding

author.name: Ruozhen He, Nisarg A. Shah, Qihua Dong, Zilin Xiao, Jaywon Koo, Vicente Ordonez

entry.summary: Introduces scenario-based visual grounding (RSC benchmark) requiring inference from roles, intentions, and relational context rather than explicit naming, with paragraph-length queries and deliberate distractors.

entry.title: Stop Wandering: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation via Metacognitive Reasoning

author.name: Xueying Li, Feng Lyu, Hao Wu, Mingliu Liu, Jia-Nan Liu, Guozi Liu

entry.summary: MetaNav introduces metacognitive capabilities (progress monitoring, strategy diagnosis, reflective correction) for VLN agents, addressing inefficient behaviors like local oscillation and redundant revisiting through history-aware planning.

entry.title: Low-Burden LLM-Based Preference Learning: Personalizing Assistive Robots from Natural Language Feedback for Users with Paralysis

author.name: Keshav Shankar, Dan Ding, Wei Gao

entry.summary: Proposes a low-burden framework for personalizing assistive robots using natural language feedback, grounding LLM interpretation in the Occupational Therapy Practice Framework to translate subjective reactions into robotic control policies.

entry.title: Bridging Large-Model Reasoning and Real-Time Control via Agentic Fast-Slow Planning

author.name: Jiayi Chen, Shuai Wang, Guangxu Zhu, Chengzhong Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Agentic Fast-Slow Planning that decouples perception, reasoning, planning, and control across natural timescales for autonomous driving, using VLM for perception and LLM for high-level reasoning while MPC handles real-time control.

entry.title: Causal Scene Narration with Runtime Safety Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Driving

author.name: Yun Li, Yidu Zhang, Simon Thompson, Ehsan Javanmardi, Manabu Tsukada

entry.summary: Introduces Causal Scene Narration for autonomous driving VLA models that restructures text inputs through intent-constraint alignment and quantitative grounding, complemented by runtime safety supervision and Plackett-Luce DPO training.

entry.title: Can We Secure AI With Formal Methods? January-March 2026

author.name: Quinn

entry.summary: Quarterly review of formal methods applied to AI security (Jan-March 2026), covering the explosion of work on secure program synthesis and AI verification. Notes the field is going exponential and increasingly focused on agentic systems.

entry.title: Logarithmic Scores, Power-Law Discoveries: Disentangling Measurement from Coverage in Agent-Based Evaluation

author.name: HyunJoon Jung, William Na

entry.summary: Analyzes LLM-based agent judges for conversational AI evaluation, showing that quality scores improve logarithmically with panel size while unique issue discoveries follow a sublinear power law, revealing a score-coverage dissociation.

entry.title: VeriAct: Beyond Verifiability -- Agentic Synthesis of Correct and Complete Formal Specifications

author.name: Md Rakib Hossain Misu, Iris Ma, Cristina V. Lopes

entry.summary: Examines whether LLM-generated formal specifications (JML) that pass verification are actually correct and complete, finding significant gaps. Proposes VeriAct, an agentic system that improves specification synthesis beyond mere verifiability.

entry.title: Bias Inheritance in Neural-Symbolic Discovery of Constitutive Closures Under Function-Class Mismatch

author.name: Hanbing Liang, Ze Tao, Fujun Liu

entry.summary: Investigates bias inheritance in neural-symbolic discovery of constitutive closures, showing that low residuals don't guarantee physical recovery. Proposes a three-stage framework with forward re-simulation validation.

entry.title: CompassAD: Intent-Driven 3D Affordance Grounding in Functionally Competing Objects

author.name: Jingliang Li, Jindou Jia, Tuo An, Chuhao Zhou, Xiangyu Chen, Shilin Shan, Boyu Ma, Bofan Lyu, Gen Li, Jianfei Yang

entry.summary: CompassAD formalizes intent-driven 3D affordance grounding in scenes with functionally competing objects (e.g., choosing knife over scissors for cutting), introducing a new setting requiring disambiguation of objects sharing identical affordances.

entry.title: Decision-Centric Design for LLM Systems

author.name: Wei Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a decision-centric framework for LLM systems that separates decision-relevant signals from the policy that maps them to actions, making control decisions (route, retrieve, escalate) explicit and inspectable rather than implicit within generation.

entry.title: Can LLMs Perceive Time? An Empirical Investigation

author.name: Aniketh Garikaparthi

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs can estimate task duration, finding systematic failures: pre-task estimates overshoot by 4-7x, relative ordering is at or below chance, and post-hoc recall is disconnected from reality.

entry.title: Task-Centric Personalized Federated Fine-Tuning of Language Models

author.name: Gabriel U. Talasso, Meghdad Kurmanji, Allan M. de Souza, Nicholas D. Lane, Leandro A. Villas

entry.summary: Proposes task-centric personalized federated fine-tuning for language models that addresses generalization to unseen tasks and intra-client task interference during federated learning.

entry.title: Agentic AI and Occupational Displacement: A Multi-Regional Task Exposure Analysis of Emerging Labor Market Disruption

author.name: Ravish Gupta, Saket Kumar

entry.summary: Extends the Acemoglu-Restrepo labor economics framework to analyze how agentic AI (autonomous end-to-end workflow completion) differs from traditional task-level automation in occupational displacement risk. Introduces an Agentic Task Exposure (ATE) score computed from O*NET data.

entry.title: Benchmarking Interaction, Beyond Policy: a Reproducible Benchmark for Collaborative Instance Object Navigation

author.name: Edoardo Zorzi, Francesco Taioli, Yiming Wang, Marco Cristani, Alessandro Farinelli, Alberto Castellini, Loris Bazzani

entry.summary: Proposes QAsk-Nav, the first reproducible benchmark for collaborative instance object navigation that separately evaluates navigation and question-asking abilities in embodied agents using natural language dialogue.

entry.title: First Logit Boosting: Visual Grounding Method to Mitigate Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jiwoo Ha, Jongwoo Baek, Jinhyun So

entry.summary: Proposes First Logit Boosting (FLB) to mitigate object hallucination in large vision-language models by boosting visual grounding in the first generated token's logits, addressing long-term decay in contrastive decoding.

entry.title: UniMixer: A Unified Architecture for Scaling Laws in Recommendation Systems

author.name: Mingming Ha, Guanchen Wang, Linxun Chen, Xuan Rao, Yuexin Shi, Tianbao Ma, Zhaojie Liu, Yunqian Fan, Zilong Lu, Yanan Niu, Han Li, Kun Gai

entry.summary: Proposes UniMixer, a unified scaling architecture for recommendation systems that unifies attention-based, TokenMixer-based, and factorization-machine approaches into a single framework for improved scaling efficiency.

entry.title: AutoEG: Exploiting Known Third-Party Vulnerabilities in Black-Box Web Applications

author.name: Ruozhao Yang, Mingfei Cheng, Gelei Deng, Junjie Wang, Tianwei Zhang, Xiaofei Xie

entry.summary: Proposes AutoEG, an LLM-based system for automatically generating exploits for known third-party vulnerabilities in black-box web applications, addressing precise vulnerability triggering and exploit adaptation.

entry.title: GRASP: Gradient Realignment via Active Shared Perception for Multi-Agent Collaborative Optimization

author.name: Sihan Zhou, Tiantian He, Yifan Lu, Yaqing Hou, Yew-Soon Ong

entry.summary: Proposes GRASP, a multi-agent RL framework that uses gradient sharing for active perception of other agents' policies, defining generalized Bellman equilibrium as a stable optimization objective.

entry.title: OrgAgent: Organize Your Multi-Agent System like a Company

author.name: Yiru Wang, Xinyue Shen, Yaohui Han, Michael Backes, Pin-Yu Chen, Tsung-Yi Ho

entry.summary: Introduces OrgAgent, a company-style hierarchical multi-agent framework with governance, execution, and compliance layers, showing that hierarchical organization generally outperforms flat multi-agent systems for reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Massively Parallel Exact Inference for Hawkes Processes

author.name: Ahmer Raza, Hudson Smith

entry.summary: Shows that Hawkes process intensity can be expressed as sparse transition matrix products enabling parallel prefix scan computation on GPUs, reducing MLE from sequential O(N) to massively parallel computation.

entry.title: Malliavin Calculus for Counterfactual Gradient Estimation in Adaptive Inverse Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Vikram Krishnamurthy, Luke Snow

entry.summary: Proposes using Malliavin calculus for counterfactual gradient estimation in adaptive inverse reinforcement learning, overcoming the inefficiency of Monte Carlo estimators for events of probability zero.

entry.title: Residuals-based Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Qing Zhu, Xian Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a residuals-based offline RL framework that incorporates estimation error from transition dynamics into policy optimization via empirical residuals, working for general state and action spaces.

entry.title: Learning ECG Image Representations via Dual Physiological-Aware Alignments

author.name: Hung Manh Pham, Jialu Tang, Aaqib Saeed, Dong Ma, Bin Zhu, Pan Zhou

entry.summary: Presents ECG-Scan, a self-supervised framework for learning ECG image representations using dual physiological-aware alignments: multimodal contrastive alignment between image and signal-text modalities, plus soft-lead constraints encoding domain knowledge.

entry.title: DDCL-INCRT: A Self-Organising Transformer with Hierarchical Prototype Structure (Theoretical Foundations)

author.name: Giansalvo Cirrincione

entry.summary: Introduces DDCL-INCRT, a self-organizing transformer that determines its own structure during training by combining prototype-based competitive learning with incremental architecture growth.

entry.title: PAC-Bayesian Reward-Certified Outcome Weighted Learning

author.name: Yuya Ishikawa, Shu Tamano

entry.summary: Introduces PROWL, a PAC-Bayesian framework for outcome weighted learning that provides finite-sample guarantees when observed rewards are noisy proxies for true utility. Constructs conservative reward bounds to prevent policy selection with inflated performance.

entry.title: go-$m$HC: Direct Parameterization of Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections via Generalized Orthostochastic Matrices

author.name: Torque Dandachi, Sophia Diggs-Galligan

entry.summary: Introduces a novel parameterization of doubly stochastic matrices based on generalized orthostochastic matrices for learned residual stream mixing, scaling as O(d³) with a tunable expressivity-efficiency tradeoff. Builds on Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections.

entry.title: Infeasibility Aware Large Language Models for Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Yakun Wang, Min Chen, Zeguan Wu, Junyu Liu, Sitao Zhang, Zhenwen Shao

entry.summary: Proposes an infeasibility-aware framework for LLMs applied to combinatorial optimization, combining certifiable dataset construction, supervised fine-tuning, and LLM-assisted search with provable zero-phase infeasibility screening for the minor-embedding problem.

entry.title: Investigating Permutation-Invariant Discrete Representation Learning for Spatially Aligned Images

author.name: Jamie S. J. Stirling, Noura Al-Moubayed, Hubert P. H. Shum

entry.summary: Proposes permutation-invariant vector-quantized autoencoders (PI-VQ) that constrain latent codes to carry no positional information, encouraging global semantic features and enabling direct interpolation between spatially aligned images without learned priors.

entry.title: RuleForge: Automated Generation and Validation for Web Vulnerability Detection at Scale

author.name: Ayush Garg, Sophia Hager, Jacob Montiel, Aditya Tiwari, Michael Gentile, Zach Reavis, David Magnotti, Wayne Fullen

entry.summary: Presents RuleForge, an AWS internal system that automatically generates web vulnerability detection rules from Nuclei templates using LLMs, addressing the gap between CVE disclosure volume and manual rule creation capacity.

entry.title: Topological Effects in Neural Network Field Theory

author.name: Christian Ferko, James Halverson, Vishnu Jejjala, Brandon Robinson

entry.summary: Extends neural network field theory to topological settings, recovering the BKT transition and verifying T-duality of the bosonic string, showing neural network ensembles can capture topological effects in physics.

entry.title: A Taxonomy of Programming Languages for Code Generation

author.name: Nishat Raihan, Christian Newman, Marcos Zampieri

entry.summary: Presents the first resource-tier taxonomy for programming languages (646 languages in 4 tiers), showing extreme concentration where 1.9% of languages account for 74.6% of tokens in major code corpora.

entry.title: Speech LLMs are Contextual Reasoning Transcribers

author.name: Keqi Deng, Ruchao Fan, Bo Ren, Yiming Wang, Jinyu Li

entry.summary: Proposes Chain-of-Thought ASR (CoT-ASR) where speech LLMs first generate contextual analysis before transcription, enabling richer use of LLM knowledge and supporting user-guided transcription in a single pass.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Variational Reward Factorization via Probabilistic Preference Bases for LLM Personalization

author.name: Gyuseok Lee, Wonbin Kweon, Zhenrui Yue, SeongKu Kang, Jiawei Han, Dong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Variational Reward Factorization (VRF) for LLM personalization, representing user preferences as variational distributions and using Wasserstein distance matching with shared probabilistic bases.

entry.title: MF-QAT: Multi-Format Quantization-Aware Training for Elastic Inference

author.name: Zifei Xu, Sayeh Sharify, Hesham Mostafa

entry.summary: Studies multi-format quantization-aware training where a single model is trained to be robust across multiple quantization formats, finding it can match single-format QAT at each precision level.

entry.title: Sparse Spectral LoRA: Routed Experts for Medical VLMs

author.name: Omid Nejati Manzari, Hojat Asgariandehkordi, Taha Koleilat, Yiming Xiao, Hassan Rivaz

entry.summary: Proposes MedQwen, a parameter-efficient medical VLM using spectrally routed MoE with LoRA experts, incorporating a scaling rule to align low-rank updates with full-rank fine-tuned MoE behavior.

entry.title: Better Rigs, Not Bigger Networks: A Body Model Ablation for Gaussian Avatars

author.name: Derek Austin

entry.summary: Demonstrates that replacing SMPL with the Momentum Human Rig (MHR) in Gaussian splatting avatar pipelines achieves highest reported PSNR on PeopleSnapshot and ZJU-MoCap without learned deformations, suggesting better body models matter more than complex networks.

entry.title: Universal computational thermal imaging overcoming the ghosting effect

author.name: Hongyi Xu, Du Wang, Chenjun Zhao, Jiashuo Chen, Jiale Lin, Liqin Cao, Yanfei Zhong, Yiyuan She, Fanglin Bao

entry.summary: Proposes TAG (thermal anti-ghosting), a universal computational thermal imaging framework that addresses the ghosting effect in thermal imaging for scenes with non-uniform materials, extending HADAR capabilities.

entry.title: Satellite-Free Training for Drone-View Geo-Localization

author.name: Tao Liu, Yingzhi Zhang, Kan Ren, Xiaoqi Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes satellite-free training for drone-view geo-localization using multi-view UAV sequences to construct geometry-normalized representations, eliminating the need for satellite imagery during training.

entry.title: NEMESIS: Noise-suppressed Efficient MAE with Enhanced Superpatch Integration Strategy

author.name: Kyeonghun Kim, Hyeonseok Jung, Youngung Han, Hyunsu Go, Eunseob Choi, Seongbin Park, Junsu Lim, Jiwon Yang, Sumin Lee, Insung Hwang, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Nam-Joon Kim

entry.summary: NEMESIS proposes a masked autoencoder framework for 3D CT volumes using local superpatches with noise-enhanced reconstruction, masked anatomical transformer blocks, and anatomy-aware masking for memory-efficient self-supervised learning.

entry.title: Director: Instance-aware Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scene Modeling and Understanding

author.name: Yuheng Jiang, Yiwen Cai, Zihao Wang, Yize Wu, Sicheng Li, Zhuo Su, Shaohui Jiao, Lan Xu

entry.summary: Director proposes a unified spatio-temporal Gaussian representation for dynamic scenes that jointly models human performance, rendering, and instance-level semantics for volumetric video.

entry.title: Bias mitigation in graph diffusion models

author.name: Meng Yu, Kun Zhan

entry.summary: Identifies and addresses two bias problems in graph diffusion models: reverse-starting bias from mismatched perturbation distributions and exposure bias, using Langevin sampling and score correction.

entry.title: Control-DINO: Feature Space Conditioning for Controllable Image-to-Video Diffusion

author.name: Edoardo A. Dominici, Thomas Deixelberger, Konstantinos Vardis, Markus Steinberger

entry.summary: Control-DINO uses high-dimensional self-supervised features (like DINOv2) as conditioning signals for pretrained video diffusion models, enabling controllable image-to-video generation.

entry.title: GeoAI Agency Primitives

author.name: Akram Zaytar, Rohan Sawahn, Caleb Robinson, Gilles Q. Hacheme, Girmaw A. Tadesse, Inbal Becker-Reshef, Rahul Dodhia, Juan Lavista Ferres

entry.summary: Proposes 9 agency primitives for GeoAI assistants connecting foundation models to GIS practitioner workflows, including navigation, perception, geo-referenced memory, and dual modeling capabilities.

entry.title: Resonance4D: Frequency-Domain Motion Supervision for Preset-Free Physical Parameter Learning in 4D Dynamic Physical Scene Simulation

author.name: Changshe Zhang, Jie Feng, Siyu Chen, Guanbin Li, Ronghua Shang, Junpeng Zhang

entry.summary: Resonance4D presents a physics-driven 4D dynamic simulation framework coupling 3D Gaussian Splatting with Material Point Method, using frequency-domain motion supervision instead of expensive video diffusion or optical flow pipelines.

entry.title: COMPASS: Complete Multimodal Fusion via Proxy Tokens and Shared Spaces for Ubiquitous Sensing

author.name: Hao Wang, Yanyu Qian, Pengcheng Weng, Zixuan Xia, William Dan, Yangxin Xu, Fei Wang

entry.summary: COMPASS addresses missing modalities in multimodal sensing by maintaining a fixed N-slot fusion input, synthesizing proxy tokens for missing modalities so the fusion head always sees complete structure during inference.

entry.title: Non-Rigid 3D Shape Correspondences: From Foundations to Open Challenges and Opportunities

author.name: Aleksei Zhuravlev, Lennart Bastian, Dongliang Cao, Nafie El Amrani, Paul Roetzer, Viktoria Ehm, Riccardo Marin, Hiroki Nishizawa, Shigeo Morishima, Christian Theobalt, Nassir Navab, Daniel Cremers, Florian Bernard, Zorah L\"ahner, Vladislav Golyanik

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of non-rigid 3D shape correspondence methods, categorizing approaches into spectral (functional maps), combinatorial, and deformation-based paradigms, with analysis of open challenges.

entry.title: Novel Memory Forgetting Techniques for Autonomous AI Agents: Balancing Relevance and Efficiency

author.name: Payal Fofadiya, Sunil Tiwari

entry.summary: Introduces an adaptive budgeted forgetting framework for conversational AI agents, using relevance-guided scoring (recency, frequency, semantic alignment) to manage memory under constrained context windows.

entry.title: Learning When to See and When to Feel: Adaptive Vision-Torque Fusion for Contact-Aware Manipulation

author.name: Jiuzhou Lei, Chang Liu, Yu She, Xiao Liang, Minghui Zheng

entry.summary: Compares different strategies for integrating vision and force/torque signals in diffusion-based manipulation policies, introducing an adaptive strategy that transitions between sensing modalities based on task phase.

entry.title: AURA: Multimodal Shared Autonomy for Real-World Urban Navigation

author.name: Yukai Ma, Honglin He, Selina Song, Wayne Wu, Bolei Zhou

entry.summary: AURA presents a multimodal shared autonomy framework for urban navigation where humans provide high-level instructions and AI handles low-level control, using a Spatial-Aware Instruction Encoder to align various input modalities.

entry.title: Posterior Optimization with Clipped Objective for Bridging Efficiency and Stability in Generative Policy Learning

author.name: Yuhui Chen, Haoran Li, Zhennan Jiang, Yuxing Qin, Yuxuan Wan, Weiheng Liu, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces POCO, a reinforcement learning framework that formulates policy improvement as posterior inference for generative robotic manipulation policies. Uses an Expectation-Maximization procedure with clipped objectives for stable offline-to-online fine-tuning of action-chunk policies.

entry.title: Automated AI R&D and AI Alignment

author.name: Eleni Angelou

entry.summary: Examines what it means to automate AI alignment research, drawing on philosophy of science to argue that alignment is a pre-paradigmatic field requiring 'revolutionary science' rather than routine automation. Questions whether AI systems can meaningfully contribute to the creative, paradigm-shifting work alignment requires.

entry.title: Reviewing the evidence on psychological manipulation by Bots and AI

author.name: D Wong

entry.summary: Reviews empirical evidence on psychological manipulation by AI chatbots, concluding that hyper-persuasion is unlikely to be a serious threat currently. Advocates for more research on long-term influence from AI companions rather than one-off manipulation.

entry.title: SHOE: Semantic HOI Open-Vocabulary Evaluation Metric

author.name: Maja Noack, Qinqian Lei, Taipeng Tian, Bihan Dong, Robby T. Tan, Yixin Chen, John Young, Saijun Zhang, Bo Wang

entry.summary: SHOE introduces a semantic evaluation metric for open-vocabulary human-object interaction detection that credits semantically valid but lexically different predictions, moving beyond rigid categorical matching.

entry.title: WHBench: Evaluating Frontier LLMs with Expert-in-the-Loop Validation on Women's Health Topics

author.name: Sneha Maurya, Pragya Saboo, Girish Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces WHBench, a women's health evaluation benchmark with 47 expert-crafted scenarios and 23-criterion rubric, evaluating 22 models and finding no model achieves consistently safe and accurate responses across all topics.

entry.title: BloClaw: An Omniscient, Multi-Modal Agentic Workspace for Next-Generation Scientific Discovery

author.name: Yao Qin, Yangyang Yan, Jinhua Pang, Xiaoming Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces BloClaw, a multi-modal operating system for AI-assisted scientific discovery that addresses infrastructure limitations of current AI scientist frameworks through XML-Regex tool-calling and improved execution sandboxes.

entry.title: PsychAgent: An Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning Agent for Self-Evolving Psychological Counselor

author.name: Yutao Yang, Junsong Li, Qianjun Pan, Jie Zhou, Kai Chen, Qin Chen, Jingyuan Zhao, Ningning Zhou, Xin Li, Liang He

entry.summary: Proposes PsychAgent, an experience-driven lifelong learning agent for psychological counseling that maintains persistent memory, plans strategically across sessions, and extracts new skills from historical counseling trajectories.

entry.title: Temporal Memory for Resource-Constrained Agents: Continual Learning via Stochastic Compress-Add-Smooth

author.name: Michael Chertkov

entry.summary: Proposes a memory framework for resource-constrained agents using Bridge Diffusion as a stochastic process for memory, with a Compress-Add-Smooth recursion for incorporating new experience under fixed memory budgets.

entry.title: Making Sense of AI Agents Hype: Adoption, Architectures, and Takeaways from Practitioners

author.name: Ruoyu Su, Matteo Esposito, Roberta Capuano, Rafiullah Omar, June Sallou, Henry Muccini, Davide Taibi

entry.summary: Analyzes 138 practitioner conference talks on AI agents to identify how companies adopt agent-based architectures, recurring patterns, and technologies used in real-world industrial LLM-driven agentic systems.

entry.title: MAESIL: Masked Autoencoder for Enhanced Self-supervised Medical Image Learning

author.name: Kyeonghun Kim, Hyeonseok Jung, Youngung Han, Junsu Lim, YeonJu Jean, Seongbin Park, Eunseob Choi, Hyunsu Go, SeoYoung Ju, Seohyoung Park, Gyeongmin Kim, MinJu Kwon, KyungSeok Yuh, Soo Yong Kim, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Nam-Joon Kim, Hyuk-Jae Lee

entry.summary: Proposes MAESIL, a masked autoencoder for self-supervised learning on 3D medical CT scans that preserves axial coherence rather than treating volumes as independent 2D slices.

entry.title: Streaming Model Cascades for Semantic SQL

author.name: Pawe{\l} Liskowski, Kyle Schmaus
