entry.summary: Presents adaptive cascade algorithms for streaming SQL with semantic LLM operators, routing most rows through cheap proxy models while delegating uncertain cases to expensive models, designed for per-partition execution.

entry.title: Emotion Entanglement and Bayesian Inference for Multi-Dimensional Emotion Understanding

author.name: Hemanth Kotaprolu, Kishan Maharaj, Raey Zhao, Abhijit Mishra, Pushpak Bhattacharyya

entry.summary: Introduces EmoScene, a benchmark of 4,731 scenarios with 8-dimensional emotion vectors from Plutchik's theory, and proposes emotion entanglement + Bayesian inference to model structured dependencies among emotions in LLMs.

entry.title: Flow-based Policy With Distributional Reinforcement Learning in Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Ruijie Hao, Longfei Zhang, Yang Dai, Yang Ma, Xingxing Liang, Guangquan Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes FP-DRL, combining flow matching-based policies with distributional RL for trajectory optimization, enabling multimodal policy representation and richer return distributions for policy guidance.

entry.title: Lightweight Prompt-Guided CLIP Adaptation for Monocular Depth Estimation

author.name: Reyhaneh Ahani Manghotay (Simon Fraser University, Burnaby, Canada), Jie Liang (Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo, China)

entry.summary: Introduces MoA-DepthCLIP, a parameter-efficient framework adapting pretrained CLIP for monocular depth estimation using a Mixture-of-Adapters module with minimal supervision, achieving competitive results with far fewer tunable parameters.

entry.title: JetPrism: diagnosing convergence for generative simulation and inverse problems in nuclear physics

author.name: Zeyu Xia, Tyler Kim, Trevor Reed, Judy Fox, Geoffrey Fox, Adam Szczepaniak

entry.summary: Demonstrates that Conditional Flow Matching's standard training loss is fundamentally misleading for physics applications, plateauing prematurely. Introduces JetPrism, a configurable CFM framework for evaluating generative surrogates in nuclear physics.

entry.title: SECURE: Stable Early Collision Understanding via Robust Embeddings in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Wenjing Wang, Wenxuan Wang, Songning Lai

entry.summary: Introduces SECURE framework for robust accident anticipation in autonomous driving, revealing that SOTA models like CRASH are unstable under minor perturbations and proposing formal robustness constraints in both prediction and latent space.

entry.title: DISCO-TAB: A Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning Framework for Privacy-Preserving Synthesis of Complex Clinical Data

author.name: Arshia Ilaty, Hossein Shirazi, Amir Rahmani, Hajar Homayouni

entry.summary: Introduces DISCO-TAB, combining fine-tuned LLMs with multi-objective discriminators optimized via RL to generate privacy-preserving synthetic clinical data that captures complex dependencies and class imbalances in EHR data.

entry.title: Beyond Logit Adjustment: A Residual Decomposition Framework for Long-Tailed Reranking

author.name: Zhanliang Wang, Hongzhuo Chen, Quan Minh Nguyen, Mian Umair Ahsan, Kai Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a residual decomposition framework for long-tailed classification reranking, separating the Bayes-optimal correction into classwise (constant) and pairwise (input-dependent) components, showing fixed offsets like logit adjustment are suboptimal.

entry.title: DDCL: Deep Dual Competitive Learning: A Differentiable End-to-End Framework for Unsupervised Prototype-Based Representation Learning

author.name: Giansalvo Cirrincione

entry.summary: Introduces DDCL, the first fully differentiable end-to-end framework for unsupervised prototype-based representation learning, replacing external k-means with an internal Dual Competitive Layer.

entry.title: CANDI: Curated Test-Time Adaptation for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection Under Distribution Shift

author.name: HyunGi Kim, Jisoo Mok, Hyungyu Lee, Juhyeon Shin, Sungroh Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes CANDI for test-time adaptation in multivariate time-series anomaly detection under distribution shift, selectively identifying and adapting to potential false positives while preserving pre-trained knowledge.

entry.title: Generalization Bounds and Statistical Guarantees for Multi-Task and Multiple Operator Learning with MNO Networks

author.name: Adrien Weihs, Hayden Schaeffer

entry.summary: Provides covering-number-based generalization bounds for multiple operator learning architectures, focusing on the Multiple Neural Operator (MNO). Derives metric-entropy estimates and excess risk bounds for hierarchically sampled operator learning settings.

entry.title: Interpretable Battery Aging without Extra Tests via Neural-Assisted Physics-based Modelling

author.name: Yuan Qiu, Wei Li, Wei Zhang, Yi Zhou, Fang Liu, Jianbiao Wang, Zhi Wei Seh

entry.summary: Proposes IBAM, a neural-assisted physics-based framework for interpretable battery aging that outputs a 2D aging fingerprint capturing polarization voltage loss and end-of-discharge tail loss, using only routine battery management system logs without extra diagnostic tests.

entry.title: Regularizing Attention Scores with Bootstrapping

author.name: Neo Christopher Chung, Maxim Laletin

entry.summary: Proposes bootstrapping attention scores in Vision Transformers to quantify uncertainty and obtain regularized attention maps, treating non-zero attention scores as potentially noise-driven and using statistical resampling to identify significant attention.

entry.title: Random Coordinate Descent on the Wasserstein Space of Probability Measures

author.name: Yewei Xu, Qin Li

entry.summary: Proposes a randomized coordinate descent framework for optimization over the Wasserstein-2 space, with convergence guarantees that exploit coordinate-wise structure for anisotropic objectives where full-gradient methods struggle.

entry.title: A Novel Theoretical Analysis for Clustering Heteroscedastic Gaussian Data without Knowledge of the Number of Clusters

author.name: Dominique Pastor, Elsa Dupraz, Ismail Hbilou, Guillaume Ansel

entry.summary: Introduces a novel clustering approach for heteroscedastic Gaussian data that doesn't require knowing the number of clusters, generalizing the Mean-Shift algorithm with theoretical guarantees that fixed points converge to true centroids.

entry.title: When to ASK: Uncertainty-Gated Language Assistance for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Juarez Monteiro, Nathan Gavenski, Gianlucca Zuin, Adriano Veloso

entry.summary: Introduces ASK, a framework that combines RL policies with language models by using Monte Carlo Dropout uncertainty estimation to selectively query the LM only when the RL agent is uncertain, improving OOD generalization.

entry.title: Agentic Tool Use in Large Language Models

author.name: Jinchao Hu (Harbin Institute of Technology Shenzhen, Shenzhen, China), Meizhi Zhong (TikTok Inc, Beijing, China), Kehai Chen (Harbin Institute of Technology Shenzhen, Shenzhen, China), Xuefeng Bai (Harbin Institute of Technology Shenzhen, Shenzhen, China), Min Zhang (Harbin Institute of Technology Shenzhen, Shenzhen, China)

entry.summary: Surveys agentic tool use in LLMs, organizing literature into three paradigms (prompting, supervised learning, reward-driven learning) and analyzing methods, strengths, and failure modes.

entry.title: CARE: Privacy-Compliant Agentic Reasoning with Evidence Discordance

author.name: Haochen Liu, Weien Li, Rui Song, Zeyu Li, Chun Jason Xue, Xiao-Yang Liu, Sam Nallaperuma, Xue Liu, Ye Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces MIMIC-DOS, a dataset for organ dysfunction prediction in ICU settings where patient signs and symptoms are discordant, challenging existing LLM approaches that perform poorly on inconsistent evidence.

entry.title: LLM REgression with a Latent Iterative State Head

author.name: Yiheng Su, Matthew Lease

entry.summary: Presents RELISH, a lightweight architecture for text regression with LLMs that predicts scalar values by iteratively refining a learned latent state through cross-attention over frozen LLM representations.

entry.title: LinguDistill: Recovering Linguistic Ability in Vision- Language Models via Selective Cross-Modal Distillation

author.name: Patrick Amadeus Irawan, Erland Hilman Fuadi, Shanu Kumar, Alham Fikri Aji, Yova Kementchedjhieva

entry.summary: Proposes LinguDistill, an adapter-free distillation method that restores linguistic capabilities degraded during vision-language model adaptation by distilling from the original frozen language model.

entry.title: AffordTissue: Dense Affordance Prediction for Tool-Action Specific Tissue Interaction

author.name: Aiza Maksutova, Lalithkumar Seenivasan, Hao Ding, Jiru Xu, Chenhao Yu, Chenyan Jing, Yiqing Shen, Mathias Unberath

entry.summary: Introduces AffordTissue, a multimodal framework for predicting tool-action specific tissue interaction regions during surgery as dense heatmaps. Combines temporal vision encoding with affordance prediction for safer surgical automation.

entry.title: Mitigating the ID-OOD Tradeoff in Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Wenjie Zhao, Jia Li, Xin Dong, Yapeng Tian, Yu Xiang, Yunhui Guo

entry.summary: Addresses the tradeoff between in-distribution classification and out-of-distribution detection in open-set test-time adaptation by mitigating conflicts between entropy minimization and maximization.

entry.title: TOL: Textual Localization with OpenStreetMap

author.name: Youqi Liao, Shuhao Kang, Jingyu Xu, Olaf Wysocki, Yan Xia, Jianping Li, Zhen Dong, Bisheng Yang, Xieyuanli Chen

entry.summary: TOL formulates text-to-OpenStreetMap localization, estimating 2DoF positions in urban environments from textual descriptions using OSM's compact semantic representation without geometric observations.

entry.title: From Understanding to Erasing: Towards Complete and Stable Video Object Removal

author.name: Dingming Liu, Wenjing Wang, Chen Li, Jing Lyu

entry.summary: Proposes understanding-assisted video object removal that uses knowledge distillation from vision foundation models to better handle object-induced side effects like shadows and reflections.

entry.title: Unifying UAV Cross-View Geo-Localization via 3D Geometric Perception

author.name: Haoyuan Li, Wen Yang, Fang Xu, Hong Tan, Haijian Zhang, Shengyang Li, Gui-Song Xia

entry.summary: Proposes a geometry-aware UAV geo-localization framework that explicitly models 3D scene geometry to unify coarse place recognition and fine-grained pose estimation in a single inference pipeline.

entry.title: A deep learning pipeline for PAM50 subtype classification using histopathology images and multi-objective patch selection

author.name: Arezoo Borji, Gernot Kronreif, Bernhard Angermayr, Francisco Mario Calisto, Wolfgang Birkfellner, Inna Servetnyk, Yinyin Yuan, Sepideh Hatamikia

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning pipeline for PAM50 breast cancer subtype classification from histopathology images using multi-objective patch selection with NSGA-II and Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty estimation.

entry.title: FaCT-GS: Fast and Scalable CT Reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Pawel Tomasz Pieta, Rasmus Juul Pedersen, Sina Borgi, Jakob Sauer J{\o}rgensen, Jens Wenzel Andreasen, Vedrana Andersen Dahl

entry.summary: FaCT-GS optimizes Gaussian Splatting for CT reconstruction with significantly improved speed and scalability through optimized voxelization and rasterization pipelines.

entry.title: GS^2: Graph-based Spatial Distribution Optimization for Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Xianben Yang, Tao Wang, Yuxuan Li, Yi Jin, Haibin Ling

entry.summary: GS² proposes graph-based spatial distribution optimization for compact 3D Gaussian Splatting using ELBO-based adaptive densification and graph neural network-driven repositioning.

entry.title: Are VLMs Lost Between Sky and Space? LinkS$^2$Bench for UAV-Satellite Dynamic Cross-View Spatial Intelligence

author.name: Dian Liu, Jie Feng, Di Li, Yuhui Zheng, Guanbin Li, Weisheng Dong, Guangming Shi

entry.summary: LinkS²Bench introduces the first benchmark evaluating VLMs' ability to perform dynamic cross-view spatial reasoning between UAV and satellite imagery, testing local-to-global spatial mapping essential for emergency response.

entry.title: Rare-Aware Autoencoding: Reconstructing Spatially Imbalanced Data

author.name: Alejandro Casta\~neda Garcia, Jan van Gemert, Daan Brinks, Nergis T\"omen

entry.summary: Proposes a self-entropy-based loss and Sample Propagation replay mechanism to address spatial imbalance in autoencoders, where rare spatial patterns are dominated by common background appearances.

entry.title: GroundVTS: Visual Token Sampling in Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Temporal Grounding

author.name: Rong Fan, Kaiyan Xiao, Minghao Zhu, Liuyi Wang, Kai Dai, Zhao Yang

entry.summary: GroundVTS proposes query-guided visual token sampling for video temporal grounding, filtering visual tokens before LLM processing to preserve essential spatiotemporal information rather than relying on uniform frame sampling.

entry.title: UAV-Track VLA: Embodied Aerial Tracking via Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Qiyao Zhang, Shuhua Zheng, Jianli Sun, Chengxiang Li, Xianke Wu, Zihan Song, Zhiyong Cui, Yisheng Lv, Yonglin Tian

entry.summary: UAV-Track VLA proposes a VLA model for embodied aerial tracking with 890K frames dataset, introducing temporal compression and spatial geometric priors built on the π₀.₅ architecture.

entry.title: EventHub: Data Factory for Generalizable Event-Based Stereo Networks without Active Sensors

author.name: Luca Bartolomei, Fabio Tosi, Matteo Poggi, Stefano Mattoccia, Guillermo Gallego

entry.summary: EventHub provides a framework for training event stereo networks without ground truth from active sensors, using standard color images to generate proxy annotations through novel view synthesis, achieving unprecedented generalization.

entry.title: Observable Geometry of Singular Statistical Models

author.name: Sean Plummer

entry.summary: Introduces an invariant framework for analyzing singular statistical models using 'observable charts' - functionals of data distributions that serve as parameterization-independent local coordinates. Formalizes observable completeness for detecting identifiability boundaries.

entry.title: Open, Reliable, and Collective: A Community-Driven Framework for Tool-Using AI Agents

author.name: Hy Dang, Quang Dao, Meng Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces OpenTools, a community-driven toolbox that standardizes tool schemas, provides plug-and-play wrappers, and evaluates tools with automated test suites for LLM agents. Addresses both tool-use accuracy and intrinsic tool accuracy.

entry.title: The Chronicles of RiDiC: Generating Datasets with Controlled Popularity Distribution for Long-form Factuality Evaluation

author.name: Pavel Braslavski, Dmitrii Iarosh, Nikita Sushko, Andrey Sakhovskiy, Vasily Konovalov, Elena Tutubalina, Alexander Panchenko

entry.summary: Presents RiDiC, a configurable pipeline for generating multilingual entity datasets with controlled popularity distribution for evaluating LLM factuality in long-form generation, using Wikipedia and Wikidata.

entry.title: Perspective: Towards sustainable exploration of chemical spaces with machine learning

author.name: Leonardo Medrano Sandonas, David Balcells, Anton Bochkarev, Jacqueline M. Cole, Volker L. Deringer, Werner Dobrautz, Adrian Ehrenhofer, Thorben Frank, Pascal Friederich, Rico Friedrich, Janine George, Luca Ghiringhelli, Alejandra Hinostroza Caldas, Veronika Juraskova, Hannes Kneiding, Yury Lysogorskiy, Johannes T. Margraf, Hanna T\"urk, Anatole von Lilienfeld, Milica Todorovi\'c, Alexandre Tkatchenko, Mariana Rossi, Gianaurelio Cuniberti

entry.summary: Perspective paper examining sustainability challenges across the AI-driven molecular and materials discovery pipeline, from data generation and model training to automated research workflows.

entry.title: A Study on the Impact of Fault localization Granularity for Repository-Scale Code Repair Tasks

author.name: Joseph Townsend, Chandresh Pravin, Kwun Ho Ngan, Matthieu Parizy

entry.summary: Studies the impact of fault localization granularity on repository-scale code repair, testing code repair under perfect fault localization at different granularity levels.

entry.title: LLM Essay Scoring Under Holistic and Analytic Rubrics: Prompt Effects and Bias

author.name: Filip J. Kucia, Anirban Chakraborty, Anna Wr\'oblewska

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates LLMs for essay scoring across holistic and analytic rubrics, finding moderate-to-high agreement with humans on holistic scoring but significant negative bias on lower-order concerns in analytic scoring.

entry.title: Prompt-Guided Prefiltering for VLM Image Compression

author.name: Bardia Azizian, Ivan V. Bajic

entry.summary: Proposes a prompt-guided prefiltering module for VLM image compression that identifies task-relevant regions based on text prompts, reducing transmitted data while maintaining VLM accuracy.

entry.title: MOON3.0: Reasoning-aware Multimodal Representation Learning for E-commerce Product Understanding

author.name: Junxian Wu, Chenghan Fu, Zhanheng Nie, Daoze Zhang, Bowen Wan, Wanxian Guan, Chuan Yu, Jian Xu, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces MOON3.0, a reasoning-aware multimodal representation learning system for e-commerce that explicitly models fine-grained product attributes through MLLM reasoning rather than implicit global embeddings.

entry.title: Representation Selection via Cross-Model Agreement using Canonical Correlation Analysis

author.name: Dylan B. Lewis, Jens Gregor, Hector Santos-Villalobos

entry.summary: Proposes using canonical correlation analysis between two pretrained image encoders as a training-free method for representation selection and dimensionality reduction, leveraging cross-model agreement.

entry.title: Approximating Pareto Frontiers in Stochastic Multi-Objective Optimization via Hashing and Randomization

author.name: Jinzhao Li, Nan Jiang, Yexiang Xue

entry.summary: Proposes XOR-SMOO, a novel algorithm for approximating Pareto frontiers in stochastic multi-objective optimization using hashing and randomization, providing probabilistic guarantees on approximation quality.

entry.title: DySCo: Dynamic Semantic Compression for Effective Long-term Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Xiang Ao, Yinyu Tan, Mengru Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DySCo for long-term time series forecasting, using entropy-guided dynamic sampling to retain high-entropy segments while compressing redundant trends, combined with hierarchical frequency-enhanced decomposition.

entry.title: Soft MPCritic: Amortized Model Predictive Value Iteration

author.name: Thomas Banker, Nathan P. Lawrence, Ali Mesbah

entry.summary: Proposes soft MPCritic combining RL with model predictive control, using MPPI for planning and fitted value iteration for terminal Q-function, with an amortized warm-start strategy for efficient batched value target computation.

entry.title: MATA-Former & SIICU: Semantic Aware Temporal Alignment for High-Fidelity ICU Risk Prediction

author.name: Zhichong Zheng, Xiaohang Nie, Xueqi Wang, Yuanjin Zhao, Haitao Zhang, Yichao Tang

entry.summary: Proposes MATA-Former for ICU risk prediction using event semantics to dynamically weight attention (prioritizing causal validity over time proximity) with Plateau-Gaussian Soft Labeling for continuous risk modeling. Introduces SIICU dataset.

entry.title: Physics Informed Reinforcement Learning with Gibbs Priors for Topology Control in Power Grids

author.name: Pantelis Dogoulis, Maxime Cordy

entry.summary: Proposes physics-informed RL with Gibbs priors for power grid topology control, using GNN surrogates to predict post-action overload risk and construct physics-informed action priors to handle combinatorial action spaces.

entry.title: LEO: Graph Attention Network based Hybrid Multi Sensor Extended Object Fusion and Tracking for Autonomous Driving Applications

author.name: Mayank Mayank, Bharanidhar Duraisamy, Florian Geiss

entry.summary: Presents LEO, a graph attention network for multi-sensor extended object fusion and tracking in autonomous driving, learning adaptive fusion weights across production-grade sensor tracks while modeling complex vehicle geometries.

entry.title: Causal Optimal Coupling for Gaussian Input-Output Distributional Data

author.name: Daran Xu, Amirhossein Taghvaei

entry.summary: Studies causal optimal coupling between input-output distributional data from dynamical systems using a Schrödinger Bridge formulation with causality constraints. Derives tractable Sinkhorn iterations for Gaussian marginals.

entry.title: The topological gap at criticality: scaling exponent d + {\eta}, universality, and scope

author.name: Matthew Loftus

entry.summary: Establishes finite-size scaling for the topological gap in spin models, showing the scaling exponent d+η matches known critical exponents for 2D Ising and Potts models with high precision, connecting topological data analysis to statistical physics.

entry.title: Prosodic ABX: A Language-Agnostic Method for Measuring Prosodic Contrast in Speech Representations

author.name: Haitong Sun, Stephen McIntosh, Kwanghee Choi, Eunjung Yeo, Daisuke Saito, Nobuaki Minematsu

entry.summary: Introduces prosodic ABX, extending the ABX discrimination framework to evaluate prosodic contrast (stress, pitch accent, tone) in self-supervised speech model representations, with datasets for English, Japanese, and Mandarin.

entry.title: Computing the Exact Pareto Front in Average-Cost Multi-Objective Markov Decision Processes

author.name: Jiping Luo, Nikolaos Pappas

entry.summary: Characterizes the exact Pareto front in average-cost multi-objective MDPs, proving it is a continuous piecewise-linear surface on a convex polytope boundary with a vertex-enumeration algorithm for exact computation.

entry.title: De Jure: Iterative LLM Self-Refinement for Structured Extraction of Regulatory Rules

author.name: Keerat Guliani, Deepkamal Gill, David Landsman, Nima Eshraghi, Krishna Kumar, Lovedeep Gondara

entry.summary: Presents De Jure, a fully automated pipeline for extracting structured regulatory rules from legal documents using iterative LLM self-refinement with multi-criteria evaluation across 19 dimensions, requiring no human annotation.

entry.title: Multi-lingual Multi-institutional Electronic Health Record based Predictive Model

author.name: Kyunghoon Hur, Heeyoung Kwak, Jinsu Jang, Nakhwan Kim, Edward Choi

entry.summary: Investigates multilingual multi-institutional EHR prediction by converting records to unified text format, addressing language as an additional heterogeneity layer across international healthcare systems.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Self-Correct in Medical Question Answering? An Exploratory Study

author.name: Zaifu Zhan, Mengyuan Cui, Rui Zhang

entry.summary: Explores whether LLMs can self-correct in medical QA through iterative self-reflection, finding that self-reflective prompting shows limited and inconsistent improvement on medical multiple-choice questions using GPT-4o.

entry.title: TR-ICRL: Test-Time Rethinking for In-Context Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Wenxuan Jiang, Yuxin Zuo, Zijian Zhang, Xuecheng Wu, Zining Fan, Wenxuan Liu, Li Chen, Xiaoyu Li, Xuezhi Cao, Xiaolong Jin, Ninghao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes TR-ICRL, a framework for in-context reinforcement learning that uses test-time rethinking with pseudo-labels derived from majority voting on retrieved instances to improve reward estimation.

entry.title: Phase transition on a context-sensitive random language model with short range interactions

author.name: Yuma Toji, Jun Takahashi, Vwani Roychowdhury, Hideyuki Miyahara

entry.summary: Constructs a context-sensitive random language model with short-range interactions and numerically demonstrates phase transitions, addressing whether such transitions require long-range interactions or arise from linguistic properties.

entry.title: DOne: Decoupling Structure and Rendering for High-Fidelity Design-to-Code Generation

author.name: Xinhao Huang, Jinke Yu, Wenhao Xu, Zeyi Wen, Ying Zhou, Junzhuo Liu, Junhao Ji, Zulong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DOne, an end-to-end design-to-code framework that decouples structural understanding from element rendering using learned layout segmentation, hybrid element retrieval, and schema-guided generation.

entry.title: Look Twice: Training-Free Evidence Highlighting in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Marco Morini, Sara Sarto, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi

entry.summary: Proposes Look Twice (LoT), a training-free inference-time framework that exploits MLLM attention patterns to identify relevant visual regions and textual evidence for knowledge-intensive visual QA.

entry.title: Harmonized Tabular-Image Fusion via Gradient-Aligned Alternating Learning

author.name: Longfei Huang, Yang Yang

entry.summary: GAAL proposes gradient-aligned alternating learning for tabular-image multimodal fusion, using uncertainty-based cross-modal gradient surgery to resolve gradient conflicts between modalities.

entry.title: Riemannian and Symplectic Geometry for Hierarchical Text-Driven Place Recognition

author.name: Tianyi Shang, Zhenyu Li

entry.summary: SympLoc proposes a coarse-to-fine text-to-point-cloud localization framework using Riemannian and symplectic geometry for hierarchical multi-level alignment between text and 3D scenes.

entry.title: Can Video Diffusion Models Predict Past Frames? Bidirectional Cycle Consistency for Reversible Interpolation

author.name: Lingyu Liu, Yaxiong Wang, Li Zhu, Zhedong Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes a bidirectional cycle-consistency framework for video frame interpolation using diffusion models, enforcing symmetry between forward and backward generation to reduce motion drift.

entry.title: Dense Point-to-Mask Optimization with Reinforced Point Selection for Crowd Instance Segmentation

author.name: Hongru Chen, Jiyang Huang, Jia Wan, Antoni B. Chan

entry.summary: Proposes dense point-to-mask optimization integrating SAM with nearest neighbor constraints for crowd instance segmentation from point annotations, with reinforced point selection for optimal prompting.

entry.title: FSKD: Monocular Forest Structure Inference via LiDAR-to-RGBI Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Taimur Khan, Hannes Feilhauer, Muhammad Jazib Zafar

entry.summary: FSKD proposes LiDAR-to-RGBI knowledge distillation for forest structure inference, enabling monocular prediction of canopy metrics from RGB-infrared imagery without LiDAR at inference time.

entry.title: Semantic Segmentation of Textured Non-manifold 3D Meshes using Transformers

author.name: Mohammadreza Heidarianbaei, Max Mehltretter, Franz Rottensteiner

entry.summary: Introduces a texture-aware transformer for semantic segmentation of 3D meshes that learns directly from raw texture pixels per face, with hierarchical multi-scale feature aggregation.

entry.title: SHARC: Reference point driven Spherical Harmonic Representation for Complex Shapes

author.name: Panagiotis Sapoutzoglou, George Terzakis, Maria Pateraki

entry.summary: SHARC represents complex shapes using collections of spherical harmonic distance fields anchored at optimally placed interior reference points, enabling genus-agnostic shape synthesis.

entry.title: Enhancing Medical Visual Grounding via Knowledge-guided Spatial Prompts

author.name: Yifan Gao, Tao Zhou, Yi Zhou, Ke Zou, Yizhe Zhang, Huazhu Fu

entry.summary: KnowMVG enhances medical visual grounding in VLMs by incorporating knowledge priors and global-local attention enhancement to improve spatial precision during decoding.

entry.title: ProDiG: Progressive Diffusion-Guided Gaussian Splatting for Aerial to Ground Reconstruction

author.name: Sirshapan Mitra, Yogesh S. Rawat

entry.summary: ProDiG progressively transforms aerial 3D Gaussian Splatting representations toward ground-level fidelity using diffusion guidance, addressing the extreme viewpoint change challenge in aerial-to-ground reconstruction.

entry.title: Decouple and Rectify: Semantics-Preserving Structural Enhancement for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation

author.name: Jie Feng, Fengze Li, Junpeng Zhang, Siyu Chen, Yuping Liang, Junying Chen, Ronghua Shang

entry.summary: DR-Seg proposes a decouple-and-rectify framework for open-vocabulary remote sensing segmentation, separating CLIP's semantic representations to identify where structural enhancement is needed without disrupting semantic integrity.

entry.title: FlowSlider: Training-Free Continuous Image Editing via Fidelity-Steering Decomposition

author.name: Taichi Endo, Guoqing Hao, Kazuhiko Sumi

entry.summary: FlowSlider enables training-free continuous image editing with slider-style strength control in Rectified Flow models, decomposing edits into fidelity-preserving and edit-direction components.

entry.title: Beyond the Fold: Quantifying Split-Level Noise and the Case for Leave-One-Dataset-Out AU Evaluation

author.name: Saurabh Hinduja, Gurmeet Kaur, Maneesh Bilalpur, Jeffrey Cohn, Shaun Canavan

entry.summary: Shows that cross-validation introduces measurable stochastic variance in facial AU detection evaluation, proposing Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO) protocol across five datasets for more reliable evaluation.

entry.title: AdamFlow: Adam-based Wasserstein Gradient Flows for Surface Registration in Medical Imaging

author.name: Qiang Ma, Qingjie Meng, Xin Hu, Yicheng Wu, Wenjia Bai

entry.summary: AdamFlow formulates surface registration as distributional optimization using sliced Wasserstein distance with a novel Adam-inspired optimizer for Wasserstein gradient flows, achieving fast and robust mesh registration.

entry.title: Modulate-and-Map: Crossmodal Feature Mapping with Cross-View Modulation for 3D Anomaly Detection

author.name: Alex Costanzino, Pierluigi Zama Ramirez, Giuseppe Lisanti, Luigi Di Stefano

entry.summary: ModMap presents a multiview and multimodal framework for 3D anomaly detection using crossmodal feature mapping with view-dependent modulation, plus a publicly released depth encoder for industrial datasets.

entry.title: DarwinNet: An Evolutionary Network Architecture for Agent-Driven Protocol Synthesis

author.name: Jinliang Xu, Bingqi Li

entry.summary: DarwinNet proposes a bio-inspired self-evolving network architecture that uses LLM-driven protocol synthesis to replace static human-defined communication rules, enabling runtime adaptation of network protocols.

entry.title: Identifying and Estimating Causal Direct Effects Under Unmeasured Confounding

author.name: Philippe Boileau, Nima S. Hejazi, Ivana Malenica, Peter B. Gilbert, Sandrine Dudoit, Mark J. van der Laan

entry.summary: Develops methods for identifying and estimating causal direct effects under unmeasured confounding, addressing limitations of natural direct/indirect effects that require stringent identification assumptions. Provides practical estimation approaches with relaxed requirements.

entry.title: Ontology-Constrained Neural Reasoning in Enterprise Agentic Systems: A Neurosymbolic Architecture for Domain-Grounded AI Agents

author.name: Thanh Luong Tuan

entry.summary: Presents a neurosymbolic architecture for enterprise AI agents using ontology-constrained neural reasoning with three-layer ontological framework (Role, Domain, Interaction) to address hallucination and domain drift in enterprise LLM deployments.

entry.title: Benchmark for Assessing Olfactory Perception of Large Language Models

author.name: Eftychia Makri, Nikolaos Nakis, Laura Sisson, Gigi Minsky, Leandros Tassiulas, Vahid Satarifard, Nicholas A. Christakis

entry.summary: Introduces the Olfactory Perception benchmark with 1,010 questions across 8 categories to assess LLM reasoning about smell, evaluating 21 model configurations. Finds compound-name prompts outperform SMILES representations.

entry.title: MSA-Thinker: Discrimination-Calibration Reasoning with Hint-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Miaosen Luo, Zhenhao Yang, Jieshen Long, Jinghu Sun, Yichu Liu, Sijie Mai

entry.summary: Proposes MSA-Thinker for multimodal sentiment analysis combining structured Discrimination-Calibration reasoning with Hint-based Reinforcement Learning, addressing interpretability limitations of SFT approaches.

entry.title: The Energy Footprint of LLM-Based Environmental Analysis: LLMs and Domain Products

author.name: Alicia Bao (James), Jiamian He (James), Angel Hsu (James), Diego Manya (James), Ji (James), Zhang

entry.summary: Assesses the inference-time energy consumption of LLM-based climate analysis chatbots using RAG compared to direct generic LLM usage, providing practical energy footprint measurements.

entry.title: Hierarchical Apprenticeship Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations with Evolving Rewards

author.name: Md Mirajul Islam, Rajesh Debnath, Adittya Soukarjya Saha, Min Chi

entry.summary: Introduces HALIDE, a hierarchical apprenticeship learning approach that leverages imperfect student demonstrations with evolving rewards in e-learning environments, treating sub-optimal demonstrations as structured signals rather than noise.

entry.title: SANA I2I: A Text Free Flow Matching Framework for Paired Image to Image Translation with a Case Study in Fetal MRI Artifact Reduction

author.name: Italo Felix Santos, Gilson Antonio Giraldi, Heron Werner Junior

entry.summary: Proposes SANA-I2I, a text-free image-to-image translation framework using flow matching in latent space, applied to fetal MRI artifact reduction with synthetic paired training data.

entry.title: Procela: Epistemic Governance in Mechanistic Simulations Under Structural Uncertainty

author.name: Kinson Vernet

entry.summary: Introduces Procela, a simulation framework where variables act as epistemic authorities and mechanisms encode competing causal ontologies, applied to antimicrobial resistance modeling where the true causal structure is contested.

entry.title: BioCOMPASS: Integrating Biomarkers into Transformer-Based Immunotherapy Response Prediction

author.name: Sayed Hashim, Frank Soboczenski, Paul Cairns

entry.summary: Proposes BioCOMPASS, extending a transformer-based immunotherapy response prediction model by integrating biomarkers as loss components rather than inputs, improving cross-cohort generalization.

entry.title: Aligning Recommendations with User Popularity Preferences

author.name: Mona Schirmer, Anton Thielmann, Pola Schw\"obel, Thomas Martynec, Giuseppe Di Benedetto, Ben London, Yannik Stein

entry.summary: Introduces Popularity Quantile Calibration to measure misalignment between user preferences for popular vs. niche content and what recommender systems suggest, plus SPREE, an inference-time method to fix this. Addresses the rich-get-richer dynamic in recommendation systems.

entry.title: AdaLoRA-QAT: Adaptive Low-Rank and Quantization-Aware Segmentation

author.name: Prantik Deb, Srimanth Dhondy, N. Ramakrishna, Anu Kapoor, Raju S. Bapi, Tapabrata Chakraborti

entry.summary: Proposes AdaLoRA-QAT for chest X-ray segmentation, combining adaptive low-rank encoder adaptation with quantization-aware training to achieve 95.6% Dice score while reducing parameters by 16.6x and model size by 2.24x.

entry.title: Optimizing EEG Graph Structure for Seizure Detection: An Information Bottleneck and Self-Supervised Learning Approach

author.name: Lincan Li, Rikuto Kotoge, Xihao Piao, Zheng Chen, Yushun Dong

entry.summary: Presents an Information Bottleneck-guided approach for EEG seizure detection that jointly learns denoised dynamic graph structures and spatial-temporal representations, explicitly accounting for EEG noise to remove redundant connections.

entry.title: Graph Neural Operator Towards Edge Deployability and Portability for Sparse-to-Dense, Real-Time Virtual Sensing on Irregular Grids

author.name: William Howes, Jason Yoo, Kazuma Kobayashi, Subhankar Sarkar, Farid Ahmed, Souvik Chakraborty, Syed Bahauddin Alam

entry.summary: Introduces VIRSO, a graph-based neural operator for sparse-to-dense reconstruction on irregular geometries with Variable KNN for mesh-informed graph construction, specifically designed for edge deployment.

entry.title: Towards Intrinsically Calibrated Uncertainty Quantification in Industrial Data-Driven Models via Diffusion Sampler

author.name: Yiran Ma, Jerome Le Ny, Zhichao Chen, Zhihuan Song

entry.summary: Introduces a diffusion-based posterior sampling framework for industrial process monitoring that produces intrinsically calibrated uncertainty estimates without post-hoc calibration, validated on ammonia synthesis and Raman spectroscopy benchmarks.

entry.title: Evolutionary Multi-Objective Fusion of Deepfake Speech Detectors

author.name: Vojt\v{e}ch Stan\v{e}k, Martin Pere\v{s}\'ini, Luk\'a\v{s} Sekanina, Anton Firc, Kamil Malinka

entry.summary: Proposes an evolutionary multi-objective score fusion framework using NSGA-II to jointly minimize detection error and system complexity for deepfake speech detection, combining multiple SSL-based detectors efficiently.

entry.title: EXHIB: A Benchmark for Realistic and Diverse Evaluation of Function Similarity in the Wild

author.name: Yiming Fan (The Ohio State University), Jun Yeon Won (The Ohio State University), Ding Zhu (The Ohio State University), Melih Sirlanci (The Ohio State University), Mahdi Khalili (The Ohio State University), Carter Yagemann (The Ohio State University)

entry.summary: Introduces EXHIB, a comprehensive benchmark for binary function similarity detection comprising five realistic datasets from real-world binaries, addressing limitations of existing narrow benchmarks that don't reflect production security analysis scenarios.

entry.title: Learning in Prophet Inequalities with Noisy Observations

author.name: Jung-hun Kim, Vianney Perchet

entry.summary: Studies prophet inequalities with unknown reward distributions and noisy observations, proposing lower-confidence-bound thresholding algorithms that achieve the sharp competitive ratio of 1-1/e in the i.i.d. setting.

entry.title: Mining Instance-Centric Vision-Language Contexts for Human-Object Interaction Detection

author.name: Soo Won Seo, KyungChae Lee, Hyungchan Cho, Taein Son, Nam Ik Cho, Jun Won Choi

entry.summary: Proposes InCoM-Net for human-object interaction detection, mining instance-centric vision-language contexts by integrating VLM semantic priors with instance-specific features from object detectors for better contextual reasoning.

entry.title: Hierarchical Chain-of-Thought Prompting: Enhancing LLM Reasoning Performance and Efficiency

author.name: Xingshuai Huang, Derek Li, Bahareh Nikpour, Parsa Omidi

entry.summary: Introduces Hierarchical Chain-of-Thought (Hi-CoT) prompting that decomposes reasoning into hierarchical substeps alternating between planning and execution, improving performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

entry.title: Large Language Models in the Abuse Detection Pipeline

author.name: Suraj Kath, Sanket Badhe, Preet Shah, Ashwin Sampathkumar, Shivani Gupta

entry.summary: Surveys how LLMs are being integrated into the abuse detection lifecycle across four stages: label/feature generation, detection, review, and enforcement, providing a structured analysis of LLM capabilities in content safety.

entry.title: More Human, More Efficient: Aligning Annotations with Quantized SLMs

author.name: Jiayu Wang, Junyoung Lee

entry.summary: Shows that finetuning a quantized 1.7B parameter model on limited human-annotated data can serve as a highly aligned, deterministic evaluator/annotator, outperforming larger proprietary models in alignment with human consensus.

entry.title: GPT-NL Public Corpus: A Permissively Licensed, Dutch-First Dataset for LLM Pre-training

author.name: Jesse van Oort, Frank Brinkkemper, Erik de Graaf, Bram Vanroy, Saskia Lensink

entry.summary: Presents GPT-NL Public Corpus, the largest permissively licensed Dutch language corpus with 36B Dutch tokens not in existing LLM training data, plus curated English, Code, and German/Danish tokens.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Vessel Segmentation via Latent Similarity Mining and Iterative Co-Optimization

author.name: Zhanqiang Guo, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a domain transfer framework for retinal vessel segmentation using latent vascular similarity across domains and iterative co-optimization of generation and segmentation networks with diffusion models.

entry.title: Towards Minimal Focal Stack in Shape from Focus

author.name: Khurram Ashfaq, Muhammad Tariq Mahmood

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-based focal stack augmentation enabling Shape from Focus methods to work with just two images instead of dense focal stacks, using all-in-focus estimation and energy-of-difference maps.

entry.title: MonoSAOD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Sparsely Annotated Label

author.name: Junyoung Jung, Seokwon Kim, Jun Uk Kim

entry.summary: MonoSAOD addresses monocular 3D object detection with sparse annotations, proposing road-aware patch augmentation and prototype-based filtering for pseudo-label generation.

entry.title: Robust Embodied Perception in Dynamic Environments via Disentangled Weight Fusion

author.name: Juncen Guo, Xiaoguang Zhu, Jingyi Wu, Jingyu Zhang, Jingnan Cai, Zhenghao Niu, Liang Song

entry.summary: Proposes a domain-id and exemplar-free incremental learning framework for embodied perception systems handling dynamic environment distribution drift using disentangled weight fusion.

entry.title: Ranking-Guided Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation for Severity Classification

author.name: Shota Harada, Ryoma Bise, Kiyohito Tanaka, Seiichi Uchida

entry.summary: Proposes ranking-guided semi-supervised domain adaptation for severity classification in medical imaging, using rank scores learned from class order to align source and target domains.

entry.title: MAR-MAER: Metric-Aware and Ambiguity-Adaptive Autoregressive Image Generation

author.name: Kai Dong, Tingting Bai

entry.summary: MAR-MAER introduces a hierarchical autoregressive framework for text-to-image generation with metric-aware embedding regularization and a probabilistic latent model for handling ambiguous prompts.

entry.title: Light-ResKAN: A Parameter-Sharing Lightweight KAN with Gram Polynomials for Efficient SAR Image Recognition

author.name: Pan Yi, Weijie Li, Xiaodong Chen, Jiehua Zhang, Li Liu, Yongxiang Liu

entry.summary: Light-ResKAN applies Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks to SAR image recognition, replacing convolutions with KAN convolutions and using Gram polynomial basis with parameter sharing for efficiency.

entry.title: Rethinking Representations for Cross-Domain Infrared Small Target Detection: A Generalizable Perspective from the Frequency Domain

author.name: Yimin Fu, Songbo Wang, Feiyan Wu, Jialin Lyu, Zhunga Liu, Michael K. Ng

entry.summary: Proposes frequency domain representations for cross-domain infrared small target detection, identifying that certain frequency components generalize better across domains than spatial features.

entry.title: MAVFusion: Efficient Infrared and Visible Video Fusion via Motion-Aware Sparse Interaction

author.name: Xilai Li, Weijun Jiang, Xiaosong Li, Yang Liu, Hongbin Wang, Tao Ye, Huafeng Li, Haishu Tan

entry.summary: MAVFusion proposes a motion-aware sparse interaction mechanism for infrared and visible video fusion that uses optical flow to identify dynamic regions, enabling efficient cross-frame interactions without the high computational cost of existing methods. This addresses the gap between static image fusion and video fusion needs.

entry.title: True to Tone? Quantifying Skin Tone Fidelity and Bias in Photographic-to-Virtual Human Pipelines

author.name: Gabriel Ferri Schneider, Erick Menezes, Rafael Mecenas, Paulo Knob, Victor Araujo, Soraia Raupp Musse

entry.summary: Proposes a methodology to evaluate skin tone fidelity across virtual human generation pipelines, quantifying bias in photographic-to-avatar conversion using systematic color analysis.

entry.title: Reflection Generation for Composite Image Using Diffusion Model

author.name: Haonan Zhao, Qingyang Liu, Jiaxuan Chen, Li Niu

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion model-based method for generating physically coherent reflections in composite images, constructing the first large-scale object reflection dataset DEROBA.

entry.title: Country-wide, high-resolution monitoring of forest browning with Sentinel-2

author.name: Samantha Biegel, David Br\"uggemann, Francesco Grossi, Michele Volpi, Konrad Schindler, Benjamin D. Stocker

entry.summary: Presents a scalable approach for country-wide forest health monitoring at 10m resolution using Sentinel-2, learning predictive NDVI models to detect vegetation anomalies across Switzerland from 2017-2025.

entry.title: Simulating Realistic LiDAR Data Under Adverse Weather for Autonomous Vehicles: A Physics-Informed Learning Approach

author.name: Vivek Anand, Bharat Lohani, Rakesh Mishra, Gaurav Pandey

entry.summary: PICWGAN integrates physics-driven constraints for modeling signal attenuation into a learning pipeline for generating realistic adverse-weather LiDAR data, reducing the sim-to-real gap for autonomous driving.

entry.title: Open-loop POMDP Simplification and Safe Skipping of Replanning with Formal Performance Guarantees

author.name: Da Kong, Vadim Indelman

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for adaptive open-loop POMDP simplification with formal performance guarantees, interleaving open-loop and closed-loop planning via topology-based belief trees to reduce complexity.

entry.title: OpenGo: An OpenClaw-Based Robotic Dog with Real-Time Skill Switching

author.name: Hanbing Li, Xuewei Cao, Zhiwen Zeng, Yuhan Wu, Yanyong Zhang, Yan Xia

entry.summary: OpenGo presents a robotic dog with real-time skill switching capabilities, featuring a customizable skill library, task-aware dispatcher, and self-learning framework for skill refinement.

entry.title: Hi-LOAM: Hierarchical Implicit Neural Fields for LiDAR Odometry and Mapping

author.name: Zhiliu Yang, Jianyuan Zhang, Lianhui Zhao, Jinyu Dai, Zhu Yang

entry.summary: Hi-LOAM proposes multi-scale implicit neural localization and mapping using hierarchical hash tables on an octree structure for LiDAR-based SLAM, targeting large-scale complex scenes.

entry.title: Neural Robust Control on Lie Groups Using Contraction Methods (Extended Version)

author.name: Yi Lok Lo, Longhao Qian, Hugh H. T. Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a learning framework for robust control on Lie groups using contraction methods, jointly training a robust control contraction metric and neural feedback controller. Demonstrated on quadrotor control.

entry.title: How many attention heads do you need to do XOR?

author.name: Karthik Viswanathan

entry.summary: A crisp mathematical proof that at least two attention heads are needed to compute XOR in a transformer, using simple algebraic arguments about the limitations of single softmax attention heads.

entry.title: A Safety-Aware Role-Orchestrated Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Behavioral Health Communication Simulation

author.name: Ha Na Cho

entry.summary: Proposes a safety-aware multi-agent LLM framework for behavioral health communication, decomposing conversational responsibilities across empathy-focused, action-oriented, and supervisory agents with continuous safety auditing.

entry.title: Beyond Symbolic Solving: Multi Chain-of-Thought Voting for Geometric Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Md. Abu Bakor Siddique, Shahrin Hossain, Sadman Ahmed Siam, Syed Rifat Raiyan, Hasan Mahmud, Md Kamrul Hasan

entry.summary: Proposes multi chain-of-thought voting for geometric reasoning in LLMs, addressing the limitation that existing approaches use only single CoT for logical inference in geometric problem solving.

entry.title: Criterion Validity of LLM-as-Judge for Business Outcomes in Conversational Commerce

author.name: Liang Chen, Qi Liu, Wenhuan Lin, Feng Liang

entry.summary: Tests whether LLM-as-judge evaluation rubrics have criterion validity for business outcomes in conversational commerce on a Chinese matchmaking platform, finding significant heterogeneity across evaluation dimensions.

entry.title: Whittaker-Henderson smoother for long satellite image time series interpolation

author.name: Mathieu Fauvel (CESBIO)

entry.summary: Casts the Whittaker smoother as a differentiable neural layer for satellite image time series interpolation, with neural network-inferred smoothing parameters and heteroscedastic noise handling.

entry.title: Brain MR Image Synthesis with Multi-contrast Self-attention GAN

author.name: Zaid A. Abod, Furqan Aziz

entry.summary: Proposes a 3D multi-contrast MRI synthesis framework using self-attention GAN to generate missing brain imaging modalities from a single T2 input.

entry.title: Explainable AI for Blind and Low-Vision Users: Navigating Trust, Modality, and Interpretability in the Agentic Era

author.name: Abu Noman Md Sakib, Protik Dey, Zijie Zhang, Taslima Akter

entry.summary: Investigates explainable AI requirements for blind and low-vision users, highlighting how the shift to agentic AI systems makes accessible explanations even more critical since errors can propagate irreversibly. Based on user interviews and literature analysis.

entry.title: Softmax gradient policy for variance minimization and risk-averse multi armed bandits

author.name: Gabriel Turinici

entry.summary: Proposes a softmax-parameterized policy gradient algorithm for multi-armed bandits that selects the arm with lowest variance rather than highest expected reward, with convergence proofs.

entry.title: Improving Generalization of Deep Learning for Brain Metastases Segmentation Across Institutions

author.name: Yuchen Yang, Shuangyang Zhong, Haijun Yu, Langcuomu Suo, Hongbin Han, Florian Putz, Yixing Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a VAE-MMD preprocessing pipeline for domain adaptation in brain metastases segmentation, combining variational autoencoders with maximum mean discrepancy loss for cross-institutional generalization.

entry.title: COTTA: Context-Aware Transfer Adaptation for Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Seohyoung Park, Jaeyeol Lim, Seoyoung Ju, Kyeonghun Kim, Nam-Joon Kim, Hyuk-Jae Lee

entry.summary: Investigates domain adaptation of trajectory prediction models (QCNet) from U.S. to Korean road environments, proposing context-aware transfer adaptation methods for autonomous driving.

entry.title: Not My Truce: Personality Differences in AI-Mediated Workplace Negotiation

author.name: Veda Duddu, Jash Rajesh Parekh, Andy Mao, Hanyi Min, Ziang Xiao, Vedant Das Swain, Koustuv Saha

entry.summary: Studies how personality differences moderate the effectiveness of AI-driven negotiation coaching, finding that different personality profiles (resilient, overcontrolled, undercontrolled) benefit differently from AI vs. traditional coaching.

entry.title: MATHENA: Mamba-based Architectural Tooth Hierarchical Estimator and Holistic Evaluation Network for Anatomy

author.name: Kyeonghun Kim, Jaehyung Park, Youngung Han, Anna Jung, Seongbin Park, Sumin Lee, Jiwon Yang, Jiyoon Han, Subeen Lee, Junsu Lim, Hyunsu Go, Eunseob Choi, Hyeonseok Jung, Soo Yong Kim, Woo Kyoung Jeong, Won Jae Lee, Pa Hong, Hyuk-Jae Lee, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Nam-Joon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes MATHENA, a unified Mamba-based framework for dental diagnosis from panoramic X-rays that handles tooth detection, caries segmentation, anomaly detection, and developmental staging with linear-complexity state space models.

entry.title: Transfer learning for nonparametric Bayesian networks

author.name: Rafael Sojo, Pedro Larra\~naga, Concha Bielza

entry.summary: Introduces two transfer learning methods for nonparametric Bayesian networks under scarce data with metrics to detect negative transfer, using kernel density estimation for the parameters.

entry.title: Trust and Reliance on AI in Education: AI Literacy and Need for Cognition as Moderators

author.name: Griffin Pitts, Neha Rani, Weedguet Mildort

entry.summary: Studies how 432 undergraduates' trust in AI relates to their reliance on an AI assistant during programming tasks, finding that AI literacy and need for cognition moderate the trust-reliance relationship, especially when AI provides misleading information.

entry.title: LAtent Phase Inference from Short time sequences using SHallow REcurrent Decoders (LAPIS-SHRED)

author.name: Yuxuan Bao, Xingyue Zhang, J. Nathan Kutz

entry.summary: Introduces LAPIS-SHRED for reconstructing full spatiotemporal dynamics from sparse sensor observations in short temporal windows, using a three-stage pipeline combining SHRED with latent phase inference.

entry.title: UQ-SHRED: uncertainty quantification of shallow recurrent decoder networks for sparse sensing via engression

author.name: Mars Liyao Gao, Yuxuan Bao, Amy S. Rude, Xinwei Shen, J. Nathan Kutz

entry.summary: Introduces UQ-SHRED, adding uncertainty quantification to the SHRED sparse sensing architecture through engression (distributional regression), enabling calibrated uncertainty estimates for spatiotemporal field reconstruction.

entry.title: Pseudo-Quantized Actor-Critic Algorithm for Robustness to Noisy Temporal Difference Error

author.name: Taisuke Kobayashi

entry.summary: Proposes pseudo-quantized actor-critic for reinforcement learning that is robust to noisy temporal difference errors, derived from control-as-inference framework using distribution models of optimality.

entry.title: Cognitive Energy Modeling for Neuroadaptive Human-Machine Systems using EEG and WGAN-GP

author.name: Sriram Sattiraju, Vaibhav Gollapalli, Aryan Shah, Timothy McMahan

entry.summary: Uses Schrödinger Bridge Problem-derived transport cost to evaluate whether WGAN-GP synthetic EEG preserves cognitive state transition dynamics, proposing 'cognitive energy' as a metric for synthetic data quality.

entry.title: LI-DSN: A Layer-wise Interactive Dual-Stream Network for EEG Decoding

author.name: Chenghao Yue, Zhiyuan Ma, Zhongye Xia, Xinche Zhang, Yisi Zhang, Xinke Shen, Sen Song

entry.summary: Proposes LI-DSN, a layer-wise interactive dual-stream network for EEG decoding that enables progressive cross-stream communication between temporal and spatial branches at each layer, addressing the information silo problem.

entry.title: Generative Profiling for Soft Real-Time Systems and its Applications to Resource Allocation

author.name: Georgiy A. Bondar, Abigail Eisenklam, Yifan Cai, Robert Gifford, Tushar Sial, Linh Thi Xuan Phan, Abhishek Halder

entry.summary: Introduces a generative profiling approach using conditional multi-marginal Schrödinger Bridge to synthesize context-dependent timing profiles for real-time tasks, enabling resource allocation optimization for unmeasured configurations.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Transformer for Multi-Band Channel Frequency Response Reconstruction

author.name: Anatolij Zubow, Joana Angjo, Sigrid Dimce, Falko Dressler

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed complex Transformer for reconstructing wideband channel frequency responses from fragmented spectrum snapshots with interference modeled as Markov chains, using factored self-attention for efficiency.

entry.title: Abnormal Head Movements in Neurological Conditions: A Knowledge-Based Dataset with Application to Cervical Dystonia

author.name: Saja Al-Dabet, Sherzod Turaev, Nazar Zaki

entry.summary: Introduces NeuroPose-AHM, a knowledge-based dataset of abnormal head movements across 57 neurological conditions, constructed via multi-LLM extraction from 1,430 publications, containing 2,756 patient-group records.

entry.title: IndoorCrowd: A Multi-Scene Dataset for Human Detection, Segmentation, and Tracking with an Automated Annotation Pipeline

author.name: Sebastian-Ion Nae, Radu Moldoveanu, Alexandra Stefania Ghita, Adina Magda Florea

entry.summary: Introduces IndoorCrowd, a multi-scene indoor dataset for human detection, segmentation, and tracking with 31 videos and human-verified masks, benchmarking foundation model auto-annotators (SAM3, GroundingSAM) against human labels.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Speculative Trading under Exploratory Framework

author.name: Yun Zhao, Alex S. L. Tse, Harry Zheng

entry.summary: Formulates speculative trading as sequential optimal stopping within exploratory RL, modeling stopping times via Cox processes and deriving Gibbs distributions from entropy-regularized HJB equations.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Visuo-Tactile Object Perception

author.name: Anirvan Dutta, Simone Tasciotti, Claudia Cusseddu, Ang Li, Panayiota Poirazi, Julijana Gjorgjieva, Etienne Burdet, Patrick van der Smagt, Mohsen Kaboli

entry.summary: Surveys cross-modal visuo-tactile perception for robotic manipulation, addressing how vision and tactile sensing can be integrated for estimating physical properties during contact-rich interactions with non-rigid objects.

entry.title: AstroConcepts: A Large-Scale Multi-Label Classification Corpus for Astrophysics

author.name: Atilla Kaan Alkan, Felix Grezes, Sergi Blanco-Cuaresma, Jennifer Lynn Bartlett, Daniel Chivvis, Anna Kelbert, Kelly Lockhart, Alberto Accomazzi

entry.summary: Introduces AstroConcepts, a multi-label classification corpus of 21,702 astrophysics paper abstracts labeled with 2,367 concepts from a controlled vocabulary, exhibiting extreme class imbalance (76% of concepts have <50 examples).

entry.title: From High-Dimensional Spaces to Verifiable ODD Coverage for Safety-Critical AI-based Systems

author.name: Thomas Stefani, Johann Maximilian Christensen, Elena Hoemann, Frank K\"oster, Sven Hallerbach

entry.summary: Proposes a method for verifiable Operational Design Domain (ODD) coverage for safety-critical AI systems in aviation, addressing the gap between abstract ODD definitions and verifiable completeness in high-dimensional spaces.

entry.title: BVFLMSP : Bayesian Vertical Federated Learning for Multimodal Survival with Privacy

author.name: Abhilash Kar, Basisth Saha, Tanmay Sen, Biswabrata Pradhan

entry.summary: Proposes BVFLMSP, a Bayesian vertical federated learning framework for multimodal survival analysis that provides uncertainty estimates while keeping data private across parties using a split neural network architecture.

entry.title: Common TF-IDF variants arise as key components in the test statistic of a penalized likelihood-ratio test for word burstiness

author.name: Zeyad Ahmed, Paul Sheridan, Michael McIsaac, Aitazaz A. Farooque

entry.summary: Shows that common TF-IDF variants arise naturally from the test statistic of a penalized likelihood-ratio test for word burstiness, providing a principled statistical foundation for TF-IDF.

entry.title: Narrative Fingerprints: Multi-Scale Author Identification via Novelty Curve Dynamics

author.name: Fred Zimmerman, Hilmar AI

entry.summary: Demonstrates that authors have measurable 'fingerprints' in information-theoretic novelty curves of their works, with multi-scale features (book-level scalar dynamics and chapter-level SAX motif patterns) achieving significant attribution.

entry.title: Benchmarking and Mechanistic Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Cross-Depiction Assembly Instruction Alignment

author.name: Zhuchenyang Liu, Yao Zhang, Yu Xiao

entry.summary: Constructs IKEA-Bench to evaluate VLMs on assembly instruction understanding across depiction gaps (diagrams vs. real images), testing 19 models and finding significant struggles with cross-depiction alignment.

entry.title: Perceptual misalignment of texture representations in convolutional neural networks

author.name: Ludovica de Paolis, Fabio Anselmi, Alessio Ansuini, Eugenio Piasini

entry.summary: Investigates whether CNN texture representations (Gram matrices) align with human texture perception, testing if CNNs considered better models of the visual system also have more human-like texture representations. This bridges computational neuroscience and deep learning.

entry.title: HOT: Harmonic-Constrained Optimal Transport for Remote Photoplethysmography Domain Adaptation

author.name: Ba-Thinh Nguyen, Thi-Duyen Ngo, Thanh-Trung Huynh, Thanh-Ha Le, Huy-Hieu Pham

entry.summary: HOT introduces harmonic-constrained optimal transport for domain adaptation in remote photoplethysmography, using frequency domain adaptation to handle appearance variation across datasets.

entry.title: Setup-Independent Full Projector Compensation

author.name: Haibo Li, Qingyue Deng, Jijiang Li, Haibin Ling, Bingyao Huang

entry.summary: SIComp introduces the first setup-independent projector compensation framework that generalizes across different surfaces, lighting, and projector-camera poses without retraining.

entry.title: PTC-Depth: Pose-Refined Monocular Depth Estimation with Temporal Consistency

author.name: Leezy Han, Seunggyu Kim, Dongseok Shim, Hyeonbeom Lee

entry.summary: PTC-Depth uses wheel odometry from mobile robots to achieve temporally consistent monocular depth estimation by refining predictions with sparse depth from triangulation.

entry.title: Combining Boundary Supervision and Segment-Level Regularization for Fine-Grained Action Segmentation

author.name: Hinako Mitsuoka, Kazuhiro Hotta

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight dual-loss framework for temporal action segmentation combining boundary regression and CDF-based segment-level regularization, requiring minimal architectural modification.

entry.title: ProVG: Progressive Visual Grounding via Language Decoupling for Remote Sensing Imagery

author.name: Ke Li, Ting Wang, Di Wang, Yongshan Zhu, Yiming Zhang, Tao Lei, Quan Wang

entry.summary: ProVG proposes progressive visual grounding for remote sensing by decoupling language expressions into global context, spatial relations, and object attributes, using them at different grounding stages.

entry.title: A Self supervised learning framework for imbalanced medical imaging datasets

author.name: Yash Kumar Sharma, Charan Ramtej Kodi, Vineet Padmanabhan

entry.summary: Extends self-supervised learning for imbalanced medical imaging with asymmetric multi-image multi-view pairs, addressing both data scarcity and class imbalance simultaneously.

entry.title: SDesc3D: Towards Layout-Aware 3D Indoor Scene Generation from Short Descriptions

author.name: Jie Feng, Jiawei Shen, Junjia Huang, Junpeng Zhang, Mingtao Feng, Weisheng Dong, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: SDesc3D generates 3D indoor scenes from short textual descriptions, addressing challenges of physical plausibility and detail richness when semantic cues are condensed. Uses enhanced 3D reasoning with prior integration and spatial anchoring.

entry.title: MTLSI-Net: A Linear Semantic Interaction Network for Parameter-Efficient Multi-Task Dense Prediction

author.name: Chen Liu, Hengyu Man, Xiaopeng Fan, Debin Zhao

entry.summary: MTLSI-Net proposes linear attention-based cross-task interaction for multi-task dense prediction, reducing the quadratic complexity of standard self-attention while maintaining multi-scale feature capture.

entry.title: Network Structure in UK Payment Flows: Evidence on Economic Interdependencies and Implications for Real-Time Measurement

author.name: Aditya Humnabadkar

entry.summary: Analyzes UK payment network structure using graph-theoretic features on 532K payment records, showing network features improve forecasting by 8.8pp and prove especially valuable during economic disruptions like COVID-19.

entry.title: CoRegOVCD: Consistency-Regularized Open-Vocabulary Change Detection

author.name: Weidong Tang, Hanbin Sun, Zihan Li, Yikai Wang, Feifan Zhang

entry.summary: CoRegOVCD proposes a training-free framework for open-vocabulary change detection in remote sensing, using consistency regularization to handle appearance variation and noisy change evidence across dates.

entry.title: SCALE: Semantic- and Confidence-Aware Conditional Variational Autoencoder for Zero-shot Skeleton-based Action Recognition

author.name: Soroush Oraki, Feng Ding, Jie Liang

entry.summary: SCALE formulates zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition as class-conditional energy ranking using a text-conditioned CVAE, replacing brittle explicit skeleton-text alignment with likelihood-based evaluation.

entry.title: DenOiS: Dual-Domain Denoising of Observation and Solution in Ultrasound Image Reconstruction

author.name: Can Deniz Bezek, Orcun Goksel

entry.summary: DenOiS proposes dual-domain denoising for ultrasound image reconstruction, denoising both input observations and reconstruction solutions, improving plug-and-play approaches that currently depend heavily on measurement quality.

entry.title: When does learning pay off? A study on DRL-based dynamic algorithm configuration for carbon-aware scheduling

author.name: Andrea Mencaroni, Robbert Reijnen, Yingqian Zhang, Dieter Claeys

entry.summary: Investigates when deep reinforcement learning for dynamic algorithm configuration is worth the training cost, using carbon-aware flow-shop scheduling as a case study to assess generalization across instance types and scales.

entry.title: Robust Autonomous Control of a Magnetic Millirobot in In Vitro Cardiac Flow

author.name: Anuruddha Bhattacharjee, Xinhao Chen, Lamar O. Mair, Suraj Raval, Yancy Diaz-Mercado, Axel Krieger

entry.summary: Presents a vision-guided control framework for autonomous navigation of magnetic millirobots in cardiac flow, integrating UNet localization, A* planning, and sliding mode control for minimally invasive therapy.

entry.title: A Graph Neural Network Approach for Solving the Ranked Assignment Problem in Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Robin Dehler, Martin Herrmann, Jan Strohbeck, Michael Buchholz

entry.summary: Applies Graph Neural Networks to solve the ranked assignment problem in multi-object tracking, replacing Murty's algorithm or Gibbs sampling in the δ-GLMB filter for better complexity-accuracy tradeoff.

entry.title: Preferential Bayesian Optimization with Crash Feedback

author.name: Johanna Menn, David Stenger, Sebastian Trimpe

entry.summary: Extends Preferential Bayesian Optimization (PBO) to handle crash feedback from hardware systems like quadcopters, where standard methods cannot incorporate information from catastrophic failures. This is practically important for real-world robotics optimization.

entry.title: Koopman Subspace Pruning in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces via Principal Vectors

author.name: Dhruv Shah, Jorge Cortes

entry.summary: Extends Koopman operator subspace pruning to Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces by developing methods for computing principal angles and vectors in RKHS geometry. Enables better finite-dimensional approximations of the infinite-dimensional Koopman operator.

entry.title: Is AI a house of cards?

author.name: David Scott Krueger (formerly: capybaralet)

entry.summary: David Krueger argues AI is not a bubble in the traditional sense because the fundamentals may be sound - if AI takes everyone's jobs, AI company investments are rational. However, he raises the concept of AI as a 'house of cards' due to structural fragility from interconnected dependencies.

entry.title: Thoughts on causal isolation of AI evaluation benchmarks

author.name: Dentosal

entry.summary: Discusses the challenge of causally isolating AI benchmarks from training data contamination. Analyzes limitations of holdout sets and proposes thinking about causal isolation as a framework for benchmark design.

entry.title: Collaborative AI Agents and Critics for Fault Detection and Cause Analysis in Network Telemetry

author.name: Syed Eqbal Alam, Zhan Shu

entry.summary: Develops collaborative multi-agent AI systems with critics for fault detection and cause analysis in network telemetry, using a federated multi-agent architecture where critics evaluate and provide feedback to agents.

entry.title: Cosine-Normalized Attention for Hyperspectral Image Classification

author.name: Muhammad Ahmad, Manuel Mazzara

entry.summary: Proposes cosine-normalized attention for hyperspectral image classification that uses angular similarity on a unit hypersphere instead of dot-product, better matching the geometric structure of spectral signatures.

entry.title: FTPFusion: Frequency-Aware Infrared and Visible Video Fusion with Temporal Perturbation

author.name: Xilai Li, Chusheng Fang, Xiaosong Li

entry.summary: FTPFusion proposes frequency-aware infrared-visible video fusion with temporal perturbation, decomposing features into high/low frequency components for collaborative spatial-temporal modeling.

entry.title: Test-Time Adaptation for Height Completion via Self-Supervised ViT Features and Monocular Foundation Models

author.name: Osher Rafaeli, Tal Svoray, Ariel Nahlieli

entry.summary: Prior2DSM proposes a training-free test-time adaptation method for completing digital surface models using self-supervised ViT features and monocular depth foundation models, avoiding the need for sensor-specific training.

entry.title: MorphoGuard: A Morphology-Based Whole-Body Interactive Motion Controller

author.name: Chenjin Wang, Zheng Yan, Yanmin Zhou, Runjie Shen, Bin He

entry.summary: Proposes MorphoGuard, a whole-body control network for robots handling dynamic multi-contact combinations along single kinematic chains. Trained on both physical and simulated dual-arm platforms with morphology constraints.

entry.title: Improvisational Games as a Benchmark for Social Intelligence of AI Agents: The Case of Connections

author.name: Gaurav Rajesh Parikh, Angikar Ghosal

entry.summary: Introduces an improvisational wordplay game called Connections as a benchmark for evaluating social intelligence of AI agents, testing knowledge retrieval, summarization, and awareness of other agents' cognitive states.

entry.title: How Trustworthy Are LLM-as-Judge Ratings for Interpretive Responses? Implications for Qualitative Research Workflows

author.name: Songhee Han, Jueun Shin, Jiyoon Han, Bung-Woo Jun, Hilal Ayan Karabatman

entry.summary: Studies whether LLM-as-judge evaluations align with human judgments for interpretive qualitative research responses, using 712 excerpts from teacher interviews to assess model selection for research workflows.

entry.title: Detecting Complex Money Laundering Patterns with Incremental and Distributed Graph Modeling

author.name: Haseeb Tariq, Alen Kaja, Marwan Hassani

entry.summary: Proposes ReDiRect framework for money laundering detection using incremental and distributed graph modeling to handle scale, complexity, and reduce false positives compared to rule-based systems.

entry.title: Label Shift Estimation With Incremental Prior Update

author.name: Yunrui Zhang, Gustavo Batista, Salil S. Kanhere

entry.summary: Proposes incremental prior update method for label shift estimation, addressing the practical scenario where test label distributions change over time while the likelihood p(x|y) remains stable.

entry.title: A Learning-Based Cooperative Coevolution Framework for Heterogeneous Large-Scale Global Optimization

author.name: Wenjie Qiu, Zixin Wang, Hongyu Fang, Zeyuan Ma, Yue-Jiao Gong

entry.summary: Proposes LH-CC, a learning-based cooperative coevolution framework for heterogeneous large-scale optimization that uses a meta-agent to adaptively select optimizers for subproblems with diverse dimensions and landscapes.

entry.title: Learning Spatial Structure from Pre-Beamforming Per-Antenna Range-Doppler Radar Data via Visibility-Aware Cross-Modal Supervision

author.name: George Sebastian, Philipp Berthold, Bianca Forkel, Leon Pohl, Mirko Maehlisch

entry.summary: Investigates learning spatial structure directly from pre-beamforming per-antenna radar data rather than traditional angle-domain representations, using dual-chirp shared-weight architectures on commodity automotive radar.

entry.title: Prototype-Based Low Altitude UAV Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Da Zhang, Gao Junyu, Zhao Zhiyuan

entry.summary: PBSeg proposes an efficient prototype-based segmentation framework for UAV imagery using prototype-based cross-attention to reduce computational complexity while handling extreme scale variations.

entry.title: BTS-rPPG: Orthogonal Butterfly Temporal Shifting for Remote Photoplethysmography

author.name: Ba-Thinh Nguyen, Thi-Duyen Ngo, Thanh-Trung Huynh, Thanh-Ha Le, Huy-Hieu Pham

entry.summary: BTS-rPPG proposes an orthogonal butterfly temporal shifting mechanism inspired by FFT communication patterns for remote photoplethysmography, enabling structured long-range temporal frame interactions.

entry.title: End-to-End Shared Attention Estimation via Group Detection with Feedback Refinement

author.name: Chihiro Nakatani, Norimichi Ukita, Jean-Marc Odobez

entry.summary: Proposes an end-to-end method for shared attention estimation via group detection with feedback refinement, simultaneously detecting groups and estimating shared attention points.

entry.title: M3D-BFS: a Multi-stage Dynamic Fusion Strategy for Sample-Adaptive Multi-Modal Brain Network Analysis

author.name: Rui Dong, Xiaotong Zhang, Jiaxing Li, Yueying Li, Jiayin Wei, Youyong Kong

entry.summary: M3D-BFS proposes a multi-stage dynamic fusion strategy for brain network analysis that adapts computation per sample, unlike static fusion methods, integrating structural and functional connectivity modalities.

entry.title: HyVGGT-VO: Tightly Coupled Hybrid Dense Visual Odometry with Feed-Forward Models

author.name: Junxiang Pan, Lipu Zhou, Baojie Chen

entry.summary: Proposes HyVGGT-VO, a hybrid visual odometry system that combines efficient sparse tracking for high-frequency pose estimation with dense feed-forward models for 3D reconstruction, addressing the computational limitations of dense-only SLAM systems.

entry.title: Human-in-the-Loop Control of Objective Drift in LLM-Assisted Computer Science Education

author.name: Mark Dranias, Adam Whitley

entry.title: Preference Guided Iterated Pareto Referent Optimisation for Accessible Route Planning

author.name: Paolo Speziali, Arno De Greef, Mehrdad Asadi, Willem R\"opke, Ann Now\'e, Diederik M. Roijers

entry.summary: Proposes PG-IPRO for accessible urban route planning with user feedback, allowing users to specify which objectives to minimize or relax through intuitive interaction, without computing the full Pareto front.

entry.title: Towards Automatic Soccer Commentary Generation with Knowledge-Enhanced Visual Reasoning

author.name: Zeyu Jin, Xiaoyu Qin, Songtao Zhou, Kaifeng Yun, Jia Jia

entry.summary: Proposes GameSight, a two-stage model for automatic soccer commentary generation using knowledge-enhanced visual reasoning with accurate entity references.

entry.title: Beyond Symbolic Control: Societal Consequences of AI-Driven Workforce Displacement and the Imperative for Genuine Human Oversight Architectures

author.name: Richard J. Mitchell

entry.summary: A broad societal analysis of AI-driven workforce displacement examining effects on economics, psychology, politics, education, healthcare, and geopolitics, with focus on the gap between nominal and genuine human oversight.

entry.title: Neural-Assisted in-Motion Self-Heading Alignment

author.name: Zeev Yampolsky, Felipe O. Silva, Adriano Frutuoso, Itzik Klein

entry.title: HabitatAgent: An End-to-End Multi-Agent System for Housing Consultation

author.name: Hongyang Yang, Yanxin Zhang, Yang She, Yue Xiao, Hao Wu, Yiyang Zhang, Jiapeng Hou, Rongshan Zhang

entry.summary: Presents HabitatAgent, a multi-agent LLM system for housing consultation with specialized Memory, Retrieval, Generation, and Validation agents that maintain multi-layer user memory and verify factual claims.

entry.title: Learning Quantised Structure-Preserving Motion Representations for Dance Fingerprinting

author.name: Arina Kharlamova, Bowei He, Chen Ma, Xue Liu

entry.summary: Presents DANCEMATCH, a motion-based dance retrieval system that constructs discrete motion signatures from skeleton data using quantization and spatio-temporal transformers for efficient large-scale dance fingerprinting.

entry.title: Multimodal Analysis of State-Funded News Coverage of the Israel-Hamas War on YouTube Shorts

author.name: Daniel Miehling, Sandra Kuebler

entry.summary: Analyzes YouTube Shorts coverage of the Israel-Hamas war by state-funded outlets using a multimodal pipeline combining transcription, aspect-based sentiment analysis, and visual scene classification across 2,300+ videos.

entry.title: Adversarial Attacks in AI-Driven RAN Slicing: SLA Violations and Recovery

author.name: Deemah H. Tashman, Soumaya Cherkaoui

entry.summary: Studies adversarial jamming attacks on AI-driven RAN slicing in next-generation cellular networks, where attackers bias deep reinforcement learning models to cause SLA violations across network slices.

entry.title: Feature Weighting Improves Pool-Based Sequential Active Learning for Regression

author.name: Dongrui Wu

entry.summary: Proposes feature-weighted active learning approaches for regression that incorporate feature importance via ridge regression coefficients into inter-sample distance computations, improving sample selection for both single-task and multi-task settings.

entry.title: Application of parametric Shallow Recurrent Decoder Network to magnetohydrodynamic flows in liquid metal blankets of fusion reactors

author.name: M. Lo Verso, C. Introini, E. Cervi, L. Savoldi, J. N. Kutz, A. Cammi

entry.summary: Applies a data-driven Shallow Recurrent Decoder Network with SVD-based dimensionality reduction for reconstructing magnetohydrodynamic flow states in fusion reactor liquid metal blankets, enabling faster computation for parametric studies.

entry.title: When AI Gets it Wong: Reliability and Risk in AI-Assisted Medication Decision Systems

author.name: Khalid Adnan Alsayed

entry.summary: Examines reliability failures in AI-assisted medication decision systems, shifting focus from aggregate metrics to system failures and their clinical consequences in high-risk pharmacy settings.

entry.title: Probabilistic classification from possibilistic data: computing Kullback-Leibler projection with a possibility distribution

author.name: Isma\"il Baaj, Pierre Marquis

entry.title: Systematic Analyses of Reinforcement Learning Controllers in Signalized Urban Corridors

author.name: Xiaofei Song, Kerstin Eder, Jonathan Lawry, R. Eddie Wilson

entry.title: AEGIS: Adversarial Entropy-Guided Immune System -- Thermodynamic State Space Models for Zero-Day Network Evasion Detection

author.name: Vickson Ferrel

entry.title: Best-Arm Identification with Noisy Actuation

entry.title: Phonological Fossils: Machine Learning Detection of Non-Mainstream Vocabulary in Sulawesi Basic Lexicon

entry.title: A Japanese Benchmark for Evaluating Social Bias in Reasoning Based on Attribution Theory

entry.title: English to Central Kurdish Speech Translation: Corpus Creation, Evaluation, and Orthographic Standardization

author.name: Mohammad Mohammadamini, Daban Q. Jaff, Josep Crego, Marie Tahon, Antoine Laurent
