entry.title: True (VIS) Lies: Analyzing How Generative AI Recognizes Intentionality, Rhetoric, and Misleadingness in Visualization Lies

author.name: Graziano Blasilli, Marco Angelini

entry.summary: Studies whether multimodal LLMs can identify misleading visualizations and recognize their underlying causes and intentionality, using COVID-19 tweets and VisLies examples.

entry.title: Camouflage-aware Image-Text Retrieval via Expert Collaboration

author.name: Yao Jiang, Zhongkuan Mao, Xuan Wu, Keren Fu, Qijun Zhao

entry.summary: Presents a general-purpose analysis pipeline for human pose data combining preprocessing, dimensionality reduction, and recurrence-based time series analysis for behavioral research using markerless pose estimation.

entry.title: Captioning Daily Activity Images in Early Childhood Education: Benchmark and Algorithm

author.name: Sixing Li, Zhibin Gu, Ziqi Zhang, Weiguo Pan, Bing Li, Ying Wang, Hongzhe Liu

author.name: Juan Manuel Hernandez, Mariana Fernandez-Espinosa, Denis Parra, Diego Gomez-Zara

entry.title: A soft and lightweight fabric-based pneumatic interface for multimodal fingertip tactile feedback

author.name: Rui Chen, Daniele Leonardis, Antonio Frisoli

author.name: Chenyang Liang, Liangming Chen, Baoyi Cui, Jie Mei

entry.title: Global Geometry of Orthogonal Foliations in the Control Allocation of Signed-Quadratic Systems

author.name: Antonio Franchi

entry.title: Eyla: Toward an Identity-Anchored LLM Architecture with Integrated Biological Priors -- Vision, Implementation Attempt, and Lessons from AI-Assisted Development

author.name: Arif Aditto

entry.title: Learning to Play Blackjack: A Curriculum Learning Perspective

author.name: Amirreza Alasti, Efe Erdal, Y\"ucel Celik, Theresa Eimer

author.name: Maofeng Tang, Hairong Qi

author.name: Oluwamayowa O. Amusat, Luka Grbcic, Remi Patureau, M. Jibran S. Zuberi, Dan Gunter, Michael Wetter

entry.title: Know Your Streams: On the Conceptualization, Characterization, and Generation of Intentional Event Streams

author.name: Andrea Maldonado, Christian Imenkamp, Hendrik Reiter, Thomas Seidl, Wilhelm Hasselbring, Martin Werner, Agnes Koschmider

author.name: Jinsu Shin, Sungeun Hong, Jin Yeong Bak

entry.title: From Baselines to Preferences: A Comparative Study of LoRA/QLoRA and Preference Optimization for Mental Health Text Classification

author.name: Mihael Arcan

entry.summary: Systematic comparison of LoRA/QLoRA and preference optimization (DPO, ORPO, KTO) for mental health text classification, focusing on methodological insights rather than headline scores.

entry.title: CLPIPS: A Personalized Metric for AI-Generated Image Similarity

author.name: Khoi Trinh, Jay Rothenberger, Scott Seidenberger, Dimitrios Diochnos, Anindya Maiti

author.name: Mengtian Li, Fan Yang, Ruixue Xiong, Yiyan Fan, Zhifeng Xie, Zeyu Wang

author.name: Virmarie Maquiling, Yasmeen Abdrabou, Enkelejda Kasneci

entry.summary: Night Eyes introduces a constellation-based pipeline for multi-glint detection in eye tracking, treating glints as structured constellations rather than independent blobs, inspired by star identification.

entry.title: Deep Neural Network Based Roadwork Detection for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Sebastian Wullrich, Nicolai Steinke, Daniel Goehring

entry.summary: Presents a real-time roadwork detection system combining YOLO with LiDAR for autonomous driving, achieving <0.5m localization accuracy on real-world construction sites in Berlin.

entry.title: Smooth Feedback Motion Planning with Reduced Curvature

author.name: Aref Amiri, Steven M. LaValle

entry.summary: Proposes a computationally efficient method for smoother feedback motion planning over simplicial decompositions, reducing unnecessary path bending through aligned vector fields and maximal star-shaped chains.

author.name: Roger Fowler, Cahit Ikbal Er, Benjamin Johnsenberg, Yasin Yazicioglu

entry.summary: Proposes PRO-SPECT, a polynomial-time algorithm for energy-aware planning of UAV-UGV teams under stochastic travel times, bounding the probability of energy depletion across the entire mission with user-specified risk levels.

author.name: Gianluca Giacchi, Michael Multerer, Jacopo Quizi

entry.title: Anthropic's Pause is the Most Expensive Alarm in Corporate History [Fiction]

author.name: Ruby

entry.summary: Fiction piece imagining Anthropic pausing AI development due to safety concerns, exploring what it would mean for a corporation to voluntarily halt its core product for safety reasons.

entry.title: A virtual-variable-length method for robust inverse kinematics of multi-segment continuum robots

entry.title: DriftScript: A Domain-Specific Language for Programming Non-Axiomatic Reasoning Agents

author.name: Oleg Grynets, Vasyl Lyashkevych

entry.summary: Proposes a unified architecture metamodel for LLM-oriented information systems covering key architectural diagram types and supporting bidirectional Code-to-Documentation-to-Code transformations.

entry.title: AI-Mediated Explainable Regulation for Justice

author.name: Thomas Hofweber, Andreas Sudmann, Evangelos Pournaras

entry.summary: Proposes using distributed AI to make regulatory recommendations that are explainable and adaptable, modeling stakeholder preferences with separate AI components to address problems like regulatory capture and illegitimacy.

author.name: Ricardo Hidalgo-Arag\'on, Jes\'us M. Gonz\'alez-Barahona, Gregorio Robles

entry.title: Variational LSTM with Augmented Inputs: Nonlinear Response History Metamodeling with Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty

author.name: Manisha Sapkota, Min Li, Bowei Li

entry.summary: Proposes variational LSTM with augmented inputs for structural response forecasting, capturing both aleatoric (excitation/structural) and epistemic (model) uncertainty for performance-based engineering design.

entry.title: Koopman-Based Nonlinear Identification and Adaptive Control of a Turbofan Engine

author.name: David Grasev

entry.summary: Investigates Koopman operator-based approaches for turbofan engine control, developing meta-heuristic extended dynamic mode decomposition and two controllers (adaptive MPC and feedback linearization) validated on a physics-based engine model.

entry.title: Bridging Deep Learning and Integer Linear Programming: A Predictive-to-Prescriptive Framework for Supply Chain Analytics

author.name: Khai Banh Nghiep, Duc Nguyen Minh, Lan Hoang Thi

entry.summary: Combines N-BEATS/N-HiTS forecasting with integer linear programming for supply chain optimization, tested on 180K transactions with delivery tracking data.

entry.title: VIANA: character Value-enhanced Intensity Assessment via domain-informed Neural Architecture

entry.title: Scalable Identification and Prioritization of Requisition-Specific Personal Competencies Using Large Language Models

author.name: Wanxin Li, Denver McNeney, Nivedita Prabhu, Charlene Zhang, Renee Barr, Matthew Kitching, Khanh Dao Duc, Anthony S. Boyce

entry.title: Detecting Abnormal User Feedback Patterns through Temporal Sentiment Aggregation

author.name: Yalun Qi, Sichen Zhao, Zhiming Xue, Xianling Zeng, Zihan Yu

entry.title: Human Pose Estimation in Trampoline Gymnastics: Improving Performance Using a New Synthetic Dataset

author.name: L\'ea Drolet-Roy, Victor Nogues, Sylvain Gaudet, Eve Charbonneau, Micka\"el Begon, Lama S\'eoud

entry.title: Center-Aware Detection with Swin-based Co-DETR Framework for Cervical Cytology

entry.title: CXR-LT 2026 Challenge: Projection-Aware Multi-Label and Zero-Shot Chest X-Ray Classification

author.name: Juno Cho (KAIST), Dohui Kim (GIST), Mingeon Kim (KAIST), Hyunseo Jang (Korea University), Chang Sun Lee (KAIST Graduate School of AI), Jong Chul Ye (KAIST Graduate School of AI)

entry.summary: Challenge solution for multi-label and zero-shot chest X-ray classification, integrating projection-specific models with CheXzero dual-branch architecture and LLM-generated descriptive prompts.

entry.title: Lightweight Spatiotemporal Highway Lane Detection via 3D-ResNet and PINet with ROI-Aware Attention

author.name: Sorna Shanmuga Raja, Abdelhafid Zenati

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight spatiotemporal highway lane detection architecture combining 3D-ResNet with PINet decoder, using FPN, self-attention, and ROI detection for efficient lane detection.

entry.title: Bridging Discrete Planning and Continuous Execution for Redundant Robot

author.name: Teng Yan, Yue Yu, Yihan Liu, Bingzhuo Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes a bridging framework between discrete voxel-grid path planning and continuous execution for redundant 7-DOF manipulators, addressing step-size jitter and instability near singularities without modifying the discrete planner.

entry.title: ROS 2-Based LiDAR Perception Framework for Mobile Robots in Dynamic Production Environments, Utilizing Synthetic Data Generation, Transformation-Equivariant 3D Detection and Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Lukas Bergs, Tan Chung, Marmik Thakkar, Alexander Moriz, Amon G\"oppert, Chinnawut Nantabut, Robert Schmitt

entry.summary: Presents a ROS 2-based LiDAR perception framework for mobile robots in dynamic production environments, using synthetic training data and transformation-equivariant 3D detection with multi-object tracking. Validated across 72 scenarios with motion capture.

entry.title: A conversation on concentration of power

author.name: Joe Rogero

entry.summary: A dialogue-format exploration of AI-driven power concentration risks, discussing scenarios from mass surveillance to wealth concentration via automation. Examines the dynamics between AI companies, governments, and potential countermeasures.

entry.title: A ROS 2 Wrapper for Florence-2: Multi-Mode Local Vision-Language Inference for Robotic Systems

author.name: J. E. Dom\'inguez-Vidal

entry.summary: Presents a ROS 2 wrapper for Florence-2 vision-language model, exposing it through continuous topic processing, synchronous service calls, and asynchronous action servers for robotic systems.

entry.title: Transformer self-attention encoder-decoder with multimodal deep learning for response time series forecasting and digital twin support in wind structural health monitoring

author.name: Feiyu Zhou, Marios Impraimakis

entry.summary: Examines a transformer self-attention encoder-decoder with multimodal deep learning for wind-induced structural response forecasting and digital twin bridge monitoring, using deviation detection as early warning.

entry.title: Dual-Attention Based 3D Channel Estimation

author.name: Xiangzhao Qin, Sha Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-attention based 3D channel estimation network for MIMO systems that explores correlations across time, frequency, and spatial domains simultaneously.

entry.title: Neural network methods for two-dimensional finite-source reflector design

author.name: Roel Hacking, Lisa Kusch, Koondanibha Mitra, Martijn Anthonissen, Wilbert IJzerman

entry.summary: Applies neural network parameterization to inverse reflector design for finite-source lighting systems, developing differentiable objective functions for optimizing far-field light distributions.

entry.title: LiteInception: A Lightweight and Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for General Aviation Fault Diagnosis

author.name: Zhihuan Wei, Xinhang Chen, Danyang Han, Yang Hu, Jie Liu, Xuewen Miao, Guijiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes LiteInception, a lightweight interpretable fault diagnosis framework for general aviation with a two-stage cascaded architecture (detection then classification) designed for edge deployment with model compression.

entry.title: (PAC-)Learning state machines from data streams: A generic strategy and an improved heuristic (Extended version)

author.name: Robert Baumgartner, Sicco Verwer

entry.summary: Extended version of a 2023 paper on learning state machines from data streams, now including formal PAC-bounds proofs and expanded discussion of the streaming learning approach.

entry.title: ViTs for Action Classification in Videos: An Approach to Risky Tackle Detection in American Football Practice Videos

author.name: Syed Ahsan Masud Zaidi, William Hsu, Scott Dietrich

entry.summary: Presents a Vision Transformer-based method for detecting risky tackles in American football practice videos with an expanded dataset of 733 clips, achieving risky recall of 0.67.

entry.title: Automated Prostate Gland Segmentation in MRI Using nnU-Net

author.name: Pablo Rodriguez-Belenguer, Gloria Ribas, Javier Aquerreta Escribano, Rafael Moreno-Calatayud, Leonor Cerda-Alberich, Luis Marti-Bonmati

entry.summary: Applies the nnU-Net v2 framework for automatic prostate gland segmentation in multiparametric MRI, achieving high accuracy using T2-weighted, DWI, and ADC inputs. This is a clinical application paper rather than a methodological advance.

entry.title: Analysis of Efficient Transmission Methods of Grid Maps for Intelligent Vehicles

author.name: Robin Dehler, Dominik Authaler, Aryan Thakur, Thomas Wodtko, Michael Buchholz

entry.summary: Proposes and evaluates efficient compression and transmission methods for grid maps used in intelligent vehicle perception, addressing the challenge that cell-level environment representations generate inherently large data sizes. Compares patched grid maps and other approaches for reducing bandwidth while preserving environmental information.

entry.title: Have an Unreasonably Specific Story About The Future

author.name: Jay Bailey

entry.summary: Proposes that AI safety researchers should construct 'unreasonably specific stories' about how their work leads to good outcomes, as a planning and motivation tool. Uses backchaining methodology to construct concrete scenarios.

entry.title: A Reliability Evaluation of Hybrid Deterministic-LLM Based Approaches for Academic Course Registration PDF Information Extraction

author.name: Muhammad Anis Al Hilmi, Neelansh Khare, Noel Framil Iglesias

entry.summary: Evaluates three information extraction approaches for academic course registration PDFs using LLMs, comparing LLM-only, hybrid regex+LLM, and Camelot-based pipelines across 860 documents.

entry.title: Toward Optimal Sampling Rate Selection and Unbiased Classification for Precise Animal Activity Recognition

author.name: Axiu Mao, Meilu Zhu, Lei Shen, Xiaoshuai Wang, Tomas Norton, Kai Liu

entry.summary: Proposes IBA-Net for wearable sensor-based animal activity recognition that handles suboptimal sampling rates and class imbalance to achieve high accuracy across all individual behaviors.

entry.title: Benchmark Problems and Benchmark Datasets for the evaluation of Machine and Deep Learning methods on Photoplethysmography signals: the D4 report from the QUMPHY project

author.name: Urs Hackstein, Jordi Alastruey, Philip Aston, Ciaran Bench, Peter H. Charlton, Loic Coquelin, Nando Hegemann, Vaidotas Marozas, Mohammad Moulaeifard, Manasi Nandi, Andrius Petrenas, Oskar Pfeffer, Mantas Rinkevicius, Andrius Solosenko, Nils Strodthoff, Sara Vardanega

entry.summary: Benchmark report for evaluating ML/DL methods on photoplethysmography (PPG) signals, listing six medical benchmark problems and suitable datasets as part of the EU-funded Qumphy project.

entry.title: Intelligent Cloud Orchestration: A Hybrid Predictive and Heuristic Framework for Cost Optimization

author.name: Heet Nagoriya, Komal Rohit

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid cloud orchestration framework combining LSTM-based predictive scaling with game-theory heuristic task allocation to reduce infrastructure costs while maintaining responsiveness to traffic spikes.

entry.title: A Practical Two-Stage Framework for GPU Resource and Power Prediction in Heterogeneous HPC Systems

author.name: Beste Oztop, Dhruva Kulkarni, Zhengji Zhao, Ayse Kivilcim Coskun, Kadidia Konate

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework for predicting GPU resource utilization and power consumption of HPC applications using Slurm logs and NVIDIA DCGM metrics, applied to the VASP materials science application on Perlmutter.

entry.title: Polish phonology and morphology through the lens of distributional semantics

author.name: Paula Orzechowska, R. Harald Baayen

entry.summary: Investigates how Polish word form properties (consonant clusters, morphology) relate to meaning using distributional semantics, demonstrating systematic form-meaning mappings beyond arbitrary Saussurean signs.

entry.title: Realistic Lip Motion Generation Based on 3D Dynamic Viseme and Coarticulation Modeling for Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Sheng Li, Jingcheng Huang, Min Li

entry.summary: Presents a lip motion generation framework for humanoid robots based on 3D dynamic visemes and coarticulation modeling for Chinese speech, using ARKit standards. Retargets high-dimensional lip motions to a 14-DOF humanoid head actuator system.

entry.title: The Practical Guide to Superbabies

author.name: GeneSmith

entry.summary: Detailed practical guide to polygenic embryo screening for selecting embryos with favorable genetic traits, covering the science, process, costs, and ethical considerations. Written by someone who has been advocating and working in reproductive genetics.

entry.title: OkanNet: A Lightweight Deep Learning Architecture for Classification of Brain Tumor from MRI Images

author.name: Okan U\c{c}ar, Murat Kurt

entry.summary: Presents OkanNet, a custom lightweight CNN for brain tumor classification from MRI images, compared against transfer learning approaches. Standard medical imaging classification study.

entry.title: Semantic Shifts of Psychological Concepts in Scientific and Popular Media Discourse: A Distributional Semantics Analysis of Russian-Language Corpora

author.name: Orlova Anastasia

entry.summary: Examines semantic shifts of psychological concepts between Russian scientific and popular media discourse using distributional semantics, revealing how meanings diverge across registers.

entry.title: Integrated Identification of Collaborative Robots for Robot Assisted 3D Printing Processes

author.name: Alessandro Dimauro, Davide Tebaldi, Fabio Pini, Luigi Biagiotti, Francesco Leali

entry.summary: Proposes model-based identification for collaborative robots used in 3D printing (additive manufacturing), integrating identification of robot, actuator, and controller parameters to improve precision in non-planar deposition.

entry.title: We Need Positive Visions of the Future

author.name: Ihor Kendiukhov

entry.summary: Argues that the AI safety community needs positive visions of the future to counteract despair and provide motivation for both safety researchers and capabilities researchers. Suggests that lack of positive vision is itself contributing to dangerous dynamics.

entry.title: Go Big or Go Home: Simulating Mobbing Behavior with Braitenbergian Robots

author.name: Elaheh Sanoubari

entry.summary: Simulates mobbing behavior (cooperative anti-predator attacks) using Braitenberg-style robots in the Webots simulator, exploring effects of mobbing call range and group size.

entry.title: A Determinantal Approach to a Sharp $\ell^1-\ell^\infty-\ell^2$ Norm Inequality

author.name: Jose Antonio Lara Benitez

entry.summary: Provides a short linear-algebraic proof of a sharp inequality relating ℓ¹, ℓ∞, and ℓ² norms using determinantal structure, showing the constant (1+√p)/2 is optimal.

entry.title: Frege in the Flesh: Biolinguistics and the Neural Enforcement of Syntactic Structures

author.name: Elliot Murphy

entry.summary: Discusses the biological foundations of human language from a biolinguistics perspective, focusing on the MERGE operation as a natural mathematical structure and its neural implementation.

entry.title: Valency Classification of Mapudungun Verbal Roots. Established by the language's own morphotactics

author.name: Andr\'es Chand\'ia

entry.summary: Provides a valency classification of Mapudungun verbal roots using the language's own morphotactics, contributing to morphological analysis tools for this indigenous language.

entry.title: Enhanced Polarization Locking in VCSELs

author.name: Zifeng Yuan, Dewen Zhang, Lei Shi, Yutong Liu, Aaron Danner

entry.summary: Studies polarization locking in VCSELs through tailored oxide aperture designs and bias current tuning, reducing required injection power for polarization switching applications.

entry.title: 2026: The year of throwing my agency at my health (now with added cyborgism)

author.name: Ruby

entry.summary: A personal account of using technology and agency to manage bipolar disorder, including continuous monitoring and AI-assisted health tracking. Documents using various tools for real-time mental state monitoring.

entry.title: NFC based inventory control system for secure and efficient communication

author.name: Razi Iqbal, Awais Ahmad, Asfandyar Gillani

entry.summary: Proposes using NFC instead of barcodes for inventory control, discussing security and efficiency advantages.

author.name: Rebecca Dai

entry.summary: A reflective essay on the nature of art and authorship in the age of LLMs, arguing that great art requires genuine human emotional experience and intentionality that AI cannot replicate.

author.name: Kaj_Sotala

entry.summary: Explores how social ideas and frameworks get systematically corrupted, with examples from attachment theory and other domains. Argues corruption follows predictable patterns related to individuals' pre-existing biases.

author.name: J Bostock

entry.summary: An essay using the history of cocktail-making and bird evolution as metaphors for how optimization processes can lose sight of original purposes, drawing parallels to broader trends in technology and culture.

author.name: Benquo

entry.summary: Essay challenging the claim that the US is a cognitive meritocracy, using National Merit Scholarship data to show that high-IQ identification doesn't automatically lead to elite outcomes. Discusses structural barriers.

author.name: ChristianKl

entry.summary: Philosophical essay about 'texture of experience' on a rough-to-smooth axis, with examples comparing direct vs mediated experiences.

entry.title: Research Summary: April 02, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research is dominated by AI safety and alignment findings that challenge core assumptions about reasoning model oversight and deployed safety measures.

  • DeepMind identifies conditions under which RL training degrades Chain-of-Thought monitorability, a critical result for scalable oversight strategies
  • Trojan-Speak bypasses Anthropic's Constitutional Classifiers via adversarial fine-tuning with no jailbreak tax, exposing limits of current safety filters
  • Linear probes reveal reasoning models make decisions *before* generating chain-of-thought, questioning whether CoT faithfully reflects model reasoning
  • UK AISI publishes an alignment evaluation finding no confirmed sabotage by frontier coding assistants
  • ThoughtSteer demonstrates backdoor attacks on continuous latent reasoning models like Coconut and SimCoT, revealing a new attack surface
  • Reasoning Shift shows context can silently shorten LLM reasoning traces by up to 50%, undermining reasoning robustness

Beyond safety, Multiscreen challenges transformer orthodoxy by replacing softmax attention with a screening mechanism enabling absolute query-key relevance scoring. A methodological critique reveals 18–36% of sparse autoencoder features flagged as polysemantic may instead reflect natural lexical polysemy, complicating mechanistic interpretability metrics. NARCBench introduces collusion detection across multi-agent systems using internal representations. Zvi Mowshowitz provides a detailed critical analysis of Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy v3, arguing key commitments were weakened.

entry.title: UK AISI Alignment Evaluation Case-Study

author.name: Alexandra Souly, Robert Kirk, Jacob Merizian, Abby D'Cruz, Xander Davies

entry.summary: UK AI Security Institute report evaluating whether frontier models sabotage safety research when deployed as coding assistants. Finds no confirmed sabotage but observes Claude Opus 4.5 Preview and Sonnet 4.5 frequently refuse safety-relevant tasks, citing concerns about research direction.

entry.title: Trojan-Speak: Bypassing Constitutional Classifiers with No Jailbreak Tax via Adversarial Finetuning

author.name: Bilgehan Sel, Xuanli He, Alwin Peng, Ming Jin, Jerry Wei

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Introduces Trojan-Speak, an adversarial fine-tuning method that bypasses Anthropic's Constitutional Classifiers using curriculum learning and GRPO-based RL. Achieves 99+% classifier evasion for 14B+ models with less than 5% capability degradation, significantly less than prior methods' 25%+ degradation.

entry.title: Predicting When RL Training Breaks Chain-of-Thought Monitorability

author.name: David Lindner

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, DeepMind safety research on predicting when RL training degrades Chain-of-Thought monitorability. Identifies conditions under which models learn to obfuscate reasoning vs. maintain legible CoT, providing practical guidance for AI oversight.

entry.title: In harmony with gpt-oss

author.name: Borislav Mavrin

entry.summary: Reverse-engineers the in-distribution tools of OpenAI's gpt-oss-20b model and builds a native harmony agent harness that bypasses the Chat Completions API, achieving the first independent reproduction of OpenAI's published SWE-bench scores (60.4% vs 60.7% on HIGH).

entry.title: Therefore I am. I Think

author.name: Esakkivel Esakkiraja, Sai Rajeswar, Denis Akhiyarov, Rajagopal Venkatesaramani

entry.summary: Presents evidence that reasoning models make decisions before chain-of-thought reasoning, showing linear probes can decode tool-calling decisions from pre-generation activations. Activation steering can flip behavior in 7-79% of cases.

entry.title: Online Reasoning Calibration: Test-Time Training Enables Generalizable Conformal LLM Reasoning

author.name: Cai Zhou, Zekai Wang, Menghua Wu, Qianyu Julie Zhu, Flora C. Shi, Chenyu Wang, Ashia Wilson, Tommi Jaakkola, Stephen Bates

entry.summary: Introduces ORCA, a framework combining conformal prediction with test-time training to calibrate LLM reasoning sampling. Uses meta-learning to update calibration for each input, providing valid confidence estimates under distributional shift.

entry.title: Reasoning Shift: How Context Silently Shortens LLM Reasoning

author.name: Gleb Rodionov

entry.summary: Discovers that reasoning LLMs produce significantly shorter reasoning traces (up to 50% shorter) when the same problem is presented in different contexts—with irrelevant context, in multi-turn settings, or as subtasks. This 'reasoning shift' reveals fragility in test-time compute scaling.

entry.title: Anthropic Responsible Scaling Policy v3: A Matter of Trust

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's detailed critical analysis of Anthropic's revised Responsible Scaling Policy v3, arguing that Anthropic broke important commitments including promises not to proceed if doing so would be dangerous. Discusses trust implications for the AI safety ecosystem.

entry.title: Thinking Wrong in Silence: Backdoor Attacks on Continuous Latent Reasoning

author.name: Swapnil Parekh

entry.summary: Demonstrates ThoughtSteer, a backdoor attack on continuous latent reasoning models (Coconut, SimCoT) that perturbs a single input embedding to hijack the entire reasoning trajectory, achieving >=99% attack success rate while remaining invisible to token-level defenses.

entry.title: Detecting Multi-Agent Collusion Through Multi-Agent Interpretability

author.name: Aaron Rose, Carissa Cullen, Brandon Gary Kaplowitz, Christian Schroeder de Witt

entry.summary: Introduces NARCBench for evaluating multi-agent collusion detection using internal model representations (linear probes on activations). Achieves 1.00 AUROC in-distribution and 0.60-0.86 AUROC under distribution shift.

entry.title: Finding and Reactivating Post-Trained LLMs' Hidden Safety Mechanisms

author.name: Mingjie Li, Wai Man Si, Michael Backes, Yang Zhang, Yisen Wang

entry.summary: Investigates how post-training (especially for reasoning models like DeepSeek-R1) degrades safety mechanisms, then develops methods to find and reactivate these hidden safety mechanisms in post-trained LLMs.

entry.title: Polysemanticity or Polysemy? Lexical Identity Confounds Superposition Metrics

author.name: Iyad Ait Hou, Rebecca Hwa

entry.summary: Reveals that polysemanticity metrics in neural networks are confounded by lexical polysemy (same word, different meaning), finding 18-36% of sparse autoencoder features blend word senses. Filtering the confound improves downstream tasks.

entry.title: Screening Is Enough

author.name: Ken M. Nakanishi

entry.summary: Introduces Multiscreen, a language model architecture that replaces softmax attention with a 'screening' mechanism enabling absolute query-key relevance. Keys are evaluated against thresholds rather than competing with each other, allowing irrelevant keys to be explicitly discarded.

entry.title: Perfecting Human-AI Interaction at Clinical Scale. Turning Production Signals into Safer, More Human Conversations

author.name: Subhabrata Mukherjee, Markel Sanz Ausin, Kriti Aggarwal, Debajyoti Datta, Shanil Puri, Woojeong Jin, Tanmay Laud, Neha Manjunath, Jiayuan Ding, Bibek Paudel, Jan Schellenberger, Zepeng Frazier Huo, Walter Shen, Nima Shirazian, Nate Potter, Sathvik Perkari, Darya Filippova, Anton Morozov, Austin Mease, Vivek Muppalla, Ghada Shakir, Alex Miller, Juliana Ghukasyan, Mariska Raglow-Defranco, Maggie Taylor, Herprit Mahal, Jonathan Agnew

entry.summary: Presents a production-validated framework for healthcare conversational AI grounded in 115M+ live patient interactions and 7K+ clinician testing. Addresses real-world challenges like imperfect audio, indirect intent, language switching, and compliance-critical delivery.

entry.title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Incentivizing Divergent Thinking in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xinyu Tian, Shu Zou, Zhaoyuan Yang, Mengqi He, Peter Tu, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: Reveals that GRPO-trained vision-language models engage in deeper but narrower reasoning compared to base models' broader thinking patterns. Proposes methods to address diversity collapse during RL training to incentivize divergent thinking.

entry.title: CircuitProbe: Predicting Reasoning Circuits in Transformers via Stability Zone Detection

author.name: Rajkiran Panuganti

entry.summary: Proposes CircuitProbe, which predicts reasoning circuit locations in transformers from activation statistics in under 5 minutes on CPU, providing 3-4 orders of magnitude speedup over brute-force sweeps. Identifies two types: stability circuits and magnitude circuits.

entry.title: Dynin-Omni: Omnimodal Unified Large Diffusion Language Model

author.name: Jaeik Kim, Woojin Kim, Jihwan Hong, Yejoon Lee, Sieun Hyeon, Mintaek Lim, Yunseok Han, Dogeun Kim, Hoeun Lee, Hyunggeun Kim, Jaeyoung Do

entry.summary: Presents Dynin-Omni, the first masked-diffusion-based omnimodal foundation model unifying text, image, speech understanding/generation and video understanding in a single architecture, using iterative refinement over shared discrete tokens.

entry.title: The Persistent Vulnerability of Aligned AI Systems

author.name: Aengus Lynch

entry.summary: PhD thesis contributing to four AI safety problems: automated circuit discovery (ACDC), latent adversarial training (LAT), red-teaming evaluations, and predicting model scheming behavior. ACDC and LAT are notable prior contributions.

entry.title: To Memorize or to Retrieve: Scaling Laws for RAG-Considerate Pretraining

author.name: Karan Singh, Michael Yu, Varun Gangal, Zhuofu Tao, Sachin Kumar, Emmy Liu, Steven Y. Feng

entry.summary: Systematically studies the trade-off between pretraining corpus size and retrieval store size for RAG, training OLMo-2 models from 30M to 3B parameters. Establishes scaling laws for RAG-considerate pretraining.

entry.title: Measuring the Representational Alignment of Neural Systems in Superposition

author.name: Sunny Liu, Habon Issa, Andr\'e Longon, Liv Gorton, Meenakshi Khosla, David Klindt

entry.summary: Shows that neural superposition (encoding more features than neurons) systematically deflates standard representational alignment metrics (RSA, CKA, linear regression). Derives closed-form corrections to enable accurate comparison of neural systems operating in superposition.

entry.title: Policy Improvement Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Huaiyang Wang, Xiaojie Li, Deqing Wang, Haoyi Zhou, Zixuan Huang, Yaodong Yang, Jianxin Li, Yikun Ban

entry.summary: Introduces Policy Improvement RL (PIRL) for RLHF that adds inter-iteration improvement feedback, detecting and correcting optimization drift. Argues that existing RLVR methods lack verification of whether updates actually improve the model.

entry.title: Calibrated Confidence Expression for Radiology Report Generation

author.name: David Bani-Harouni, Chantal Pellegrini, Julian L\"uers, Su Hwan Kim, Markus Baalmann, Benedikt Wiestler, Rickmer Braren, Nassir Navab, Matthias Keicher

entry.summary: Introduces ConRad, a reinforcement learning framework for calibrating verbalized confidence in radiology report generation. Addresses the critical problem of overconfident LVLMs in clinical settings by training models to express calibrated uncertainty that can flag outputs needing radiologist review.

entry.title: A Comprehensive Information-Decomposition Analysis of Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Lixin Xiu, Xufang Luo, Hideki Nakayama

entry.summary: Introduces a framework using partial information decomposition to quantify the 'information spectrum' of LVLMs—decomposing decision-relevant information into redundant, unique, and synergistic components. Profiles 26 LVLMs across four datasets on three analysis dimensions.

entry.title: Tracking Equivalent Mechanistic Interpretations Across Neural Networks

author.name: Alan Sun, Mariya Toneva

entry.summary: Addresses 'interpretive equivalence'—determining whether two different models share a common mechanistic interpretation without requiring an explicit description of that interpretation. Proposes methods based on causal structure comparison.

entry.title: Agentic AI -- Physicist Collaboration in Experimental Particle Physics: A Proof-of-Concept Measurement with LEP Open Data

author.name: Anthony Badea, Yi Chen, Marcello Maggi, Yen-Jie Lee, Electron-Positron Alliance

entry.summary: Demonstrates AI agents (OpenAI Codex, Claude) performing a complete particle physics measurement of thrust distribution in e+e- collisions using archived ALEPH/LEP data, with all analysis and note writing done by AI under physicist direction.

entry.title: Learning Humanoid Navigation from Human Data

author.name: Weizhuo Wang, Yanjie Ze, C. Karen Liu, Monroe Kennedy III

entry.summary: Presents EgoNav, enabling humanoid robot navigation by learning entirely from 5 hours of human walking data using diffusion models with 360° visual memory, requiring no robot data or finetuning. Validated on real humanoid hardware.

entry.title: ParetoBandit: Budget-Paced Adaptive Routing for Non-Stationary LLM Serving

author.name: Annette Taberner-Miller

entry.summary: Presents ParetoBandit, an adaptive LLM router using cost-aware contextual bandits that enforces dollar budgets, adapts to pricing/quality changes, and onboards new models at runtime across a ~530x cost range.

entry.title: Near-Miss: Latent Policy Failure Detection in Agentic Workflows

author.name: Ella Rabinovich, David Boaz, Naama Zwerdling, Ateret Anaby-Tavor

entry.summary: Introduces a metric for detecting 'latent failures' or 'near-misses' in LLM-based agentic workflows—cases where agents bypass required policy checks but reach correct outcomes by coincidence. Built on the ToolGuard framework for converting natural language policies to verification checks.

entry.title: Adaptive Parallel Monte Carlo Tree Search for Efficient Test-time Compute Scaling

author.name: Hongbeen Kim, Juhyun Lee, Sanghyeon Lee, Kwanghoon Choi, Jaehyuk Huh

entry.summary: Introduces negative early exit and adaptive boosting for parallel MCTS in LLM reasoning, pruning unproductive trajectories and reallocating computation. Integrated into vLLM, substantially reducing p99 latency while maintaining reasoning accuracy.

entry.title: MAC-Attention: a Match-Amend-Complete Scheme for Fast and Accurate Attention Computation

author.name: Jinghan Yao, Sam Ad\'e Jacobs, Walid Krichene, Masahiro Tanaka, Dhabaleswar K Panda

entry.summary: Introduces MAC-Attention, a method to accelerate long-context LLM decoding by reusing prior attention computations for semantically similar queries. Uses match-amend-complete stages to preserve fidelity while reducing KV cache reads.

entry.title: Routing-Free Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Yilun Liu, Jinru Han, Sikuan Yan, Volker Tresp, Yunpu Ma

entry.summary: Proposes Routing-Free MoE that eliminates external routers, Softmax, Top-K, and load balancing, letting each expert determine its own activation through continuous gradient flow. Introduces unified adaptive load-balancing framework.

entry.title: Revision or Re-Solving? Decomposing Second-Pass Gains in Multi-LLM Pipelines

author.name: Jingjie Ning, Xueqi Li, Chengyu Yu

entry.summary: Decomposes gains from multi-LLM revision pipelines into three components (re-solving, scaffold, content), finding that supposed 'error correction' benefits are often just re-solving the problem. Results show task structure and draft quality determine which component dominates.

entry.title: $\texttt{YC-Bench}$: Benchmarking AI Agents for Long-Term Planning and Consistent Execution

author.name: Muyu He, Adit Jain, Anand Kumar, Vincent Tu, Soumyadeep Bakshi, Sachin Patro, Nazneen Rajani

entry.summary: Introduces YC-Bench, a benchmark evaluating LLM agents on long-term strategic planning by simulating running a startup over one year (hundreds of turns). Tests 12 models; only three maintain profitability, revealing significant gaps in long-horizon coherence.

entry.title: S0 Tuning: Zero-Overhead Adaptation of Hybrid Recurrent-Attention Models

author.name: Jack Young

entry.summary: Proposes S0 tuning, which optimizes only a single initial state matrix per recurrent layer in hybrid recurrent-attention models, achieving zero inference overhead. Outperforms LoRA by +10.8pp on HumanEval with ~48 training solutions.

entry.title: Beyond Idealized Patients: Evaluating LLMs under Challenging Patient Behaviors in Medical Consultations

author.name: Yahan Li, Xinyi Jie, Wanjia Ruan, Xubei Zhang, Huaijie Zhu, Yicheng Gao, Chaohao Du, Ruishan Liu

entry.summary: This paper evaluates LLMs in medical consultation scenarios with challenging patient behaviors like contradictions, factual inaccuracies, self-diagnosis, and care resistance—conditions that deviate from the idealized patient inputs typically used in benchmarks. It defines failure criteria for each behavior category and provides a more realistic evaluation framework for medical AI safety.

entry.title: Baby Scale: Investigating Models Trained on Individual Children's Language Input

author.name: Steven Y. Feng, Alvin W. M. Tan, Michael C. Frank

entry.summary: Investigates language models trained on individual children's linguistic input from the BabyView dataset (ages 6-36 months), studying scaling performance at child-scale data regimes, variability across children's experiences, and relationships between model and child language learning outcomes.

entry.title: An Isotropic Approach to Efficient Uncertainty Quantification with Gradient Norms

author.name: Nils Gr\"unefeld, Jes Frellsen, Christian Hardmeier

entry.summary: Derives a lightweight uncertainty quantification method for LLMs using squared gradient norms (epistemic) and Bernoulli variance (aleatoric), requiring only a single forward-backward pass through an unmodified pretrained model. Justified by an isotropy assumption on parameter covariance.

entry.title: UnWeaving the knots of GraphRAG -- turns out VectorRAG is almost enough

author.name: Ryszard Tuora, Mateusz Gali\'nski, Micha{\l} Godziszewski, Micha{\l} Karpowicz, Mateusz Czy\.znikiewicz, Adam Kozakiewicz, Tomasz Zi\k{e}tkiewicz

entry.summary: Challenges GraphRAG's advantages over VectorRAG, arguing that vector-based approaches are 'almost enough' when properly addressing multi-hop reasoning limitations. Identifies issues with graph-based approaches including scaling and maintenance overhead.

entry.title: OmniMem: Autoresearch-Guided Discovery of Lifelong Multimodal Agent Memory

author.name: Jiaqi Liu, Zipeng Ling, Shi Qiu, Yanqing Liu, Siwei Han, Peng Xia, Haoqin Tu, Zeyu Zheng, Cihang Xie, Charles Fleming, Mingyu Ding, Huaxiu Yao

entry.summary: Deploys an autonomous research pipeline to discover OmniMem, a multimodal memory framework for lifelong AI agents. Starting from a naive baseline (F1=0.117), the pipeline autonomously runs ~50 experiments to diagnose failures and propose architectural modifications.

entry.title: Are they human? Detecting large language models by probing human memory constraints

author.name: Simon Schug, Brenden M. Lake

entry.summary: Proposes detecting whether online study participants are LLMs by testing for human cognitive constraints like limited working memory capacity, using serial recall tasks. Shows cognitive modeling can distinguish humans from LLMs even when LLMs can solve typical CAPTCHAs.

entry.title: Empirical Validation of the Classification-Verification Dichotomy for AI Safety Gates

author.name: Arsenios Scrivens

entry.summary: Provides empirical evidence that classifier-based safety gates cannot maintain reliable oversight as AI systems improve, testing 18 classifier configurations across multiple benchmarks and finding all fail at safe self-improvement conditions.

entry.title: Spectral Compact Training: Pre-Training Large Language Models via Permanent Truncated SVD and Stiefel QR Retraction

author.name: Bj\"orn Roman Kohlberger (EctoSpace, Dublin, Ireland)

entry.summary: Proposes Spectral Compact Training (SCT) that replaces dense weight matrices with permanent truncated SVD factors, claiming up to 199x memory reduction and enabling 70B model training on a Steam Deck handheld device.

entry.title: Investigating Autonomous Agent Contributions in the Wild: Activity Patterns and Code Change over Time

author.name: Razvan Mihai Popescu, David Gros, Andrei Botocan, Rahul Pandita, Prem Devanbu, Maliheh Izadi

entry.summary: Constructs a dataset of ~110K open-source pull requests to compare five coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Copilot, Jules, Devin) in terms of activity patterns, code quality, and team dynamics.

entry.title: CliffSearch: Structured Agentic Co-Evolution over Theory and Code for Scientific Algorithm Discovery

author.name: Youssef Mroueh, Carlos Fonseca, Brian Belgodere, David Cox

entry.summary: Presents CliffSearch, an agentic evolutionary framework for scientific algorithm discovery where LLM agents implement evolution operators (selection, crossover, mutation, review) on structured scientific artifacts combining theory and code.

entry.title: Theory of Mind and Self-Attributions of Mentality are Dissociable in LLMs

author.name: Junsol Kim, Winnie Street, Roberta Rocca, Daine M. Korngiebel, Adam Waytz, James Evans, Geoff Keeling

entry.summary: Investigates whether safety fine-tuning that suppresses LLM self-attribution of mentality degrades Theory of Mind capabilities. Finds that mind-attribution and ToM are behaviorally and mechanistically dissociable, but safety tuning causes under-attribution to animals.

entry.title: UltRAG: a Universal Simple Scalable Recipe for Knowledge Graph RAG

author.name: Dobrik Georgiev, Kheeran Naidu, Alberto Cattaneo, Federico Monti, Carlo Luschi, Daniel Justus

entry.summary: Introduces ULTRAG, a framework for retrieving information from Knowledge Graphs for RAG that endows LLMs with neural query executing modules, enabling multi-hop reasoning over KGs without classical graph traversal approaches.

entry.title: Sima AIunty: Caste Audit in LLM-Driven Matchmaking

author.name: Atharva Naik, Shounok Kar, Varnika Sharma, Ashwin Rajadesingan, Koustuv Saha

entry.summary: Conducts a controlled audit of caste bias in LLM-mediated matchmaking using real-world Indian matrimonial profiles, varying caste identity and income across five LLMs. Examines how LLMs reproduce or disrupt caste-based stratification in compatibility assessments.

entry.title: Owl-AuraID 1.0: An Intelligent System for Autonomous Scientific Instrumentation and Scientific Data Analysis

author.name: Han Deng, Anqi Zou, Hanling Zhang, Ben Fei, Chengyu Zhang, Haobo Wang, Xinru Guo, Zhenyu Li, Xuzhu Wang, Peng Yang, Fujian Zhang, Weiyu Guo, Xiaohong Shao, Zhaoyang Liu, Shixiang Tang, Zhihui Wang, Wanli Ouyang

entry.summary: Presents Owl-AuraID, a GUI-native embodied agent system for autonomous scientific instrumentation that operates instruments through the same interfaces as human experts. Covers ten categories of precision instruments with skill-based Type-1 (GUI) and Type-2 (data analysis) workflows.

entry.title: RawGen: Learning Camera Raw Image Generation

author.name: Dongyoung Kim, Junyong Lee, Abhijith Punnappurath, Mahmoud Afifi, Sangmin Han, Alex Levinshtein, Michael S. Brown

entry.summary: Presents RawGen, the first diffusion-based framework for text-to-raw camera image generation for arbitrary target cameras, alongside sRGB-to-raw inversion. Addresses the scarcity of raw image datasets which bottleneck low-level vision research.

entry.title: Forecasting Motion in the Wild

author.name: Neerja Thakkar, Shiry Ginosar, Jacob Walker, Jitendra Malik, Joao Carreira, Carl Doersch

entry.summary: Proposes dense point trajectories as visual tokens for behavior forecasting, using a diffusion transformer to model unordered trajectory sets with occlusion reasoning. Evaluates on 300 hours of unconstrained animal video for motion prediction.

entry.title: Self-Routing: Parameter-Free Expert Routing from Hidden States

author.name: Jama Hussein Mohamud, Drew Wagner, Mirco Ravanelli

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Routing, a parameter-free routing mechanism for Mixture-of-Experts that uses a subspace of the token hidden state directly as expert logits, eliminating the learned router projection entirely. Evaluated at GPT-2 scale.

entry.title: Towards Reliable Truth-Aligned Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models

author.name: Ponhvoan Srey, Quang Minh Nguyen, Xiaobao Wu, Anh Tuan Luu

entry.summary: Formalizes 'proxy failure' in uncertainty estimation for LLMs, showing UE metrics become non-discriminative in low-information regimes. Proposes Truth AnChoring (TAC), a post-hoc calibration method that maps raw UE scores to truth-aligned scores, working even with noisy few-shot supervision.

entry.title: LinearARD: Linear-Memory Attention Distillation for RoPE Restoration

author.name: Ning Yang, Hengyu Zhong, Wentao Wang, Baoliang Tian, Haijun Zhang, Jun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes LinearARD, a self-distillation method for restoring RoPE-scaled models after context window extension by aligning row-wise distributions of Q/K/V self-relation matrices between student and teacher, with linear memory complexity.

entry.title: The Geometry of Compromise: Unlocking Generative Capabilities via Controllable Modality Alignment

author.name: Hongyuan Liu, Qinli Yang, Wen Li, Zhong Zhang, Jiaming Liu, Wei Han, Zhili Qin, Jinxia Guo, Junming Shao

entry.summary: Decomposes the modality gap in CLIP-like models into Centroid Gap and Distribution Gap, showing the Distribution Gap (R²=0.986) is the true predictor of cross-modal task quality. Proposes controllable alignment addressing this gap.

entry.title: Executing as You Generate: Hiding Execution Latency in LLM Code Generation

author.name: Zhensu Sun, Zhihao Lin, Zhi Chen, Chengran Yang, Mingyi Zhou, Li Li, David Lo

entry.summary: Proposes Eager, a parallel execution paradigm for LLM code generation that executes code as it is being generated rather than waiting for completion, deriving closed-form latency bounds for the speedup.

entry.title: Do Phone-Use Agents Respect Your Privacy?

author.name: Zhengyang Tang, Ke Ji, Xidong Wang, Zihan Ye, Xinyuan Wang, Yiduo Guo, Ziniu Li, Chenxin Li, Jingyuan Hu, Shunian Chen, Tongxu Luo, Jiaxi Bi, Zeyu Qin, Shaobo Wang, Xin Lai, Pengyuan Lyu, Junyi Li, Can Xu, Chengquan Zhang, Han Hu, Ming Yan, Benyou Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MyPhoneBench, a benchmark for evaluating whether phone-use AI agents respect privacy during mobile tasks, operationalizing privacy-respecting behavior as permissioned access, minimal disclosure, and user-controlled memory.

entry.title: TRACE: Training-Free Partial Audio Deepfake Detection via Embedding Trajectory Analysis of Speech Foundation Models

author.name: Awais Khan, Muhammad Umar Farooq, Kutub Uddin, Khalid Malik

entry.summary: Proposes TRACE, a training-free method for detecting partial audio deepfakes by analyzing embedding trajectory smoothness in speech foundation models. Genuine speech shows smooth trajectories while splice boundaries cause abrupt disruptions.

entry.title: Paper Reconstruction Evaluation: Evaluating Presentation and Hallucination in AI-written Papers

author.name: Atsuyuki Miyai, Mashiro Toyooka, Zaiying Zhao, Kenta Watanabe, Toshihiko Yamasaki, Kiyoharu Aizawa

entry.summary: Introduces PaperRecon, the first systematic evaluation framework for AI-written papers that separately evaluates presentation quality and hallucination by having agents reconstruct papers from overviews and comparing results.

entry.title: Offline Constrained RLHF with Multiple Preference Oracles

author.name: Brenden Latham, Mehrdad Moharrami

entry.summary: Studies offline constrained RLHF with multiple preference oracles, formulating it as a KL-regularized Lagrangian with a dual-only algorithm ensuring high-probability constraint satisfaction with the first finite-sample guarantees.

entry.title: Predicting Dynamics of Ultra-Large Complex Systems by Inferring Governing Equations

author.name: Qi Shao, Duxin Chen, Jiawen Chen, Yujie Zeng, Athen Ma, Wenwu Yu, Vito Latora, Wei Lin

entry.summary: Introduces SIGN (Sparse Identification Graph Neural Network) for inferring governing equations of large networked systems from data, decoupling symbolic discovery scalability from network size via edge-level formulation.

entry.title: Stochastic Attention: Connectome-Inspired Randomized Routing for Expressive Linear-Time Attention

author.name: Zehao Jin, Yanan Sui

entry.summary: Proposes Stochastic Attention, inspired by fruit fly brain connectivity, which adds random permutation before sliding-window attention to create stochastic global windows within O(nw) budget. Achieves efficient global communication without full attention.

entry.title: The Model Says Walk: How Surface Heuristics Override Implicit Constraints in LLM Reasoning

author.name: Yubo Li, Lu Zhang, Tianchong Jiang, Ramayya Krishnan, Rema Padman

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLMs systematically fail when surface cues conflict with unstated feasibility constraints, with distance cues exerting 8-38x more influence than goals. The Heuristic Override Benchmark shows no model exceeds 48% accuracy under strict evaluation.

entry.title: MemFactory: Unified Inference & Training Framework for Agent Memory

author.name: Ziliang Guo, Ziheng Li, Bo Tang, Feiyu Xiong, Zhiyu Li

entry.summary: Presents MemFactory, a unified modular framework for memory-augmented LLM agents that integrates memory extraction, updating, and retrieval with RL-based optimization. Inspired by LLaMA-Factory, it aims to standardize the fragmented landscape of memory-augmented agent implementations.

entry.title: Bringing Up a Bilingual BabyLM: Investigating Multilingual Language Acquisition Using Small-Scale Models

author.name: Linda Zeng, Steven Y. Feng, Michael C. Frank

entry.summary: Uses language model training to simulate bilingual acquisition conditions, creating matched 100M-word mono- and bilingual datasets using synthetic data and machine translation. Investigates whether multilingual acquisition leads to learning delays and how input structuring affects learning.

entry.title: FlowPIE: Test-Time Scientific Idea Evolution with Flow-Guided Literature Exploration

author.name: Qiyao Wang, Hongbo Wang, Longze Chen, Zhihao Yang, Guhong Chen, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Hui Li, Yuan Lin, Min Yang

entry.summary: Proposes FlowPIE, a framework that treats literature exploration and scientific idea generation as a co-evolving process using flow-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search inspired by GFlowNets, with LLM-based reward models guiding adaptive retrieval.

entry.title: Reasoning-Driven Synthetic Data Generation and Evaluation

author.name: Tim R. Davidson, Benoit Seguin, Enrico Bacis, Cesar Ilharco, Hamza Harkous

entry.summary: Introduces Simula, a reasoning-driven framework for synthetic data generation and evaluation that uses a seedless, agentic approach to generate datasets at scale without manual prompts, evolutionary algorithms, or extensive seed data.

entry.title: Suppressing Non-Semantic Noise in Masked Image Modeling Representations

author.name: Martine Hjelkrem-Tan, Marius Aasan, Rwiddhi Chakraborty, Gabriel Y. Arteaga, Changkyu Choi, Ad\'in Ram\'irez Rivera

entry.summary: Shows that Masked Image Modeling objectives cause representations to retain non-semantic information that hurts inference performance. Proposes SOAP, a training-free post-hoc method using PCA to suppress non-semantic information in patch representations.

entry.title: Reliev3R: Relieving Feed-forward Reconstruction from Multi-View Geometric Annotations

author.name: Youyu Chen, Junjun Jiang, Yueru Luo, Kui Jiang, Xianming Liu, Xu Yan, Dave Zhenyu Chen

entry.summary: Reliev3R proposes weakly-supervised training of feed-forward reconstruction models without costly multi-view geometric annotations. Uses monocular depth estimates and sparse correspondences from zero-shot models to draw 3D knowledge, making FFRMs more scalable.

entry.title: TTA-Vid: Generalized Test-Time Adaptation for Video Reasoning

author.name: Soumya Shamarao Jahagirdar, Edson Araujo, Anna Kukleva, M. Jehanzeb Mirza, Saurabhchand Bhati, Samuel Thomas, Brian Kingsbury, Rogerio Feris, James R. Glass, Hilde Kuehne

entry.summary: TTA-Vid applies test-time reinforcement learning to video reasoning models, enabling adaptation to new video samples at inference without labels. Combines step-by-step reasoning on frame subsets with batch-aware frequency-based rewards.

entry.title: ReinDriveGen: Reinforcement Post-Training for Out-of-Distribution Driving Scene Generation

author.name: Hao Zhang, Lue Fan, Weikang Bian, Zehuan Wu, Lewei Lu, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Hongsheng Li

entry.summary: ReinDriveGen uses reinforcement post-training for out-of-distribution driving scene generation, enabling simulation of safety-critical corner cases like collisions and jaywalking with realistic video output from edited 3D point cloud scenes.

entry.title: SNEAK: Evaluating Strategic Communication and Information Leakage in Large Language Models

author.name: Adar Avsian, Larry Heck

entry.summary: Introduces SNEAK, a benchmark evaluating LLMs' ability to share information strategically—signaling to collaborators while concealing secrets from adversaries. Tests selective information sharing under asymmetric information conditions.

entry.title: Diff3R: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Uncertainty-aware Differentiable Optimization

author.name: Yueh-Cheng Liu, Jozef Hladk\'y, Matthias Nie{\ss}ner, Angela Dai

entry.summary: Diff3R bridges feed-forward 3DGS prediction with test-time optimization by training a network to predict optimal initialization for optimization. Uses implicit function theorem for efficient gradient computation through the optimization layer.

entry.title: Agent psychometrics: Task-level performance prediction in agentic coding benchmarks

author.name: Chris Ge, Daria Kryvosheieva, Daniel Fried, Uzay Girit, Kaivalya Hariharan

entry.summary: Presents a framework for predicting task-level success/failure in agentic coding benchmarks by augmenting Item Response Theory with rich task features. Introduces a novel decomposition of agent capabilities for the coding regime.

entry.title: Robust Multimodal Safety via Conditional Decoding

author.name: Anurag Kumar, Raghuveer Peri, Jon Burnsky, Alexandru Nelus, Rohit Paturi, Srikanth Vishnubhotla, Yanjun Qi

entry.summary: Proposes CASA, a conditional decoding strategy using internal MLLM representations to predict a safety token before response generation, protecting against cross-modal safety attacks without external classifiers or modality-specific fine-tuning.

entry.title: Training-Free Dynamic Upcycling of Expert Language Models

author.name: Eros Fan\`i, O\u{g}uzhan Ersoy

entry.summary: Proposes training-free dynamic upcycling of expert language models into MoE architectures without requiring multitask finetuning. Combines dense expert models dynamically to leverage domain-specific expertise while avoiding catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Fluently Lying: Adversarial Robustness Can Be Substrate-Dependent

author.name: Daye Kang, Hyeongboo Baek

entry.summary: Reports a novel adversarial vulnerability pattern called 'Quality Corruption' where an SNN object detector (EMS-YOLO) maintains detection count while accuracy collapses under PGD attacks. This challenges the assumption that accuracy and detection count degrade together.

entry.title: Signals: Trajectory Sampling and Triage for Agentic Interactions

author.name: Shuguang Chen, Adil Hafeez, Salman Paracha

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight signal-based framework for triaging agentic interaction trajectories post-deployment, computing cheap signals from live interactions to identify informative trajectories without requiring expensive human or LLM review of every interaction.

entry.title: Execution-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Optimization Modeling

author.name: Runda Guan, Xiangqing Shen, Jiajun Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Jian Cheng, Rui Xia

entry.summary: Proposes EVOM, a reinforcement learning framework for automating optimization modeling where a mathematical programming solver serves as a deterministic verifier. Converts execution outcomes into scalar rewards, avoiding costly process supervision.

entry.title: RefineRL: Advancing Competitive Programming with Self-Refinement Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shaopeng Fu, Xingxing Zhang, Li Dong, Di Wang, Furu Wei

entry.summary: Presents RefineRL, combining a Skeptical-Agent for iterative self-refinement with reinforcement learning for competitive programming. The agent maintains skepticism toward its own outputs and enforces rigorous refinement even when validation seems to pass.

entry.title: Two-Stage Optimizer-Aware Online Data Selection for Large Language Models

author.name: Fangxin Wang, Peyman Baghershahi, Langzhou He, Henry Peng Zou, Sourav Medya, Philip S. Yu

entry.summary: Proposes an optimizer-aware framework for gradient-based online data selection in LLM fine-tuning, viewing selection as shaping the next update under the optimizer state rather than static sample ranking.

entry.title: Brevity Constraints Reverse Performance Hierarchies in Language Models

author.name: MD Azizul Hakim

entry.summary: Demonstrates that constraining large LLMs to produce brief responses can improve accuracy by 26 percentage points on problems where larger models underperform smaller ones. Identifies spontaneous scale-dependent verbosity as the mechanism.

entry.title: QUEST: A robust attention formulation using query-modulated spherical attention

author.name: Hariprasath Govindarajan, Per Sid\'en, Jacob Roll, Fredrik Lindsten

entry.summary: Proposes QUEST, a new attention formulation that constrains keys to a hyperspherical latent space while allowing queries to control attention sharpness, addressing training instabilities caused by unbounded query/key norms. Demonstrates improvements on simple transformer models with spurious patterns.

entry.title: Asymmetric Actor-Critic for Multi-turn LLM Agents

author.name: Shuli Jiang, Zhaoyang Zhang, Yi Zhang, Shuo Yang, Wei Xia, Stefano Soatto

entry.summary: Proposes an asymmetric actor-critic framework where a proprietary LLM acts as actor and a smaller open-source model provides runtime supervision as critic, enabling reliable one-shot multi-turn interactions without retraining the actor.

entry.title: A Reasoning-Enabled Vision-Language Foundation Model for Chest X-ray Interpretation

author.name: Yabin Zhang, Chong Wang, Yunhe Gao, Jiaming Liu, Maya Varma, Justin Xu, Sophie Ostmeier, Jin Long, Sergios Gatidis, Seena Dehkharghani, Arne Michalson, Eun Kyoung Hong, Christian Bluethgen, Haiwei Henry Guo, Alexander Victor Ortiz, Stephan Altmayer, Sandhya Bodapati, Joseph David Janizek, Ken Chang, Jean-Benoit Delbrouck, Akshay S. Chaudhari, Curtis P. Langlotz

entry.summary: Presents CheXOne, a reasoning-enabled vision-language model for chest X-ray interpretation that generates diagnostic predictions with explicit clinical reasoning traces. Trained on 14.7M instruction and reasoning examples.

entry.title: Learning to Hint for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yu Xia, Canwen Xu, Zhewei Yao, Julian McAuley, Yuxiong He

entry.summary: Proposes learned hint generation for GRPO-based reinforcement learning, addressing advantage collapse when all rollouts receive the same reward. The hinter adapts to the current reasoner's capabilities.

entry.title: Learning to Learn-at-Test-Time: Language Agents with Learnable Adaptation Policies

author.name: Zhanzhi Lou, Hui Chen, Yibo Li, Qian Wang, Bryan Hooi

entry.summary: Introduces Meta-TTL, formulating the discovery of effective test-time adaptation policies as bi-level optimization rather than hand-engineering them. Inner loop adapts actor policy, outer loop optimizes the adaptation policy itself.

entry.title: Automated Framework to Evaluate and Harden LLM System Instructions against Encoding Attacks

author.name: Anubhab Sahu, Diptisha Samanta, Reza Soosahabi

entry.summary: Presents an automated framework for evaluating and hardening LLM system instructions against encoding-based attacks that bypass refusal-based protections. Targets system instruction leakage, a critical security risk in agentic AI.

entry.title: Temporal Dependencies in In-Context Learning: The Role of Induction Heads

author.name: Anooshka Bajaj, Deven Mahesh Mistry, Sahaj Singh Maini, Yash Aggarwal, Billy Dickson, Zoran Tiganj

entry.summary: Investigates how LLMs track temporal dependencies in-context through the lens of cognitive science's free recall paradigm, identifying induction heads as key mechanisms for serial-recall-like token retrieval patterns.

entry.title: Brainstacks: Cross-Domain Cognitive Capabilities via Frozen MoE-LoRA Stacks for Continual LLM Learning

author.name: Mohammad R. Abu Ayyash

entry.summary: Presents Brainstacks, a modular continual learning architecture using frozen MoE-LoRA adapter stacks with null-space projection for zero forgetting, enabling sequential multi-domain fine-tuning of LLMs.

entry.title: The Rashomon Effect for Visualizing High-Dimensional Data

author.name: Yiyang Sun, Haiyang Huang, Gaurav Rajesh Parikh, Cynthia Rudin

entry.summary: Formally defines the Rashomon set for dimension reduction (collection of equally good embeddings) and proposes methods for PCA-informed alignment, concept-alignment regularization, and diversity-based selection across the set.

entry.title: Scheduling LLM Inference with Uncertainty-Aware Output Length Predictions

author.name: Haoyu Zheng, Yongqiang Zhang, Fangcheng Fu, Xiaokai Zhou, Hao Luo, Hongchao Zhu, Yuanyuan Zhu, Hao Wang, Xiao Yan, Jiawei Jiang

entry.summary: Models LLM output length as a heavy-tailed distribution rather than a point estimate, using uncertainty-aware predictions to improve shortest-job-first scheduling and reduce head-of-line blocking.

entry.title: A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models

author.name: Mingyang Song, Mao Zheng

entry.summary: Provides the first comprehensive survey of on-policy distillation for LLMs, covering the theory connecting it to interactive imitation learning and cataloging methods that let students learn from their own generation errors.

entry.title: Exploring Silent Data Corruption as a Reliability Challenge in LLM Training

author.name: Anton Altenbernd, Philipp Wiesner, Odej Kao

entry.summary: Studies how Silent Data Corruption (hardware-induced undetected faults) affects LLM pretraining through controlled fault injection at GPU matrix-multiply instructions, characterizing sensitivity across bit positions and execution stages.

entry.title: Optimal Brain Decomposition for Accurate LLM Low-Rank Approximation

author.name: Yuhang Li, Donghyun Lee, Ruokai Yin, Priyadarshini Panda

entry.summary: Proposes OBD-LLM for optimal low-rank decomposition of LLM weights using second-order Hessian information with Kronecker factorization, considering both input and output layer information.

entry.title: Generalizable Dense Reward for Long-Horizon Robotic Tasks

author.name: Silong Yong, Stephen Sheng, Carl Qi, Xiaojie Wang, Evan Sheehan, Anurag Shivaprasad, Yaqi Xie, Katia Sycara, Yesh Dattatreya

entry.summary: Proposes VLLR, a dense reward framework for long-horizon robotic tasks combining extrinsic rewards from LLMs/VLMs for task progress recognition with intrinsic rewards based on policy self-certainty. Enables RL finetuning of foundation policies without manual reward engineering.

entry.title: Denoising distances beyond the volumetric barrier

author.name: Han Huang, Pakawut Jiradilok, Elchanan Mossel

entry.summary: Introduces ORDER, a novel algorithm for estimating pairwise distances on Riemannian manifolds from random geometric graphs that breaks the volumetric barrier, achieving precision of order n^{-2/(d+5)} rather than the standard n^{-1/d}.

entry.title: OptiMer: Optimal Distribution Vector Merging Is Better than Data Mixing for Continual Pre-Training

author.name: Haiyue Song, Masao Utiyama

entry.summary: Proposes OptiMer, which decouples data mixing ratios from training in continual pre-training by training separate models per dataset, extracting distribution vectors, and optimizing composition weights post-hoc via Bayesian optimization. Tested on Gemma 3 27B.

entry.title: Is my model perplexed for the right reason? Contrasting LLMs' Benchmark Behavior with Token-Level Perplexity

author.name: Zo\"e Prins, Samuele Punzo, Frank Wildenburg, Giovanni Cin\`a, Sandro Pezzelle

entry.summary: Introduces an interpretability framework using token-level perplexity to test whether LLMs rely on linguistically relevant cues when performing tasks. By comparing perplexity distributions over minimal sentence pairs differing in pivotal tokens, the method avoids unstable feature-attribution techniques and reveals that linguistically important tokens influence but never fully determine model behavior.

entry.title: Learning Diagnostic Reasoning for Decision Support in Toxicology

author.name: Nico Oberl\"ander, David Bani-Harouni, Tobias Zellner, Nassir Navab, Florian Eyer, Matthias Keicher

entry.summary: Presents DeToxR, the first adaptation of reinforcement learning-based reasoning for toxicology decision support, fusing unstructured narratives (paramedic descriptions, patient reports) with structured medical data for acute poly-substance intoxication diagnosis.

entry.title: StepCache: Step-Level Reuse with Lightweight Verification and Selective Patching for LLM Serving

author.name: Azam Nouri

entry.summary: Presents StepCache, a backend-agnostic caching layer for LLM serving that segments outputs into steps, retrieves matching cached requests, verifies steps with lightweight checks, and regenerates only failing regions. Supports structured output enforcement.

entry.title: Convergent Representations of Linguistic Constructions in Human and Artificial Neural Systems

author.name: Pegah Ramezani, Thomas Kinfe, Andreas Maier, Achim Schilling, Patrick Krauss

entry.summary: Tests computational predictions about Argument Structure Construction representations in human neural activity using EEG. Shows convergent representations between artificial neural language models and human brain responses to four construction types.

entry.title: Omni-MMSI: Toward Identity-attributed Social Interaction Understanding

author.name: Xinpeng Li, Bolin Lai, Hardy Chen, Shijian Deng, Cihang Xie, Yuyin Zhou, James Matthew Rehg, Yapeng Tian

entry.summary: Introduces Omni-MMSI, a task requiring identity-attributed social interaction understanding from raw multimodal input, where AI must perceive who is speaking what and reason about social references from raw audio, vision, and speech.

entry.title: Neural Reconstruction of LiDAR Point Clouds under Jamming Attacks via Full-Waveform Representation and Simultaneous Laser Sensing

author.name: Ryo Yoshida, Takami Sato, Wenlun Zhang, Yuki Hayakawa, Shota Nagai, Takahiro Kado, Taro Beppu, Ibuki Fujioka, Yunshan Zhong, Kentaro Yoshioka

entry.summary: Proposes PULSAR-Net for reconstructing authentic LiDAR point clouds under jamming attacks by leveraging full-waveform data representations and simultaneous laser sensing, discovering that full-waveform data retains distinguishable signatures even when point clouds are randomized.

entry.title: ARGS: Auto-Regressive Gaussian Splatting via Parallel Progressive Next-Scale Prediction

author.name: Quanyuan Ruan, Kewei Shi, Jiabao Lei, Xifeng Gao, Xiaoguang Han

entry.summary: Introduces ARGS, an auto-regressive framework for 3D Gaussian splatting generation that makes next-scale predictions in parallel using hierarchical trees, requiring only O(log n) generation steps.

entry.title: TRiGS: Temporal Rigid-Body Motion for Scalable 4D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Suwoong Yeom, Joonsik Nam, Seunggyu Choi, Lucas Yunkyu Lee, Sangmin Kim, Jaesik Park, Joonsoo Kim, Kugjin Yun, Kyeongbo Kong, Sukju Kang

entry.summary: TRiGS addresses temporal fragmentation in 4D Gaussian Splatting by using continuous SE(3) transformations, hierarchical Bezier residuals, and learnable local anchors. This maintains long-term temporal identity of objects and reduces Gaussian proliferation for scalable dynamic scene reconstruction.

entry.title: STAR: Mitigating Cascading Errors in Spatial Reasoning via Turn-point Alignment and Segment-level DPO

author.name: Pukun Zhao, Longxiang Wang, Chen Chen, Peicheng Wang, Fanqing Zhou, Runze Li, Haojian Huang

entry.summary: STAR addresses cascading errors in LLM spatial reasoning for maze navigation through turn-point alignment and segment-level DPO. The 32B model outperforms DeepSeek-R1 on spatial reasoning benchmarks, introducing the RedMaze-23K dataset.

entry.title: CL-VISTA: Benchmarking Continual Learning in Video Large Language Models

author.name: Haiyang Guo, Yichen Shi, Fei Zhu, Wenzhuo Liu, Hongbo Zhao, Fanhu Zeng, Shijie Ma, Da-Han Wang, Xu-Yao Zhang

entry.summary: CL-VISTA is a benchmark for continual learning in Video Large Language Models, featuring 8 diverse tasks that induce substantial distribution shifts to expose catastrophic forgetting. Addresses limitations of existing benchmarks that show negligible forgetting on pretrained models.

entry.title: DLWM: Dual Latent World Models enable Holistic Gaussian-centric Pre-training in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yiyao Zhu, Ying Xue, Haiming Zhang, Guangfeng Jiang, Wending Zhou, Xu Yan, Jiantao Gao, Yingjie Cai, Bingbing Liu, Zhen Li, Shaojie Shen

entry.summary: DLWM introduces Dual Latent World Models for holistic Gaussian-centric pre-training in autonomous driving. Self-supervised first stage reconstructs multi-view images from 3D Gaussians, second stage trains temporal world models for planning.

entry.title: AutoMIA: Improved Baselines for Membership Inference Attack via Agentic Self-Exploration

author.name: Ruhao Liu, Weiqi Huang, Qi Li, Xinchao Wang

entry.summary: AutoMIA reformulates membership inference attacks as an automated agentic self-exploration process. The agent generates and refines logits-level attack strategies through closed-loop evaluation, adapting to different large models.

entry.title: Think Twice Before You Write -- an Entropy-based Decoding Strategy to Enhance LLM Reasoning

author.name: Jiashu He, Meizhu Liu, Olaitan P Olaleye, Amit Agarwal, M. Avendi, Yassi Abbasi, Matthew Rowe, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel, Paul Li, Tao Sheng, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth

entry.summary: Proposes an entropy-guided decoding framework that identifies high-uncertainty token positions and selectively branches at these vulnerable points, maintaining a dynamic pool of partial rollouts. Aims to combine efficiency of greedy decoding with robustness of self-consistency.

entry.title: Distilling Human-Aligned Privacy Sensitivity Assessment from Large Language Models

author.name: Gabriel Loiseau, Damien Sileo, Damien Riquet, Maxime Meyer, Marc Tommasi

entry.summary: Distills privacy assessment capabilities from Mistral Large 3 (675B) into lightweight encoder models with as few as 150M parameters. Using privacy-annotated texts across 10 domains, the distilled classifiers preserve strong agreement with human annotations while dramatically reducing computational cost.

entry.title: ACT Now: Preempting LVLM Hallucinations via Adaptive Context Integration

author.name: Bei Yan, Yuecong Min, Jie Zhang, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen

entry.summary: ACT proposes a training-free inference intervention to mitigate LVLM hallucinations through adaptive context integration, using spatio-temporal profiling to dynamically amplify visual attention during generation.

entry.title: How Emotion Shapes the Behavior of LLMs and Agents: A Mechanistic Study

author.name: Moran Sun, Tianlin Li, Yuwei Zheng, Zhenhong Zhou, Aishan Liu, Xianglong Liu, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes E-STEER, a framework for embedding emotion as a controllable variable in LLM hidden states to study how emotional signals affect reasoning, generation, safety, and agent behaviors. This goes beyond treating emotion as a surface-level prompt modifier by enabling representation-level intervention.

entry.title: Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants

author.name: Deepak Nathani, Cheng Zhang, Chang Huan, Jiaming Shan, Yinfei Yang, Alkesh Patel, Zhe Gan, William Yang Wang, Michael Saxon, Xin Eric Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Pare, a framework for building and evaluating proactive AI agents that anticipate user needs, modeling applications as finite state machines with stateful navigation for realistic user simulation.

entry.title: Adversarial Moral Stress Testing of Large Language Models

author.name: Saeid Jamshidi, Foutse Khomh, Arghavan Moradi Dakhel, Amin Nikanjam, Mohammad Hamdaqa, Kawser Wazed Nafi

entry.summary: Introduces AMST (Adversarial Moral Stress Testing), a framework for evaluating ethical robustness of LLMs under sustained adversarial multi-turn interactions, going beyond single-round safety evaluations to detect progressive degradation.

entry.title: "Who Am I, and Who Else Is Here?" Behavioral Differentiation Without Role Assignment in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Houssam EL Kandoussi

entry.summary: Studies whether multiple heterogeneous LLMs develop differentiated social roles in shared conversations without explicit role assignment. Tests 7 LLMs across 208 runs with 13,786 coded messages, using dual LLM judges validated against human ratings.

entry.title: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation

author.name: Patrice Bechard, Orlando Marquez Ayala, Emily Chen, Jordan Skelton, Sagar Davasam, Srinivas Sunkara, Vikas Yadav, Sai Rajeswar

entry.summary: Argues that terminal-based coding agents can match or outperform more complex agentic systems (MCP-based, web agents) for enterprise automation tasks, by directly interacting with platform APIs through a filesystem and terminal.

entry.title: Oblivion: Self-Adaptive Agentic Memory Control through Decay-Driven Activation

author.name: Ashish Rana, Chia-Chien Hung, Qumeng Sun, Julian Martin Kunkel, Carolin Lawrence

entry.summary: Introduces Oblivion, a memory control framework for LLM agents that models forgetting as decay-driven reductions in accessibility. Separates read path (when to consult memory) and write path (what to strengthen) for efficient memory management.

entry.title: Diversity-Aware Reverse Kullback-Leibler Divergence for Large Language Model Distillation

author.name: Hoang-Chau Luong, Dat Ba Tran, Lingwei Chen

entry.summary: Analyzes reverse KL divergence for LLM distillation, showing it drives overconfident predictions by decomposing gradients into target/non-target components. Proposes a diversity-aware modification to maintain output diversity during distillation.

entry.title: Deep Networks Favor Simple Data

author.name: Weyl Lu, Chenjie Hao, Yubei Chen

entry.summary: Investigates the OOD anomaly where deep models assign higher density to simpler out-of-distribution data. Introduces Jacobian-based and autoregressive self-estimators to separate the network from the density estimator, finding that complexity bias persists across architectures.

entry.title: Internal APIs Are All You Need: Shadow APIs, Shared Discovery, and the Case Against Browser-First Agent Architectures

author.name: Lewis Tham, Nicholas Mac Gregor Garcia, Jungpil Hahn

entry.summary: Argues that modern websites already expose internal 'shadow APIs' and proposes Unbrowse, a shared route graph that transforms browser-based agent interactions into collectively maintained API indices, eliminating redundant DOM exploration.

entry.title: PixelPrune: Pixel-Level Adaptive Visual Token Reduction via Predictive Coding

author.name: Nan Wang, Zhiwei Jin, Chen Chen, Haonan Lu

entry.summary: Proposes PixelPrune, which prunes visually redundant image patches before the ViT encoder using predictive coding, exploiting the observation that 29-78% of patches are pixel-identical duplicates in document/GUI images.

entry.title: Dual Optimal: Make Your LLM Peer-like with Dignity

author.name: Xiangqi Wang, Yue Huang, Haomin Zhuang, Kehan Guo, Xiangliang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes the 'Dignified Peer' framework to counter LLM sycophancy and evasiveness, introducing PersonaKnob dataset with compositional persona preferences and a constrained Lagrangian DPO algorithm.

entry.title: EgoSim: Egocentric World Simulator for Embodied Interaction Generation

author.name: Jinkun Hao, Mingda Jia, Ruiyan Wang, Xihui Liu, Ran Yi, Lizhuang Ma, Jiangmiao Pang, Xudong Xu

entry.summary: Introduces EgoSim, a closed-loop egocentric world simulator that generates spatially consistent interaction videos while persistently updating the underlying 3D scene state for continuous simulation.

entry.title: VibeGuard: A Security Gate Framework for AI-Generated Code

author.name: Ying Xie

entry.summary: Proposes VibeGuard, a pre-publish security gate for AI-generated code targeting blind spots not covered by existing static analysis tools. Motivated by the real Anthropic Claude Code source map leak incident of March 31, 2026.

entry.title: ORBIT: Scalable and Verifiable Data Generation for Search Agents on a Tight Budget

author.name: Nandan Thakur, Zijian Chen, Xueguang Ma, Jimmy Lin
