entry.summary: Introduces ORBIT, a 20K-query training dataset for search agents requiring multi-step retrieval and reasoning, generated frugally without paid APIs. Includes a modular framework with self and external verification stages.

entry.title: Neural Collapse Dynamics: Depth, Activation, Regularisation, and Feature Norm Threshold

author.name: Anamika Paul Rupa

entry.summary: Identifies that neural collapse onset is predictable by a critical feature norm threshold (fn*) that is largely invariant to training conditions within each model-dataset pair, providing a practical predictor with 62-epoch mean lead time.

entry.title: Fatigue-Aware Learning to Defer via Constrained Optimisation

author.name: Zheng Zhang, Cuong C. Nguyen, David Rosewarne, Kevin Wells, Gustavo Carneiro

entry.summary: Proposes FALCON, a fatigue-aware learning-to-defer framework that models workload-varying human performance using psychologically grounded fatigue curves and formulates L2D as a Constrained MDP.

entry.title: An Empirical Recipe for Universal Phone Recognition

author.name: Shikhar Bharadwaj, Chin-Jou Li, Kwanghee Choi, Eunjung Yeo, William Chen, Shinji Watanabe, David R. Mortensen

entry.summary: Presents PhoneticXEUS, a multilingual phone recognition model trained on large-scale data achieving SOTA performance across 100+ languages. Through controlled ablations, establishes an empirical recipe quantifying the impact of SSL representations, data scale, and training objectives.

entry.title: Deconfounding Scores and Representation Learning for Causal Effect Estimation with Weak Overlap

author.name: Oscar Clivio, Alexander D'Amour, Alexander Franks, David Bruns-Smith, Chris Holmes, Avi Feller

entry.summary: Proposes deconfounding scores for causal effect estimation under weak overlap, generalizing propensity and prognostic scores. Derives closed-form optimal representations minimizing overlap divergence, addressing curse of dimensionality in causal inference.

entry.title: PolarQuant: Optimal Gaussian Weight Quantization via Hadamard Rotation for LLM Compression

author.name: Caio Vicentino

entry.summary: Presents PolarQuant, a post-training quantization method using Hadamard rotation to transform weights into Gaussian-like distributions for optimal quantization. Achieves near-lossless compression without calibration data, with Hadamard rotation accounting for 98% of improvement.

entry.title: CounselReflect: A Toolkit for Auditing Mental-Health Dialogues

author.name: Yahan Li, Chaohao Du, Zeyang Li, Christopher Chun Kuizon, Shupeng Cheng, Angel Hsing-Chi Hwang, Adam C. Frank, Ruishan Liu

entry.summary: Introduces CounselReflect, a toolkit for auditing mental-health support dialogues that provides structured multi-dimensional reports with session-level summaries, turn-level scores, and evidence-linked excerpts. It integrates 12 model-based metrics and a library of 69 rubric-based metrics derived from clinical literature.

entry.title: UCell: rethinking generalizability and scaling of bio-medical vision models

author.name: Nicholas Kuang, Vanessa Scalon, Ji Yu

entry.summary: Experiments with tiny models (10-30M parameters) for single-cell segmentation, arguing that in biomedical domains where data is scarce, improving small models is underexplored compared to building larger foundation models.

entry.title: Out of Sight, Out of Track: Adversarial Attacks on Propagation-based Multi-Object Trackers via Query State Manipulation

author.name: Halima Bouzidi, Haoyu Liu, Yonatan Gizachew Achamyeleh, Praneetsai Vasu Iddamsetty, Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque

entry.summary: Presents FADE, an adversarial attack framework targeting Tracking-by-Query-Propagation MOT methods through temporal query flooding and temporal memory corruption, exploiting architectural vulnerabilities in end-to-end tracking systems.

entry.title: Learnability-Guided Diffusion for Dataset Distillation

author.name: Jeffrey A. Chan-Santiago, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Proposes learnability-guided diffusion for dataset distillation, addressing the problem that existing distilled datasets contain 80-90% redundant/overlapping training signals. The method optimizes for sample-level diversity in learning signals rather than visual diversity.

entry.title: LinguDistill: Recovering Linguistic Ability in Vision- Language Models via Selective Cross-Modal Distillation

author.name: Patrick Amadeus Irawan, Erland Hilman Fuadi, Shanu Kumar, Alham Fikri Aji, Yova Kementchedjhieva

entry.summary: LinguDistill recovers linguistic capability degraded during VLM adaptation by distilling from the original frozen language model, without adding modules or parameters at inference time. Adapter-free approach maintains model simplicity.

entry.title: A 4D Representation for Training-Free Agentic Reasoning from Monocular Laparoscopic Video

author.name: Maximilian Fehrentz, Nicolas Stellwag, Robert Wiebe, Nicole Thorisch, Fabian Grob, Patrick Remerscheid, Ken-Joel Simmoteit, Benjamin D. Killeen, Christian Heiliger, Nassir Navab

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free 4D representation framework for surgical AI that equips agents with spatiotemporal tools for reasoning about laparoscopic video. Combines point tracking, depth, and segmentation for coherent 4D surgical scene understanding.

entry.title: A global dataset of continuous urban dashcam driving

author.name: Md Shadab Alam, Olena Bazilinska, Pavlo Bazilinskyy

entry.summary: CROWD is a massive manually curated dashcam dataset of 20,275 hours across 238 countries, focusing on routine driving rather than crashes. Supports cross-domain robustness analysis with segment-level labels.

entry.title: RT-GS: Gaussian Splatting with Reflection and Transmittance Primitives

author.name: Kunnong Zeng, Chensheng Peng, Yichen Xie, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Cem Yuksel

entry.summary: RT-GS integrates microfacet material models and ray tracing into Gaussian Splatting to jointly model specular reflections and transmittance using separate Gaussian primitives for each phenomenon.

entry.title: Does Unification Come at a Cost? Uni-SafeBench: A Safety Benchmark for Unified Multimodal Large Models

author.name: Zixiang Peng, Yongxiu Xu, Qinyi Zhang, Jiexun Shen, Yifan Zhang, Hongbo Xu, Yubin Wang, Gaopeng Gou

entry.summary: Introduces Uni-SafeBench, a safety benchmark for Unified Multimodal Large Models spanning six safety categories and seven task types, along with Uni-Judger for evaluation. Addresses the gap in safety evaluation for models that handle both understanding and generation.

entry.title: HippoCamp: Benchmarking Contextual Agents on Personal Computers

author.name: Zhe Yang, Shulin Tian, Kairui Hu, Shuai Liu, Hoang-Nhat Nguyen, Yichi Zhang, Zujin Guo, Mengying Yu, Zinan Zhang, Jingkang Yang, Chen Change Loy, Ziwei Liu

entry.summary: Presents HippoCamp, a benchmark for evaluating agents on multimodal file management across user-centric environments with 42.4 GB of data, 2K+ real files, and 581 QA pairs testing search, evidence perception, and multi-step reasoning.

entry.title: When and Where: A Model Hippocampal Network Unifies Formation of Time Cells and Place Cells

author.name: Qiaorong S. Yu, Zhaoze Wang, Vijay Balasubramanian

entry.summary: Proposes a unified RNN model of hippocampal CA3 that produces both place cells and time cells as different dynamical regimes of the same predictive autoencoder network, unifying previously separate models.

entry.title: Hybrid Energy-Based Models for Physical AI: Provably Stable Identification of Port-Hamiltonian Dynamics

author.name: Simone Betteti, Luca Laurenti

entry.summary: Introduces an energy-based model framework for system identification with provably stable, dissipative dynamics using port-Hamiltonian structure. Extends EBM theory to nonsmooth activations with formal stability guarantees.

entry.title: RAGShield: Provenance-Verified Defense-in-Depth Against Knowledge Base Poisoning in Government Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

author.name: KrishnaSaiReddy Patil

entry.summary: Proposes RAGShield, a five-layer defense-in-depth framework against RAG knowledge base poisoning, applying supply chain provenance verification concepts including cryptographic attestation and trust-weighted retrieval.

entry.title: Think, Act, Build: An Agentic Framework with Vision Language Models for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding

author.name: Haibo Wang, Zihao Lin, Zhiyang Xu, Lifu Huang

entry.summary: Proposes TAB, an agentic framework for zero-shot 3D visual grounding that decouples the task: using 2D VLMs for spatial semantics and deterministic multi-view geometry for 3D structure, bypassing reliance on preprocessed point clouds.

entry.title: IWP: Token Pruning as Implicit Weight Pruning in Large Vision Language Models

author.name: Dong-Jae Lee, Sunghyun Baek, Junmo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes IWP, a training-free token pruning framework for vision-language models grounded in the dual form of attention, reformulating token pruning as selecting optimal rank-1 updates to approximate the original weight matrix.

entry.title: DVGT-2: Vision-Geometry-Action Model for Autonomous Driving at Scale

author.name: Sicheng Zuo, Zixun Xie, Wenzhao Zheng, Shaoqing Xu, Fang Li, Hanbing Li, Long Chen, Zhi-Xin Yang, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: Proposes DVGT-2, a Vision-Geometry-Action model for autonomous driving that uses dense 3D geometry as the critical cue instead of language descriptions, with streaming capability for online planning.

entry.title: Bridging Structured Knowledge and Data: A Unified Framework with Finance Applications

author.name: Yi Cao, Zexun Chen, Lin William Cong, Heqing Shi

entry.summary: Develops SKINNs (Structured-Knowledge-Informed Neural Networks) that embed theoretical constraints as differentiable constraints within neural networks, nesting approaches like functional GMM, Bayesian updating, and PINNs.

entry.title: Fast and Accurate Probing of In-Training LLMs' Downstream Performances

author.name: Zhichen Liu, Tianle Lun, Zhibin Wen, Hao An, Yulin Ou, Jianhui Xu, Hao Zhang, Wenyi Fang, Yang Zheng, Yang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight probing paradigm for monitoring in-training LLM downstream performance, addressing the problem that training loss doesn't always correlate with task outcomes while full evaluation is too expensive.

entry.title: The Recipe Matters More Than the Kitchen:Mathematical Foundations of the AI Weather Prediction Pipeline

author.name: Piyush Garg, Diana R. Gergel, Andrew E. Shao, Galen J. Yacalis

entry.summary: Provides a unified mathematical framework for AI weather prediction explaining what determines forecast skill, covering architecture, loss functions, training strategy, and data distribution using approximation theory, dynamical systems, and information theory.

entry.title: Learning to Shuffle: Block Reshuffling and Reversal Schemes for Stochastic Optimization

author.name: Lam M. Nguyen, Dzung T. Phan, Jayant Kalagnanam

entry.summary: Uses LLM-guided program evolution to discover new shuffling rules for SGD, identifying block reshuffling and reversal as fundamental operations that improve optimization constants beyond random reshuffling.

entry.title: MF-QAT: Multi-Format Quantization-Aware Training for Elastic Inference

author.name: Zifei Xu, Sayeh Sharify, Hesham Mostafa

entry.summary: Introduces MF-QAT, multi-format quantization-aware training producing a single model robust across multiple quantization formats, with a Slice-and-Scale conversion procedure for MXINT and MXFP formats.

entry.title: Orthogonal Learner for Estimating Heterogeneous Long-Term Treatment Effects

author.name: Haorui Ma, Dennis Frauen, Valentyn Melnychuk, Stefan Feuerriegel

entry.summary: Introduces LT-O-learners, orthogonal learners for estimating heterogeneous long-term treatment effects by combining short-term randomized experiments with long-term observational data, addressing overlap challenges.

entry.title: Data-Driven Reachability Analysis via Diffusion Models with PAC Guarantees

author.name: Yanliang Huang, Peng Xie, Wenyuan Wu, Zhuoqi Zeng, Amr Alanwar

entry.summary: Presents a data-driven reachability analysis framework using diffusion models for nonlinear dynamical systems, requiring no explicit model. Provides PAC guarantees via Learn Then Test calibration.

entry.title: Breaking Data Symmetry is Needed For Generalization in Feature Learning Kernels

author.name: Marcel Tom\`as Bernal, Neil Rohit Mallinar, Mikhail Belkin

entry.summary: Studies grokking on algebraic tasks using the Recursive Feature Machine algorithm, finding that generalization occurs only when a certain symmetry in the training set is broken. Shows RFM generalizes by recovering task-relevant features.

entry.title: Concept Training for Human-Aligned Language Models

author.name: Christine Zhang, Dan Jurafsky, Chen Shani

entry.summary: Proposes concept training for language models that predicts sets of semantically related tokens rather than single tokens, improving alignment with human semantic similarity judgments on lexical benchmarks.

entry.title: When Can We Trust LLM Graders? Calibrating Confidence for Automated Assessment

author.name: Robinson Ferrer, Damla Turgut, Zhongzhou Chen, Shashank Sonkar

entry.summary: Addresses predicting when LLM graders are likely to be correct, comparing three confidence estimation methods (self-reported, self-consistency, token probability) across seven LLMs on educational datasets. Finds self-reported confidence is consistently unreliable while other methods show promise for selective automation.

entry.title: OneComp: One-Line Revolution for Generative AI Model Compression

author.name: Yuma Ichikawa, Keiji Kimura, Akihiro Yoshida, Yudai Fujimoto, Hiroki Tokura, Yamato Arai, Yoshiyuki Ishii, Yusei Kawakami, Genki Shikada, Achille Jacquemond, Yoshihiko Fujisawa, Katsuki Fujisawa, Takumi Honda, Akira Sakai

entry.summary: Presents OneComp, an open-source framework that automates model compression by inspecting models, planning mixed-precision assignments, and executing quantization—transforming expert compression workflows into reproducible, resource-adaptive pipelines.

entry.title: Xuanwu: Evolving General Multimodal Models into an Industrial-Grade Foundation for Content Ecosystems

author.name: Zhiqian Zhang, Xu Zhao, Xiaoqing Xu, Guangdong Liang, Weijia Wang, Xiaolei Lv, Bo Li, Jun Gao

entry.summary: Presents Xuanwu VL-2B, an industrial-grade 2B-parameter multimodal model for content moderation using InternViT-300M + MLP + Qwen3 1.7B architecture. Addresses real-world challenges of fine-grained visual perception, long-tail noise, and catastrophic forgetting in content ecosystems.

entry.title: Less Is More? Selective Visual Attention to High-Importance Regions for Multimodal Radiology Summarization

author.name: Mst. Fahmida Sultana Naznin, Adnan Ibney Faruq, Mushfiqur Rahman, Niloy Kumar Mondal, Md. Mehedi Hasan Shawon, Md Rakibul Hasan

entry.summary: Introduces ViTAS for multimodal radiology summarization, showing that selectively focusing on pathology-relevant visual patches rather than full images yields better performance. Challenges assumptions that more visual input is always better.

entry.title: Q-Mask: Query-driven Causal Masks for Text Anchoring in OCR-Oriented Vision-Language Models

author.name: Longwei Xu, Feng Feng, Shaojie Zhang, Xin Chen, Hang Li, Anan Du, Hailong Yu, Pei Fu, Zhenbo Luo, Jian Luan

entry.summary: Introduces TABench for evaluating text-region grounding in VLMs and Q-Mask, a query-driven causal mask framework for precise OCR text anchoring. Reveals that both general-purpose and OCR-specific VLMs struggle with accurate text spatial grounding.

entry.title: PET-DINO: Unifying Visual Cues into Grounding DINO with Prompt-Enriched Training

author.name: Weifu Fu, Jinyang Li, Bin-Bin Gao, Jialin Li, Yuhuan Lin, Hanqiu Deng, Wenbing Tao, Yong Liu, Chengjie Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PET-DINO, a universal open-set object detector supporting both text and visual prompts with an Alignment-Friendly Visual Prompt Generation module and novel training strategies for data-driven OSOD models.

entry.title: When AI and Experts Agree on Error: Intrinsic Ambiguity in Dermatoscopic Images

author.name: Loris Cino, Pier Luigi Mazzeo, Alessandro Martella, Giulia Radi, Renato Rossi, Cosimo Distante

entry.summary: Studies the intrinsic visual ambiguity in dermatoscopic images by identifying cases systematically misclassified across all CNN architectures. Expert dermatologists confirmed these failures stem from inherent visual ambiguity rather than algorithmic bias.

entry.title: HICT: High-precision 3D CBCT reconstruction from a single X-ray

author.name: Wen Ma, Jiaxiang Liu, Zikai Xiao, Ziyang Wang, Feng Yang, Zuozhu Liu

entry.summary: HiCT reconstructs 3D dental CBCT volumes from a single panoramic X-ray using a two-stage framework with video diffusion for multi-view projection generation and ray-based dynamic attention for reconstruction. Builds a large-scale paired PX-CBCT dataset.

entry.title: MotionGrounder: Grounded Multi-Object Motion Transfer via Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Samuel Teodoro, Yun Chen, Agus Gunawan, Soo Ye Kim, Jihyong Oh, Munchurl Kim

entry.summary: MotionGrounder is the first DiT-based framework for multi-object motion transfer in video generation, using flow-based motion signals and object-caption alignment loss for grounded multi-object controllability.

entry.title: IDDM: Identity-Decoupled Personalized Diffusion Models with a Tunable Privacy-Utility Trade-off

author.name: Linyan Dai, Xinwei Zhang, Haoyang Li, Qingqing Ye, Haibo Hu

entry.summary: IDDM introduces identity-decoupled personalized diffusion models that protect user identity in generated images while maintaining visual quality. Addresses the gap where authorized personalization still leaks identity through shared outputs.

entry.title: PHASOR: Anatomy- and Phase-Consistent Volumetric Diffusion for CT Virtual Contrast Enhancement

author.name: Zilong Li, Dongyang Li, Chenglong Ma, Zhan Feng, Dakai Jin, Junping Zhang, Hao Luo, Fan Wang, Hongming Shan

entry.summary: PHASOR uses volumetric video diffusion for virtual contrast enhancement of CT scans, synthesizing contrast-enhanced CT from non-contrast scans while maintaining anatomical consistency across phases.

entry.title: Open-Set Supervised 3D Anomaly Detection: An Industrial Dataset and a Generalisable Framework for Unknown Defects

author.name: Hanzhe Liang, Luocheng Zhang, Junyang Xia, HanLiang Zhou, Bingyang Guo, Yingxi Xie, Can Gao, Ruiyun Yu, Jinbao Wang, Pan Li

entry.summary: Introduces open-set supervised 3D anomaly detection with Open-Industry dataset (15 categories, 5 real anomaly types each) and Open3D-AD framework for detecting unknown anomalies given only a few known anomaly examples.

entry.title: TRACE: High-Fidelity 3D Scene Editing via Tangible Reconstruction and Geometry-Aligned Contextual Video Masking

author.name: Jiyuan Hu, Zechuan Zhang, Zongxin Yang, Yi Yang

entry.summary: TRACE enables mesh-guided 3DGS scene editing with part-level manipulation capability. Introduces MV-TRACE dataset for multi-view consistent scene editing and Tangible Geometry Anchoring for structural preservation.

entry.title: One Panel Does Not Fit All: Case-Adaptive Multi-Agent Deliberation for Clinical Prediction

author.name: Yuxing Lu, Yushuhong Lin, Jason Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces CAMP, a multi-agent clinical prediction system where an attending-physician agent dynamically assembles specialist panels based on diagnostic uncertainty, using three-valued voting (KEEP/REFUSE/NEUTRAL) to handle case-level heterogeneity. Addresses the gap between simple and complex clinical cases.

entry.title: Experience as a Compass: Multi-agent RAG with Evolving Orchestration and Agent Prompts

author.name: Sha Li, Naren Ramakrishnan

entry.summary: Proposes HERA, a hierarchical framework for multi-agent RAG that jointly evolves orchestration strategies and role-specific agent prompts through reward-guided sampling and experience accumulation.

entry.title: Quantifying Gender Bias in Large Language Models: When ChatGPT Becomes a Hiring Manager

author.name: Nina Gerszberg, Janka Hamori, Andrew Lo

entry.summary: Quantifies gender bias in LLM hiring decisions, finding that LLMs are more likely to hire female candidates and perceive them as more qualified, but still recommend lower pay relative to male candidates.

entry.title: How Do Language Models Process Ethical Instructions? Deliberation, Consistency, and Other-Recognition Across Four Models

author.name: Hiroki Fukui

entry.summary: Conducts 600+ multi-agent simulations across four models to study how ethical instructions are internally processed, introducing metrics for Deliberation Depth, Value Consistency, and Other-Recognition Sophistication. Finds model-specific patterns.

entry.title: GenoBERT: A Language Model for Accurate Genotype Imputation

author.name: Lei Huang, Chuan Qiu, Kuan-Jui Su, Anqi Liu, Yun Gong, Weiqiang Lin, Lindong Jiang, Chen Zhao, Meng Song, Jeffrey Deng, Qing Tian, Zhe Luo, Ping Gong, Hui Shen, Chaoyang Zhang, Hong-Wen Deng

entry.summary: Presents GenoBERT, a transformer-based genotype imputation method that tokenizes phased genotypes and uses self-attention to capture linkage disequilibrium patterns, achieving reference-free imputation across ancestry groups.

entry.title: Hierarchical Pre-Training of Vision Encoders with Large Language Models

author.name: Eugene Lee, Ting-Yu Chang, Jui-Huang Tsai, Jiajie Diao, Chen-Yi Lee

entry.summary: Proposes HIVE, a framework enhancing vision-language alignment through hierarchical cross-attention between vision encoder layers and LLM, improving gradient flow compared to methods that flatten image embeddings.

entry.title: REM-CTX: Automated Peer Review via Reinforcement Learning with Auxiliary Context

author.name: Pawin Taechoyotin, Daniel E. Acuna

entry.summary: Introduces REM-CTX, an RL-based automated peer review system that incorporates figures and external scholarly signals via correspondence-aware reward functions using GRPO on an 8B model. Achieves highest review quality across multiple science domains.

entry.title: EvolveTool-Bench: Evaluating the Quality of LLM-Generated Tool Libraries as Software Artifacts

author.name: Alibek T. Kaliyev, Artem Maryanskyy

entry.summary: Introduces EvolveTool-Bench, a benchmark evaluating LLM-generated tool libraries as software artifacts beyond task completion, measuring reuse, redundancy, regression stability, and safety.

entry.title: Towards Initialization-dependent and Non-vacuous Generalization Bounds for Overparameterized Shallow Neural Networks

author.name: Yunwen Lei, Yufeng Xie

entry.summary: Derives initialization-dependent generalization bounds for overparameterized shallow neural networks that are non-vacuous, avoiding dependence on spectral norms that scale with width.

entry.title: Scalable Pretraining of Large Mixture of Experts Language Models on Aurora Super Computer

author.name: Dharma Teja Vooturi, Dhiraj Kalamkar, Dipankar Das, Bharat Kaul

entry.summary: Demonstrates large-scale MoE LLM pretraining on the Aurora supercomputer (127K GPU tiles), training models up to 220B parameters using the Optimus training library on Intel PVC hardware.

entry.title: L\'evy-Flow Models: Heavy-Tail-Aware Normalizing Flows for Financial Risk Management

author.name: Rachid Drissi

entry.summary: Introduces Lévy-Flows, normalizing flow models using Lévy process-based distributions (Variance Gamma, Normal-Inverse Gaussian) instead of Gaussian bases, with theoretical tail preservation guarantees. Evaluated on financial risk management.

entry.title: Hierarchical Discrete Flow Matching for Graph Generation

author.name: Yoann Boget, Pablo Strasser, Alexandros Kalousis

entry.summary: Introduces a hierarchical discrete flow matching framework for graph generation that reduces computational cost from quadratic to sub-quadratic in node count while decreasing required denoising iterations.

entry.title: A Cross-graph Tuning-free GNN Prompting Framework

author.name: Yaqi Chen, Shixun Huang, Ryan Twemlow, Lei Wang, John Le, Sheng Wang, Willy Susilo, Jun Yan, Jun Shen

entry.summary: Introduces CTP, a cross-graph tuning-free GNN prompting framework that supports both homogeneous and heterogeneous graphs and achieves 30.8% average accuracy gain over SOTAs in few-shot prediction.

entry.title: Super-Resolving Coarse-Resolution Weather Forecasts With Flow Matching

author.name: Aymeric Delefosse, Anastase Charantonis, Dominique B\'er\'eziat

entry.summary: Presents a modular framework decoupling weather forecasting from spatial resolution by applying flow matching-based generative super-resolution as post-processing to coarse-resolution forecasts.

entry.title: Generalization Bounds for Spectral GNNs via Fourier Domain Analysis

author.name: Vahan A. Martirosyan, Daniele Malitesta, Hugues Talbot, Jhony H. Giraldo, Fragkiskos D. Malliaros

entry.summary: Derives data-dependent, depth and order-aware generalization bounds for spectral GNNs by analyzing them in the graph Fourier domain, showing Gaussian complexity invariance under Graph Fourier Transform.

entry.title: Bridging the Simulation-to-Experiment Gap with Generative Models using Adversarial Distribution Alignment

author.name: Kai Nelson, Tobias Kreiman, Sergey Levine, Aditi S. Krishnapriyan

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for bridging the simulation-to-experiment gap by pre-training a generative model on simulation data then aligning it with partial experimental observations using adversarial distribution alignment. Applicable across science and engineering domains.

entry.title: Forecast collapse of transformer-based models under squared loss in financial time series

author.name: Pierre Andreoletti (IDP)

entry.summary: Proves that transformer-based models trained with squared loss on financial time series with weak conditional structure will exhibit 'forecast collapse'—producing trivial predictions. Greater model expressivity introduces spurious fluctuations without improving accuracy.

entry.title: Inverse-Free Sparse Variational Gaussian Processes

author.name: Stefano Cortinovis, Laurence Aitchison, Stefanos Eleftheriadis, Mark van der Wilk

entry.summary: Makes inverse-free sparse variational Gaussian processes practical by proposing a better-conditioned bound and matmul-only natural-gradient updates, enabling GP training on modern hardware without Cholesky decompositions.

entry.title: Multimodal Language Models Cannot Spot Spatial Inconsistencies

author.name: Om Khangaonkar, Hadi J. Rad, Hamed Pirsiavash

entry.summary: Evaluates multimodal LLMs on detecting spatial inconsistencies between two views of the same scene, finding they significantly underperform humans. Proposes a scalable method for generating test data from multi-view scenes.

entry.title: On the limited utility of parallel data for learning shared multilingual representations

author.name: Julius Leino, J\"org Tiedemann

entry.summary: Shows that parallel (translated) data in pretraining has minimal effect on cross-lingual alignment in multilingual models. Alignment emerges at similar levels even without explicit parallel data.

entry.title: Authorship Impersonation via LLM Prompting does not Evade Authorship Verification Methods

author.name: Baoyi Zeng, Andrea Nini

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLM-prompted authorship impersonation can evade forensic authorship verification systems. Using GPT-4o under four prompting conditions across three genres, the study finds that LLM-generated impersonation texts do not successfully evade existing verification methods.

entry.title: Structural Feature Engineering for Generative Engine Optimization: How Content Structure Shapes Citation Behavior

author.name: Junwei Yu, Mufeng Yang, Yepeng Ding, Hiroyuki Sato

entry.summary: Proposes GEO-SFE, a framework for structural feature engineering in Generative Engine Optimization—studying how document structure (macro, meso, micro levels) influences AI search engines' citation behavior, as opposed to semantic content alone.

entry.title: OmniSch: A Multimodal PCB Schematic Benchmark For Structured Diagram Visual Reasoning

author.name: Taiting Lu, Kaiyuan Lin, Yuxin Tian, Yubo Wang, Muchuan Wang, Sharique Khatri, Akshit Kartik, Yixi Wang, Amey Santosh Rane, Yida Wang, Yifan Yang, Yi-Chao Chen, Yincheng Jin, Mahanth Gowda

entry.summary: Introduces OmniSch, the first benchmark for evaluating LMMs on PCB schematic understanding and spatial netlist graph construction, with 1,854 real-world schematics across four tasks including visual grounding and connectivity extraction.

entry.title: Mine-JEPA: In-Domain Self-Supervised Learning for Mine-Like Object Classification in Side-Scan Sonar

author.name: Taeyoun Kwon, Youngwon Choi, Hyeonyu Kim, Myeongkyun Cho, Junhyeok Choi, Moon Hwan Kim

entry.summary: Presents Mine-JEPA, the first in-domain self-supervised learning pipeline for side-scan sonar mine classification, achieving F1 of 0.935 with only 1,170 unlabeled sonar images, outperforming DINOv3 fine-tuned on 1.7B images.

entry.title: Advancing Complex Video Object Segmentation via Tracking-Enhanced Prompt: The 1st Winner for 5th PVUW MOSE Challenge

author.name: Jinrong Zhang, Canyang Wu, Xusheng He, Weili Guan, Jianlong Wu, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: Proposes TEP, a training-free approach for complex video object segmentation that uses external tracking models and multimodal LLMs to enhance SAM3's prompting for tiny and semantic-dominated objects. Won 1st place in the 5th PVUW MOSE Challenge.

entry.title: Towards Viewpoint-Robust End-to-End Autonomous Driving with 3D Foundation Model Priors

author.name: Hiroki Hashimoto, Hiromichi Goto, Hiroyuki Sugai, Hiroshi Kera, Kazuhiko Kawamoto

entry.summary: Investigates viewpoint robustness in end-to-end autonomous driving by injecting 3D foundation model priors as positional embeddings. Shows reduced performance degradation under camera viewpoint perturbations without data augmentation.

entry.title: Disentangling to Re-couple: Resolving the Similarity-Controllability Paradox in Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Shuang Li, Chao Deng, Hang Chen, Liqun Liu, Zhenyu Hu, Te Cao, Mengge Xue, Yuan Chen, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang

entry.summary: DisCo resolves the similarity-controllability paradox in subject-driven T2I generation by disentangling visual identity from textual modifications. Separates subject identity extraction from text-based context editing.

entry.title: Autoregressive Appearance Prediction for 3D Gaussian Avatars

author.name: Michael Steiner, Zhang Chen, Alexander Richard, Vasu Agrawal, Markus Steinberger, Michael Zollh\"ofer

entry.summary: Proposes an autoregressive approach for 3D Gaussian avatar appearance prediction that conditions on both pose and learned appearance latents. Addresses ambiguity when similar poses correspond to different appearances in large motion capture datasets.

entry.title: PDA: Text-Augmented Defense Framework for Robust Vision-Language Models against Adversarial Image Attacks

author.name: Jingning Xu, Haochen Luo, Chen Liu

entry.summary: PDA introduces a training-free defense against adversarial image attacks on VLMs using text augmentation via prompt paraphrasing, question decomposition, and consistency aggregation at test time.

entry.title: ONE-SHOT: Compositional Human-Environment Video Synthesis via Spatial-Decoupled Motion Injection and Hybrid Context Integration

author.name: Fengyuan Yang, Luying Huang, Jiazhi Guan, Quanwei Yang, Dongwei Pan, Jianglin Fu, Haocheng Feng, Wei He, Kaisiyuan Wang, Hang Zhou, Angela Yao

entry.summary: ONE-SHOT enables compositional human-environment video generation with disentangled subject and scene editing. Uses canonical-space injection for human motion and hybrid context integration for environments, avoiding heavy 3D pre-processing.

entry.title: Compact Keyframe-Optimized Multi-Agent Gaussian Splatting SLAM

author.name: Monica M. Q. Li, Pierre-Yves Lajoie, Jialiang Liu, Giovanni Beltrame

entry.summary: Improves multi-agent Gaussian Splatting SLAM by incorporating map compaction and keyframe optimization to reduce communication load while preserving map fidelity for bandwidth-constrained robotic teams.

entry.title: Instrumental Convergence Without Agency: What’s Necessary, What’s Assumed?

author.name: E.G. Blee-Goldman

entry.summary: Derives instrumental convergence from structural/physical principles using constructor theory, without invoking decision theory or agency. Separates observational from predictive aspects of instrumental convergence, showing certain organizational features must exist in any persistent system.

entry.title: G-Drift MIA: Membership Inference via Gradient-Induced Feature Drift in LLMs

author.name: Ravi Ranjan, Utkarsh Grover, Xiaomin Lin, Agoritsa Polyzou

entry.summary: Introduces G-Drift MIA, a white-box membership inference attack that measures gradient-induced feature drift in internal LLM representations after a single gradient step, outperforming existing methods on same-distribution settings.

entry.title: WARP: Guaranteed Inner-Layer Repair of NLP Transformers

author.name: Hsin-Ling Hsu, Min-Yu Chen, Nai-Chia Chen, Yan-Ru Chen, Yi-Ling Chang, Fang Yu

entry.summary: Proposes WARP, a constraint-based repair framework for transformer NLP models that extends repair beyond the last layer by formulating it as a convex quadratic program with provable guarantees.

entry.title: VLM-in-the-Loop: A Plug-In Quality Assurance Module for ECG Digitization Pipelines

author.name: Jiachen Li, Shihao Li, Soovadeep Bakshi, Wei Li, Dongmei Chen

entry.summary: Introduces VLM-in-the-Loop, a plug-in quality assurance module for ECG digitization that uses closed-loop VLM feedback with tool grounding. Raises verdict consistency from 71% to 89% and doubles fidelity separation.

entry.title: Video Patch Pruning: Efficient Video Instance Segmentation via Early Token Reduction

author.name: Patrick Glandorf, Thomas Norrenbrock, Bodo Rosenhahn

entry.summary: VPP introduces temporal prior knowledge to enable early-layer token pruning in Vision Transformers for video instance segmentation, exploiting the observation that deeper-layer features from prior frames have strong foreground selectivity.

entry.title: Enhancing Gradient Inversion Attacks in Federated Learning via Hierarchical Feature Optimization

author.name: Hao Fang, Wenbo Yu, Bin Chen, Xuan Wang, Shu-Tao Xia, Qing Liao, Ke Xu

entry.summary: Proposes hierarchical feature optimization for gradient inversion attacks in federated learning, going beyond simple latent space inversion of GANs to improve reconstruction of private data from shared gradients.

entry.title: ReMoGen: Real-time Human Interaction-to-Reaction Generation via Modular Learning from Diverse Data

author.name: Yaoqin Ye, Yiteng Xu, Qin Sun, Xinge Zhu, Yujing Sun, Yuexin Ma

entry.summary: ReMoGen generates real-time human reaction motions from multi-source cues (other agents' actions, scene geometry, semantic inputs) using modular learning across heterogeneous single-person, human-human, and human-scene datasets.

entry.title: Decision-Centric Design for LLM Systems

author.name: Wei Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a decision-centric framework for LLM systems that separates decision-relevant signals from the policy that maps them to actions, making control decisions (whether to answer, clarify, retrieve, escalate) explicit and inspectable rather than implicit within generation.

entry.title: Can LLMs Perceive Time? An Empirical Investigation

author.name: Aniketh Garikaparthi

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs can estimate their own task durations, finding they overshoot by 4-7x, predict human-scale times for second-long tasks, and fail at relative ordering. Tests GPT-5 and other model families.

entry.title: Task-Centric Personalized Federated Fine-Tuning of Language Models

author.name: Gabriel U. Talasso, Meghdad Kurmanji, Allan M. de Souza, Nicholas D. Lane, Leandro A. Villas

entry.summary: Proposes a task-centric personalized federated learning approach for fine-tuning language models on heterogeneous tasks, addressing generalization to unseen tasks and intra-client task interference.

entry.title: Temporal Memory for Resource-Constrained Agents: Continual Learning via Stochastic Compress-Add-Smooth

author.name: Michael Chertkov

entry.summary: Proposes a continual learning framework where memory is modeled as a stochastic process (Bridge Diffusion) rather than a parameter vector, with a three-step Compress-Add-Smooth recursion for incorporating new experience under fixed memory budget.

entry.title: Optimsyn: Influence-Guided Rubrics Optimization for Synthetic Data Generation

author.name: Zhiting Fan, Ruizhe Chen, Tianxiang Hu, Ru Peng, Zenan Huang, Haokai Xu, Yixin Chen, Jian Wu, Junbo Zhao, Zuozhu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Optimsyn, a method for automatically optimizing rubrics used in synthetic data generation through influence-guided optimization, removing the need for expert-dependent manual rubric design.

entry.title: UniMixer: A Unified Architecture for Scaling Laws in Recommendation Systems

author.name: Mingming Ha, Guanchen Wang, Linxun Chen, Xuan Rao, Yuexin Shi, Tianbao Ma, Zhaojie Liu, Yunqian Fan, Zilong Lu, Yanan Niu, Han Li, Kun Gai

entry.summary: Proposes UniMixer, a unified architecture for scaling laws in recommendation systems that unifies attention-based, TokenMixer-based, and factorization-machine-based approaches under a single framework.

entry.title: Query-Conditioned Evidential Keyframe Sampling for MLLM-Based Long-Form Video Understanding

author.name: Yiheng Wang, Lichen Zhu, Yueqian Lin, Yudong Liu, Jingyang Zhang, Hai "Helen" Li, Yiran Chen

entry.summary: Proposes evidence-driven keyframe sampling for long-form video QA grounded in information bottleneck theory, maximizing conditional mutual information between selected frames and the query.

entry.title: Neural Harmonic Textures for High-Quality Primitive Based Neural Reconstruction

author.name: Jorge Condor, Nicolas Moenne-Loccoz, Merlin Nimier-David, Piotr Didyk, Zan Gojcic, Qi Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Neural Harmonic Textures for primitive-based neural reconstruction (e.g., 3D Gaussian Splatting), anchoring latent features on virtual scaffolds around primitives and using periodic activations for better high-frequency detail.

entry.title: Speeding Up Mixed-Integer Programming Solvers with Sparse Learning for Branching

author.name: Selin Bayramo\u{g}lu, George L Nemhauser, Nikolaos V Sahinidis

entry.summary: Develops sparse, interpretable models for approximating strong branching scores in MIP solvers, achieving competitive accuracy with <4% of parameters compared to state-of-the-art GNNs.

entry.title: Lipschitz Dueling Bandits over Continuous Action Spaces

author.name: Mudit Sharma, Shweta Jain, Vaneet Aggarwal, Ganesh Ghalme

entry.summary: First study of Lipschitz dueling bandits over continuous action spaces with purely comparative feedback, proposing an algorithm with zooming-dimension-dependent regret bounds.

entry.title: Learning from Many and Adapting to the Unknown in Open-set Test Streams

author.name: Xiao Zhang, Juntao Lyu, Tianyu Hu, Qianchuan Zhao, Huimin Ma

entry.summary: Proposes SyCo (Synapse Consolidation), a bio-inspired parameter-efficient LLM test-time adaptation method inspired by Drosophila memory signaling cascades, using low-rank adapters with Rac1/MAPK pathway dynamics.

entry.title: ActivityNarrated: An Open-Ended Narrative Paradigm for Wearable Human Activity Understanding

author.name: Lala Shakti Swarup Ray, Mengxi Liu, Alcina Pinto, Deepika Gurung, Daniel Geissler, Paul Lukowoicz, Bo Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes an open-vocabulary framework for wearable human activity recognition that models activities as narratives rather than fixed classes, aligning sensor data with natural language descriptions.

entry.title: Scaled Gradient Descent for Ill-Conditioned Low-Rank Matrix Recovery with Optimal Sampling Complexity

author.name: Zhenxuan Li, Meng Huang

entry.summary: Proposes scaled gradient descent for ill-conditioned low-rank matrix recovery achieving optimal sample complexity O((n1+n2)r) and condition-number-free convergence rate, overcoming two key limitations of existing gradient-based methods.

entry.title: Activation Saturation and Floquet Spectrum Collapse in Neural ODEs

author.name: Nikolaos M. Matzakos

entry.summary: Proves that activation saturation in Neural ODEs with saturating activations (tanh, sigmoid) forces the Floquet spectrum to collapse, limiting both contraction and chaotic sensitivity. Provides theoretical bounds on dynamical expressiveness.

entry.title: Multi-Camera View Scaling for Data-Efficient Robot Imitation Learning

author.name: Yichen Xie, Yixiao Wang, Shuqi Zhao, Cheng-En Wu, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Jianwen Xie, Hao-Shu Fang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for data-efficient robot imitation learning by scaling camera views during demonstration collection, generating pseudo-demonstrations from multiple synchronized perspectives to enrich training distribution without additional human effort.

entry.title: LLM REgression with a Latent Iterative State Head

author.name: Yiheng Su, Matthew Lease

entry.summary: Proposes RELISH, a lightweight architecture for text regression with LLMs that iteratively refines a learned latent state through cross-attention over frozen LLM token representations, mapping to scalar values. Consistently outperforms baselines across 5 datasets and 4 LLM backbones.

entry.title: CrossTrace: A Cross-Domain Dataset of Grounded Scientific Reasoning Traces for Hypothesis Generation

author.name: Andrew Bouras, OMS-II Research Fellow

entry.summary: Introduces CrossTrace, a dataset of 1,389 grounded scientific reasoning traces spanning biomedical, AI/ML, and cross-domain research. Each trace captures the chain from known knowledge through intermediate steps to a novel hypothesis.

entry.title: M-MiniGPT4: Multilingual VLLM Alignment via Translated Data

author.name: Seung Hun Han, Youssef Mohamed, Mohamed Elhoseiny

entry.summary: Presents M-MiniGPT4, a multilingual vision-language model supporting 11 languages, using a mixture of native multilingual and translated data with a multilingual alignment training stage. Achieves 36% accuracy on multilingual MMMU, outperforming models in its weight class.

entry.title: ContextClaim: A Context-Driven Paradigm for Verifiable Claim Detection

author.name: Yufeng Li, Rrubaa Panchendrarajan, Arkaitz Zubiaga

entry.summary: Introduces ContextClaim, which improves verifiable claim detection by incorporating retrieved context rather than relying solely on the claim text. Shows that knowing what entities/events a claim references and whether evidence exists improves detection of checkable claims.

entry.title: GISTBench: Evaluating LLM User Understanding via Evidence-Based Interest Verification

author.name: Iordanis Fostiropoulos, Muhammad Rafay Azhar, Abdalaziz Sawwan, Boyu Fang, Yuchen Liu, Jiayi Liu, Hanchao Yu, Qi Guo, Jianyu Wang, Fei Liu, Xiangjun Fan

entry.summary: Introduces GISTBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to understand users from interaction histories in recommendation systems. Proposes Interest Groundedness and Interest Specificity metrics to measure hallucinated interests and profile distinctiveness.

entry.title: Aligning Multimodal Sequential Recommendations via Robust Direct Preference Optimization with Sparse MoE

author.name: Hejin Huang, Jusheng Zhang, Kaitong Cai, Jian Wang, Rong Pan

entry.summary: Examines how Direct Preference Optimization behaves under implicit feedback in multimodal sequential recommendation, finding that stochastic sampling from dynamic top-K candidate pools outperforms deterministic hard negatives for negative selection.

entry.title: Reward-Based Online LLM Routing via NeuralUCB

author.name: Ming-Hua Tsai, Phat Tran

entry.summary: Investigates NeuralUCB for cost-aware LLM routing, showing it outperforms random and min-cost baselines in utility reward while achieving substantially lower inference cost than max-quality approaches.

entry.title: Excite, Attend and Segment (EASe): Domain-Agnostic Fine-Grained Mask Discovery with Feature Calibration and Self-Supervised Upsampling

author.name: Deepank Singh, Anurag Nihal, Vedhus Hoskere

entry.summary: Proposes EASe, an unsupervised domain-agnostic semantic segmentation framework for fine-grained mask discovery that addresses limitations of coarse patch-level representations in foundation model-based approaches.

entry.title: mmAnomaly: Leveraging Visual Context for Robust Anomaly Detection in the Non-Visual World with mmWave Radar

author.name: Tarik Reza Toha (Louie), Shao-Jung (Louie), Lu, Mahathir Monjur, Shahriar Nirjon

entry.summary: Presents mmAnomaly, a multi-modal anomaly detection framework combining mmWave radar with RGBD input for human sensing in non-visual scenarios. Uses visual context (scene geometry, material properties) to improve radar-based anomaly detection.

entry.title: The 1st Winner for 5th PVUW MeViS-Text Challenge: Strong MLLMs Meet SAM3 for Referring Video Object Segmentation

author.name: Xusheng He, Canyang Wu, Jinrong Zhang, Weili Guan, Jianlong Wu, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: Presents the winning solution for the 5th PVUW MeViS-Text Challenge using a training-free pipeline combining Gemini-3.1 Pro for target decomposition and SAM3 for segmentation and tracking in motion-centric referring video object segmentation.

entry.title: Neuropsychiatric Deviations From Normative Profiles: An MRI-Derived Marker for Early Alzheimer's Disease Detection

author.name: Synne Hjertager Osenbroch, Lisa Ramona Rosvold, Yao Lu, Alvaro Fernandez-Quilez

entry.summary: Uses deep learning normative modeling on structural MRI to detect atypical neuropsychiatric symptom burden as an early marker for Alzheimer's disease. Trains on cognitively stable participants and uses deviation scores to identify early AD signs.

entry.title: DirectFisheye-GS: Enabling Native Fisheye Input in Gaussian Splatting with Cross-View Joint Optimization

author.name: Zhengxian Yang, Fei Xie, Xutao Xue, Rui Zhang, Taicheng Huang, Yang Liu, Mengqi Ji, Tao Yu

entry.summary: DirectFisheye-GS enables native fisheye camera input in Gaussian Splatting without undistortion preprocessing, avoiding information loss from black borders and detail dilution. Uses cross-view joint optimization for fisheye-native 3DGS.

entry.title: Continual Vision-Language Learning for Remote Sensing: Benchmarking and Analysis

author.name: Xingxing Weng, Ruifeng Ni, Chao Pang, XiangYu Hao, Yishan Wang, Xiaokang Zhang, Wei Xu, Gui-Song Xia

entry.summary: CLeaRS provides the first comprehensive benchmark for continual vision-language learning in remote sensing, with 10 curated subsets covering 207k image-text pairs across diverse sensing modalities and interpretation tasks.

entry.title: Sparkle: A Robust and Versatile Representation for Point Cloud based Human Motion Capture

author.name: Yiming Ren, Yujing Sun, Aoru Xue, Kwok-Yan Lam, Yuexin Ma

entry.summary: Sparkle proposes a structured representation for point cloud motion capture that unifies skeletal joints with surface anchors through kinematic-geometric factorization, balancing expressiveness and robustness.

entry.title: YieldSAT: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for High-Resolution Crop Yield Prediction

author.name: Miro Miranda, Deepak Pathak, Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Hiba Najjar, Francisco Mena, Cristhian Sanchez, Akshay Pai, Diego Arenas, Matias Valdenegro-Toro, Marcela Charfuelan, Marlon Nuske, Andreas Dengel

entry.summary: YieldSAT releases a large-scale multimodal dataset for high-resolution crop yield prediction spanning multiple countries and crop types with 2,173 expert-curated fields and over 5 million satellite image patches.

entry.title: Maximizing T2-Only Prostate Cancer Localization from Expected Diffusion Weighted Imaging

author.name: Weixi Yi, Yipei Wang, Wen Yan, Hanyuan Zhang, Natasha Thorley, Alexander Ng, Shonit Punwani, Fernando Bianco, Mark Emberton, Veeru Kasivisvanathan, Dean C. Barratt, Shaheer U. Saeed, Yipeng Hu

entry.summary: Investigates using only T2-weighted MRI for prostate cancer localization by treating DWI as a latent modality available during training but not inference. Aims to reduce clinical costs by eliminating the need for DWI acquisition.

entry.title: True (VIS) Lies: Analyzing How Generative AI Recognizes Intentionality, Rhetoric, and Misleadingness in Visualization Lies

author.name: Graziano Blasilli, Marco Angelini

entry.summary: Investigates multimodal LLMs' ability to identify misleading visualizations, recognize rhetorical intent, and detect deception in COVID-19 data visualizations. Uses examples from IEEE VIS's VisLies event.

entry.title: Integer-State Dynamics of Quantized Spiking Neural Networks for Efficient Hardware Acceleration

author.name: Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Models hardware-oriented spiking neural networks as deterministic maps on bounded integer lattices, analyzing how quantization, clipping, and overflow alter network dynamics rather than merely approximating higher-precision models.

entry.title: Behavioral Score Diffusion: Model-Free Trajectory Planning via Kernel-Based Score Estimation from Data

author.name: Shihao Li, Jiachen Li, Jiamin Xu, Dongmei Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Behavioral Score Diffusion (BSD), a training-free and model-free trajectory planner that computes diffusion scores directly from a library of trajectory data via kernel-weighted estimation. Eliminates need for learned score networks or analytical dynamics models.

entry.title: SMASH: Mastering Scalable Whole-Body Skills for Humanoid Ping-Pong with Egocentric Vision

author.name: Junli Ren, Yinghui Li, Kai Zhang, Penglin Fu, Haoran Jiang, Yixuan Pan, Guangjun Zeng, Tao Huang, Weizhong Guo, Peng Lu, Tianyu Li, Jingbo Wang, Li Chen, Hongyang Li, Ping Luo

entry.summary: Presents SMASH, a system for humanoid ping-pong using egocentric vision and whole-body coordination. Addresses onboard perception under fast motion and diverse strike motion generation for precise yet natural behaviors.

entry.title: Phase transition on a context-sensitive random language model with short range interactions

author.name: Yuma Toji, Jun Takahashi, Vwani Roychowdhury, Hideyuki Miyahara

entry.summary: Constructs a random language model with short-range interactions and demonstrates phase transitions, addressing whether transitions in language models originate from genuinely linguistic properties absent in conventional spin models.

entry.title: Coefficient Giving is seeking proposals for biosecurity projects

author.name: cwbakerlee

entry.summary: Coefficient Giving announces a request for proposals for biosecurity projects, with >$100M in expected grants. Focus on AI-enabled biological threats, mirror biology risks, and pandemic preparedness.

entry.title: Criterion Validity of LLM-as-Judge for Business Outcomes in Conversational Commerce

author.name: Liang Chen, Qi Liu, Wenhuan Lin, Feng Liang

entry.summary: Tests criterion validity of LLM-as-Judge rubric evaluations against actual business conversion outcomes on a Chinese matchmaking platform. Finds dimension-level heterogeneity - some quality dimensions predict business outcomes while others don't.

entry.title: Streaming Model Cascades for Semantic SQL

author.name: Pawe{\l} Liskowski, Kyle Schmaus

entry.summary: Presents streaming model cascade algorithms for semantic SQL queries that invoke LLMs per-row, enabling per-partition execution without inter-worker communication while maintaining quality guarantees.

entry.title: MVNN: A Measure-Valued Neural Network for Learning McKean-Vlasov Dynamics from Particle Data

author.name: Liyao Lyu, Xinyue Yu, Hayden Schaeffer

entry.summary: Introduces a measure-valued neural network (MVNN) that learns interaction forces in collective behavior systems from particle trajectory data. Proves well-posedness, propagation-of-chaos, and universal approximation for the architecture.

entry.title: Foundation Model-guided Iteratively Prompting and Pseudo-Labeling for Partially Labeled Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Qiaochu Zhao, Wei Wei, David Horowitz, Richard Bakst, Yading Yuan

entry.summary: IPnP iteratively generates and refines pseudo-labels for partially labeled medical image segmentation through collaboration between a trainable specialist network and a frozen foundation model generalist.

entry.title: Feature-level Site Leakage Reduction for Cross-Hospital Chest X-ray Transfer via Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Ayoub Louaye Bouaziz, Lokmane Chebouba

entry.summary: Studies feature-level site leakage in cross-hospital chest X-ray transfer and demonstrates that multi-site self-supervised learning with adversarial site confusion reduces acquisition site information in learned features.

entry.title: WHBench: Evaluating Frontier LLMs with Expert-in-the-Loop Validation on Women's Health Topics

author.name: Sneha Maurya, Pragya Saboo, Girish Kumar

entry.summary: Presents WHBench, a women's health benchmark with 47 expert-crafted scenarios evaluating 22 models on clinical accuracy, safety, and equity across 10 health topics. No model achieves fully safe and accurate responses across all scenarios.

entry.title: GRASP: Gradient Realignment via Active Shared Perception for Multi-Agent Collaborative Optimization

author.name: Sihan Zhou, Tiantian He, Yifan Lu, Yaqing Hou, Yew-Soon Ong

entry.summary: Proposes GRASP for multi-agent reinforcement learning that addresses non-stationarity through active shared perception and gradient realignment, defining generalized Bellman equilibrium as a stable optimization target.

entry.title: TF-SSD: A Strong Pipeline via Synergic Mask Filter for Training-free Co-salient Object Detection

author.name: Zhijin He, Shuo Jin, Siyue Yu, Shuwei Wu, Bingfeng Zhang, Li Yu, Jimin Xiao

entry.summary: TF-SSD is a training-free co-salient object detection method leveraging SAM and DINO foundation models. Uses SAM for candidate mask proposals and DINO for co-saliency reasoning without any task-specific training.

entry.title: Shape Representation using Gaussian Process mixture models

author.name: Panagiotis Sapoutzoglou, George Terzakis, Georgios Floros, Maria Pateraki

entry.summary: Proposes using Gaussian Process mixture models as lightweight, continuous functional shape representations, avoiding heavy neural architectures. Learns directional distance fields from sparse point clouds using GP priors at strategic reference points.

entry.title: Logarithmic Scores, Power-Law Discoveries: Disentangling Measurement from Coverage in Agent-Based Evaluation

author.name: HyunJoon Jung, William Na

entry.summary: Studies LLM-based agent judges for conversational AI evaluation, finding that quality scores improve logarithmically with panel size while unique issue discoveries follow a sublinear power law. Provides practical guidance on panel sizing for evaluation.

entry.title: PsychAgent: An Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning Agent for Self-Evolving Psychological Counselor

author.name: Yutao Yang, Junsong Li, Qianjun Pan, Jie Zhou, Kai Chen, Qin Chen, Jingyuan Zhao, Ningning Zhou, Xin Li, Liang He

entry.summary: Proposes PsychAgent, a lifelong learning agent for psychological counseling with memory-augmented planning for multi-session continuity and a skill evolution engine that extracts practice-grounded skills from historical trajectories.

entry.title: A Study on the Impact of Fault localization Granularity for Repository-Scale Code Repair Tasks

author.name: Joseph Townsend, Chandresh Pravin, Kwun Ho Ngan, Matthieu Parizy

entry.summary: Studies the impact of fault localization granularity on repository-scale code repair, testing different granularity levels under perfect localization to isolate this factor from localization accuracy.

entry.title: Agentic AI and Occupational Displacement: A Multi-Regional Task Exposure Analysis of Emerging Labor Market Disruption

author.name: Ravish Gupta, Saket Kumar

entry.summary: Extends the Acemoglu-Restrepo task exposure framework to model labor market displacement from agentic AI systems that complete entire workflows rather than discrete tasks. Introduces the Agentic Task Exposure (ATE) score computed from O*NET data. Timely policy-relevant work but largely an extension of existing economic frameworks.

entry.title: VeriAct: Beyond Verifiability -- Agentic Synthesis of Correct and Complete Formal Specifications

author.name: Md Rakib Hossain Misu, Iris Ma, Cristina V. Lopes

entry.summary: Proposes VeriAct, an agentic system for synthesizing formal JML specifications that are both correct and complete, questioning whether passing a verifier actually means specifications are adequate.

entry.title: First Logit Boosting: Visual Grounding Method to Mitigate Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jiwoo Ha, Jongwoo Baek, Jinhyun So

entry.summary: Proposes First Logit Boosting to mitigate object hallucination in large vision-language models by maintaining visual grounding throughout generation, addressing the long-term decay problem of contrastive decoding.

entry.title: AutoEG: Exploiting Known Third-Party Vulnerabilities in Black-Box Web Applications

author.name: Ruozhao Yang, Mingfei Cheng, Gelei Deng, Junjie Wang, Tianwei Zhang, Xiaofei Xie

entry.summary: Introduces AutoEG for automatically generating exploits against known third-party vulnerabilities in black-box web applications, addressing the gap between known CVEs and practical exploitability.

entry.title: OrgAgent: Organize Your Multi-Agent System like a Company

author.name: Yiru Wang, Xinyue Shen, Yaohui Han, Michael Backes, Pin-Yu Chen, Tsung-Yi Ho

entry.summary: Introduces OrgAgent, a company-style hierarchical multi-agent framework with governance, execution, and compliance layers. Evaluates across reasoning tasks showing hierarchical organization outperforms flat structures.

entry.title: PASM: Population Adaptive Symbolic Mixture-of-Experts Model for Cross-location Hurricane Evacuation Decision Prediction

author.name: Xiao Qian, Shangjia Dong

entry.summary: Proposes PASM, combining LLM-guided symbolic regression with mixture-of-experts for cross-location hurricane evacuation prediction. Discovers interpretable decision rules that specialize to different populations.

entry.title: Is One Token All It Takes? Graph Pooling Tokens for LLM-based GraphQA

author.name: Ankit Grover, Lodovico Giaretta, R\'emi Bourgerie, Sarunas Girdzijauskas

entry.summary: Investigates multi-token graph pooling and enhanced graph encoders to address the information bottleneck when encoding graphs into LLM latent spaces for Graph Question Answering.

entry.title: Gradient-Based Data Valuation Improves Curriculum Learning for Game-Theoretic Motion Planning

author.name: Shihao Li, Jiachen Li, Dongmei Chen

entry.summary: Applies TracIn gradient-based data valuation to create curriculum orderings for training game-theoretic motion planners, significantly outperforming metadata-based heuristics on the nuPlan benchmark.

entry.title: Full-Gradient Successor Feature Representations

author.name: Ritish Shrirao, Aditya Priyadarshi, Raghuram Bharadwaj Diddigi

entry.summary: Proposes FG-SFRQL, a full-gradient approach to successor feature learning that addresses convergence issues of semi-gradient TD methods with non-linear function approximation in multi-task RL.

entry.title: Using predefined vector systems to speed up neural network multimillion class classification

author.name: Nikita Gabdullin, Ilya Androsov

entry.summary: Shows that neural network classification complexity can be reduced from O(n) to O(1) when latent space geometry is known and possesses specific properties, using predefined vector systems.

entry.title: Cost-Penalized Fitness in FMA-Orchestrated Mixture of Experts: Experimental Evidence for Molecular Memory in Domain Adaptation

author.name: Martin Jaraiz

entry.summary: Shows that cost-penalized fitness in FMA-orchestrated MoE transformers produces domain memory effects with 9-11x faster recovery when returning to previously learned domains, through expert diversification rather than replacement.

entry.title: Event Embedding of Protein Networks : Compositional Learning of Biological Function

author.name: Antonin Sulc

entry.summary: Shows that compositional structure (Event2Vec) in protein network embeddings yields 30.2x pathway coherence improvement over DeepWalk and 0.966 functional analogy accuracy, demonstrating meaningful geometric organization.

entry.title: Differentially Private Manifold Denoising

author.name: Jiaqi Wu, Yiqing Sun, Zhigang Yao

entry.summary: Introduces a differentially private framework for manifold denoising, allowing users to leverage sensitive reference datasets to correct noisy query points while maintaining (ε,δ)-DP guarantees. The method iteratively estimates local geometry privately and projects queries accordingly.

entry.title: Transformers for Program Termination

author.name: Yoav Alon, Cristina David

entry.summary: Investigates whether transformer architectures can recognize program termination patterns from source code. Designs an ensemble framework of compact transformer encoders with imbalance-aware training, outperforming LLMs and classical tools.

entry.title: Long-Document QA with Chain-of-Structured-Thought and Fine-Tuned SLMs

author.name: Zhuowen Liang, Xiaotian Lin, Zhengxuan Zhang, Yuyu Luo, Haixun Wang, Nan Tang

entry.summary: Proposes LiteCoST for long-document QA, using Chain-of-Structured-Thought to consolidate dispersed evidence into structured outputs (tables, graphs) for reliable QA with small language models.

entry.title: Enhancing Structural Mapping with LLM-derived Abstractions for Analogical Reasoning in Narratives

author.name: Mohammadhossein Khojasteh, Yifan Jiang, Stefano De Giorgis, Frank van Harmelen, Filip Ilievski

entry.summary: Proposes YARN, a modular framework combining LLMs with structural mapping for analogical reasoning in narratives. Uses LLMs to decompose narratives into units, abstract them, and then apply structural mapping for analogy identification.

entry.title: Covertly improving intelligibility with data-driven adaptations of speech timing

author.name: Paige Tutt\"os\'i, Angelica Lim, H. Henny Yeung, Yue Wang, Jean-Julien Aucouturier

entry.summary: Uses machine-generated speech with precise rate control to investigate how targeted speech-rate adjustments improve comprehension. Discovers a 'scissor-like' pattern where speech rate before target vowel contrasts has opposite effects in early vs. late context windows.

entry.title: Advancing LLM-based phoneme-to-grapheme for multilingual speech recognition

author.name: Lukuang Dong, Ziwei Li, Saierdaer Yusuyin, Xianyu Zhao, Zhijian Ou

entry.summary: Studies multilingual LLM-based phoneme-to-grapheme conversion for ASR on a ten-language benchmark. Proposes robustness strategies including Simplified SKM that avoids CTC-based probability weighting, reducing average WER from 10.56% to 7.12%.

entry.title: Label-efficient underwater species classification with semi-supervised learning on frozen foundation model embeddings

author.name: Thomas Manuel Rost

entry.summary: Investigates semi-supervised methods on frozen foundation model embeddings for underwater species classification, showing that with <5% labels, self-training on frozen DINOv3 embeddings closes much of the gap to fully supervised baselines.

entry.title: VADMamba++: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection via Hybrid Modeling in Grayscale Space

author.name: Jihao Lyu, Minghua Zhao, Jing Hu, Yifei Chen, Shuangli Du, Cheng Shi

entry.summary: Introduces VADMamba++, an efficient video anomaly detection method using a Gray-to-RGB paradigm that infers color from grayscale structure, eliminating dependence on optical flow auxiliary input while revealing anomalies through structure-chromatic inconsistencies.

entry.title: RegFormer: Transferable Relational Grounding for Efficient Weakly-Supervised Human-Object Interaction Detection

author.name: Jihwan Park, Chanhyeong Yang, Jinyoung Park, Taehoon Song, Hyunwoo J. Kim

entry.summary: RegFormer introduces a Relational Grounding Transformer for weakly-supervised Human-Object Interaction detection that avoids expensive pairwise enumeration. It uses transferable relational grounding to reduce false positives from non-interactive combinations while scaling more efficiently.

entry.title: HarassGuard: Detecting Harassment Behaviors in Social Virtual Reality with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Junhee Lee, Minseok Kim, Hwanjo Heo, Seungwon Woo, Jinwoo Kim

entry.summary: HarassGuard detects physical harassment in social VR using vision-language models with only visual input, avoiding biometric data privacy concerns. Constructs an IRB-approved dataset and fine-tunes VLMs for harassment detection.

entry.title: TP-Seg: Task-Prototype Framework for Unified Medical Lesion Segmentation

author.name: Jiawei Xu, Qiangqiang Zhou, Dandan Zhu, Yong Chen, Yugen Yi, Xiaoqi Zhao

entry.summary: TP-Seg proposes a task-prototype framework for unified medical lesion segmentation across diverse modalities and lesion types. Uses task-conditioned adapters with dual-path expert structure to balance shared and task-specific representations.

entry.title: Perturb-and-Restore: Simulation-driven Structural Augmentation Framework for Imbalance Chromosomal Anomaly Detection

author.name: Yilan Zhang, Hanbiao Chen, Changchun Yang, Yuetan Chu, Siyuan Chen, Jing Wu, Jingdong Hu, Na Li, Junkai Su, Yuxuan Chen, Ao Xu, Xin Gao, Aihua Yin

entry.summary: Perturb-and-Restore (P&R) simulates structural chromosomal abnormalities to address extreme data imbalance in anomaly detection. Creates synthetic abnormalities through structure perturbation and restoration simulation.

entry.title: Benchmarking and Mechanistic Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Cross-Depiction Assembly Instruction Alignment

author.name: Zhuchenyang Liu, Yao Zhang, Yu Xiao

entry.summary: IKEA-Bench evaluates 19 VLMs (2B-38B) on cross-depiction assembly instruction alignment, revealing that assembly understanding remains challenging with a large depiction gap between diagrams and video frames.

entry.title: Pupil Design for Computational Wavefront Estimation

author.name: Ali Almuallem, Nicholas Chimitt, Bole Ma, Qi Guo, Stanley H. Chan

entry.summary: Introduces a quantitative asymmetry metric for pupil design in computational wavefront estimation, demonstrating that increasing asymmetry enhances wavefront recoverability from single intensity measurements.

entry.title: LiPS: Lightweight Panoptic Segmentation for Resource-Constrained Robotics

author.name: Calvin Galagain, Martyna Poreba, Fran\c{c}ois Goulette, Cyrill Stachniss

entry.summary: LiPS proposes a lightweight panoptic segmentation architecture for resource-constrained robots, maintaining query-based decoding while streamlining feature extraction to reduce computational demands.

entry.title: G-ICSO-NAS: Shifting Gears between Gradient and Swarm for Robust Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Xingbang Du, Enzhi Zhang, Rui Zhong, Yang Cao, Masaharu Munetomo

entry.summary: G-ICSO-NAS combines gradient-based and evolutionary algorithm approaches for neural architecture search via a three-stage optimization strategy, bridging DARTS-style efficiency with EA search quality.

entry.title: DreamControl-v2: Simpler and Scalable Autonomous Humanoid Skills via Trainable Guided Diffusion Priors

author.name: Sudarshan Harithas, Sangkyung Kwak, Pushkal Katara, Srujan Deolasee, Dvij Kalaria, Srinath Sridhar, Sai Vemprala, Ashish Kapoor, Jonathan Chung-Kuan Huang

entry.summary: Improves DreamControl by training a guided diffusion model directly in the humanoid robot's motion space, unifying human and robot datasets. Enables more scalable autonomous loco-manipulation skills for humanoid robots by combining diffusion priors with RL policies.

entry.title: Implicit Primal-Dual Interior-Point Methods for Quadratic Programming

author.name: Jon Arrizabalaga, Zachary Manchester

entry.summary: Introduces implicit primal-dual interior-point methods for quadratic programming that ensure complementarity by construction via an auxiliary variable and retraction map. Proves the softplus function has favorable numerical properties, eliminating ill-conditioning near solutions.

entry.title: Tucker Diffusion Model for High-dimensional Tensor Generation

author.name: Jianhua Guo, Xinbing Kong, Zeyu Li, Junfan Mao

entry.summary: Proposes Tucker Diffusion Model for generating high-dimensional tensor data with low Tucker rank structure. Shows that the score function admits structured decomposition under low-rank assumptions, enabling efficient learning.

entry.title: Open, Reliable, and Collective: A Community-Driven Framework for Tool-Using AI Agents

author.name: Hy Dang, Quang Dao, Meng Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces OpenTools, a community-driven toolbox that standardizes tool schemas and evaluates both tool-use accuracy and intrinsic tool accuracy for LLM agents. Includes automated test suites, continuous monitoring, and a public web demo.

entry.title: The Silicon Mirror: Dynamic Behavioral Gating for Anti-Sycophancy in LLM Agents

author.name: Harshee Jignesh Shah (Independent Researcher)

entry.summary: Presents 'The Silicon Mirror,' a framework to combat LLM sycophancy through behavioral access control, trait classification of persuasion tactics, and a generator-critic loop that vetoes sycophantic drafts. Evaluated on TruthfulQA adversarial scenarios.

entry.title: Making Sense of AI Agents Hype: Adoption, Architectures, and Takeaways from Practitioners

author.name: Ruoyu Su, Matteo Esposito, Roberta Capuano, Rafiullah Omar, June Sallou, Henry Muccini, Davide Taibi

entry.summary: Reviews 138 practitioner conference talks on AI agents to understand real-world adoption patterns, architectural strategies, and implementation technologies for LLM-driven agentic systems. Provides a useful industry snapshot but is descriptive rather than proposing new methods.

entry.title: Benchmarking Interaction, Beyond Policy: a Reproducible Benchmark for Collaborative Instance Object Navigation

author.name: Edoardo Zorzi, Francesco Taioli, Yiming Wang, Marco Cristani, Alessandro Farinelli, Alberto Castellini, Loris Bazzani

entry.summary: Proposes QAsk-Nav, a benchmark for collaborative object navigation that separately evaluates navigation ability and collaborative question-asking in ambiguous scenarios with visually similar objects.

entry.title: MAESIL: Masked Autoencoder for Enhanced Self-supervised Medical Image Learning

author.name: Kyeonghun Kim, Hyeonseok Jung, Youngung Han, Junsu Lim, YeonJu Jean, Seongbin Park, Eunseob Choi, Hyunsu Go, SeoYoung Ju, Seohyoung Park, Gyeongmin Kim, MinJu Kwon, KyungSeok Yuh, Soo Yong Kim, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Nam-Joon Kim, Hyuk-Jae Lee

entry.summary: Proposes MAESIL, a masked autoencoder for self-supervised 3D medical image learning that exploits the inherent 3D structure of CT scans rather than treating them as independent 2D slices.

entry.title: Flow-based Policy With Distributional Reinforcement Learning in Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Ruijie Hao, Longfei Zhang, Yang Dai, Yang Ma, Xingxing Liang, Guangquan Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes FP-DRL combining flow-based policy modeling with distributional RL for trajectory optimization, enabling capture of multimodal action distributions and return distributions.

entry.title: Approximating Pareto Frontiers in Stochastic Multi-Objective Optimization via Hashing and Randomization

author.name: Jinzhao Li, Nan Jiang, Yexiang Xue

entry.summary: Introduces XOR-SMOO, an algorithm for approximating Pareto frontiers in stochastic multi-objective optimization using hashing and randomization, providing probabilistic guarantees on approximation quality.

entry.title: SYNTHONY: A Stress-Aware, Intent-Conditioned Agent for Deep Tabular Generative Models Selection

author.name: Hochan Son, Xiaofeng Lin, Jason Ni, Guang Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes SYNTHONY, a stress-aware agent for selecting deep tabular generative models based on dataset characteristics and user intent, addressing the problem that no single synthesizer works best across all datasets.

entry.title: GUIDE: Reinforcement Learning for Behavioral Action Support in Type 1 Diabetes

author.name: Saman Khamesian, Sri Harini Balaji, Di Yang Shi, Stephanie M. Carpenter, Daniel E. Rivera, W. Bradley Knox, Peter Stone, Hassan Ghasemzadeh

entry.summary: Proposes GUIDE, an RL-based decision-support framework for Type 1 Diabetes management that provides behavioral recommendations (not just insulin) to complement automated insulin delivery systems.

entry.title: Convergence of Byzantine-Resilient Gradient Tracking via Probabilistic Edge Dropout

author.name: Amirhossein Dezhboro, Fateme Maleki, Arman Adibi, Erfan Amini, Jose E. Ramirez-Marquez

entry.summary: Proposes GT-PD for Byzantine-resilient distributed optimization, combining self-centered projection clipping with probabilistic edge dropout guided by dual-metric trust scores.

entry.title: MIRANDA: MId-feature RANk-adversarial Domain Adaptation toward climate change-robust ecological forecasting with deep learning

author.name: Yuchang Jiang, Jan Dirk Wegner, Vivien Sainte Fare Garnot

entry.summary: Proposes MIRANDA, a domain adaptation method for ecological forecasting under climate change, using mid-feature rank-adversarial adaptation to handle the temporal continuum of domain shifts.

entry.title: Multi-lingual Multi-institutional Electronic Health Record based Predictive Model

author.name: Kyunghoon Hur, Heeyoung Kwak, Jinsu Jang, Nakhwan Kim, Edward Choi

entry.summary: Investigates multilingual multi-institutional EHR prediction by converting raw medical records into unified textual form, addressing language heterogeneity as a barrier to scalable cross-institutional learning without explicit data standardization.

entry.title: MambaVoiceCloning: Efficient and Expressive Text-to-Speech via State-Space Modeling and Diffusion Control

author.name: Sahil Kumar, Namrataben Patel, Honggang Wang, Youshan Zhang

entry.summary: Presents MambaVoiceCloning, a fully SSM-based (no attention at inference) TTS system achieving linear-time conditioning with bounded memory, removing all attention and RNN layers while preserving quality under controlled conditions.

entry.title: Accurate and Scalable Matrix Mechanisms via Divide and Conquer

author.name: Guanlin He, Yingtai Xiao, Jiamu Bai, Xin Gu, Zeyu Ding, Wenpeng Yin, Daniel Kifer

entry.summary: Presents QuerySmasher, a divide-and-conquer approach for scalable differentially private query answering that splits queries into sub-queries assigned to data marginals, achieving better accuracy than existing matrix mechanisms.

entry.title: Learning and Generating Mixed States Prepared by Shallow Channel Circuits

author.name: Fangjun Hu, Christian Kokail, Milan Kornja\v{c}a, Pedro L. S. Lopes, Weiyuan Gong, Sheng-Tao Wang, Xun Gao, Stefan Ostermann

entry.summary: Studies learning and generating mixed quantum states prepared by shallow channel circuits. Proves that mixed states in the trivial phase can be efficiently learned from measurement access, with the algorithm outputting an approximate preparation circuit.

entry.title: APEX-EM: Non-Parametric Online Learning for Autonomous Agents via Structured Procedural-Episodic Experience Replay

author.name: Pratyay Banerjee, Masud Moshtaghi, Ankit Chadha

entry.summary: Presents APEX-EM, a non-parametric online learning framework for LLM-based agents that accumulates and reuses structured procedural plans without modifying model weights, introducing procedural-episodic experience replay.

entry.title: LLM Probe: Evaluating LLMs for Low-Resource Languages

author.name: Hailay Kidu Teklehaymanot, Gebrearegawi Gebremariam, Wolfgang Nejdl

entry.summary: Presents LLM Probe, a lexicon-based framework for evaluating LLMs in low-resource, morphologically rich languages across lexical alignment, POS recognition, morphosyntactic probing, and translation accuracy. Demonstrates the framework using a manually annotated benchmark for a Semitic language.

entry.title: Spark-LLM-Eval: A Distributed Framework for Statistically Rigorous Large Language Model Evaluation

author.name: Subhadip Mitra

entry.summary: Presents Spark-LLM-Eval, a distributed LLM evaluation framework built on Apache Spark for scaling to millions of evaluation samples. Includes proper statistical rigor with bootstrap confidence intervals and model comparison tests.

entry.title: PRISM: PRIor from corpus Statistics for topic Modeling

author.name: Tal Ishon, Yoav Goldberg, Uri Shaham

entry.summary: Introduces PRISM, a corpus-intrinsic method that derives Dirichlet parameters from word co-occurrence statistics to initialize LDA without external knowledge. Shows improvements in topic coherence on both text and single-cell RNA-seq data.

entry.title: PRISM: Differentiable Analysis-by-Synthesis for Fixel Recovery in Diffusion MRI

author.name: Mohamed Abouagour, Atharva Shah, Eleftherios Garyfallidis

entry.summary: Introduces PRISM (different from topic modeling paper), a differentiable analysis-by-synthesis framework for diffusion MRI fiber peak recovery that fits multi-compartment forward models end-to-end over spatial patches.

entry.title: AceTone: Bridging Words and Colors for Conditional Image Grading

author.name: Tianren Ma, Mingxiang Liao, Xijin Zhang, Qixiang Ye

entry.summary: AceTone enables multimodal-conditioned color grading via 3D-LUT generation from text prompts or reference images. Uses a VQ-VAE tokenizer to compress LUTs and builds an 800K-sample dataset for training a vision-language model for color transformation.

entry.title: TALENT: Target-aware Efficient Tuning for Referring Image Segmentation

author.name: Shuo Jin, Siyue Yu, Bingfeng Zhang, Chao Yao, Meiqin Liu, Jimin Xiao

entry.summary: TALENT addresses 'non-target activation' in referring image segmentation where visual features activate co-category but unrelated objects. Proposes target-aware efficient tuning with rectified cost aggregation for parameter-efficient tuning.

entry.title: PrivHAR-Bench: A Graduated Privacy Benchmark Dataset for Video-Based Action Recognition

author.name: Samar Ansari

entry.summary: PrivHAR-Bench introduces a graduated privacy benchmark for video-based action recognition with a spectrum of visual privacy transformations from lightweight obfuscation to cryptographic permutation, enabling standardized privacy-utility tradeoff evaluation.

entry.title: Multicentric thrombus segmentation using an attention-based recurrent network with gradual modality dropout

author.name: Sofia Vargas-Ibarra, Vincent Vigneron, Hichem Maaref, Sonia Garcia-Salicetti

entry.summary: Proposes an attention-based recurrent network (UpAttLLSTM) with gradual modality dropout for multi-center thrombus segmentation in brain scans, addressing domain shifts and missing MR sequences in ischemic stroke imaging.

entry.title: JAMMEval: A Refined Collection of Japanese Benchmarks for Reliable VLM Evaluation

author.name: Issa Sugiura, Koki Maeda, Shuhei Kurita, Yusuke Oda, Daisuke Kawahara, Naoaki Okazaki
