entry.summary: JAMMEval is a refined collection of Japanese VLM benchmarks addressing issues like ambiguous questions and incorrect answers in existing datasets. Uses two rounds of human annotation to improve evaluation reliability across seven benchmark datasets.

entry.title: EmoScene: A Dual-space Dataset for Controllable Affective Image Generation

author.name: Li He, Longtai Zhang, Wenqiang Zhang, Yan Wang, Lizhe Qi

entry.summary: EmoScene constructs a large-scale dual-space emotion dataset jointly encoding affective dimensions (valence, arousal, dominance) with perceptual attributes (color, texture, layout) for controllable affective image generation.

entry.title: ProTPS: Prototype-Guided Text Prompt Selection for Continual Learning

author.name: Jie Mei, Li-Leng Peng, Keith Fuller, Jenq-Neng Hwang

entry.summary: ProTPS uses prototype-guided text prompt selection for continual learning, learning class-specific vision prototypes to encourage unique text prompts that prevent semantic overlap between old and new classes.

entry.title: A Dual-Stream Transformer Architecture for Illumination-Invariant TIR-LiDAR Person Tracking

author.name: Yuki Minase, Kanji Tanaka

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-stream transformer for person tracking using thermal infrared and LiDAR depth (TIR-D), achieving illumination-invariant tracking. Uses sequential knowledge transfer to address scarce multi-modal training data.

entry.title: A Hierarchical Importance-Guided Multi-objective Evolutionary Framework for Deep Neural Network Pruning

author.name: Zak Khan, Azam Asilian Bidgoli

entry.summary: Proposes hierarchical importance-guided multi-objective evolutionary framework for DNN pruning, reformulating it as a tractable large-scale optimization problem with coarse-to-fine search across weight and filter granularities.

entry.title: Advancing Multi-Robot Networks via MLLM-Driven Sensing, Communication, and Computation: A Comprehensive Survey

author.name: Hyun Jong Yang, Howon Lee, Kyuhong Shim, Jeongho Kwak, Hyunsoo Kim, Donghoon Kim, Khoa Anh Ngo, Sehyun Ryu, Jaehyun Choi, Youbin Kim, Chanjun Moon, Michael Ryoo, Byonghyo Shim

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on using multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to advance multi-robot networks across sensing, communication, and computation. Covers how MLLM-driven intent understanding can optimize resource allocation in coordinated multi-agent robotic systems.

entry.title: A Physical Imitation Learning Pipeline for Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion Assisted by Parallel Elastic Joint

author.name: Huyue Ma, Yurui Jin, Helmut Hauser, Rui Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Physical Imitation Learning (PIL) that distills RL control policies into passive Parallel Elastic Joints for energy-efficient quadruped locomotion. Demonstrates that body dynamics can share control effort with active control, embodying physical intelligence principles.

entry.title: BAT: Balancing Agility and Stability via Online Policy Switching for Long-Horizon Whole-Body Humanoid Control

author.name: Donghoon Baek, Sang-Hun Kim, Sehoon Ha

entry.summary: Proposes BAT, an online policy-switching framework for humanoid robots that dynamically selects between coupled and decoupled whole-body RL controllers to balance agility and stability in long-horizon tasks.

entry.title: A Generalized Matrix Inverse that is Consistent with Respect to Diagonal Transformations

author.name: Jeffrey Uhlmann

entry.summary: Derives a new generalized matrix inverse that preserves units under diagonal transformations, solving a longstanding open problem in robotics, tracking, and control. Complements the Drazin and Moore-Penrose inverses.

entry.title: BloClaw: An Omniscient, Multi-Modal Agentic Workspace for Next-Generation Scientific Discovery

author.name: Yao Qin, Yangyang Yan, Jinhua Pang, Xiaoming Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces BloClaw, a multi-modal operating system for AI-driven scientific research with XML-Regex dual-channel parsing, reconstructing the Agent-Computer Interaction paradigm for scientific workflows.

entry.title: Benchmark for Assessing Olfactory Perception of Large Language Models

author.name: Eftychia Makri, Nikolaos Nakis, Laura Sisson, Gigi Minsky, Leandros Tassiulas, Vahid Satarifard, Nicholas A. Christakis

entry.summary: Introduces the Olfactory Perception benchmark with 1,010 questions across eight olfactory task categories to assess LLMs' reasoning about smell. Tests 21 model configurations and finds compound-name prompts outperform SMILES representations.

entry.title: MSA-Thinker: Discrimination-Calibration Reasoning with Hint-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Miaosen Luo, Zhenhao Yang, Jieshen Long, Jinghu Sun, Yichu Liu, Sijie Mai

entry.summary: Proposes MSA-Thinker for multimodal sentiment analysis, integrating structured discrimination-calibration reasoning with hint-based reinforcement learning to improve interpretability and performance on hard samples.

entry.title: The Energy Footprint of LLM-Based Environmental Analysis: LLMs and Domain Products

author.name: Alicia Bao (James), Jiamian He (James), Angel Hsu (James), Diego Manya (James), Ji (James), Zhang

entry.summary: Assesses energy consumption of LLM-based climate analysis chatbots compared to direct LLM usage, examining whether RAG workflows have different energy footprints than generic LLM calls.

entry.title: LLM Essay Scoring Under Holistic and Analytic Rubrics: Prompt Effects and Bias

author.name: Filip J. Kucia, Anirban Chakraborty, Anna Wr\'oblewska

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates LLMs for essay scoring across holistic and analytic rubrics, finding moderate agreement with humans on holistic scoring (QWK ~0.6) but large negative bias on lower-order concerns. Important for understanding LLM limitations in educational assessment.

entry.title: Prompt-Guided Prefiltering for VLM Image Compression

author.name: Bardia Azizian, Ivan V. Bajic

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight prompt-guided prefiltering module for VLM image compression that identifies task-relevant regions based on text prompts, reducing bandwidth for cloud-hosted VLM queries.

entry.title: Procela: Epistemic Governance in Mechanistic Simulations Under Structural Uncertainty

author.name: Kinson Vernet

entry.summary: Introduces Procela, a simulation framework where variables act as epistemic authorities and the simulation can test its own causal assumptions at runtime, applied to antimicrobial resistance modeling.

entry.title: Emotion Entanglement and Bayesian Inference for Multi-Dimensional Emotion Understanding

author.name: Hemanth Kotaprolu, Kishan Maharaj, Raey Zhao, Abhijit Mishra, Pushpak Bhattacharyya

entry.summary: Introduces EmoScene, a theory-grounded benchmark of 4,731 context-rich scenarios with 8-dimensional emotion vectors based on Plutchik's theory. Proposes Bayesian inference for modeling emotion entanglement.

entry.title: Aligning Recommendations with User Popularity Preferences

author.name: Mona Schirmer, Anton Thielmann, Pola Schw\"obel, Thomas Martynec, Giuseppe Di Benedetto, Ben London, Yannik Stein

entry.summary: Introduces Popularity Quantile Calibration to measure misalignment between user popularity preferences and recommendations, plus SPREE, an inference-time method to mitigate popularity bias in sequential recommender systems.

entry.title: Lightweight Prompt-Guided CLIP Adaptation for Monocular Depth Estimation

author.name: Reyhaneh Ahani Manghotay (Simon Fraser University, Burnaby, Canada), Jie Liang (Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo, China)

entry.summary: Presents MoA-DepthCLIP, a parameter-efficient framework adapting pretrained CLIP for monocular depth estimation using a Mixture-of-Adapters module with minimal supervision.

entry.title: Autonomous Adaptive Solver Selection for Chemistry Integration via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Eloghosa Ikponmwoba, Opeoluwa Owoyele

entry.summary: Introduces a constrained RL framework for autonomously selecting between implicit BDF and quasi-steady-state solvers during chemical kinetics integration, learning trajectory-aware policies under accuracy constraints.

entry.title: Phase space integrity in neural network models of Hamiltonian dynamics: A Lagrangian descriptor approach

author.name: Abrari Noor Hasmi, Haralampos Hatzikirou, Hadi Susanto

entry.summary: Proposes Lagrangian Descriptors as a diagnostic framework for evaluating neural network models of Hamiltonian systems, embedding geometric phase-space information into statistical comparison metrics.

entry.title: Learning Shared Representations for Multi-Task Linear Bandits

author.name: Jiabin Lin, Shana Moothedath

entry.summary: Proposes an OFUL algorithm for multi-task linear bandits that leverages shared low-rank representations, improving sample efficiency when tasks share a common latent structure.

entry.title: Representation choice shapes the interpretation of protein conformational dynamics

author.name: Axel Giottonini, Thomas Lemmin

entry.summary: Demonstrates that representation choice fundamentally shapes the interpretation of protein conformational dynamics from MD simulations. Introduces Orientation features as a rotation-aware backbone encoding.

entry.title: Performance of Neural and Polynomial Operator Surrogates

author.name: Josephine Westermann, Benno Huber, Thomas O'Leary-Roseberry, Jakob Zech

entry.summary: Systematically compares neural operator surrogates (reduced-basis, Fourier neural operator) against polynomial surrogates (sparse-grid, tensor-train) for parametric PDE solution maps.

entry.title: EmbedPart: Embedding-Driven Graph Partitioning for Scalable Graph Neural Network Training

author.name: Nikolai Merkel, Ruben Mayer, Volker Markl, Hans-Arno Jacobsen

entry.summary: Proposes EmbedPart, a graph partitioning approach for scalable GNN training that uses node embeddings from the actual training workload to cluster nodes, achieving both speed and quality in distributed training. Addresses the trade-off between partitioning overhead and quality.

entry.title: Shapley-Guided Neural Repair Approach via Derivative-Free Optimization

author.name: Xinyu Sun, Wanwei Liu, Haoang Chi, Tingyu Chen, Xiaoguang Mao, Shangwen Wang, Lei Bu, Jingyi Wang, Yang Tan, Zhenyi Qi

entry.summary: Proposes SHARPEN, a neural network repair method combining Deep SHAP-based fault localization with derivative-free optimization, applicable across multiple failure types including backdoors, adversarial attacks, and unfairness.

entry.title: A Benchmark of State-Space Models vs. Transformers and BiLSTM-based Models for Historical Newspaper OCR

author.name: Merveilles Agbeti-messan, Thierry Paquet, Cl\'ement Chatelain, Pierrick Tranouez, St\'ephane Nicolas

entry.summary: Benchmarks State-Space Models (Mamba) against Transformers and BiLSTM for historical newspaper OCR, presenting the first SSM-based OCR architecture. Shows SSMs offer a scalable alternative for long-sequence text recognition.

entry.title: ProOOD: Prototype-Guided Out-of-Distribution 3D Occupancy Prediction

author.name: Yuheng Zhang, Mengfei Duan, Kunyu Peng, Yuhang Wang, Di Wen, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: Proposes ProOOD, a plug-and-play method for out-of-distribution detection in 3D occupancy prediction for autonomous driving, combining prototype-guided refinement with training-free OOD scoring to address long-tailed class bias.

entry.title: Inverse Design of Optical Multilayer Thin Films using Robust Masked Diffusion Models

author.name: Jonas Schaible, Asena Karolin \"Ozdemir, Charlotte Debus, Sven Burger, Achim Streit, Christiane Becker, Klaus J\"ager, Markus G\"otz

entry.summary: Introduces OptoLlama, a masked diffusion language model for inverse design of optical multilayer thin films from spectra. Represents film stacks as token sequences and achieves 2.9x error reduction over nearest-neighbor baselines.

entry.title: Safe learning-based control via function-based uncertainty quantification

author.name: Abdullah Tokmak, Toni Karvonen, Thomas B. Sch\"on, Dominik Baumann

entry.summary: Proposes function-based uncertainty quantification for safe learning-based control using scenario approach, constructing uncertainty tubes without restrictive assumptions on function smoothness or known bounds.

entry.title: Human-Like Lifelong Memory: A Neuroscience-Grounded Architecture for Infinite Interaction

author.name: Diego C. Lerma-Torres (Universidad de Guanajuato)

entry.summary: Proposes a bio-inspired memory framework for LLMs grounded in complementary learning systems theory, cognitive behavioral therapy, and dual-process cognition. Introduces valence vectors and belief hierarchies for persistent memory.

entry.title: FLEURS-Kobani: Extending the FLEURS Dataset for Northern Kurdish

author.name: Daban Q. Jaff, Mohammad Mohammadamini

entry.summary: Presents FLEURS-Kobani, a Northern Kurdish spoken extension of the FLEURS benchmark with 5,162 validated utterances (18+ hours) from 31 native speakers, along with ASR and speech translation baselines using fine-tuned Whisper.

entry.title: UCMNet: Uncertainty-Aware Context Memory Network for Under-Display Camera Image Restoration

author.name: Daehyun Kim, Youngmin Kim, Yoon Ju Oh, Tae Hyun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes UCMNet, a lightweight network for under-display camera image restoration that uses uncertainty-aware context memory to handle spatially varying degradation from display layers.

entry.title: KG-CMI: Knowledge graph enhanced cross-Mamba interaction for medical visual question answering

author.name: Xianyao Zheng, Hong Yu, Hui Cui, Changming Sun, Xiangyu Li, Ran Su, Leyi Wei, Jia Zhou, Junbo Wang, Qiangguo Jin

entry.summary: KG-CMI integrates medical knowledge graphs with a cross-Mamba interaction module for medical VQA, enabling free-form answer generation rather than classification-based approaches. Addresses limitations of prior methods in leveraging domain-specific knowledge.

entry.title: MoonAnything: A Vision Benchmark with Large-Scale Lunar Supervised Data

author.name: Cl\'ementine Grethen, Yuang Shi, Simone Gasparini, G\'eraldine Morin

entry.summary: MoonAnything provides a large-scale lunar surface benchmark with physically-based rendering, offering the first comprehensive geometric and photometric supervision under diverse illumination for lunar perception tasks.

entry.title: An Approach to Enriching Surgical Video Datasets for Fine-Grained Spatial-Temporal Understanding of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Lennart Maack, Alexander Schlaefer

entry.summary: SurgSTU-Pipeline generates surgical video datasets with fine-grained spatial-temporal annotations deterministically, featuring temporal and spatial continuity filtering to avoid errors from LLM-based annotation generation.

entry.title: Adversarial Attenuation Patch Attack for SAR Object Detection

author.name: Yiming Zhang, Weibo Qin, Feng Wang

entry.summary: Adversarial Attenuation Patch (AAP) proposes energy-constrained adversarial attacks on SAR object detectors with physical realizability through signal-level electromagnetic modeling.

entry.title: ProCap: Projection-Aware Captioning for Spatial Augmented Reality

author.name: Zimo Cao, Yuchen Deng, Haibin Ling, Bingyao Huang

entry.summary: ProCap introduces a framework for spatial augmented reality that distinguishes projected digital content from physical scenes. Uses automated segmentation and region-specific captioning to enable VLMs to reason about SAR scenes.

entry.title: Sub-metre Lunar DEM Generation and Validation from Chandrayaan-2 OHRC Multi-View Imagery Using Open-Source Photogrammetry

author.name: Aaranay Aadi, Jai Singla, Nitant Dube, Oleg Alexandrov

entry.summary: First generation of sub-metre digital elevation models from Chandrayaan-2 OHRC imagery using an exclusively open-source pipeline. Identifies stereo pairs from non-paired archives through geometric analysis.

entry.title: How to Train your Tactile Model: Tactile Perception with Multi-fingered Robot Hands

author.name: Christopher J. Ford, Kaichen Shi, Laura Butcher, Nathan F. Lepora, Efi Psomopoulou

entry.summary: Introduces TacViT, a Vision Transformer-based tactile perception model designed to generalize across different vision-based tactile sensors without sensor-specific retraining. Uses global self-attention to extract robust features from tactile images.

entry.title: Functional Force-Aware Retargeting from Virtual Human Demos to Soft Robot Policies

author.name: Uksang Yoo, Mengjia Zhu, Evan Pezent, Jom Preechayasomboon, Jean Oh, Jeffrey Ichnowski, Amir Memar, Ben Abbatematteo, Homanga Bharadhwaj, Ashish Deshpande, Harsha Prahlad

entry.summary: Introduces SoftAct, a framework for teaching soft robot hands manipulation skills via force-aware retargeting from VR human demonstrations. Uses a two-stage algorithm that reasons about contact forces rather than just joint trajectories.

entry.title: Hierarchical Apprenticeship Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations with Evolving Rewards

author.name: Md Mirajul Islam, Rajesh Debnath, Adittya Soukarjya Saha, Min Chi

entry.summary: Introduces HALIDE for apprenticeship learning from imperfect demonstrations with evolving rewards in e-learning environments. Argues that sub-optimal student demonstrations contain structured signals if their quality is ranked.

entry.title: COTTA: Context-Aware Transfer Adaptation for Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Seohyoung Park, Jaeyeol Lim, Seoyoung Ju, Kyeonghun Kim, Nam-Joon Kim, Hyuk-Jae Lee

entry.summary: Investigates domain transfer of trajectory prediction models (QCNet) from US to Korean road environments, proposing COTTA for context-aware transfer adaptation in autonomous driving.

entry.title: BioCOMPASS: Integrating Biomarkers into Transformer-Based Immunotherapy Response Prediction

author.name: Sayed Hashim, Frank Soboczenski, Paul Cairns

entry.summary: Proposes BioCOMPASS, extending a transformer-based immunotherapy response prediction model by integrating biomarkers as loss components rather than input features, improving cross-cohort generalizability.

entry.title: Reconsidering Dependency Networks from an Information Geometry Perspective

author.name: Kazuya Takabatake, Shotaro Akaho

entry.summary: Develops an information-geometric analysis of dependency networks, interpreting pseudo-Gibbs sampling steps as m-projections onto full conditional manifolds. Introduces a new divergence measure and provides theoretical foundations for these models.

entry.title: Improving Generalization of Deep Learning for Brain Metastases Segmentation Across Institutions

author.name: Yuchen Yang, Shuangyang Zhong, Haijun Yu, Langcuomu Suo, Hongbin Han, Florian Putz, Yixing Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a VAE-MMD preprocessing pipeline for brain metastases segmentation that enables domain adaptation across institutions, tested on 740 patients from four databases.

entry.title: A Safety-Aware Role-Orchestrated Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Behavioral Health Communication Simulation

author.name: Ha Na Cho

entry.summary: Proposes a safety-aware multi-agent LLM framework for behavioral health communication, decomposing conversational roles (empathy, action, supervision) with continuous safety auditing. Evaluated on the DAIC-WOZ corpus.

entry.title: Ontology-Constrained Neural Reasoning in Enterprise Agentic Systems: A Neurosymbolic Architecture for Domain-Grounded AI Agents

author.name: Thanh Luong Tuan

entry.summary: Presents a neurosymbolic architecture for enterprise AI agents that uses three-layer ontological constraints (Role, Domain, Interaction) to ground LLM reasoning, addressing hallucination and regulatory compliance.

entry.title: Beyond Symbolic Solving: Multi Chain-of-Thought Voting for Geometric Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Md. Abu Bakor Siddique, Shahrin Hossain, Sadman Ahmed Siam, Syed Rifat Raiyan, Hasan Mahmud, Md Kamrul Hasan

entry.summary: Proposes multi-chain-of-thought voting for geometric problem solving, addressing the limitation of single CoT reasoning by aggregating multiple reasoning paths for improved logical inference.

entry.title: How Trustworthy Are LLM-as-Judge Ratings for Interpretive Responses? Implications for Qualitative Research Workflows

author.name: Songhee Han, Jueun Shin, Jiyoon Han, Bung-Woo Jun, Hilal Ayan Karabatman

entry.summary: Examines whether LLM-as-judge evaluations align with human judgments for interpretive (qualitative) responses, testing across 712 conversational excerpts from K-12 math teacher interviews.

entry.title: The Chronicles of RiDiC: Generating Datasets with Controlled Popularity Distribution for Long-form Factuality Evaluation

author.name: Pavel Braslavski, Dmitrii Iarosh, Nikita Sushko, Andrey Sakhovskiy, Vasily Konovalov, Elena Tutubalina, Alexander Panchenko

entry.summary: Presents a configurable pipeline for generating multilingual entity datasets with controlled popularity distributions for evaluating LLM factuality, producing the RiDiC dataset with 3,000 entities across rivers, disasters, and car models.

entry.title: Perspective: Towards sustainable exploration of chemical spaces with machine learning

author.name: Leonardo Medrano Sandonas, David Balcells, Anton Bochkarev, Jacqueline M. Cole, Volker L. Deringer, Werner Dobrautz, Adrian Ehrenhofer, Thorben Frank, Pascal Friederich, Rico Friedrich, Janine George, Luca Ghiringhelli, Alejandra Hinostroza Caldas, Veronika Juraskova, Hannes Kneiding, Yury Lysogorskiy, Johannes T. Margraf, Hanna T\"urk, Anatole von Lilienfeld, Milica Todorovi\'c, Alexandre Tkatchenko, Mariana Rossi, Gianaurelio Cuniberti

entry.summary: Perspective piece examining sustainability challenges across the AI-driven molecular/materials discovery pipeline, from quantum-mechanical data generation through model training to automated research workflows.

entry.title: Brain MR Image Synthesis with Multi-contrast Self-attention GAN

author.name: Zaid A. Abod, Furqan Aziz

entry.summary: Proposes 3D-MC-SAGAN for synthesizing missing MRI modalities from a single T2 input, using a multi-scale 3D encoder-decoder with self-attention and residual connections to preserve tumor characteristics.

entry.title: Explainable AI for Blind and Low-Vision Users: Navigating Trust, Modality, and Interpretability in the Agentic Era

author.name: Abu Noman Md Sakib, Protik Dey, Zijie Zhang, Taslima Akter

entry.summary: Investigates explainable AI requirements for blind and low-vision users, particularly as AI shifts to autonomous multi-step agents where undetected errors can propagate. Based on user interviews and literature analysis. Important accessibility perspective but primarily a survey/position paper.

entry.title: SANA I2I: A Text Free Flow Matching Framework for Paired Image to Image Translation with a Case Study in Fetal MRI Artifact Reduction

author.name: Italo Felix Santos, Gilson Antonio Giraldi, Heron Werner Junior

entry.summary: Proposes SANA-I2I, a text-free image-to-image translation framework using flow matching, applied to fetal MRI artifact reduction. Removes textual conditioning entirely for paired image translation.

entry.title: Not My Truce: Personality Differences in AI-Mediated Workplace Negotiation

author.name: Veda Duddu, Jash Rajesh Parekh, Andy Mao, Hanyi Min, Ziang Xiao, Vedant Das Swain, Koustuv Saha

entry.summary: Studies how personality differences moderate AI-driven negotiation coaching outcomes, finding that resilient, overcontrolled, and undercontrolled personality profiles respond differently to theory-driven vs. general-purpose AI coaching.

entry.title: MOON3.0: Reasoning-aware Multimodal Representation Learning for E-commerce Product Understanding

author.name: Junxian Wu, Chenghan Fu, Zhanheng Nie, Daoze Zhang, Bowen Wan, Wanxian Guan, Chuan Yu, Jian Xu, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes MOON3.0 for e-commerce product understanding, using MLLMs' reasoning capabilities to explicitly model fine-grained product attributes rather than just using them as feature extractors.

entry.title: Representation Selection via Cross-Model Agreement using Canonical Correlation Analysis

author.name: Dylan B. Lewis, Jens Gregor, Hector Santos-Villalobos

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free method using canonical correlation analysis between two pretrained image encoders to find shared semantic dimensions for efficient representation selection.

entry.title: Trust and Reliance on AI in Education: AI Literacy and Need for Cognition as Moderators

author.name: Griffin Pitts, Neha Rani, Weedguet Mildort

entry.summary: Studies how student trust in AI and characteristics like AI literacy and need for cognition moderate appropriate reliance on AI assistants during programming tasks. Finds that AI literacy helps students evaluate AI output more critically.

entry.title: AdaLoRA-QAT: Adaptive Low-Rank and Quantization-Aware Segmentation

author.name: Prantik Deb, Srimanth Dhondy, N. Ramakrishna, Anu Kapoor, Raju S. Bapi, Tapabrata Chakraborti

entry.summary: Proposes AdaLoRA-QAT for efficient chest X-ray segmentation, combining adaptive low-rank encoder adaptation with quantization-aware training to achieve 95.6% Dice with 16.6x parameter reduction.

entry.title: LAtent Phase Inference from Short time sequences using SHallow REcurrent Decoders (LAPIS-SHRED)

author.name: Yuxuan Bao, Xingyue Zhang, J. Nathan Kutz

entry.summary: Introduces LAPIS-SHRED, a modular architecture for reconstructing full spatiotemporal dynamics from sparse sensor observations in short time windows, using a three-stage pipeline with shallow recurrent decoders.

entry.title: Informed Machine Learning with Knowledge Landmarks

author.name: Chuyi Dai, Witold Pedrycz, Suping Xu, Ding Liu, Xianmin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Knowledge-Data ML (KD-ML) integrating granular knowledge landmarks with numeric data, arguing that data and knowledge are complementary (data is local/precise, knowledge is global/abstract).

entry.title: When Career Data Runs Out: Structured Feature Engineering and Signal Limits for Founder Success Prediction

author.name: Yagiz Ihlamur

entry.summary: Shows that structured feature engineering from founder career data outperforms LLM-based feature extraction for startup success prediction, with LLM features capturing importance but adding zero cross-validation signal.

entry.title: A Decoupled Basis-Vector-Driven Generative Framework for Dynamic Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Yaoming Yang, Shuai Wang, Bingdong Li, Peng Yang, Ke Tang

entry.summary: Proposes DB-GEN, a decoupled basis-vector-driven generative framework for dynamic multi-objective optimization that separates evolutionary trajectories into low-frequency trends and high-frequency details using wavelet transforms.

entry.title: Model-Based Learning of Near-Optimal Finite-Window Policies in POMDPs

author.name: Philip Jordan, Maryam Kamgarpour

entry.summary: Studies model-based learning of finite-window policies in tabular POMDPs, providing sample-efficient estimation of the superstate MDP model despite mismatch between sampling process and target. Establishes theoretical guarantees for this approach.

entry.title: Finite-Time Analysis of Projected Two-Time-Scale Stochastic Approximation

author.name: Yitao Bai, Thinh T. Doan, Justin Romberg

entry.summary: Establishes finite-time convergence analysis for projected linear two-time-scale stochastic approximation with constant step sizes and Polyak-Ruppert averaging, decomposing error into approximation and statistical components.

entry.title: Internal State-Based Policy Gradient Methods for Partially Observable Markov Potential Games

author.name: Wonseok Yang, Thinh T. Doan

entry.summary: Studies multi-agent RL in partially observable Markov potential games using internal states that compress accumulated information. Establishes non-asymptotic convergence bounds for internal state-based natural policy gradient method.

entry.title: Scenario theory for multi-criteria data-driven decision making

author.name: Simone Garatti, Lucrezia Manieri, Alessandro Falsone, Algo Car\`e, Marco C. Campi, Maria Prandini

entry.summary: Extends scenario approach theory to multi-criteria data-driven decision making, enabling simultaneous consideration of multiple robustness criteria with multiple datasets. Provides probabilistic guarantees for multi-agent decision problems.

entry.title: Multi-Mode Quantum Annealing for Variational Autoencoders with General Boltzmann Priors

author.name: Gilhan Kim, Daniel K. Park

entry.summary: Presents Boltzmann-machine-prior VAEs trained using quantum annealing in three operational modes. Uses diabatic quantum annealing for training and quantum-classical hybrid sampling for inference.

entry.title: Rapid mixing in positively weighted restricted Boltzmann machines

author.name: Weiming Feng, Heng Guo, Minji Yang

entry.summary: Proves polylogarithmic mixing time bounds for alternating-scan samplers in positively weighted restricted Boltzmann machines, via analysis of ferromagnetic two-spin systems.

entry.title: Known Intents, New Combinations: Clause-Factorized Decoding for Compositional Multi-Intent Detection

author.name: Abhilash Nandy

entry.summary: Introduces CoMIX-Shift benchmark for compositional generalization in multi-intent detection, and ClauseCompose, a lightweight decoder trained on singleton intents. Tests whether models can handle new combinations of familiar intents.

entry.title: The Thiomi Dataset: A Large-Scale Multimodal Corpus for Low-Resource African Languages

author.name: Hillary Mutisya, John Mugane, Gavin Nyamboga, Brian Chege, Maryruth Gathoni

entry.summary: Presents the Thiomi Dataset with 601K+ text annotations and 385K+ audio recordings across ten African languages. Includes a community data collection platform and quality assurance pipeline.

entry.title: Can LLM Agents Identify Spoken Dialects like a Linguist?

author.name: Tobias Bystrich, Lukas Hamm, Maria Hassan, Lea Fischbach, Lucie Flek, Akbar Karimi

entry.summary: Explores using LLM agents with linguistic resources (dialect feature maps, vowel history, rules) for Swiss German dialect classification from phonetic transcriptions, comparing against HuBERT and human linguist baselines.

entry.title: Agenda-based Narrative Extraction: Steering Pathfinding Algorithms with Large Language Models

author.name: Brian Felipe Keith-Norambuena, Carolina In\'es Rojas-C\'ordova, Claudio Juvenal Meneses-Villegas, Elizabeth Johanna Lam-Esquenazi, Ang\'elica Mar\'ia Flores-Bustos, Ignacio Alejandro Molina-Villablanca, Joshua Emanuel Leyton-Vallejos

entry.summary: Introduces agenda-based narrative extraction that integrates LLMs into pathfinding processes to steer storyline construction toward user-specified perspectives, bridging the gap between coherent single-path extraction and interactive multi-storyline methods.

entry.title: Designing FSMs Specifications from Requirements with GPT 4.0

author.name: Omer Nguena Timo, Paul-Alexis Rodriguez, Florent Avellaneda

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based framework for designing finite state machine specifications from natural language requirements, relevant to model-driven system engineering and automated testing.

entry.title: PC-SAM: Patch-Constrained Fine-Grained Interactive Road Segmentation in High-Resolution Remote Sensing Images

author.name: Chengcheng Lv, Rushi Li, Mincheng Wu, Xiufang Shi, Zhenyu Wen, Shibo He

entry.summary: Proposes PC-SAM for fine-grained interactive road segmentation in high-resolution remote sensing images, addressing SAM's poor performance on remote sensing roads and supporting local refinement of regions of interest.

entry.title: FecalFed: Privacy-Preserving Poultry Disease Detection via Federated Learning

author.name: Tien-Yu Chi

entry.summary: FecalFed introduces a federated learning framework for privacy-preserving poultry disease classification from fecal images. Reveals 46.89% data contamination in existing datasets and releases a deduplicated 8,770-image dataset.

entry.title: Customizing Large Vision Model-Guided Low-Rank Approximation for Ground-Roll Denoise

author.name: Jiacheng Liao, Feng Qian, Ziyin Fan, Yongjian Guo

entry.summary: Applies a large vision model for ground-roll noise attenuation in seismic data, reformulating it as a semantic-guided signal separation problem without training on seismic-specific data.

entry.title: Generalized Heavy-tailed Mutation for Evolutionary Algorithms

author.name: Anton V. Eremeev, Dmitri V. Silaev, Valentin A. Topchii

entry.summary: Generalizes the heavy-tailed mutation operator for evolutionary algorithms by relaxing the power-law assumption to regularly varying distributions. Proves O(n) optimization time bounds for the (1+(λ,λ)) GA on OneMax under weaker conditions.

entry.title: Certificate-Driven Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Path Finding with Inheritable Factorization

author.name: Jiarui Li, Runyu Zhang, Gioele Zardini

entry.summary: Introduces certificate trajectories for closed-loop multi-agent path finding (MAPF), providing a mechanism to inherit global guarantees across replanning cycles. Improves scalability and deadlock resolution in dense warehouse-like environments.

entry.title: Infinite-Horizon Ergodic Control via Kernel Mean Embeddings

author.name: Christian Hughes, Ian Abraham

entry.summary: Derives an infinite-horizon ergodic controller using kernel mean embeddings for long-duration coverage tasks. Resolves computational scaling issues of prior kernel-based methods through a recursive extended state that decouples past visitation from future control.

entry.title: Stein Variational Uncertainty-Adaptive Model Predictive Control

author.name: Hrishikesh Sathyanarayan, Ian Abraham

entry.summary: Proposes a Stein variational distributionally robust controller for nonlinear systems with latent parametric uncertainty. Couples optimal control with Stein variational inference to avoid conservative worst-case optimization while maintaining robustness.

entry.title: Convergence of projected stochastic natural gradient variational inference for various step size and sample or batch size schedules

author.name: Thomas Guilmeau, Hadrien Hendrikx, Florence Forbes

entry.summary: Proves new non-asymptotic convergence results for projected stochastic natural gradient variational inference with exponential families. Covers combinations of constant/decreasing step sizes and constant/increasing batch sizes.

entry.title: AI for AI for Epistemics

author.name: owencb

entry.summary: Discusses how AI-powered tools for epistemics could be transformative as R&D is automated. Argues for shaping early versions and building trust in truth-tracking systems, especially where verification is hard.

entry.title: Softmax gradient policy for variance minimization and risk-averse multi armed bandits

author.name: Gabriel Turinici

entry.summary: Proposes a softmax-parameterized policy gradient algorithm for multi-armed bandits that selects the arm with lowest variance rather than highest expected reward. Proves convergence under natural conditions.

entry.title: Isomorphic Functionalities between Ant Colony and Ensemble Learning: Part II-On the Strength of Weak Learnability and the Boosting Paradigm

author.name: Ernest Fokou\'e, Gregory Babbitt, Yuval Levental

entry.summary: Proves mathematical isomorphism between boosting algorithms (especially AdaBoost) and ant colony decision-making through pheromone-mediated recruitment, establishing that the weak learnability theorem has a direct biological analog.

entry.title: PanoAir: A Panoramic Visual-Inertial SLAM with Cross-Time Real-World UAV Dataset

author.name: Yiyang Wu, Xiaohu Zhang, Yanjin Du, Tongsu Zhang, Chujun Li, Siyang Chen, Guoyi Zhang, Xiangpeng Xu

entry.summary: Constructs a real-world panoramic visual-inertial dataset for UAVs covering diverse flight conditions and proposes PanoAir, a panoramic VI-SLAM system. Addresses the gap in omnidirectional perception for robust UAV localization.

entry.title: VRUD: A Drone Dataset for Complex Vehicle-VRU Interactions within Mixed Traffic

author.name: Ziyu Wang, Hongrui Kou, Cheng Wang, Ruochen Li, Hubert P. H. Shum, Amir Atapour-Abarghouei, Yuxin Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces VRUD, a drone-based dataset focusing on complex vehicle-VRU (Vulnerable Road User) interactions in chaotic urban mixed traffic. Fills a gap in autonomous driving datasets that typically focus on structured scenarios.

entry.title: Collaborative AI Agents and Critics for Fault Detection and Cause Analysis in Network Telemetry

author.name: Syed Eqbal Alam, Zhan Shu

entry.summary: Develops collaborative multi-agent systems with AI agents and critics in a federated architecture for network telemetry fault detection. Critics evaluate agent outputs and provide feedback for iterative improvement.

entry.title: Transfer learning for nonparametric Bayesian networks

author.name: Rafael Sojo, Pedro Larra\~naga, Concha Bielza

entry.summary: Introduces two transfer learning methods for nonparametric Bayesian networks under scarce data, with specific metrics to tackle negative transfer, using kernel density estimation networks.

entry.title: Adversarial Attacks in AI-Driven RAN Slicing: SLA Violations and Recovery

author.name: Deemah H. Tashman, Soumaya Cherkaoui

entry.summary: Studies adversarial jamming attacks on AI-driven RAN slicing in next-gen cellular networks, analyzing how budget-constrained adversaries can bias deep RL-based resource allocation to cause SLA violations.

entry.title: Unsupervised 4D Flow MRI Velocity Enhancement and Unwrapping Using Divergence-Free Neural Networks

author.name: Javier Bisbal, Julio Sotelo, Hern\'an Mella, Oliver Welin Odeback, Joaqu\'in Mura, David Marlevi, Junya Matsuda, Kotomi Iwata, Tetsuro Sekine, Cristian Tejos, Sergio Uribe

entry.summary: Introduces DAF-FlowNet for unsupervised 4D Flow MRI enhancement, parameterizing velocities as curl of vector potential to enforce mass conservation, with simultaneous denoising and phase unwrapping.

entry.title: NeuroDDAF: Neural Dynamic Diffusion-Advection Fields with Evidential Fusion for Air Quality Forecasting

author.name: Prasanjit Dey, Soumyabrata Dev, Angela Meyer, Bianca Schoen-Phelan

entry.summary: Proposes NeuroDDAF, a physics-informed air quality forecasting framework that unifies neural representation learning with diffusion-advection transport modeling, incorporating GRU-Graph Attention encoding and evidential uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Vocal Prognostic Digital Biomarkers in Monitoring Chronic Heart Failure: A Longitudinal Observational Study

author.name: Fan Wu, Matthias P. N\"agele, Daryush D. Mehta, Elgar Fleisch, Frank Ruschitzka, Andreas J. Flammer, Filipe Barata

entry.summary: Longitudinal study evaluating voice features as digital biomarkers for predicting health deterioration in chronic heart failure patients, using daily recordings over 2 months from 32 patients.

entry.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation under Distribution Shift with Bounded Extremum Seeking

author.name: Shaifalee Saxena, Rafael Fierro, Alexander Scheinker

entry.summary: Investigates combining deep RL with bounded extremum seeking for robotic manipulation under distribution shift, improving robustness in contact-rich tasks when test conditions differ from training.

entry.title: MemRerank: Preference Memory for Personalized Product Reranking

author.name: Zhiyuan Peng, Xuyang Wu, Huaixiao Tou, Yi Fang, Yi Gong

entry.summary: Proposes MemRerank, which distills user purchase history into concise preference memory for personalized product reranking with LLM-based shopping agents, trained with RL using downstream reranking performance.

entry.title: Rewrite the News: Tracing Editorial Reuse Across News Agencies

author.name: Soveatin Kuntur, Nina Smirnova, Anna Wroblewska, Philipp Mayr, Sebastijan Razbor\v{s}ek Ma\v{c}ek

entry.summary: Investigates sentence-level cross-lingual text reuse in journalism, presenting a weakly supervised method for detecting reuse without full translations. Analyzes how the Slovenian Press Agency reuses content from 15 foreign agencies across seven languages.

entry.title: Dynamic Graph Neural Network with Adaptive Features Selection for RGB-D Based Indoor Scene Recognition

author.name: Qiong Liu, Ruofei Xiong, Xingzhen Chen, Muyao Peng, You Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a dynamic graph neural network with adaptive node selection for RGB-D indoor scene recognition, modeling relations among objects and scenes using both color and depth modalities.

entry.title: Revisiting Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval with Pre-Trained Vision Transformers

author.name: Kawtar Zaher, Olivier Buisson, Alexis Joly

entry.summary: Revisits human-in-the-loop object retrieval using pre-trained Vision Transformers with active learning, showing that modern ViT features significantly improve interactive retrieval without prior labels.

entry.title: AI-assisted Human-in-the-Loop Web Platform for Structural Characterization in Hard drive design

author.name: Utkarsh Pratiush, Huaixun Huyan, Maryam Zahiri Azar, Esmeralda Yitamben, Allen Bourez, Sergei V Kalinin, Vasfi Burak Ozdol

entry.summary: Presents a human-AI-assisted workflow for STEM microscopy analysis in hard drive design, with automated layer thickness and interface roughness quantification for multilayer thin films.

entry.title: Sampling-based Task and Kinodynamic Motion Planning under Semantic Uncertainty

author.name: Qi Heng Ho, Zachary N. Sunberg, Morteza Lahijanian

entry.summary: Tackles integrated task and kinodynamic motion planning under semantic uncertainty using LTL specifications. Models the problem as a Partially Observable Stochastic Hybrid System and proposes an anytime algorithm combining decision-making with sampling-based planning.

entry.title: Human-in-the-Loop Control of Objective Drift in LLM-Assisted Computer Science Education

author.name: Mark Dranias, Adam Whitley

entry.summary: Frames 'objective drift' in LLM-assisted CS education as a control-theoretic problem, proposing human-in-the-loop approaches where students configure objectives and world models as operational artifacts rather than learning tool-specific prompting.

entry.title: Preference Guided Iterated Pareto Referent Optimisation for Accessible Route Planning

author.name: Paolo Speziali, Arno De Greef, Mehrdad Asadi, Willem R\"opke, Ann Now\'e, Diederik M. Roijers

entry.summary: Proposes PG-IPRO for accessible urban route planning where users give feedback on routes to iteratively optimize multi-objective paths, avoiding full Pareto front computation for better efficiency.

entry.title: Whittaker-Henderson smoother for long satellite image time series interpolation

author.name: Mathieu Fauvel (CESBIO)

entry.summary: Casts the Whittaker smoother as a differentiable neural layer for satellite image time series interpolation, enabling learned smoothing parameters and heteroscedastic noise handling.

entry.title: Towards Automatic Soccer Commentary Generation with Knowledge-Enhanced Visual Reasoning

author.name: Zeyu Jin, Xiaoyu Qin, Songtao Zhou, Kaifeng Yun, Jia Jia

entry.summary: Proposes GameSight for automatic soccer commentary generation using knowledge-enhanced visual reasoning, enabling commentary with accurate entity references through a two-stage visual reasoning approach.

entry.title: MATHENA: Mamba-based Architectural Tooth Hierarchical Estimator and Holistic Evaluation Network for Anatomy

author.name: Kyeonghun Kim, Jaehyung Park, Youngung Han, Anna Jung, Seongbin Park, Sumin Lee, Jiwon Yang, Jiyoon Han, Subeen Lee, Junsu Lim, Hyunsu Go, Eunseob Choi, Hyeonseok Jung, Soo Yong Kim, Woo Kyoung Jeong, Won Jae Lee, Pa Hong, Hyuk-Jae Lee, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Nam-Joon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes MATHENA, a unified dental diagnosis framework using Mamba's linear-complexity state space models for tooth detection, caries segmentation, anomaly detection, and developmental staging from panoramic X-rays.

entry.title: Multimodal Analysis of State-Funded News Coverage of the Israel-Hamas War on YouTube Shorts

author.name: Daniel Miehling, Sandra Kuebler

entry.summary: Presents a multimodal pipeline for analyzing YouTube Shorts coverage of the Israel-Hamas war by state-funded outlets, combining transcription, sentiment analysis, and scene classification across 2,300+ Shorts.

entry.title: Looking into a Pixel by Nonlinear Unmixing -- A Generative Approach

author.name: Maofeng Tang, Hairong Qi

entry.summary: Develops a generative model approach for hyperspectral nonlinear unmixing that doesn't require explicit knowledge of the mixing model, using an invertible mixing-unmixing network.

entry.title: Evolution Strategies for Deep RL pretraining

author.name: Adrian Mart\'inez, Ananya Gupta, Hanka Goralija, Mario Rico, Sa\'ul Fenollosa, Tamar Alphaidze

entry.summary: Examines whether evolution strategies can be used to pretrain deep RL agents, comparing ES and DRL across Flappy Bird, Breakout, and MuJoCo environments.

entry.title: SAGE: Subsurface AI-driven Geostatistical Extraction with proxy posterior

author.name: Huseyin Tuna Erdinc, Ipsita Bhar, Rafael Orozco, Thales Souza, Felix J. Herrmann

entry.summary: Introduces SAGE, a framework for generating subsurface velocity models from sparse well logs and migrated seismic images, learning a proxy posterior over velocity models conditioned on both modalities.

entry.title: Chameleons do not Forget: Prompt-Based Online Continual Learning for Next Activity Prediction

author.name: Marwan Hassani, Tamara Verbeek, Sjoerd van Straten

entry.summary: Proposes CNAPwP, adapting DualPrompt for online continual learning in predictive process monitoring to handle concept drifts while avoiding catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Property-Level Flood Risk Assessment Using AI-Enabled Street-View Lowest Floor Elevation Extraction and ML Imputation Across Texas

author.name: Xiangpeng Li, Yu-Hsuan Ho, Sam D Brody, Ali Mostafavi

entry.summary: Develops a three-stage pipeline for property-level flood risk assessment in Texas using AI analysis of street-view imagery to extract building elevation data, ML imputation of missing values, and integration with flood inundation models.

entry.title: Genetic algorithms for multi-omic feature selection: a comparative study in cancer survival analysis

author.name: Luca Cattelani, Vittorio Fortino

entry.summary: Introduces Sweeping*, a multi-view multi-objective genetic algorithm for feature selection across multi-omic cancer datasets, alternating between single- and multi-view optimization for biomarker discovery.

entry.title: Focal plane wavefront control with model-based reinforcement learning

author.name: Jalo Nousiainen, Iremsu Taskin, Markus Kasper, Gilles Orban De Xivry, Olivier Absil

entry.summary: Presents a model-based RL algorithm for focal plane wavefront control in astronomy, enabling automatic detection and correction of optical aberrations for exoplanet imaging without mechanical probes.

entry.title: Dual Perspectives in Emotion Attribution: A Generator-Interpreter Framework for Cross-Cultural Analysis of Emotion in LLMs

author.name: Aizirek Turdubaeva, Uichin Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a Generator-Interpreter framework for cross-cultural emotion attribution in LLMs, evaluating six models across 15 countries. Reveals that performance varies with both generator and interpreter cultural backgrounds.

entry.title: Impact of enriched meaning representations for language generation in dialogue tasks: A comprehensive exploration of the relevance of tasks, corpora and metrics

author.name: Alain V\'azquez, Maria In\'es Torres

entry.summary: Analyzes whether providing a task demonstrator (MR-sentence pair from original data) enhances NLG outputs of fine-tuned models for dialogue systems. Evaluates across five metrics focusing on different linguistic aspects.

entry.title: ENEIDE: A High Quality Silver Standard Dataset for Named Entity Recognition and Linking in Historical Italian

author.name: Cristian Santini, Sebastian Barzaghi, Paolo Sernani, Emanuele Frontoni, Laura Melosi, Mehwish Alam

entry.summary: Introduces ENEIDE, a silver standard dataset for Named Entity Recognition and Linking in historical Italian texts, covering 2,111 documents with 8,000+ entity annotations from digital editions of Leopardi and Aldo Moro's works.

entry.title: Semantic Interaction for Narrative Map Sensemaking: An Insight-based Evaluation

author.name: Brian Felipe Keith-Norambuena, Fausto German, Eric Krokos, Sarah Joseph, Chris North

entry.summary: Evaluates semantic interaction for narrative map sensemaking in a 33-participant user study. Finds that SI-enabled narrative maps yield more insights than timeline baselines, with statistical significance for the interactive condition.

entry.title: FreqPhys: Repurposing Implicit Physiological Frequency Prior for Robust Remote Photoplethysmography

author.name: Wei Qian, Dan Guo, Jinxing Zhou, Bochao Zou, Zitong Yu, Meng Wang

entry.summary: FreqPhys proposes a frequency-guided framework for remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) that uses physiological frequency priors to improve contactless heart rate monitoring from facial videos. Applies bandpass filtering and spectral modulation to suppress noise from motion and illumination.

entry.title: Hierarchical Motion Planning and Control under Unknown Nonlinear Dynamics via Predicted Reachability

author.name: Zhiquan Zhang, Melkior Ornik

entry.summary: Develops a hierarchical planning-control framework for autonomous motion under unknown nonlinear dynamics. Uses piecewise-affine models with adaptive state space partitioning and predicted reachability for online planning without prior system knowledge.

entry.title: Collaborative Task and Path Planning for Heterogeneous Robotic Teams using Multi-Agent PPO

author.name: Matthias Rubio, Julia Richter, Hendrik Kolvenbach, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: Uses Multi-Agent PPO for collaborative task and path planning for heterogeneous robotic teams, motivated by extraterrestrial exploration. Learning-based approach addresses scalability limitations of classical planners.

entry.title: Improvisational Games as a Benchmark for Social Intelligence of AI Agents: The Case of Connections

author.name: Gaurav Rajesh Parikh, Angikar Ghosal

entry.summary: Introduces the 'Connections' improvisational wordplay game as a benchmark for evaluating social intelligence in AI agents, requiring knowledge retrieval, summarization, and theory-of-mind capabilities.

entry.title: Beyond Symbolic Control: Societal Consequences of AI-Driven Workforce Displacement and the Imperative for Genuine Human Oversight Architectures

author.name: Richard J. Mitchell

entry.summary: Analyzes societal consequences of AI-driven workforce displacement, arguing for genuine (not symbolic) human oversight architectures across economic, psychological, political, educational, and geopolitical domains.

entry.title: Epileptic Seizure Detection in Separate Frequency Bands Using Feature Analysis and Graph Convolutional Neural Network (GCN) from Electroencephalogram (EEG) Signals

author.name: Ferdaus Anam Jibon, Fazlul Hasan Siddiqui, F. Deeba, Gahangir Hossain

entry.summary: Presents a frequency-aware framework for epileptic seizure detection using EEG decomposition into five frequency bands with graph convolutional networks for spatial relationship modeling.

entry.title: HabitatAgent: An End-to-End Multi-Agent System for Housing Consultation

author.name: Hongyang Yang, Yanxin Zhang, Yang She, Yue Xiao, Hao Wu, Yiyang Zhang, Jiapeng Hou, Rongshan Zhang

entry.summary: Presents HabitatAgent, a multi-agent LLM system for housing consultation with Memory, Retrieval, Generation, and Validation agents for end-to-end decision support.

entry.title: Learning Quantised Structure-Preserving Motion Representations for Dance Fingerprinting

author.name: Arina Kharlamova, Bowei He, Chen Ma, Xue Liu

entry.summary: Presents DANCEMATCH for motion-based dance retrieval using skeleton motion quantization and spatio-temporal transformers to create compact discrete motion signatures for efficient large-scale retrieval.

entry.title: Predicting Wave Reflection and Transmission in Heterogeneous Media via Fourier Operator-Based Transformer Modeling

author.name: Zhe Bai, Hans Johansen

entry.summary: Develops an ML surrogate model for 1D Maxwell's equations at material interfaces using a Fourier operator-based vision transformer framework for wave reflection and transmission.

entry.title: Embedded Variational Neural Stochastic Differential Equations for Learning Heterogeneous Dynamics

author.name: Sandeep Kumar Samota, Reema Gupta, Snehashish Chakraverty

entry.summary: Develops a Variational Neural SDE model combining Neural SDEs with VAEs for modeling noisy socioeconomic time series data across heterogeneous districts in India.

entry.title: Risk-Aware Batch Testing for Performance Regression Detection

author.name: Ali Sayedsalehi, Peter C. Rigby, Gregory Mierzwinski

entry.summary: Introduces a risk-aware framework for performance regression testing in CI systems that integrates ML-based commit risk prediction with adaptive batching. Uses Mozilla Firefox as case study with fine-tuned ModernBERT.

entry.title: Automated Detection of Multiple Sclerosis Lesions on 7-tesla MRI Using U-net and Transformer-based Segmentation

author.name: Michael Maynord, Minghui Liu, Cornelia Ferm\"uller, Seongjin Choi, Yuxin Zeng, Shishir Dahal, Daniel M. Harrison

entry.summary: Analyzes automated segmentation of multiple sclerosis lesions on 7-tesla MRI using U-net and transformer-based models, comparing with tools designed for lower-field imaging. Evaluates across multiple resolutions.

entry.title: Kwame 2.0: Human-in-the-Loop Generative AI Teaching Assistant for Large Scale Online Coding Education in Africa

author.name: George Boateng, Samuel Boateng, Victor Kumbol

entry.summary: Presents Kwame 2.0, a bilingual AI teaching assistant using RAG deployed in a coding course across 35 African countries over 15 months. Reports on real-world deployment with 3,717 enrollments.

entry.title: Physiological and Semantic Patterns in Medical Teams Using an Intelligent Tutoring System

author.name: Xiaoshan Huang, Conrad Borchers, Jiayi Zhang, Susanne P. Lajoie

entry.summary: Investigates physiological synchrony and conversational dynamics in medical dyads using an intelligent tutoring system, finding that semantic shifts in dialogue correlate with transient physiological synchrony peaks.

entry.title: Finding Low Star Discrepancy 3D Kronecker Point Sets Using Algorithm Configuration Techniques

author.name: Im\`ene Ait Abderrahim, Carola Doerr, Martin Durand

entry.summary: Studies low star discrepancy 3D Kronecker point sets using algorithm configuration techniques, showing that size-specific optimization can outperform classical constructions like Sobol' and Halton sequences.

entry.title: Long-Horizon Geometry-Aware Navigation among Polytopes via MILP-MPC and Minkowski-Based CBFs

author.name: Yi-Hsuan Chen, Salman Ghori, Ania Adil, Eric Feron, Calin Belta

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical navigation framework combining MILP-MPC for high-level trajectory planning with Minkowski-based control barrier functions for geometry-aware safety at the low level. Handles polytopic robots navigating among polytopic obstacles with exact geometric guarantees.

entry.title: Real Time Local Wind Inference for Robust Autonomous Navigation

author.name: Spencer Folk

entry.summary: Thesis presenting a framework for aerial robots to infer surrounding wind fields in real-time using onboard LiDAR and sparse wind measurements, fused via deep learning. Enables energy-efficient motion planning in urban environments.

entry.title: SoftHand Model-W: A 3D-Printed, Anthropomorphic, Underactuated Robot Hand with Integrated Wrist and Carpal Tunnel

author.name: Dhillon B. Merritt, Christopher J. Ford, Haoran Li, Malia Smith, Zhixing Chen, Efi Psomopoulou, Nathan F. Lepora

entry.summary: Presents a 3D-printed anthropomorphic robot hand with integrated 2-DOF wrist and carpal tunnel-inspired tendon routing. Features four degrees of actuation with synergistic and self-adaptive grasping.

entry.title: Eyla: Toward an Identity-Anchored LLM Architecture with Integrated Biological Priors -- Vision, Implementation Attempt, and Lessons from AI-Assisted Development

author.name: Arif Aditto

entry.summary: Describes Eyla, an identity-anchored LLM architecture integrating biologically-inspired subsystems for identity consistency. Notably presents a transparent failure analysis of the implementation attempt.

entry.title: Learning to Play Blackjack: A Curriculum Learning Perspective

author.name: Amirreza Alasti, Efe Erdal, Y\"ucel Celik, Theresa Eimer

entry.summary: Uses an LLM to generate a curriculum of progressively complex actions for RL agents learning Blackjack, improving DQN win rates from 43.97% to 47.41%.

entry.title: Neural-Assisted in-Motion Self-Heading Alignment

author.name: Zeev Yampolsky, Felipe O. Silva, Adriano Frutuoso, Itzik Klein

entry.summary: Proposes a neural-assisted framework for rapid initial heading estimation in autonomous ocean platforms, replacing model-based approaches with end-to-end neural networks for faster alignment.

entry.title: AI-Mediated Explainable Regulation for Justice

author.name: Thomas Hofweber, Andreas Sudmann, Evangelos Pournaras

entry.summary: Proposes using distributed AI to make regulatory recommendations that are explainable and adaptable, modeling stakeholder preferences with separate AI components. A conceptual/position paper on AI-mediated governance.

entry.title: A CEFR-Inspired Classification Framework with Fuzzy C-Means To Automate Assessment of Programming Skills in Scratch

author.name: Ricardo Hidalgo-Arag\'on, Jes\'us M. Gonz\'alez-Barahona, Gregorio Robles

entry.summary: Introduces a CEFR-inspired framework using Fuzzy C-Means clustering to automatically assess programming proficiency in Scratch projects, applied to over 2 million projects.

entry.title: Deep Learning-Accelerated Surrogate Optimization for High-Dimensional Well Control in Stress-Sensitive Reservoirs

author.name: Mahammad Valiyev, Jodel Cornelio, Behnam Jafarpour

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning-based surrogate optimization framework for well control in stress-sensitive reservoirs, handling high-dimensional time-varying control strategies.

entry.title: Efficient Software Vulnerability Detection Using Transformer-based Models

author.name: Sameer Shaik, Zhen Huang, Daniela Stan Raicu, Jacob Furst

entry.summary: Applies transformers to C/C++ vulnerability detection using program slices that capture key syntactic and semantic features. Leverages transformers' ability to capture global contextual information for identifying vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Towards Empowering Consumers through Sentence-level Readability Scoring in German ESG Reports

author.name: Benjamin Josef Sch\"u{\ss}ler, Jakob Prange

entry.summary: Extends a sentence-level dataset of German ESG reports with crowdsourced readability annotations, finding that native speakers generally perceive ESG sentences as easy to read but that readability is subjective.

entry.title: Set-Based Value Function Characterization and Neural Approximation of Stabilization Domains for Input-Constrained Discrete-Time Systems

author.name: Mohamed Serry, S. Sivaranjani, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for estimating domains of stabilization for input-constrained discrete-time nonlinear systems using set-based value functions and neural network approximation. Introduces Bellman/Zubov-type equations on metric spaces of compact sets. Technically solid but narrow contribution to control theory.

entry.title: MRReP: Mixed Reality-based Hand-drawn Reference Path Editing Interface for Mobile Robot Navigation

author.name: Takumi Taki, Masato Kobayashi, Yuki Uranishi

entry.summary: Presents MRReP, a mixed reality interface allowing users to draw navigation paths for mobile robots directly on physical floors using hand gestures. The drawn paths are integrated into the robot's navigation stack for autonomous following. Demonstrates a practical human-robot interaction paradigm.

entry.title: StretchBot: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Adaptive Guidance with Assistive Robots

author.name: Luca Vogelgesang, Ahmed Mehdi Soltani, Mohammadhossein Khojasteh, Xinrui Zu, Stefano De Giorgis, Madalina Croitoru, Filip Ilievski

entry.summary: Presents StretchBot, a hybrid neuro-symbolic robotic coach for adaptive stretching guidance. Combines multimodal perception with knowledge-graph-grounded LLM reasoning for context-aware adjustments during rehabilitation sessions.

entry.title: A Dual-Action Fabric-Based Soft Robotic Glove for Ergonomic Hand Rehabilitation

author.name: Rui Chen, Firman Isma Serdana, Domenico Chiaradia, Xianlong Mai, Elena Losanno, Gabriele Righi, Claudia De Santis, Federica Serra, Vincent Mendez, Cristian Camardella, Daniele Leonardis, Giulio Del Popolo, Silvestro Micera, Antonio Frisoli

author.name: Seamus Brady

author.name: Rafal Wlodarski

entry.title: Unified Architecture Metamodel of Information Systems Developed by Generative AI

author.name: Oleg Grynets, Vasyl Lyashkevych

entry.summary: Proposes a unified architecture metamodel for LLM-oriented applications supporting bidirectional 'Code to Documentation to Code' transformations based on selected architectural frameworks.

entry.title: A ROS 2 Wrapper for Florence-2: Multi-Mode Local Vision-Language Inference for Robotic Systems

author.name: J. E. Dom\'inguez-Vidal

entry.summary: Provides a ROS 2 wrapper for Florence-2 vision-language model, enabling multi-mode inference (topics, services, actions) for robotic systems with practical middleware integration.

entry.title: Scalable Identification and Prioritization of Requisition-Specific Personal Competencies Using Large Language Models

entry.title: From Consensus to Split Decisions: ABC-Stratified Sentiment in Holocaust Oral Histories

author.name: Daban Q. Jaff

entry.summary: Diagnostic study of sentiment classifiers on Holocaust oral histories, introducing an agreement-based stability taxonomy (ABC) to stratify inter-model output stability across 107K utterances.

author.name: Jorge Francisco Garc\'ia-Samart\'in, Christyan Cruz Ulloa, Andr\'es S\'anchez-Silva, Jaime del Cerro, Antonio Barrientos

entry.summary: Designs a soft gripper integrated into a mobile robotic system for measuring pulse and blood pressure of victims in search-and-rescue environments. The gripper inflates like a sphygmomanometer around the victim's arm.

entry.title: A Reliability Evaluation of Hybrid Deterministic-LLM Based Approaches for Academic Course Registration PDF Information Extraction

author.name: Muhammad Anis Al Hilmi, Neelansh Khare, Noel Framil Iglesias

entry.summary: Evaluates three approaches for extracting information from academic course registration PDFs: LLM-only, hybrid deterministic-LLM, and Camelot-based pipeline with LLM fallback, using local 12-14B models.

entry.title: Toward Optimal Sampling Rate Selection and Unbiased Classification for Precise Animal Activity Recognition

author.name: Axiu Mao, Meilu Zhu, Lei Shen, Xiaoshuai Wang, Tomas Norton, Kai Liu

entry.summary: Proposes IBA-Net for animal activity recognition from wearable sensors, addressing suboptimal sampling rates and class imbalance for individual behavior recognition in farm animals.

entry.title: KUET at StanceNakba Shared Task: StanceMoE: Mixture-of-Experts Architecture for Stance Detection

author.name: Abdullah Al Shafi, Md. Milon Islam, Sk. Imran Hossain, K. M. Azharul Hasan

entry.summary: Proposes StanceMoE, a MoE architecture built on BERT for actor-level stance detection, integrating diverse linguistic signals. A shared task submission.

entry.title: Lead Zirconate Titanate Reservoir Computing for Classification of Written and Spoken Digits

author.name: Thomas Buckley, Leslie Schumm, Manor Askenazi, Edward Rietman

entry.summary: Applies physical reservoir computing using a Lead Zirconate Titanate cube for handwritten and spoken digit classification, showing modest improvements over logistic regression baselines on MNIST.

entry.title: Decomposable Reward Modeling and Realistic Environment Design for Reinforcement Learning-Based Forex Trading

author.name: Nabeel Ahmad Saidd

entry.summary: Presents a modular RL framework for Forex trading with friction-aware execution, decomposable multi-objective rewards, and realistic anti-lookahead semantics. Addresses common simplifications in RL trading simulators.

entry.title: SyriSign: A Parallel Corpus for Arabic Text to Syrian Arabic Sign Language Translation

author.name: Mohammad Amer Khalil, Raghad Nahas, Ahmad Nassar, Khloud Al Jallad

entry.summary: Introduces SyriSign, a dataset of 1,500 video samples across 150 signs for Syrian Arabic Sign Language translation, evaluated with three deep learning architectures.

entry.title: CADEL: A Corpus of Administrative Web Documents for Japanese Entity Linking

author.name: Shohei Higashiyama, Masao Ideuchi, Masao Utiyama

entry.summary: Develops CADEL, an annotated corpus for Japanese entity linking from administrative web documents, with rich coverage of Japan-specific entities and inter-annotator agreement validation.

entry.title: L-ReLF: A Framework for Lexical Dataset Creation

author.name: Anass Sedrati, Mounir Afifi, Reda Benkhadra

entry.summary: Introduces L-ReLF, a framework for creating lexical datasets for underserved languages, demonstrated on Moroccan Darija. Addresses challenges of OCR bias and standardization for low-resource languages.

entry.title: Reachability-Aware Time Scaling for Path Tracking

author.name: Hossein Gholampour, Logan E. Beaver

entry.summary: Studies reachability-aware time scaling for tracking collision-free waypoint paths with bounded speed and acceleration. Uses a pure-pursuit-style tracker with offline speed-scaling profile computation based on acceleration margins.

entry.title: A wearable haptic device for edge and surface simulation

author.name: Rui Chen, Xianlong Mai, Alireza Sanaei, Domenico Chiaradia, Antonio Frisoli, Daniele Leonardis

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight (24.3g) fingertip haptic device that delivers distinct surface and edge contact feedback through a dual-motor mechanism. Achieves 93% classification accuracy across four conditions in a preliminary user study.

entry.title: Sit-to-Stand Transitions Detection and Duration Measurement Using Smart Lacelock Sensor

entry.summary: Presents a methodology for detecting sit-to-stand transitions using a smart shoe-mounted sensor with load cell, accelerometer, and gyroscope for elderly mobility monitoring.

entry.title: Large Language Models for Analyzing Enterprise Architecture Debt in Unstructured Documentation

author.name: Christin Pagels, Simon Hacks, Rob Henk Bemthuis

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs to identify and quantify Enterprise Architecture Debt in unstructured architectural documentation, detecting 'EA Smells' that indicate suboptimal design decisions.

entry.title: SiPaKosa: A Comprehensive Corpus of Canonical and Classical Buddhist Texts in Sinhala and Pali

author.name: Ranidu Gurusinghe, Nevidu Jayatilleke

entry.summary: Presents SiPaKosa, a corpus of 786K sentences of Sinhala and Pali Buddhist texts, incorporating historical manuscripts via OCR and web scraping. Evaluates ten pretrained language models on the corpus.

entry.title: Open Machine Translation for Esperanto

author.name: Ona de Gibert, Llu\'is de Gibert

entry.summary: Presents the first comprehensive evaluation of open-source MT systems for Esperanto, comparing rule-based, encoder-decoder, and LLM approaches across six language directions with human evaluation.

entry.title: Rusty Flying Robots: Learning a Full Robotics Stack with Real-Time Operation on an STM32 Microcontroller in a 9 ECTS MS Course

author.name: Wolfgang Hoenig, Christoph Scherer, Khaled Wahba

entry.summary: Describes a masters-level robotics course teaching the full pipeline (dynamics, estimation, controls, planning) using Rust on STM32 microcontrollers. Emphasizes avoiding black-box software and using safe/efficient programming.

entry.title: Bistable Quad-Nets Composed of Four-Bar Linkages

author.name: Gudrun Szewieczek, Daniel Huczala, Martin Pfurner, Hans-Peter Schr\"ocker

entry.summary: Studies bistable mechanical structures composed of spatial four-bar linkages using the Study quadric framework. Provides geometric construction methods from discrete differential geometry, including discrete minimal surfaces.

author.name: Elaheh Sanoubari

entry.summary: Simulates mobbing behavior (coordinated anti-predator attacks) using Braitenberg-inspired robots in Webots, exploring effects of call range and group size.

entry.title: Toward Personalized Darts Training: A Data-Driven Framework Based on Skeleton-Based Biomechanical Analysis and Motion Modeling

author.name: Zhantao Chen, Dongyi He, Jin Fang, Xi Chen, Yisuo Liu, Xiaozhen Zhong, Xuejun Hu

entry.summary: Presents a data-driven dart training assistance system using skeleton-based biomechanical analysis and motion modeling. Creates a closed-loop framework for motion capture, feature modeling, and personalized feedback for dart throwing.

entry.title: On rankings in multiplayer games with an application to the game of Whist

author.name: Alexis Coyette, Charles Modera, Candy Sonveaux, Judica\"el Mohet, Franc\c{c}ois-Gr\'egoire Bierwart, Sylverio Pool Marquez, Jarod Ketcha Kouakep, C\'edric Simal, Komlan Fiagbe, Violaine Piengeon, Martin Moriam\'e, Justine Bodart, Marie Dorchain, Maxime Lucas, Rommel Tchinda Djeudjo, Gianluca Peri, Eve Tilman

author.name: Amane Watahiki, Tomoki Doi, Akari Kikuchi, Hiroshi Ohata, Yuki I. Nakata, Takuya Niikawa, Taiga Shinozaki, Hitomi Yanaka

entry.summary: Develops guidelines for applying Labovian structural narrative analysis to Japanese oral narratives, adapting the framework with explicit clause segmentation rules for Japanese constructions.

entry.title: Play-Testing REMind: Evaluating an Educational Robot-Mediated Role-Play Game

author.name: Elaheh Sanoubari, Neil Fernandes, Keith Rebello, Alicia Pan, Andrew Houston, Kerstin Dautenhahn

entry.summary: Presents REMind, an educational robot-mediated role-play game for anti-bullying bystander intervention among children aged 9-10. Uses social robots to enact bullying scenarios for perspective-taking and rehearsal. Small pilot study (n=18) shows promising learning outcomes.

entry.title: Neural Ordinary Differential Equations for Modeling Socio-Economic Dynamics

author.name: Sandeep Kumar Samota, Snehashish Chakraverty, Narayan Sethi

entry.summary: Applies Neural ODE framework to model poverty dynamics in Odisha, India using socioeconomic time-series data from 2007-2020. A straightforward application of Neural ODEs to socio-economic modeling.

author.name: Benjamin Smith

entry.summary: Review and replication of Javanmard and Montanari (2014)'s debiased LASSO framework for high-dimensional inference. Evaluates the theoretical claims through numerical experiments.

author.name: grandtheftarto

entry.summary: Proposes using NFC instead of barcodes for inventory control systems, discussing security, reliability, and efficiency advantages.

entry.summary: Proposes using musical semitones as an intuitive system for reasoning about orders of magnitude and logarithmic scales, leveraging existing musical intuitions for mathematical estimation.

entry.title: Research Summary: April 01, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary: Analysis complete. Top items selected by score.

entry.title: Trojan-Speak: Bypassing Constitutional Classifiers with No Jailbreak Tax via Adversarial Finetuning

author.name: Bilgehan Sel, Xuanli He, Alwin Peng, Ming Jin, Jerry Wei

entry.summary: Introduces Trojan-Speak, an adversarial fine-tuning method that bypasses Anthropic's Constitutional Classifiers with 99+% evasion while maintaining <5% capability degradation, compared to >25% in prior work. Uses curriculum learning and GRPO-based hybrid RL.

entry.title: On the Mirage of Long-Range Dependency, with an Application to Integer Multiplication

author.name: Zichao Wei

entry.summary: Challenges the conventional understanding that integer multiplication is hard for neural networks due to long-range carry chain dependencies. Shows this is a 'mirage' of representation choice—a 2D outer-product grid collapses operations to 3x3 local neighborhoods, enabling a 321-parameter neural cellular automaton to achieve perfect length generalization up to 683x training range.

entry.title: Aligned, Orthogonal or In-conflict: When can we safely optimize Chain-of-Thought?

author.name: Max Kaufmann, David Lindner, Roland S. Zimmermann, and Rohin Shah

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for predicting when CoT training will degrade monitorability. Models post-training as RL where reward decomposes into output-dependent and CoT-dependent terms, classifiable as aligned, orthogonal, or in-conflict.

entry.title: Theory of Mind and Self-Attributions of Mentality are Dissociable in LLMs

author.name: Junsol Kim, Winnie Street, Roberta Rocca, Daine M. Korngiebel, Adam Waytz, James Evans, Geoff Keeling

entry.summary: Investigates whether suppressing LLM self-attribution of mental states (via safety fine-tuning) degrades Theory of Mind capabilities. Finds these are behaviorally and mechanistically dissociable, but notes safety-tuned models under-attribute mind to non-human animals and suppress spiritual beliefs.

entry.title: From Density Matrices to Phase Transitions in Deep Learning: Spectral Early Warnings and Interpretability

author.name: Max Hennick, Guillaume Corlouer

entry.summary: Introduces the '2-datapoint reduced density matrix' from quantum chemistry to study phase transitions during deep learning training. Derives spectral heat capacity for early warning of phase transitions and participation ratio for measuring reorganization dimensionality.

entry.title: Strategic Candidacy in Generative AI Arenas

author.name: Chris Hays, Rachel Li, Bailey Flanigan, Manish Raghavan

entry.summary: Analyzes how AI model producers can game arena-style rankings (like Chatbot Arena) by submitting multiple model variants to artificially boost their top models' rankings. Establishes theoretical conditions for exploitation and proposes algorithmic solutions to make rankings manipulation-resistant.

entry.title: From Pixels to BFS: High Maze Accuracy Does Not Imply Visual Planning

author.name: Alberto G. Rodriguez Salgado

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Introduces MazeBench (110 procedurally generated mazes) and reveals that multimodal models solve mazes by converting to text grids and enumerating paths (1,710-22,818 tokens) rather than genuine visual planning. GPT-5.4 solves 91% but fails on hard mazes.

entry.title: The Model Says Walk: How Surface Heuristics Override Implicit Constraints in LLM Reasoning

author.name: Yubo Li, Lu Zhang, Tianchong Jiang, Ramayya Krishnan, Rema Padman

entry.summary: Shows that LLMs systematically fail when salient surface cues conflict with unstated feasibility constraints. Introduces the Heuristic Override Benchmark (HOB) with 500 instances demonstrating that no model exceeds 24% accuracy under strict evaluation, revealing fundamental reasoning limitations.

entry.title: Generative AI in Action: Field Experimental Evidence from Alibaba's Customer Service Operations

author.name: Xiao Ni, Yiwei Wang, Tianjun Feng, Lauren Xiaoyan Lu, Yitong Wang, Congyi Zhou

entry.summary: Large-scale field experiment at Alibaba assessing generative AI assistant impact on customer service workers. Finds AI improves service speed but agents retain discretion to adopt, modify, or ignore suggestions.

entry.title: Tucker Attention: A generalization of approximate attention mechanisms

author.name: Timon Klein, Jonas Kusch, Sebastian Sager, Stefan Schnake, Steffen Schotth\"ofer

entry.summary: Proposes Tucker Attention as a generalized view of attention approximation methods (GQA, MLA), using Tucker decomposition to provide a unified framework for understanding and constructing parameter-efficient attention mechanisms.

entry.title: Scaling Atomistic Protein Binder Design with Generative Pretraining and Test-Time Compute

author.name: Kieran Didi, Zuobai Zhang, Guoqing Zhou, Danny Reidenbach, Zhonglin Cao, Sooyoung Cha, Tomas Geffner, Christian Dallago, Jian Tang, Michael M. Bronstein, Martin Steinegger, Emine Kucukbenli, Arash Vahdat, Karsten Kreis

entry.summary: Proposes Proteina-Complexa, a fully atomistic protein binder generation method unifying conditional generation and hallucination paradigms, with a new large-scale synthetic dataset (Teddymer) for pretraining.

entry.title: Next-Token Prediction and Regret Minimization

author.name: Mehryar Mohri, Clayton Sanford, Jon Schneider, Kiran Vodrahalli, Yifan Wu

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical connections between next-token prediction and adversarial regret minimization, showing that any distribution is exponentially close to a low-regret distribution for unbounded context windows, while bounded windows require specific distributional properties.

entry.title: Stable Reasoning, Unstable Responses: Mitigating LLM Deception via Stability Asymmetry

author.name: Guoxi Zhang, Jiawei Chen, Tianzhuo Yang, Lang Qin, Juntao Dai, Yaodong Yang, Jingwei Yi

entry.summary: Proposes detecting LLM deception via 'stability asymmetry': measuring whether a model's internal beliefs (CoT) are more stable than its external responses under perturbation. Grounded in cognitive psychology.

entry.title: Architecting Secure AI Agents: Perspectives on System-Level Defenses Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks

author.name: Chong Xiang, Drew Zagieboylo, Shaona Ghosh, Sanjay Kariyappa, Kai Greshake, Hanshen Xiao, Chaowei Xiao, G. Edward Suh

entry.summary: Position paper on system-level defenses against indirect prompt injection attacks in AI agents. Argues for dynamic replanning, constrained LLM security decisions, and human-in-the-loop for ambiguous cases.

entry.title: Squish and Release: Exposing Hidden Hallucinations by Making Them Surface as Safety Signals

author.name: Nathaniel Oh, Paul Attie

entry.summary: Introduces Squish and Release (S&R), an activation-patching method that detects hidden hallucinations by exploiting 'stability asymmetry' - deceptive LLMs maintain stable CoT beliefs while responses are fragile under perturbation.

entry.title: OccSim: Multi-kilometer Simulation with Long-horizon Occupancy World Models

author.name: Tianran Liu, Shengwen Zhao, Mozhgan Pourkeshavarz, Weican Li, Nicholas Rhinehart

entry.summary: OccSim introduces the first occupancy world model-driven 3D simulator for autonomous driving that doesn't require pre-recorded logs or HD maps. From a single initial frame and ego-actions, it generates 3,000+ continuous frames spanning 4+ km, representing an 80x improvement over prior methods.

entry.title: UnWeaving the knots of GraphRAG -- turns out VectorRAG is almost enough

author.name: Ryszard Tuora, Mateusz Gali\'nski, Micha{\l} Godziszewski, Micha{\l} Karpowicz, Mateusz Czy\.znikiewicz, Adam Kozakiewicz, Tomasz Zi\k{e}tkiewicz
