entry.summary: Conducts a controlled empirical study comparing diffusion and rectified flow objectives within the MotionGPT3 framework for text-driven motion generation. Tests whether advantages of rectified flow seen in image/audio transfer to motion.

entry.title: Neural Approximation of Generalized Voronoi Diagrams

author.name: Panagiotis Rigas, George Ioannakis, Ioannis Emiris

entry.summary: Introduces VoroFields, a hierarchical neural-field framework for approximating generalized Voronoi diagrams under arbitrary point-to-site distances. Uses continuous differentiable surrogate fields with hierarchical decomposition.

entry.title: On-Device Super Resolution Imaging Using Low-Cost SPAD Array and Embedded Lightweight Deep Learning

author.name: Zhenya Zang, Xingda Li, David Day Uei Li

entry.summary: Presents LiteSR, a lightweight super-resolution neural network for consumer-grade SPAD arrays with 48x32 resolution, reconstructing 256x256 images. Deployed on Arduino microcontroller for on-device inference.

entry.title: PeopleSearchBench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Evaluating AI-Powered People Search Platforms

author.name: Wei Wang, Tianyu Shi, Shuai Zhang, Boyang Xia, Zequn Xie, Chenyu Zeng, Qi Zhang, Lynn Ai, Yaqi Yu, Kaiming Zhang, Feiyue Tang

entry.summary: Introduces PeopleSearchBench, an open-source benchmark comparing AI-powered people search platforms across 119 queries with Criteria-Grounded Verification using live web search for factual relevance.

entry.title: Data is All You Need: Markov Chain Car-Following (MC-CF) Model

author.name: Sungyong Chung, Yanlin Zhang, Nachuan Li, Dana Monzer, Alireza Talebpour

entry.summary: Introduces Markov Chain Car-Following model representing state transitions as a Markov process with empirical acceleration distributions. Outperforms physics-based models on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset.

entry.title: Enhancing Box and Block Test with Computer Vision for Post-Stroke Upper Extremity Motor Evaluation

author.name: David Robinson, Animesh Gupta, Elizabeth Clark, Olga Melnik, Qiushi Fu, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Presents a computer vision framework for analyzing upper-extremity movement during the Box and Block Test for post-stroke motor evaluation, using joint angles without depth sensors.

entry.title: Multimodal Models Meet Presentation Attack Detection on ID Documents

author.name: Marina Villanueva, Juan M. Espin, Juan E. Tapia

entry.summary: Evaluates multimodal models (Paligemma, Llava, Qwen) for presentation attack detection on ID documents, finding that current models struggle with this task despite combining visual and textual modalities.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Federated Learning under Data Heterogeneity for Label-Scarce Diatom Classification

author.name: Mingkun Tan, Xilu Wang, Michael Kloster, Tim W. Nattkemper

entry.summary: Investigates self-supervised federated learning for diatom classification under stage-specific data heterogeneity, studying how different heterogeneity patterns in pre-training vs fine-tuning affect performance.

entry.title: NeuroBRIDGE: Behavior-Conditioned Koopman Dynamics with Riemannian Alignment for Early Substance Use Initiation Prediction from Longitudinal Functional Connectome

author.name: Badhan Mazumder, Sir-Lord Wiafe, Vince D. Calhoun, Dong Hye Ye

entry.summary: NeuroBRIDGE is a graph neural network framework that models longitudinal changes in brain functional connectivity using Riemannian geometry and Koopman dynamics to predict adolescent substance use initiation. It captures temporal brain network evolution conditioned on behavioral data and was evaluated on the ABCD dataset.

entry.title: STRADAViT: Towards a Foundational Model for Radio Astronomy through Self-Supervised Transfer

author.name: Andrea DeMarco, Ian Fenech Conti, Hayley Camilleri, Ardiana Bushi, Simone Riggi

entry.summary: STRADAViT is a self-supervised Vision Transformer framework for radio astronomy that uses continued pretraining on multi-survey radio data (MeerKAT, ASKAP, LOFAR, SKA) with radio-astronomy-aware augmentations for transferable image encoders.

entry.title: Bootstrap Perception Under Hardware Depth Failure for Indoor Robot Navigation

author.name: Nishant Pushparaju, Vivek Mattam, Aliasghar Arab

entry.summary: Presents a bootstrap perception system for indoor robots that handles depth sensor failure (78% pixel loss on reflective surfaces) by using surviving valid pixels to calibrate monocular depth estimation, creating a failure-aware sensing hierarchy.

entry.title: SuperGrasp: Single-View Object Grasping via Superquadric Similarity Matching, Evaluation, and Refinement

author.name: Lijingze Xiao, Jinhong Du, Yang Cong, Supeng Diao, Yu Ren

entry.summary: SuperGrasp is a two-stage framework for single-view robotic grasping that first generates grasp candidates via superquadric similarity matching, then evaluates and refines them using a learned evaluation-refinement network.

entry.title: Koopman Operator Framework for Modeling and Control of Off-Road Vehicle on Deformable Terrain

author.name: Kartik Loya, Phanindra Tallapragada

entry.summary: Develops a hybrid physics-informed and data-driven framework using Koopman operator methods to create linear representations of complex terramechanics for predictive control of off-road vehicles on deformable terrain.

entry.title: mlr3mbo: Bayesian Optimization in R

author.name: Marc Becker, Lennart Schneider, Martin Binder, Lars Kotthoff, Bernd Bischl

entry.summary: mlr3mbo is a comprehensive R toolbox for Bayesian optimization supporting single/multi-objective optimization, parallelization, and custom algorithm construction, with extensive empirical evaluation on the YAHPO Gym benchmark suite.

entry.title: Monday AI Radar #19

author.name: Against Moloch

entry.summary: Weekly AI safety and capabilities news roundup covering Boaz Barak's state-of-AI-safety assessment, Claude Code updates, and broader observations about the gap between lab preparedness and government readiness for AI risks.

entry.title: EarthEmbeddingExplorer: A Web Application for Cross-Modal Retrieval of Global Satellite Images

author.name: Yijie Zheng, Weijie Wu, Bingyue Wu, Long Zhao, Guoqing Li, Mikolaj Czerkawski, Konstantin Klemmer

entry.summary: EarthEmbeddingExplorer is a web application enabling cross-modal retrieval (text, visual, geolocation) of global satellite images using precomputed Earth embeddings, democratizing access to Earth observation foundation models.

entry.title: Reconfiguration of supernumerary robotic limbs for human augmentation

author.name: Mustafa Mete, Anastasia Bolotnikova, Alexander Schuessler, Jamie Paik

entry.summary: Introduces a reconfigurable supernumerary robotic limb (SRL) framework with quantitative analysis of human augmentation ratios, evaluating how SRL configuration shapes workspace extension and human-robot collaboration potential.

entry.title: iPoster: Content-Aware Layout Generation for Interactive Poster Design via Graph-Enhanced Diffusion Models

author.name: Xudong Zhou, Jinyuan Liang, Qiuyi Guo, Guozheng Li

entry.summary: iPoster enables interactive poster layout generation with user-specified constraints using a graph-enhanced diffusion architecture with masking strategies for constraint preservation.

entry.title: Multimodal Forecasting for Commodity Prices Using Spectrogram-Based and Time Series Representations

author.name: Soyeon Park, Doohee Chung, Charmgil Hong

entry.summary: Presents SEMF, combining wavelet spectrograms processed by Vision Transformers with temporal encoding of exogenous variables via cross-attention for commodity price forecasting.

entry.title: Taming the Instability: A Robust Second-Order Optimizer for Federated Learning over Non-IID Data

author.name: Yuanqiao Zhang, Tiantian He, Yuan Gao, Yixin Wang, Yew-Soon Ong, Maoguo Gong, A. K. Qin, Hui Li

entry.summary: FedRCO proposes a second-order optimization framework for federated learning with gradient anomaly monitoring, fail-safe resilience protocols, and approximate curvature optimization for non-IID data.

entry.title: Label-efficient Training Updates for Malware Detection over Time

author.name: Luca Minnei, Cristian Manca, Giorgio Piras, Angelo Sotgiu, Maura Pintor, Daniele Ghiani, Davide Maiorca, Giorgio Giacinto, Battista Biggio

entry.summary: Proposes a label-efficient framework for updating malware detectors over time by systematically evaluating active learning and semi-supervised learning strategies to handle distribution drift with reduced labeling costs.

entry.title: Multiverse: Language-Conditioned Multi-Game Level Blending via Shared Representation

author.name: In-Chang Baek, Jiyun Jung, Geum-Hwan Hwang, Sung-Hyun Kim, Kyung-Joong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes Multiverse, a language-conditioned multi-game level generator that enables cross-game level blending through textual specifications. Uses shared latent space with threshold-based multi-positive contrastive supervision.

entry.title: Beyond Freshness and Semantics: A Coupon-Collector Framework for Effective Status Updates

author.name: Youssef Ahmed, Arnob Ghosh, Chih-Chun Wang, Ness B. Shroff

entry.summary: Addresses status update scheduling over unreliable channels using a coupon-collector framework with expiring coupons. Proves optimal schedule is doubly thresholded and designs Structure-Aware Q-learning.

entry.title: Pan-Cancer Mapping of the Tumor Immune Landscape through Metagene Clustering and Predictive Modeling

author.name: Soham Chatterjee

entry.summary: Uses metagene clustering and predictive modeling to map the tumor immune landscape across pan-cancer types. Identifies novel immune-related gene clusters and evaluates their prognostic significance.

entry.title: Dual-Imbalance Continual Learning for Real-World Food Recognition

author.name: Xiaoyan Zhang, Jiangpeng He

entry.summary: Addresses dual imbalance in continual food recognition: long-tailed class distributions within tasks and varying numbers of new categories across incremental steps.

entry.title: Transmittance-Guided Structure-Texture Decomposition for Nighttime Image Dehazing

author.name: Jiangen He, Wanqi Zhang, Jessica K. Barfield

author.name: Nicolas Tricard, Zituo Chen, Sili Deng

author.name: Patryk Ni\.zeniec, Marcin Iwanowski, Marcin Gahbler

entry.title: Diffusion-Based Feature Denoising with NNMF for Robust handwritten digit multi-class classification

author.name: Hiba Adil Al-kharsan, R\'obert Rajk\'o

entry.summary: Combines diffusion-driven feature denoising with hybrid NNMF-CNN features for handwritten digit classification, claiming improved robustness to noise and adversarial attacks.

entry.title: Long-Reach Robotic Cleaning for Lunar Solar Arrays

author.name: Stanley Wang, Velin Kojouharov, Long Yin Chung, Daniel Morton, Mark Cutkosky

entry.summary: Proposes a small mobile robot with a deployable boom for cleaning lunar solar arrays to mitigate dust accumulation degradation, addressing a practical maintenance need for lunar surface infrastructure.

entry.title: Rethinking AI Literacy Education in Higher Education: Bridging Risk Perception and Responsible Adoption

author.name: Shasha Yu, Fiona Carroll, Barry L. Bentley

entry.summary: Analyzes how 139 technology students perceive AI risks, finding higher concern for concrete risks than abstract ones, an inverse relationship between perceived risk and adoption willingness, and gender differences.

entry.title: Optimizing Coverage and Difficulty in Reinforcement Learning for Quiz Composition

author.name: Ricardo Pedro Querido Andrade Silva, Nassim Bouarour, Dina Fettache, Sarab Boussouar, Noha Ibrahim, Sihem Amer-Yahia

entry.summary: Automates quiz composition using RL agents (DQN, SARSA, A2C/A3C) to select multiple choice questions meeting desired topic coverage and difficulty levels, with experiments on synthetic and real datasets.

entry.title: GPU-Accelerated Optimization of Transformer-Based Neural Networks for Real-Time Inference

author.name: Soutrik Mukherjee, Sangwhan Cha

entry.summary: Evaluates GPU-accelerated inference for BERT-base and GPT-2 using TensorRT with mixed-precision optimization, achieving up to 64.4x speedup over CPU with a hybrid precision strategy preserving numerical fidelity.

entry.title: AI Safety Manual

author.name: humanityfirst

entry.summary: An introductory guide to AI safety covering preferences, reward signals, mesa-optimization, deceptive alignment, interpretability, scalable oversight, and practical career advice for entering the field.

entry.title: Detecting the Unexpected: AI-Driven Anomaly Detection in Smart Bridge Monitoring

author.name: Rahul Jaiswal, Joakim Hellum, Halvor Heiberg

entry.summary: Applies AI-driven anomaly detection using density-based spatial clustering (DBSCAN) on real-time sensor data from bridge monitoring devices in Norway. Simple ML approach for infrastructure health monitoring.

entry.title: Retinal Malady Classification using AI: A novel ViT-SVM combination architecture

author.name: Shashwat Jha, Vishvaditya Luhach, Raju Poddar

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid Vision Transformer and SVM architecture (ViT-SVM) for classifying retinal diseases including macular holes, central serous retinopathy, and diabetic retinopathy from OCT scans.

entry.title: Movie Review: The AI Doc

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Review of 'The AI Doc' documentary, discussing how the filmmaker's journey from personal concern about AI to 'apocaloptimism' reflects broader public engagement with AI existential risk, while noting the film's Straussian messaging.

entry.title: 3D Architect: An Automated Approach to Three-Dimensional Modeling

author.name: Sunil Tiwari, Payal Fofadiya, Vicky Vishwakarma

entry.summary: Presents an approach to render 3D objects from orthographic views using Harris corner detection and computational geometry.

entry.title: Is Bayesianism Susceptible to the Mail-Order Prophet Scam?

author.name: Max Kaye

entry.summary: Explores whether Bayesian reasoning is susceptible to the 'mail-order prophet' scam where segmented mailing lists create an illusion of prophetic accuracy for a lucky subset of recipients. Discusses how Bayesian priors should handle such scenarios.

entry.title: Co-Found Lens Academy With Me. (We have early users and funding)

author.name: Luc Brinkman

entry.summary: A co-founder recruitment post for Lens Academy, an AI safety education platform using 1-on-1 AI tutoring focused on existential risk from superintelligence, operating at under $10 per student with automated operations.

entry.title: Slack in Cells, Slack in Brains

author.name: Mateusz Bagiński

entry.summary: Argues that maintaining 'slack' (reserve capacity) is essential for effective agency, drawing parallels between biological systems (cells maintaining excess capacity) and human cognitive/organizational effectiveness. Warns against myopic optimization that sacrifices slack.

entry.title: Experiments With Opus 4.6's Fiction

author.name: Tomás B.

entry.summary: Author experiments with Opus 4.6's fiction-writing capabilities by feeding it their own stories and asking it to generate new ones, reporting significant improvement over Sonnet 4.5's earlier output.

entry.title: Forecasting Walkthrough with Metaculus pro ExMateriae

author.name: Vojtech Brynych

entry.summary: Announcement of an online event where a top Metaculus forecaster will walk through their reasoning process on a forecasting question step-by-step.

entry.title: Schr\"odinger's Seed: Purr-fect Initialization for an Impurr-fect Universe

author.name: Mi chen, Renhao Ye

entry.summary: A satirical/joke paper proposing that cats are better suited for random seed selection in deep learning than arbitrary integers, constructing a cat-driven seed generator inspired by the Friedmann equation and testing it by mapping domestic cats' physical properties.

entry.title: Forecasting Dojo Meetup - postmortem discussion.

author.name: Vojtech Brynych

entry.summary: Announcement of a forecasting practice group meetup for reviewing past forecasts and analyzing hits and misses.

entry.title: D&D.Sci Release Day: Topple the Tower Analysis & Ruleset

author.name: aphyer

entry.summary: This is the solution reveal and ruleset explanation for a 'D&D.Sci' puzzle on LessWrong, where participants analyze a synthetic dataset to make optimal decisions in a tabletop-RPG-inspired scenario involving climbing a tower. The post details the mechanics (class power scaling, enemy encounters, dice rolls) that generated the data participants had to reverse-engineer.
